title: Adversarial Images Hijack Web Agents from Visual Grounding to Browser Execution
summary: Modern web agents built on large vision-language models process webpages, select relevant UI elements, and translate model outputs into browser actions. Existing visual red-teaming approaches use adversarial visual content to manipulate this process. However, they primarily target model inference and do not explicitly account for structured input processing or action post-processing. Consequently, model-level success does not establish control over browser execution and cannot reliably characterize end-to-end agent robustness. To address this gap, we formulate red teaming for vision-grounded web agents as an end-to-end grounding-to-execution problem, and introduce WebMirage, a framework that crafts localized visual perturbations that cause agents to select attacker-controlled content and execute the corresponding browser action across varying webpage renderings. It uses a role-slot abstraction and webpage recomposition to capture competition among webpage elements, and dataflow analysis to align optimization with action post-processing. We evaluate WebMirage across four agent configurations and six VLM backbones on 2,250 tasks covering 13 public websites and a sandbox benchmark. WebMirage achieves an average attack success rate of 91.9%, compared with 17.4% for the strongest baseline, and remains effective against three agent-level defenses.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WebMirage框架，将视觉-Web代理的红队测试形式化为端到端"grounding-to-execution"问题，通过对网页元素进行局部视觉扰动，使代理选择攻击者控制的内容并执行相应浏览器动作。在4种代理配置、6个VLM骨干、2250个任务上平均攻击成功率达91.9%，远超最强基线17.4%，并对3种代理级防御仍有效。
AI.motivation: 现有针对视觉-Web代理的对抗性红队方法主要针对模型推理阶段，未显式考虑结构化输入处理与动作后处理环节。因此模型层面的攻击成功无法保证对浏览器实际执行的控制，无法可靠刻画代理的端到端鲁棒性，存在明显研究缺口。
AI.method: 提出WebMirage框架，构造局部化视觉扰动，诱导代理选择攻击者控制的内容并执行对应浏览器动作。方法采用角色-槽位(role-slot)抽象与网页重组来刻画网页元素间的竞争关系，并使用数据流分析将优化与动作后处理对齐，实现与动作执行一致的扰动优化。
AI.result: 在4种代理配置、6个VLM骨干上，覆盖13个公开网站及一个沙箱基准的2250个任务进行评测。WebMirage平均攻击成功率为91.9%，而最强基线仅为17.4%；同时对3种代理级防御仍保持有效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明仅评估模型推理不足以衡量视觉-Web代理的端到端鲁棒性，需从grounding到execution整体建模。WebMirage证明端到端视觉红队攻击具有高成功率与防御鲁棒性，揭示了当前代理系统在结构化输入处理与动作后处理环节的安全脆弱性。

title: Pooling Representation Autoencoders for Efficient Diffusion
summary: Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) generate images from pre-trained visual fea- tures, but their dense token grids make generative modeling expensive. Motivated by local feature correlations, we introduce PoolDINO, a learned affine pooling operator that merges neighboring tokens. Training the pooling operator jointly with the RGB decoder preserves the standard two-stage RAE procedure without a separate feature auto-encoder. On ImageNet-256, 4x token compression retains comparable generation quality under internal guidance, while 16x compression trades some quality for greater efficiency. At a fixed budget of 100 sampling steps, latent-sampling throughput increases by 3.7x and 9.0x, respectively, relative to the unpooled baseline. Classification and dense prediction evaluations show that comparable guided generation quality can coexist with weaker performance on other tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出PoolDINO——一种可学习的仿射池化算子，通过合并相邻token压缩RAE的密集token网格，在保持两阶段流程的前提下显著提升采样效率。
AI.motivation: RAE从预训练视觉特征生成图像，但其密集token网格导致生成建模代价高昂；动机源于局部特征之间的相关性，希望借此合并邻近token以降低计算开销。
AI.method: PoolDINO为可学习的仿射池化算子，合并相邻token；将其与RGB解码器联合训练，从而保留标准两阶段RAE流程，无需单独的特征自编码器。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256上，4倍token压缩在内部引导下生成质量相当；16倍压缩以部分质量换取更高效率。固定100步采样预算下，潜变量采样吞吐分别提升3.7倍和9.0倍（相对未池化基线）。分类与稠密预测评估显示，相当的引导生成质量可能与其它任务上的较弱性能并存。
AI.conclusion: 仿射池化可在不改变RAE两阶段范式的条件下有效压缩token网格并大幅提升采样吞吐，但压缩带来的效率收益与其他任务性能之间存在权衡。

title: Adaptive Visual Token Reduction for Accelerated Image Understanding
summary: Large Vision-Language Models achieve strong VQA performance, but processing high-resolution, information-rich images requires substantial computation, motivating visual token reduction. However, existing methods often prune individual tokens or rely on fixed-size cropping, limiting their ability to preserve spatially structured information such as horizontally or vertically elongated text. To address this limitation, we propose ReFIT, an instruction-guided visual token reduction framework for efficient LVLM inference. ReFIT consists of Relevance-Guided Window Reshaping (RWR) and Instruction-Guided Token Refinement (ITR), where RWR captures instruction-relevant regions by adapting to their spatial characteristics, while ITR further removes unnecessary visual tokens. Experiments on four VQA benchmarks demonstrate that ReFIT improves answer accuracy while reducing computational cost, and qualitative results demonstrate its effectiveness in localizing relevant regions and removing unnecessary visual information.

AI.tldr: ReFIT：面向LVLM高效推理的指令引导视觉token压缩框架，通过相关性引导窗口重塑与指令引导token精炼，在降低计算量的同时提升VQA准确率。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型虽在VQA任务上表现优异，但处理高分辨率、信息丰富的图像需大量计算，因此需要视觉token压缩。现有方法多采用独立token剪枝或固定尺寸裁剪，难以保留水平或垂直延展文本等具有空间结构的信息。
AI.method: 提出ReFIT，包含两个模块：（1）Relevance-Guided Window Reshaping（RWR），通过自适应匹配指令相关区域的空间特征来捕获这些区域；（2）Instruction-Guided Token Refinement（ITR），进一步剔除冗余视觉token。
AI.result: 在四个VQA基准上的实验表明，ReFIT在降低计算成本的同时提升了答案准确率；定性结果验证了其在定位相关区域与移除无关视觉信息方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ReFIT通过指令引导的空间自适应窗口重塑与token精炼，克服了固定裁剪与独立剪枝的局限，实现了精度与效率的兼顾，为高效LVLM推理提供了有效方案。

title: PhyDiCT: Plug-and-Play CT Reconstruction from Sparse X-Rays via Differentiable Rendering and Strong Priors
comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026; to appear in LNCS 16888
summary: Reconstructing 3D Computed Tomography (CT) images from a few X-ray projections is a highly ill-posed inverse problem due to the loss of volumetric information. We propose PhyDiCT, a training-free framework that integrates a differentiable Physics-based forward model, grounded in the Beer-Lambert law, with a text-conditioned Diffusion as a strong prior to reconstruct 3D lung CT images. We refer to our approach as training-free since the prior model is used without fine-tuning, and our goal is to steer the denoising procedure to generate samples consistent with X-ray observations. We guide the diffusion generation using Split Gibbs sampling to jointly optimize for projection fidelity (reward) and consistency with prior knowledge. Also, we introduce a test-time refinement step that enhances image realism and anatomical coherence. We extensively evaluate our method on publicly available 3D CT datasets using both perceptual and semantic metrics, demonstrating that it surpasses existing plug-and-play diffusion and fully trained reconstruction approaches. Our findings highlight that combining a strong generative prior with the underlying physics of image formation substantially improves reconstruction quality, e.g., 7.5\% improvement on SSIM compared to full training methods. Code will be released at https://github.com/batmanlab/PhyDiCT.

AI.tldr: PhyDiCT是一个免训练框架，结合基于Beer-Lambert定律的可微物理前向模型与文本条件扩散先验，通过Split Gibbs采样引导去噪过程，从少量X射线投影重建3D肺部CT图像，并优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 从少量X射线投影重建3D CT图像因体信息丢失而高度病态。作者希望利用强生成先验与成像物理模型的结合来提升重建质量。
AI.method: 提出PhyDiCT免训练框架：将基于Beer-Lambert定律的可微物理前向模型与文本条件扩散先验结合；使用Split Gibbs采样同时优化投影保真度（奖励）与先验一致性；并引入测试时细化步骤增强图像真实感与解剖连贯性。先验模型无需微调。
AI.result: 在公开3D CT数据集上用感知与语义指标评估，方法超越现有即插即用扩散方法和全训练重建方法，例如相比全训练方法SSIM提升7.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将强生成先验与图像形成的底层物理相结合能显著提升重建质量。

title: Hardware-aware Calibrated Clustered Attention for Efficient Visual Geometric Transformers
summary: The Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) marks a significant leap forward in 3D scene reconstruction, as it is the first model that directly infers all key 3D attributes (camera poses, depths, and dense geometry) jointly in one pass. However, this joint inference mechanism requires global attention layers with extremely long sequences that causes a significant latency bottleneck. In this paper, we propose blockwise clustered attention (BC attention) to accelerate the global attention layers in VGGT. By limiting the clustering within HW-friendly neighborhood blocks, BC attention reduces the computation overhead of query clustering as well as the costly data movement between on- and off-chip memory. This enables BC attention to scale to long sequences and deliver practical latency improvements on GPUs. Moreover, we introduce a hashing hyperplane calibration method and a threshold-based error compensation method to reduce clustering errors efficiently, which is a bottleneck in the current clustered attention mechanism. Overall, our experiments on GPU demonstrate that calibrated BC attention accelerates the global attention layers by 2.10-2.63$\times$ and the whole backbone by 1.77-2.35$\times$ with negligible loss (1%) for large scenes. With a small performance loss (< 5%), calibrated BC attention further achieves a 2.26-2.87$\times$ latency improvement on the global attention layers and a 1.90-2.55$\times$ improvement on the backbone.

AI.tldr: 提出分块聚类注意力（BC attention）加速VGGT全局注意力层，并辅以哈希超平面校准与阈值误差补偿，在可忽略精度损失下显著降低延迟。
AI.motivation: VGGT首次实现单次前向联合推断相机位姿、深度与稠密几何，但其联合推断依赖超长序列的全局注意力层，成为严重延迟瓶颈；现有聚类注意力存在聚类开销大、片上/片外数据搬移昂贵以及聚类误差等问题。
AI.method: 将聚类限制在HW友好的邻域块内（blockwise clustered attention），降低查询聚类计算量与数据搬移；并引入哈希超平面校准方法与基于阈值的误差补偿方法，高效降低聚类误差。
AI.result: GPU实验显示，校准后的BC attention将全局注意力层加速2.10-2.63倍、整体骨干加速1.77-2.35倍，大场景精度损失约1%；在精度损失<5%时，全局注意力层加速2.26-2.87倍、骨干加速1.90-2.55倍。
AI.conclusion: BC attention通过邻域块聚类与校准/误差补偿机制，使聚类注意力可扩展至长序列并在GPU上获得实际延迟收益，在几乎无损精度下有效缓解VGGT的性能瓶颈。

title: EM-SNN: Efficiently Modulated Spiking Neural Network for Remote Sensing Image Dehazing
summary: Although spiking neural networks (SNNs) provide an energy-efficient alternative to artificial neural networks (ANNs), their application to remote sensing image dehazing remains limited. A key challenge arises from the coupling between haze-induced high-frequency attenuation and discrete spike thresholding. This interaction suppresses weak responses and fundamentally limits the recovery of edges, textures, and fine details in spiking dehazing models. To address this challenge, we propose the Efficiently Modulated Spiking Neural Network (EM-SNN), a dedicated spiking framework tailored to remote sensing image dehazing. EM-SNN integrates a statistics-driven Threshold-Modulated Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (TM-LIF) neuron to adaptively compensate for haze-induced contrast compression, together with a Spike Sobel Modulation (SSM) module that enhances structural cues and reduces depth-wise attenuation during spiking feature propagation. By jointly modulating activation scales and structural representations, EM-SNN improves dehazing performance while preserving the inherent event-driven sparsity of SNNs. Experiments on HRSD, RICE, RRSHID, and SateHaze1K demonstrate that EM-SNN achieves competitive dehazing performance while consuming only one quarter of the energy of the strong ANN baseline SFRDP-Net.

AI.tldr: 提出EM-SNN脉冲神经网络遥感图像去雾框架，通过TM-LIF神经元与SSM模块联合调控激活尺度与结构表示，在四个数据集上以约四分之一能耗达到竞争性去雾性能。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）虽比人工神经网络（ANN）更节能，但在遥感图像去雾中应用有限。核心难点在于雾霾引起的高频衰减与离散脉冲阈值化之间的耦合：该耦合会抑制弱响应，从根本上限制脉冲去雾模型对边缘、纹理和细节的恢复能力。
AI.method: 提出高效调制脉冲神经网络（EM-SNN）。其一，设计统计驱动的阈值调制漏积分放电神经元（TM-LIF），自适应补偿雾霾导致的对比度压缩；其二，设计脉冲Sobel调制模块（SSM），增强结构线索并减轻脉冲特征传播中的深度方向衰减。二者联合调制激活尺度与结构表示，同时保持SNN事件驱动的稀疏性。
AI.result: 在HRSD、RICE、RRSHID和SateHaze1K四个数据集上的实验表明，EM-SNN取得具有竞争力的去雾性能，同时能耗仅为强ANN基线SFRDP-Net的四分之一。
AI.conclusion: 通过阈值调制与结构调制的协同设计，EM-SNN有效缓解了雾霾高频衰减与脉冲阈值化的耦合问题，在保持脉冲稀疏性与低能耗优势的同时实现了有竞争力的遥感图像去雾效果。

title: LeCuration: A Tiny World Model as a Data Curation Multi-Tool
summary: Many applications of physical AI run within finite or closed physical worlds with a limited set of physical laws governing object behavior. Examples include robots working in a warehouse and agents moving around in a video game. In order to better organize, filter, and curate data for physical AI applications, we propose a new approach centered on the unique settings and physical laws of individual datasets. We train LeCuration, a small world model intended to serve as a data curation tool for a separate, larger downstream model. To build this model, we choose LeWorldModel (LeWM)as our latent encoder and predictor, adding a diffusion transformer (DiT) decoder to add visuals to autoregressive gameplay rollout. We find that the embeddings of this model can be used as an anomaly detection signal and as a content-based clustering heuristic, and that auto-regressively predicting the game state with this model allows us to qualitatively check for action-state consistency. This paper presents a qualitative, proof-of-concept case study on CS:GO gameplay data; we do not yet report quantitative curation metrics or downstream training results, which we identify as the key next step.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以数据集的独特物理法则为中心的物理AI数据整理方法，训练小型世界模型LeCuration，用于为下游大模型筛选数据，并在CS:GO游戏数据上做定性验证。
AI.motivation: 物理AI多运行于有限或封闭的物理世界（如仓库机器人、电子游戏智能体），其数据整理需要结合各自世界与物理规则，现有通用方法难以适配这种独特设定。
AI.method: 以LeWorldModel作为潜在编码器与预测器，并加入扩散Transformer（DiT）解码器，为自回归游戏 rollout 生成视觉画面，从而构建小型世界模型LeCuration。
AI.result: 该模型嵌入可用于异常检测信号与基于内容的聚类启发式；自回归预测游戏状态可定性检查动作-状态一致性。
AI.conclusion: 本文是基于CS:GO游戏数据的定性概念验证案例研究，尚未报告量化整理指标或下游训练结果，这被列为关键的下一步工作。

title: FaceKit: a Toolkit for Interpretable Facial Phenotyping, Synthetic Image Generation and Privacy Analysis in Rare Diseases
summary: Many rare genetic diseases are associated with recognizable craniofacial features. However, traditional approaches for describing facial morphology rely largely on qualitative clinical observation and free-text descriptions, which are often subjective, non-standardized, and difficult to reproduce across observers and institutions. Although the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) provides controlled terms for describing facial features, these terms are typically categorical rather than quantitative and may vary depending on examiner experience and interpretation. Here, we present FaceKit, a computational framework for quantitative facial phenotyping from frontal facial photographs. FaceKit extracts standardized measurements of facial landmarks and derived 120 morphological features, then reports feature-level z-scores representing deviation from population reference distributions. The reference distributions are built from the FairFace dataset spanning diverse ancestral groups. We evaluated FaceKit on a curated subset of the GestaltMatcher Database covering 50 rare-disease cohorts. In addition to quantitative facial analysis, FaceKit includes synthetic facial image generation to support rare disease model development and data augmentation. We also performed privacy evaluation to assess whether synthetic images reveal identifiable information from real patient photographs and could compromise patient privacy. Across disease case studies, FaceKit-derived quantitative measurements captured known facial features associated with rare genetic disorders and provided objective support for clinical phenotyping. Together, these results establish FaceKit as a useful tool for quantitative phenotyping, and has the potential to improve rare disease diagnosis, support genotype-phenotype studies, and enable more reproducible clinical characterization across diverse patient populations.

AI.tldr: FaceKit是一个从正面人脸照片中提取定量面部表型特征的计算框架，输出基于人群参考分布的z-score，并在50个罕见病队列及合成图像隐私评估中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 罕见遗传病常伴随可识别的颅面特征，但传统面部形态描述依赖定性临床观察与自由文本，主观、非标准化、难以在不同观察者和机构间复现。HPO虽提供受控术语，但多为分类型而非定量，受检查者经验与解读影响。
AI.method: FaceKit从正面人脸照片中提取标准化面部关键点测量值并派生120个形态特征，输出特征级z-score以表示相对人群参考分布的偏离程度；参考分布基于覆盖多样祖源群体的FairFace数据集构建。在GestaltMatcher数据库中精选的50个罕见病队列子集上评估，并包含合成人脸图像生成功能以支持罕见病模型开发与数据增强，同时开展隐私评估，检验合成图像是否泄露真实患者可识别信息。
AI.result: 在多个疾病案例研究中，FaceKit的定量测量能捕捉到与罕见遗传病相关的已知面部特征，并为临床表型分析提供客观支持；同时完成了合成图像的隐私风险评估。
AI.conclusion: FaceKit可作为定量表型分析的有用工具，有望改善罕见病诊断、支持基因型-表型研究，并在多样患者群体中实现更可复现的临床特征刻画。

title: emg2face: Expressive Facial Animation with High-Density Surface EMG
summary: Facial movements convey subtle and important information that is critical for human social communication. Optical methods for face capture are difficult or impossible to use when the face is occluded by head-mounted devices (HMDs), such as VR headsets. Even with a clear line of sight, such methods raise privacy concerns and require head-mounted capture rigs that offset cameras and lighting from the face. We show that high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG) provides a viable non-optical alternative that addresses these challenges. We measured 64 EMG channels, using two textile EMG grids, with 32 from the forehead (typically occluded by an HMD) and 32 from the side of the face. EMG data were digitized at 2048 Hz and filtered. Facial movements were simultaneously recorded and used to estimate 478 3D facial landmarks using MediaPipe's Face Landmarker. A major challenge in such multimodal recordings is synchronizing EMG and video data, which have different sampling frequencies and independent clocks. We developed a novel synchronization method using analog audio bursts that is capable of sub-millisecond synchronization. We also developed a staged fitting method that fits a recent high-resolution parametric head model (GNM), with 253 identity blendshapes and 383 expression blendshapes, to the MediaPipe landmarks as participants performed different facial expressions. We trained a deep neural network comprising per-grid spatial encoders followed by a dilated temporal convolutional network (TCN) to predict blendshape parameters from HD-sEMG signals at 100 Hz. Once trained, the network can predict expression blendshapes solely from HD-sEMG recordings. The output can be rendered using standard real-time blendshape animation methods. We demonstrate the methods using recordings from 25 participants, and direct expression transfer to a variety of human faces and non-human characters.

AI.tldr: 提出使用高密度表面肌电（HD-sEMG）作为非光学替代方案进行面部动作捕捉，并结合音频脉冲亚毫秒同步与分阶段拟合高分辨率参数化头模型GNM，训练空间编码器+膨胀时序卷积网络从肌电信号以100Hz预测表情blendshape，实现25名受试者的表情迁移。
AI.motivation: 头戴设备（如VR头显）会遮挡面部，光学捕捉方法难以或无法使用；即便视线通畅，光学方法也存在隐私问题，且需要将相机与照明从面部偏移的头戴式采集装置。因此需要一种非光学、可应对遮挡与隐私挑战的面部捕捉替代方案。
AI.method: 使用两片织物EMG网格采集64通道肌电信号（前额32通道，常被HMD遮挡；面部侧面32通道），以2048Hz数字化并滤波；同步用MediaPipe Face Landmarker估计478个3D面部关键点。针对EMG与视频采样频率不同、时钟独立的问题，开发基于模拟音频脉冲的同步方法，实现亚毫秒级同步。开发分阶段拟合方法，将含253个身份blendshape和383个表情blendshape的高分辨率参数化头模型GNM拟合到MediaPipe关键点。训练深度神经网络：每网格空间编码器 + 膨胀时序卷积网络（TCN），以100Hz从HD-sEMG预测blendshape参数。
AI.result: 训练后的网络可仅凭HD-sEMG记录预测表情blendshape，输出可用标准实时blendshape动画方法渲染。在25名参与者的记录上验证了方法，并实现表情直接迁移到多种人脸和非人类角色。
AI.conclusion: HD-sEMG提供了一种可行的非光学面部捕捉替代方案，可解决HMD遮挡和隐私问题；配合亚毫秒同步与GNM分阶段拟合，实现了从肌电直接预测表情blendshape并迁移至多种角色。

title: Kuration SDK: Addressing the Virtual2Real Gap via Data Curation
summary: Benchmarks for measuring the quality of action-conditioned world models are still evolving and shifting away from visual similarity-based metrics to action-semantic and physically-grounded metrics. However, for domain and task-agnostic action-conditioned world model training, existing benchmarks provide a limited signal. By training and evaluating diffusion world models on CounterStrike gameplay data, we confirm that qualitative playability does not correspond with metrics such as FVD, LPIPS, and JEDi. We term this the Virtual2Real gap. We posit that, in lieu of reliable benchmarks, curating raw gameplay data and measuring a variety of diagnostic properties provides a more robust signal to bridge the gap, before the training even begins. We present several curation strategies and a general-purpose kit for physical AI data curation called Kuration SDK, which is being open-sourced with this paper. The SDK was instrumental in uncovering the root cause of the virtual2real gap in a specific case: why two world models trained on identical gameplay map, action and state distribution, behaved very differently when played in spite of having very similar LPIPS and FVD scores. Thus, Kuration SDK has the potential to uncover the root causes of Virtual2Real gap in specific datasets and accelerate development of sample-efficient training datasets.

AI.tldr: 论文指出动作条件世界模型现有基准（FVD、LPIPS、JEDi）无法反映实际可玩性，提出"Virtual2Real gap"概念，并开源数据治理工具包 Kuration SDK，通过策展原始游戏数据与多诊断属性测量来弥合该差距。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件世界模型基准正从视觉相似度指标转向动作语义与物理落地指标，但对领域与任务无关的训练而言信号有限；作者怀疑视觉指标高分并不等于实际可玩，需验证该假设并寻找更可靠的信号来源。
AI.method: 在 CounterStrike 游戏数据上训练并评估扩散世界模型，对比定性可玩性与 FVD、LPIPS、JEDi 等指标；提出多种数据策展策略，并开发通用物理 AI 数据策展工具包 Kuration SDK。
AI.result: 实验确认定性可玩性与 FVD、LPIPS、JEDi 不相关，即存在 Virtual2Real gap；Kuration SDK 成功定位了一个具体案例的根因——两个在相同地图、动作与状态分布上训练的模型，尽管 LPIPS 与 FVD 相近，实际游玩表现却差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 在缺乏可靠基准的情况下，策展原始游戏数据并测量多种诊断属性，能在训练开始前提供更稳健的信号；Kuration SDK 有潜力揭示特定数据集中 Virtual2Real gap 的根因，并加速样本高效训练数据集的开发。

title: Why VLMs Miss Small Objects, and When Zooming In Is Safe
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often miss small objects in large images. We ask three questions: what limits them, which of these limits better models can remove, and whether the classical way of handling large images, local decomposition, still has a future. We answer them with a theory built on two quantities of the image interface: S, the number of visual tokens across an object's side, and L, the content a call must cover. The limits: a W x H image sent whole within N tokens gives an object of side m at most m*sqrt(N/(WH)) tokens per side. Doubling the token budget N therefore raises the largest S a whole image can reach by only 41%, and seeing an image at the S an object needs costs at least order S^2 tokens whatever the model. If recognition improves gradually with S, any search strategy, zoom agents included, obeys a recall-cost frontier. What better models can change: the S an object needs and how much one call can carry, measured in bits per object found; the coverage cost remains. Decomposition: yes. Assuming only that more tokens per object and less content per call do not hurt on average, splitting an image cannot lower recall if no view zooms out relative to the whole image and views overlap by one object. Neither part of this condition can be dropped; we bound the cost of every such decomposition, and a simple rule approaches the bound as the image grows. We test the theory in about 177,000 requests on 797 images. On controlled images, none of 40 orderings predicted for 8 VLMs is violated. Checked after the fact on drawings, floor plans, natural and synthetic images, 61 of 89 implied orderings hold significantly and 4 fail, all for OpenAI models given more pixels than their default path. On construction drawings the rule never significantly lowered recall relative to the whole image and raised it by up to 0.28. Code and data: https://github.com/shijunzhe/vlm-small-objects

AI.tldr: 本文提出关于视觉语言模型（VLM）小目标识别的理论，以对象每边视觉token数S和单次调用需覆盖内容L两个量刻画图像接口限制，证明整图送模的token效率瓶颈、S^2级代价与召回-成本前沿，并证明在局部不缩小视野且重叠一个对象的条件下图像分解不会降低召回；在约17.7万次请求、797张图像上验证了预测的顺序关系。
AI.motivation: VLM在大图中常漏检小目标。作者试图回答三个问题：限制小目标识别的因素是什么、哪些限制可由更强的模型消除、以及经典的大图处理方式（局部拆解）是否仍有前景。
AI.method: 构建以图像接口两个量为基础的理论：S（对象一侧跨越的视觉token数）和L（一次调用必须覆盖的内容）。分析整图在N个token下对象的S上限、达到所需S的最小token代价，以及随S的识别提升所导致的召回-成本前沿。进一步在"更多对象token与更少单次调用内容平均无害"假设下，推导图像拆解不降低召回的条件（无视野相对整图缩小、视图间重叠一个对象），并给出分解成本界与趋近该界的规则。实验上在797张图像上进行约177,000次请求，对8个VLM检验40个预测顺序，并在图纸、平面图、自然与合成图像上事后检验89个蕴含顺序。
AI.result: W×H图像在N个token内整图发送时，边长m的对象每边最多有m·sqrt(N/(WH))个token；token预算N翻倍仅使整图可达的最大S提高约41%，而以对象所需S观察图像至少需要S^2量级token，且任何搜索策略（含缩放代理）都服从召回-成本前沿。可控图像上8个VLM的40个预测顺序无一被违反；事后检验中89个蕴含顺序有61个显著成立、4个失败（均为OpenAI模型在给定超过默认路径像素时）。在建筑图纸上，所提规则相对整图从未显著降低召回，最高提升0.28。
AI.conclusion: 理论上界定了VLM小目标识别的token效率瓶颈与分解可行性条件，实证结果表明局部拆解在满足条件时具有前景，且所提简单规则在建筑图纸上可显著提升召回而不损害整图基线。代码与数据已公开。

title: SAREO-FM: Decoupled Semantic Supervision for SAR-EO Foundation Models
comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/SAREO-FM_site/
summary: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and electro-optical (EO) imagery provide complementary observations: SAR enables day-and-night, weather-resilient sensing, whereas EO provides rich appearance and fine-grained semantic cues. We introduce SAREO-FM, which avoids forcing a single token stream to serve two distinct roles: modality tokens preserve how each sensor observes the scene through masked reconstruction, while learnable semantic queries capture what the scene contains under guidance from a pretrained vision foundation model (VFM). By jointly encoding these queries with SAR and EO tokens, the queries acquire modality-grounded semantic context, while the modality-token outputs remain the explicit targets of masked reconstruction. This design assigns semantic and reconstruction supervision to separate token streams while preserving their interaction within the shared encoder. Pretrained on the million-scale SAR-1M corpus, SAREO-FM achieves strong unimodal transfer for both SAR-only and EO-only inputs, while delivering substantial gains from joint SAR--EO observations on tasks that benefit from complementary sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAREO-FM，一种面向SAR与EO遥感图像的联合预训练基础模型。它通过将"模态令牌"（负责掩码重建）与"可学习语义查询"（负责语义提取，受预训练视觉基础模型指导）分离到不同令牌流，实现语义与重建监督的解耦，同时保留共享编码器内的交互。在百万级SAR-1M语料上预训练后，模型在单模态（SAR/EO）迁移和SAR-EO联合观测任务上均取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: SAR与EO影像具有互补性：SAR可全天时、全天候成像，EO提供丰富的表观与细粒度语义信息。然而现有方法往往强迫单一令牌流同时承担两种角色（模态观测的重建 与 语义信息提取），造成监督信号冲突，难以兼顾模态特异性重建与高层语义学习。因此需要一种能解耦语义与重建监督、同时保持跨模态交互的预训练框架。
AI.method: 提出SAREO-FM。核心设计是将两类令牌流分离：（1）模态令牌通过掩码重建保留各传感器对场景的观测方式；（2）可学习语义查询在预训练视觉基础模型（VFM）指导下捕获场景语义内容。语义查询与SAR、EO令牌在共享编码器中联合编码，使查询获得模态感知的语义上下文，而模态令牌输出仍作为掩码重建的显式目标。该设计将语义监督与重建监督分配给不同令牌流，同时保留其在共享编码器内的交互。模型在百万级SAR-1M语料上进行预训练。
AI.result: 在SAR-1M百万级语料预训练后，SAREO-FM在SAR单模态与EO单模态输入上均实现较强的单模态迁移性能；在受益于互补感知的任务上，SAR-EO联合观测相比单模态带来显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: SAREO-FM通过将语义监督与重建监督解耦到独立令牌流、同时保持共享编码器内的跨模态交互，为SAR-EO互补遥感预训练提供了有效范式，兼具单模态迁移能力与联合观测增益。

title: Dialect-Robust Speech Language Models with Synthetic Pseudo-Dialect Augmentation
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026
summary: Speech Language Model (SLM) performance often degrades on dialects due to data scarcity. Conventional text-to-speech (TTS) augmentation struggles to cover diverse dialects as it requires a certain amount of real dialect speech. We propose synthesizing pseudo-dialect speech by converting LLM-generated dialect text via a standard-language TTS model, requiring zero real dialect speech. Additionally, we introduce intermediate standard-text prediction during training, acting as semantic normalization for downstream tasks. We evaluate dialect understanding via dialect-to-English speech translation across Japanese, German, and Chinese dialects. Compared to synthetic standard speech baselines, pseudo-dialect augmentation improves scores for Japanese (from 25.38 to 26.24) and German (from 31.57 to 32.47). Furthermore, the intermediate standard-text prediction effectively bridges the semantic gap, boosting performance to 28.26 for Japanese and from 11.67 to 16.37 for Chinese. These results suggest that our approach scales to various languages without requiring speech resources specific to each dialect.

AI.tldr: 提出零真实方言语音的伪方言语音合成方法，用LLM生成方言文本经标准语TTS转为伪方言语音，并引入中间标准文本预测作语义归一化，在日、德、中方言语音翻译任务上均取得提升。
AI.motivation: 语音语言模型在方言上性能下降，根源是方言数据稀缺；传统TTS数据增强仍需一定量真实方言语音，难以覆盖多样方言。因此需要一种不依赖真实方言语音的可扩展方案。
AI.method: 1) 伪方言语音合成：由LLM生成方言文本，再通过标准语TTS模型转换，实现零真实方言语音的数据增强；2) 训练时引入中间标准文本预测，充当语义归一化，桥接方言与标准语之间的语义差距。评测任务为方言到英语的语音翻译，覆盖日语、德语、中文方言。
AI.result: 相比合成标准语音基线，伪方言增强使日语由25.38提升至26.24，德语由31.57提升至32.47；中间标准文本预测进一步桥接语义差距，日语提升至28.26，中文由11.67提升至16.37。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需各方言特定的语音资源，即可有效提升方言理解性能，表明其可扩展至多种语言。

title: VIS-Ground: Video Interactive Storytelling with Contextual Grounding
summary: Video interactive storytelling enables viewers to actively steer how a video unfolds. However, once we allow viewers to intervene during generation, a new challenge arises: The viewer's request can have latent dependencies on both the grounding source and the current rendered video state. These dependencies may not be explicitly stated in any individual input, but emerge only when the source, rendered history, and new viewer intent are considered jointly. Existing interactive video generation systems primarily emphasize following viewer instructions, while source-grounded video generation methods focus on aligning generated content with an external narrative or knowledge source. This leaves a fundamental question underexplored: What context should a generation model ground on during interactive continuation, and how can heterogeneous, unstructured inputs be transformed into such grounding context? In this work, we formulate contextual grounding as the process of transforming heterogeneous input context into an executable constraint model for video generation. To address this challenge, we introduce VIS-Ground, which performs Structured Context Abstraction to recover grounded states and cross-context dependencies, Generation Constraints Induction to project relevant dependencies into candidate-specific constraints, and Constrained Video Generation to enforce these constraints through planning, verification, revision, and rendering. Across three video generation backbones, VIS-Ground consistently achieves the highest overall composite score, reaching an average absolute improvement of 10.3 points over the strongest per-backbone baselines. Detailed analysis further shows gains across both narrative and knowledge grounding, and reveals remaining challenges in dependency extraction, and faithful realization during video rendering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交互式视频叙事中的"上下文接地"问题，并给出VIS-Ground框架，将异构输入转化为可执行的生成约束，在三种视频生成主干上平均提升10.3分。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频叙事允许观众干预生成过程，但观众请求可能对"接地来源"与"当前已渲染视频状态"存在潜在依赖，这些依赖不会显式出现在任何单一输入中，仅在联合考虑源、渲染历史和新意图时显现。现有交互式视频生成侧重指令跟随，源接地生成侧重与外部叙事/知识对齐，二者均未探讨：交互续写时模型应以何为接地上下文，以及如何将异构非结构化输入转化为该上下文。
AI.method: 将上下文接地形式化为把异构输入上下文转化为视频生成可执行约束模型的过程。提出VIS-Ground，包含三个阶段：结构化上下文抽象（恢复接地状态与跨上下文依赖）；生成约束归纳（将相关依赖投影为候选特定的约束）；约束化视频生成（通过规划、验证、修订与渲染来强制执行约束）。
AI.result: 在三种视频生成主干上，VIS-Ground均取得最高综合得分，相比各主干最强基线平均绝对提升10.3分。细粒度分析显示在叙事接地与知识接地两方面均有增益，同时揭示依赖提取与渲染阶段忠实实现方面仍存挑战。
AI.conclusion: 本工作将交互式视频生成的接地问题重新表述为约束建模问题，验证了结构化接地与约束执行范式在多种主干上的有效性，并指出依赖提取与渲染忠实度是未来需攻克的方向。

title: Visual Jev Rewards: Reference-Bound Verification for Multi-Subject Image Generation
summary: Multi-subject image generation requires rewards that verify whether requested attributes, actions, and relations hold for the specified reference subjects. Subject presence alone does not establish that the correct subjects participate in a requested interaction. We present reference-bound Visual Jev rewards that turn these visual decisions into generator training signals. Each subject-related question receives a positive label only when the requested condition and the relevant reference identities hold jointly. We construct fixed questions offline, train a Qwen3.5-4B verifier with binary supervision, and directly read Yes probabilities from its language-model head. Their mean supplies a GRPO reward while retaining individual judgments for inspection. Using 200 MICo-150K training tasks and 30 updates, the framework raises a GPT-5.4 composite score from 41.78 to 52.50 on a manually selected 897-task MICo-Bench subset; direct 27B rewards yield 51.84. Each reward is tested in one GRPO run, and offline human evaluation does not establish a statistically significant advantage over direct scoring. The study provides an initial implementation and evaluation of Visual Jev as a reference-bound reward for multi-subject image generation.

AI.tldr: 提出"reference-bound Visual Jev"奖励机制，用Qwen3.5-4B验证器对主体相关视觉问题输出Yes概率，作为GRPO训练信号，提升多主体图像生成的复合得分。
AI.motivation: 多主体图像生成需要验证请求的属性、动作、关系是否作用于指定参考主体；仅有主体出现并不能保证正确主体参与了所请求的交互，因此需要能够联合校验条件与参考身份的奖励信号。
AI.method: 将每个主体相关问题仅在"请求条件与相关参考身份同时成立"时赋予正标签；离线构造固定问题，用二值监督训练Qwen3.5-4B验证器，直接读取其语言模型头的Yes概率，以其均值作为GRPO奖励，同时保留单项判断用于检查。
AI.result: 使用200个MICo-150K训练任务、30次更新，在人工筛选的897任务MICo-Bench子集上，将GPT-5.4复合分数从41.78提升至52.50；直接使用27B奖励得分为51.84。每个奖励仅在单次GRPO运行中测试，离线人工评估未显示相对直接打分的统计显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了Visual Jev作为多主体图像生成中参考绑定奖励的初步实现与评估，验证了其可行性，但其相对直接打分的优势尚未得到统计显著性的支持。

title: GRC-Net: Global Representation Consistency Network for Unsupervised Multimodal Anomaly Detection
summary: Automated quality inspection is essential for ensuring product reliability in manufacturing.While image-based methods effectively capture appearance-related defects, these methods are limited in detecting structural and geometric anomalies, motivating multimodal approaches incorporating 3D information. However, existing methods mainly rely on local patch-level representations, which often lead to unstable reconstruction errors even in normal regions. To address this limitation, we propose GRC-Net, which integrates a global-attention MLP to enforce global representation consistency across patch embeddings with a stable reconstruction module to improve reconstruction stability. The proposed method captures holistic contextual information through a global token and suppresses reconstruction noise by minimizing discrepancies between original and predicted embeddings. Experiments on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies demonstrate that GRC-Net consistently outperforms existing methods at both image and pixel levels. Qualitative results further demonstrate reduced reconstruction errors in normal regions and more distinct reconstruction differences between normal and anomalous regions.

AI.tldr: GRC-Net：通过全局注意力MLP与稳定重建模块提升多模态工业异常检测的重建稳定性，在MVTec 3D-AD与Eyecandies上取得图像与像素级最优表现。
AI.motivation: 制造业质量检测中，图像方法只能捕捉外观缺陷，难以检测结构与几何异常，因此需要引入3D信息的多模态方法；但现有方法主要依赖局部patch级表示，导致正常区域的重建误差不稳定，影响异常判定。
AI.method: 提出GRC-Net，集成全局注意力MLP（global-attention MLP），通过全局token强制patch嵌入间的全局表示一致性；并设计稳定重建模块（stable reconstruction module），通过最小化原始嵌入与预测嵌入之间的差异来抑制重建噪声。
AI.result: 在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies数据集上，GRC-Net在图像级和像素级均持续优于现有方法；定性结果显示正常区域重建误差降低，正常与异常区域的重建差异更加显著。
AI.conclusion: 引入全局表示一致性与稳定重建机制可有效缓解局部patch表示的误差不稳定问题，提升多模态工业异常检测的性能与判别性。

title: CRT-HMAR: Causal Requirement Tracing-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Agent Regulation for Open-Task-Aware Infrared-Visible Image Fusion
summary: Infrared and visible (IR-VIS) image fusion integrates complementary multimodal information into a single fused image to support downstream vision tasks. However, existing methods are typically tailored to seen tasks within a fixed task set and struggle to generalize to unseen tasks, which restricts their applicability in real-world open-task scenarios. To address this issue, this paper proposes CRT-HMAR, a Causal Requirement Tracing-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Agent Regulation Framework for open-task-aware IR-VIS image fusion. CRT-HMAR introduces a Causal Requirement Tracing Task Localization mechanism, which actively intervenes in key image information and observes task-network response variations to map task-specific semantic preferences into image-level causal requirement maps. Based on these maps, a requirement analysis agent aggregates task-specific requirement knowledge to adaptively guide requirement-customized image fusion. Moreover, CRT-HMAR incorporates History-Analysis Multi-Objective Balancing and Task-Level-Correction Conflict Mitigation mechanisms, jointly constructing a hierarchical regulation chain of "requirement interpretation - task balancing - conflict mitigation". Through multiple collaborative agents, CRT-HMAR dynamically regulates key processes including open-task requirement modeling, multi-task balanced optimization, and gradient conflict mitigation. Extensive experiments on open-task scenarios involving five downstream tasks demonstrate that CRT-HMAR significantly improves generalization to unseen tasks while maintaining the performance and balance of seen tasks. Overall, CRT-HMAR shifts IR-VIS image fusion from task-oriented modeling toward requirement-oriented modeling, promoting its extension from closed-task settings to real-world open-task scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRT-HMAR——一个因果需求追踪引导的分层多智能体调控框架，用于开放任务感知的红外-可见光图像融合，通过需求导向建模显著提升对未见任务的泛化能力，同时保持已见任务的性能与平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有红外-可见光（IR-VIS）图像融合方法通常针对固定任务集内的已知任务定制，难以泛化到未见任务，限制了其在真实开放任务场景中的适用性。为此，本文希望将IR-VIS图像融合从"任务导向建模"转向"需求导向建模"。
AI.method: 提出CRT-HMAR框架，包含三项核心机制：(1) 因果需求追踪任务定位（Causal Requirement Tracing Task Localization），主动干预关键图像信息并观察任务网络响应变化，将任务特定语义偏好映射为图像级因果需求图；(2) 基于需求图的需求分析智能体，聚合任务特定需求知识以自适应指导需求定制的图像融合；(3) 历史分析多目标平衡（History-Analysis Multi-Objective Balancing）与任务级校正冲突缓解（Task-Level-Correction Conflict Mitigation）机制，共同构建"需求解读—任务平衡—冲突缓解"的分层调控链，通过多智能体协作动态调控开放任务需求建模、多任务均衡优化与梯度冲突缓解等关键过程。
AI.result: 在涉及五个下游任务的开放任务场景中进行的大量实验表明，CRT-HMAR显著提升了对未见任务的泛化能力，同时保持了已见任务的性能与平衡。
AI.conclusion: CRT-HMAR将IR-VIS图像融合从任务导向建模推进为需求导向建模，推动其从封闭任务设定扩展到真实世界开放任务场景。

title: TileSkipper: Region-Adaptive Tile Pruning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Tiled 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterizers often use one scene-wide contribution cutoff for tile enumeration, although content differs in its sensitivity to support truncation. TileSkipper selects a static per-Gaussian cutoff policy for a frozen checkpoint. Calibration renders measure candidate pair savings and an isolated-removal distortion proxy that accounts for front transmittance and background color. The method allocates cutoffs across 64 Gaussian groups and accepts policies only after complete renders on disjoint selection views. The exported policy uses one byte per Gaussian, with no parameter updates, additional kernel, or per-frame policy inference. Across 13 scenes from Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, and Deep Blending, a fixed-policy AccuTile sweep gives dataset-macro speedups of $1.088\times$ at standard resolution and $1.238\times$ at 3840 pixels wide, with $-0.007/-0.023$ dB mean PSNR change. Six integrations with existing opacity-aware bounds yield $1.009\times$--$1.121\times$ compiler-only speedups. For four ports from $3σ$ rasterizers, we separately attribute the prior exact-bound transition and our incremental gain. Matched-quality ablations show modest gains over scene-global calibration and parity with per-Gaussian control; the standalone comparison with AdaGScale is regime-dependent.

AI.tldr: TileSkipper 为冻结的 3D 高斯泼溅检查点分配静态逐高斯截断策略，实现免更新的瓦片枚举剪枝加速。
AI.motivation: 现有分块式 3D 高斯泼溅光栅化器通常对整个场景采用统一的贡献度截断阈值，但不同内容对支撑截断的敏感度不一致，统一阈值造成不必要的瓦片枚举开销。
AI.method: 在冻结检查点上标定：渲染候选高斯对以测量瓦片配对节省量，并构造隔离移除失真代理（计入前向透射率与背景色）；把截断阈值分配给 64 个高斯分组，仅在互不重叠的选视图完成整帧渲染后才接受策略；导出策略每高斯 1 字节，无参数更新、无额外内核、无逐帧策略推断。
AI.result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples、Deep Blending 共 13 个场景上，固定策略 AccuTile 扫描在标准分辨率取得 1.088×、在 3840 像素宽度取得 1.238× 的数据集宏平均加速，平均 PSNR 变化为 -0.007/-0.023 dB；与现有不透明度感知边界结合 6 次集成取得 1.009×–1.121× 仅编译期加速；对 4 个移植自 3σ 光栅化器的实现，分别剥离了既有精确边界转换与本文增量收益；等质量消融显示相较场景全局标定略有增益，与逐高斯控制持平；与 AdaGScale 的单独对比结果依赖具体场景。
AI.conclusion: 逐高斯静态截断策略可在几乎不损失重建质量的前提下显著降低瓦片枚举成本，且部署开销极低，但其收益相对于更强基线（逐高斯控制、AdaGScale）较为有限且依赖场景。

title: Do Image Editors Follow Depth-Dependent Blur and Aperture Response? A Rendered-Ground-Truth Pilot Audit
summary: General image editors are asked to make a photo look as if it were taken at f/1.4, yet it is rarely checked whether the blur they add follows thin-lens optics. A physical aperture edit spreads blur across depth in thin-lens proportions and changes the blur when the aperture changes; prior evaluations check blur monotonicity, sharpness-trend correlation, effective-aperture error, or vision-language judgments, and none we found reports the two properties separately at known depths. In this pilot audit of two editors (Gemini~3.1 Flash Image and GPT-image-2.5) we compare against a rendered oracle: Blender Cycles scenes with true thin-lens depth of field, one blur-width estimator applied identically to oracle and editor outputs, and preregistered depth and aperture indices. In 24 texture scenes rendered in one three-panel geometry, accepted and measurable panels show f/1.4-to-f/2.8 width ratios, $\barσ_{1.4}/\barσ_{2.8}$, of 0.99--1.18 against 1.98--2.13 for the oracle, and ratios of pooled median Gaussian-equivalent near/far blur widths of about 1.18--1.25 (Gemini) and 0.97--1.05 (GPT-image) against 1.69--1.82. Preregistered black-box interventions show that qualitative wording changes blur strength by roughly 2--10 times, whereas a request for 2 versus 6 px changes it 1.1--1.3 times and no tested wording of the f-number meets the registered ``followed'' criterion. The depth compression appears in the original and reversed centre-focus layouts; with the focus on the near panel, the available-panel depth index reaches the registered threshold, and the aperture response stays attenuated in every layout tested. Scalar metrics adapted from published ones give oracle-like scores to synthetic editors whose proportions are compressed.

AI.tldr: 该论文对两款商用图像编辑器（Gemini 3.1 Flash Image、GPT-image-2.5）的"物理光圈编辑"能力进行试点审计：以 Blender Cycles 真实薄透镜景深渲染为 oracle，用同一模糊宽度估计器与预注册的深度/光圈指标比较。结果显示编辑器的模糊随景深与光圈的变化远弱于真实薄透镜光学。
AI.motivation: 通用图像编辑器常被要求"把照片改成 f/1.4 拍摄的样子"，但很少验证其添加的模糊是否符合薄透镜光学。物理光圈编辑应满足两个性质：模糊按薄透镜比例沿深度分布，且随光圈变化而变化。既有评测只检查模糊单调性、清晰度趋势相关性、有效光圈误差或视觉语言判断，未在已知深度下分别报告这两项性质。
AI.method: 采用预注册的试点审计设计，对比两款编辑器与"渲染 oracle"：Blender Cycles 场景提供真实薄透镜景深；对 oracle 与编辑器输出施加同一个模糊宽度估计器；使用预注册的深度与光圈指标（含 f/1.4 与 f/2.8 的宽度比、近/远模糊宽度中位数比、深度指数）。共 24 个纹理场景，采用统一的三联面板几何结构，并加入黑盒干预实验（改变定性措辞、请求 2 px 与 6 px 模糊、以不同措辞给出 f 值）。
AI.result: 可测面板的 f/1.4 对 f/2.8 宽度比仅为 0.99–1.18，而 oracle 为 1.98–2.13；近/远高斯等效模糊宽度中位数比约 1.18–1.25（Gemini）与 0.97–1.05（GPT-image），oracle 为 1.69–1.82。干预显示：定性措辞可使模糊强度变化约 2–10 倍，而要求 2 px 与 6 px 仅变化 1.1–1.3 倍，且没有任何 f 值措辞达到预注册的"已遵循"标准。深度压缩在原始与反转的中心对焦布局中均出现；近面板对焦时可用面板深度指数达到阈值，但光圈响应在所有布局中都被削弱。部分改编自已发表方法的标量指标会给比例被压缩的合成编辑器打出接近 oracle 的分数。
AI.conclusion: 这两款编辑器均未真正复现薄透镜光圈物理：景深比例被显著压缩，光圈对模糊的控制被削弱且对措辞更敏感而非对数值光圈参数敏感。既有标量指标可能掩盖这一问题，因此评测需在已知深度下分别检验景深比例与光圈响应。作者主张采用 oracle 对照的预注册审计范式。

title: OnlineQAT: On-Policy Distillation for Ultra-Low-Bit Large Language Models
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover much of the accuracy lost when large language models are compressed below four bits. Existing re- covery stages, however, are commonly optimized on fixed completions or teacher-generated answers, whereas the deployed quantized model condi- tions on prefixes generated by itself. Quantization errors can therefore move the model into states that are absent from offline recovery data. We introduce OnlineQAT, a two-stage framework that first obtains a usable low-bit initialization through block-wise QAT and then performs on-policy distillation (OPD) on student-generated responses. At each visited pre- fix, a frozen full-precision teacher provides a sampled reverse-KL training signal. On Qwen3-1.7B, OnlineQAT obtains the best average among the compared quantized methods: 57.28 at W3A16 and 32.52 at W2A16, im- proving over ReasoningQAT by 2.90 and 0.44 points, respectively. The results suggest that student-visited states provide a useful recovery signal beyond fixed-completion training, particularly at three bits.

AI.tldr: OnlineQAT：两阶段低比特量化恢复框架，先用分块QAT获得可用的低比特初始化，再在学生自生成响应上做在线策略蒸馏（OPD），由冻结的全精度教师在每个访问过的前缀处提供采样的反向KL训练信号。
AI.motivation: 现有量化感知训练（QAT）的恢复阶段通常在固定补全或教师生成的答案上优化，而被部署的量化模型实际是在自己生成的前缀上进行条件建模。量化误差会把模型推入离线恢复数据中不存在的状态，导致恢复训练与实际推理分布不匹配。
AI.method: 提出OnlineQAT两阶段框架：第一阶段通过分块（block-wise）QAT获得可用的低比特初始化；第二阶段在学生自生成响应上执行在线策略蒸馏（OPD），在每个访问到的前缀处，由一个冻结的全精度教师提供采样的反向KL（reverse-KL）训练信号。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B上，OnlineQAT在所比较的量化方法中取得最佳平均成绩：W3A16为57.28，W2A16为32.52，分别较ReasoningQAT提升2.90和0.44分。
AI.conclusion: 结果表名学生实际访问到的状态能提供固定补全训练之外的有效恢复信号，尤其在3比特设置下收益更为明显。

title: Multimodal LLMs Can Learn to Read Brain Signals: A Vision--Language Model for Unified Multi-Task EEG Decoding
summary: Learning EEG representations that generalize across cognitive tasks, subjects, and recording conditions remains a key challenge in electroencephalography (EEG) decoding. Recent advances in foundation models have improved EEG decoding performance, yet a fundamental open question remains: how to effectively interface neural signals with these models to enable multi-task learning across datasets. To investigate this question, we introduce BraVista, a visual-language framework that encodes multichannel EEG signals as structured images and enables multi-task learning through instruction-conditioned vision-language models (VLMs). Our approach relies on continued post-training of a general-domain VLM, leveraging its visual and linguistic priors to adapt to neural signals without a separate large-scale EEG-specific pretraining stage. We evaluate BraVista on four datasets spanning sleep staging, emotion recognition, cognitive workload classification, and abnormal EEG detection, showing strong performance across these tasks. Further analyses show that the choice of EEG-to-image representation is critical to performance. Moreover, through controlled perturbations of the EEG signal, we observe a gradual performance degradation under increasing noise, suggesting that the model relies on EEG-relevant information rather than superficial visual patterns. Together, these findings establish structured visual representations as an effective and scalable interface between neural signals and general-domain foundation models for unified multi-task EEG decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BraVista，将多通道 EEG 编码为结构化图像，通过指令条件化的视觉-语言模型（VLM）实现无需 EEG 专用预训练的多任务解码，在睡眠分期、情绪识别、认知负荷与异常 EEG 检测四个数据集上均取得良好性能。
AI.motivation: EEG 表征跨任务、跨被试、跨记录条件的泛化仍是解码难题；基础模型虽提升性能，但如何有效将神经信号接入这些模型以支持跨数据集多任务学习尚属开放问题。
AI.method: 构建视觉-语言框架 BraVista：把多通道 EEG 信号编码为结构化图像，依托通用域 VLM 的视觉与语言先验，通过持续后训练（continued post-training）并以指令条件化方式完成多任务学习，不设独立的 EEG 大规模预训练阶段。
AI.result: 在覆盖睡眠分期、情绪识别、认知负荷分类与异常 EEG 检测的四个数据集上表现良好；分析表明 EEG 到图像的表示方式对性能至关重要；在受控噪声扰动下性能随噪声增加而渐进下降，说明模型依赖 EEG 相关信息而非浅层视觉模式。
AI.conclusion: 结构化视觉表示可作为神经信号与通用域基础模型之间有效且可扩展的接口，支持统一的多任务 EEG 解码。

title: TopoGraphRAG-Bench: Evaluating Multimodal GraphRAG on Layout-Grounded Evidence Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Real-world documents distribute evidence across text, tables, figures, and captions within complex page layouts. Answering complex questions over such documents therefore requires more than retrieving relevant passages: systems must recover the evidence topology that connects heterogeneous evidence units. Existing GraphRAG evaluations remain largely text-centered, while multimodal document RAG benchmarks assess cross-modal retrieval and generation without directly evaluating recovery of the intended evidence topology. We introduce TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH, a layout-grounded benchmark for multimodal evidence reasoning in GraphRAG, comprising 2,024 questions over 201 long, visually rich documents. Questions are constructed bottom-up from text, figure, and table evidence units under three controlled topologies: single-hop retrieval, bridge-chain reasoning, and multi-source synthesis. To ensure that questions preserve their intended structure, we apply counterfactual validation for shortcut resistance, modality necessity, and evidence necessity. We evaluate text-only GraphRAG, page-level visual retrieval, and multimodal GraphRAG systems using retrieval, generation, and topology-aware reasoning metrics. Multimodal GraphRAG systems achieve the strongest overall performance, but still fail when visual-textual evidence alignment or multi-unit composition is incomplete. Text-only GraphRAG struggles when key dependencies are grounded in figures or tables, while page-level visual retrieval lacks the fine-grained structure needed for topology recovery. These findings motivate GraphRAG systems that move beyond text-derived entity relation graphs to explicitly model document layouts, cross-modal evidence alignment, and the reasoning roles of evidence units. Code and data are available at https://richardlrc.github.io/TopoGraphRAG-Bench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH，一个面向多模态GraphRAG的、基于页面布局的证据拓扑推理基准，包含2024个问题与201份长文档，通过三种受控拓扑（单跳检索、桥链推理、多源综合）与反事实验证评估证据拓扑恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 真实文档将证据分散在文本、表格、图像与图注中，跨复杂页面布局分布，因此复杂问答不能仅依赖段落检索，而需恢复连接异构证据单元的证据拓扑。现有GraphRAG评测以文本为中心，多模态文档RAG基准虽评估跨模态检索与生成，却未直接评估目标证据拓扑的恢复能力，存在评测空白。
AI.method: 构建TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH：基于页面布局、面向多模态证据推理的GraphRAG基准，含201份视觉丰富长文档上的2024个问题；问题自底向上由文本、图像、表格证据单元构建，覆盖三种受控拓扑——单跳检索、桥链推理、多源综合；并采用反事实验证保证抗捷径性、模态必要性与证据必要性。评测对象包括纯文本GraphRAG、页面级视觉检索与多模态GraphRAG，指标涵盖检索、生成与拓扑感知推理。
AI.result: 多模态GraphRAG整体表现最强，但当视觉—文本证据对齐不完整或多单元组合不充分时仍会失败；纯文本GraphRAG在关键依赖落在图像或表格上时表现不佳；页面级视觉检索缺乏拓扑恢复所需的细粒度结构。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现推动GraphRAG系统超越文本派生的实体关系图，转而显式建模文档布局、跨模态证据对齐以及证据单元的推理角色。代码与数据已公开。

title: Closing the Loop on Contrail Avoidance with Satellite Verification
comment: Accepted into Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning: workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Contrails are the thin ice clouds that aircraft leave behind. They cause a large share of aviation's warming, and rerouting the few flights that produce them could avoid much of it. However, an avoided contrail only counts if a satellite can confirm that it never formed, and this check is hard: contrails are one to two pixels wide, cover only 0.18% of pixels, and look very similar to natural cirrus. We build a small diffusion model (8.4M parameters, trained on one GPU) that detects them, and we run a controlled study to find out which components matter. The model reaches 0.476 PR-AUC, compared with 0.414 for a DeepLabV3+ baseline and 0.119 for an adapted MedSegDiff. Doubling the input resolution of the CNN brings it to parity (0.499, p=0.07). Three lessons apply beyond contrails. First, check the input resolution before designing a new architecture. Second, simple flips and rotations more than double accuracy and matter more than any architectural choice we measured. Third, pretraining the model on contrail shapes is harmful: the model learns that thin strokes appear everywhere and paints them onto empty scenes. Precision collapses to 1% while recall-based metrics still rate the degraded model as excellent, and no threshold or guidance heuristic repairs this failure.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个仅8.4M参数的小型扩散模型用于卫星图像中的航迹云检测，并开展受控消融研究发现：输入分辨率、简单几何数据增强比架构选择更关键，而基于航迹云形状的预训练反而有害。
AI.motivation: 航迹云（contrail）是航空业致暖的重要来源，通过改航可避免大部分影响，但前提是卫星能确认某航迹云"从未形成"。该检测任务极难：航迹云仅1–2像素宽、只占0.18%像素、且与自然卷云高度相似。因此需要高精度、轻量化的检测方法，并厘清哪些设计要素真正决定性能。
AI.method: 提出一个8.4M参数的小型扩散模型（单GPU训练）进行航迹云分割，并设计受控研究（controlled study）对比各组件贡献。基线包括DeepLabV3+与适配后的MedSegDiff；同时验证将CNN输入分辨率翻倍的效果，并测试flip/rotation数据增强与基于航迹云形状的预训练两种策略。
AI.result: 扩散模型达0.476 PR-AUC，优于DeepLabV3+（0.414）和适配MedSegDiff（0.119）。将CNN输入分辨率翻倍后达到与扩散模型相当的水平（0.499，p=0.07）。简单flip与rotation增强使准确率提升逾一倍，且超过任何所测架构选择带来的增益。基于航迹云形状的预训练反而有害：模型学到"细笔画无处不在"，在空白场景中伪造航迹云，精确率骤降至1%，而基于召回率的指标仍评价为优秀，且无任何阈值或引导启发式可修复。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出三条可推广经验：一是设计新架构前应优先检查输入分辨率；二是简单几何增强比架构选择更重要；三是针对形状的预训练会造成细笔画虚假生成、精确率崩溃，且召回型指标无法暴露该失效。这提示航迹云及类似细结构检测任务需谨慎对待数据增强与预训练策略，并警惕评价指标的盲区。

title: A Camera-Native Stereo VR180 Dataset
summary: Immersive VR180 video is increasingly produced with professional stereo fisheye cameras, yet public VR180 research resources are mostly collected from online platforms such as YouTube: already stitched, projected and compressed by unknown pipelines, and without lens calibration. We present a firsthand-captured stereo VR180 dataset recorded with two Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive cameras. It contains 1,211 samples -- 636 stereo video clips (2,220.8 s, mostly 90 fps) and 575 stereo stills -- each released as camera-native Blackmagic RAW, separate-eye native fisheye HEVC (8160x7200 per eye) and half-equirectangular HEVC (7200x7200 per eye), together with the factory lens calibration, portable fisheye/half-equirectangular conversion tools and AI-generated scene and visual-challenge annotations. Re-encoding the released fisheye and half-equirectangular renders with x265 over 24 clips, both eyes, four rate points and nine viewing directions, native-fisheye coding needed more bitrate than half-equirectangular coding at equal viewport quality for all 24 clips (median +38%), in every part of the field of view. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lulinxuan/VR180 ; code: https://github.com/lulinxuan/vr180-dataset-tools

AI.tldr: 本文发布了首个第一手采集的专业级立体VR180数据集（1211个样本），含原生鱼眼与半等距柱状投影的多格式数据、镜头标定与转换工具，并在编码实验中证明等视口质量下原生鱼眼编码所需码率比半等距柱状投影高约38%。
AI.motivation: 现有公开VR180研究资源多来自YouTube等在线平台，已由未知流程完成拼接、投影与压缩，且缺乏镜头标定参数，难以支撑可复现的成像与编码研究。作者希望提供参数已知、格式可控的第一手采集数据。
AI.method: 使用两台Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive相机拍摄立体VR180内容，构建含1211个样本的数据集：636段立体视频片段（2220.8秒，多数90 fps）与575张立体静图，每项同时发布相机原生Blackmagic RAW、分眼原生鱼眼HEVC（每眼8160x7200）和半等距柱状投影HEVC（每眼7200x7200），并附带出厂镜头标定、便携式鱼眼/半等距柱状投影转换工具及AI生成场景与视觉挑战标注。编码对比实验选取24个片段、双眼、4个码率点、9个观看方向，用x265重编码两种发布渲染格式。
AI.result: 在全部24个片段及视场各个区域中，达到相同视口质量时，原生鱼眼编码均需高于半等距柱状投影编码的码率，中位增幅为+38%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了格式原生、标定完整、工具配套的立体VR180数据集，填补了公开资源在采集链路可控性上的空白；编码结果也表明半等距柱状投影在视口质量-码率权衡上优于原生鱼眼表示。数据集与代码已公开。

title: The Confidence Game: Strategic Miscalibration in Human-AI Delegation
summary: Calibrated uncertainty quantification is essential to ensuring AI agents are trustworthy and reliable. However, when agents seek to maximize user engagement or revenue, confidence reports may be strategically distorted, detracting from their informativeness. We formalize this problem in the Confidence Game: a repeated signaling game with imperfect monitoring in which an agent of unknown honesty and ability reports its confidence, and a user decides whether to delegate the task or complete it herself. The agent manages the tradeoff between manipulating signals and maintaining its reputation. We characterize the Markov Perfect Bayesian Equilibria of the two-period game and show that honest reporting is not an equilibrium, inflation is the unique best response once the agent is sufficiently myopic, and under-reporting requires that the user believe honesty to be a minority. We then place an LLM in the agent role, supplying it with its true probability of success so that any gap between what it knows and what it reports is attributable to incentives rather than to miscalibration. The model claims high confidence on 56% of tasks it has been told it will probably fail. This persists on real tasks, where it must estimate its own accuracy and causes miscalibration to increase while the agent's signal becomes less informative. Furthermore, we find that the LLM agent's decisions are coherent, but it systematically underestimates both how likely the user is to delegate and how secure its reputation is, resulting in less extreme behavior. Pricing the agent's reporting rule, we find that it destroys 68% of the gains from delegation, of which 71% is information the report no longer carries and no amount of user sophistication recovers. Overall, we establish confidence reporting under delegation as a strategic problem and provide a tractable basis for modeling, analyzing, and testing agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文将"智能体在委托关系中的置信度报告"形式化为博弈问题（Confidence Game），刻画两期不完全监测重复信号博弈的马尔可夫完美贝叶斯均衡，并用大语言模型作为智能体进行实证验证。
AI.motivation: 校准良好的不确定性量化是AI智能体可信与可靠的前提。但当智能体以最大化用户参与度或收益为目标时，其置信度报告可能被策略性扭曲，从而丧失信息价值。现有研究缺乏对"置信度报告"这一策略性问题的形式化建模与分析框架。
AI.method: 构建"Confidence Game"：一个具有不完全监测的重复信号博弈，智能体的诚实度与能力未知，其报告置信度，用户决定委托任务或自行完成，智能体在信号操纵与声誉维护之间权衡。求解两期博弈的马尔可夫完美贝叶斯均衡。随后将LLM置于智能体角色，向其提供真实成功概率，使其知悉与报告之间的差距可归因于激励而非校准误差，并开展真实任务实验与报告规则定价分析。
AI.result: 均衡分析表明：诚实报告不是均衡；当智能体足够短视时，高报（inflation）是唯一最优反应；低报（under-reporting）要求用户认为诚实者属于少数。LLM实验中，模型对56%被明确告知可能失败的任务报告高置信度；该现象在真实任务中持续存在，并导致校准误差上升、信号信息量下降。LLM决策具有内在一致性，但系统性地低估用户委托概率与自身声誉稳固程度，行为趋于不极端。对报告规则定价显示，其摧毁了68%的委托收益，其中71%源于报告不再承载的信息，且任何用户 sophistication 都无法恢复。
AI.conclusion: 本文将委托情境下的置信度报告确立为策略性问题，并为智能体行为的建模、分析与测试提供了可处理的基础框架。

title: Expert Coupling in MoE Pretraining: Reducing All-to-All Overhead with Correlated Placement and Token Shuffling
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers replace the feed-forward block of a Transformer with E expert networks, and each token is routed to k of these experts. Under expert parallelism (EP) the experts are distributed across GPUs, and every MoE layer runs all-to-all collectives in the forward and backward passes to dispatch tokens to their experts and then combine the results. On a cluster with 8 AMD Instinct MI300X GPUs per node, these collectives can take 45% of the training step at EP32 with top-2 routing and 60% with top-6 routing. We find that early in pretraining routers have already learned to assign tokens to experts in correlated patterns, both within a layer and across layers. At top-2, 0.8% of the expert pairs in a layer are selected together by 42% of tokens, and the experts a token selects at one layer predict the experts it selects at the next layer. We use these correlations to keep more token--expert assignments on the token's own GPU, which reduces communication across GPUs and across nodes. Correlated expert placement puts experts that are often selected together on the same GPU. Combined with a dispatcher that sends each token to each GPU once, it removes up to 58% of dispatched rows. Token shuffling applies when sequence parallelism shards tokens across the EP group. It moves each token to the GPU predicted to hold its next-layer experts during the reduce-scatter that follows attention. On one node this raises the share of token--expert assignments served on the token's GPU from 12.5% to 59%. In Megatron-LM, across EP degrees from 8 to 64 with top-2 and top-6 routing, the two methods reduce all-to-all time by 1.16-2.63X and end-to-end step time by up to 1.41X. Neither method changes the models' underlying routing decisions or expert parameters.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现MoE训练早期路由器已学到专家选择的层内与跨层相关性，并利用这些相关性设计相关专家放置与token shuffling两种方法，减少EP场景下all-to-all通信，在Megatron-LM上最高降低all-to-all时间2.63倍、端到端步时1.41倍。
AI.motivation: 在专家并行（EP）下，MoE层的前向与反向都要执行all-to-all集合通信来分发token并合并结果；在8×AMD MI300X节点、EP32、top-2/top-6路由下，这些通信占训练步时的45%–60%，成为严重瓶颈，因此需要降低跨GPU、跨节点通信量。
AI.method: 作者观察到预训练早期路由器已形成相关选择模式：层内0.8%的专家对共同被42%的token选中（top-2），且某层所选专家可预测下一层所选专家。基于此提出两种方法：(1) 相关专家放置，将常被共同选择的专家放到同一GPU，配合“每token每GPU只发送一次”的dispatcher，最多减少58%的分发行；(2) token shuffling，在序列并行把token切分到EP组时适用，在注意力后的reduce-scatter中把token移动到预测将持有其下一层专家的GPU上，单节点上使本GPU服务token–专家分配的比例从12.5%提升到59%。两法均不改变路由决策与专家参数。
AI.result: 在Megatron-LM上，EP度从8到64、top-2与top-6路由设置下，两种方法将all-to-all时间降低1.16–2.63倍，端到端步时最高降低1.41倍；单节点上本GPU服务分配比例从12.5%提升至59%。
AI.conclusion: 利用MoE路由在预训练早期呈现的层内与跨层相关性，可通过相关专家放置与token shuffling显著减少EP all-to-all通信，且不改变模型路由决策或专家参数，是一种对现有训练框架低侵入的通信优化方案。

title: Unified Multi-plane Autoregressive Diffusion for 3D Multi-contrast MRI Synthesis
summary: Acquiring a complete set of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) contrasts is time-intensive and uncomfortable for patients, despite the diagnostic value of multi-contrast imaging. This motivates synthesizing missing contrasts from those already acquired, which is an inherently 3D problem requiring anatomical coherence across axial, sagittal, and coronal planes. However, fully 3D generative models are often impracti- cal under computational resources that scale cubically with volume size. We propose a unified Multi-Plane Autoregressive Diffusion (MPAD), a latent diffusion framework that achieves full-volume 3D synthesis using efficient plane-wise 2D operations while preserving volumetric coherence. A 3D autoencoder first compresses MRI scans into an isotropic 3D la- tent representation. A 2D diffusion model is then trained to reconstruct masked latent slices of the target contrast, conditioned on both source- contrast slices and unmasked target-contrast slices. During inference, we introduce plane-wise autoregressive synthesis with inter-plane priors. Slices are generated autoregressively in random order within one plane orientation to maintain intra-plane continuity, then propagated as con- ditioning priors to orthogonal plane orientations to enforce inter-plane consistency. Compared to 3D latent diffusion baselines, MPAD reduces training and inference FLOPs by 7x and 3x, respectively, while also lowering inference time and peak memory consumption. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that MPAD achieves superior perfor- mance, generating high-fidelity 3D volumes and supporting one-to-many translation within a single unified model.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的多平面自回归扩散框架MPAD，在保持全容积3D一致性的同时，用高效的2D平面操作实现MRI对比度合成，训练与推理FLOPs分别降低7倍和3倍。
AI.motivation: 完整采集多对比度MRI耗时且令患者不适，需要从已有对比度合成缺失对比度；该任务本质是3D问题，要求轴位、矢状位、冠状位三个平面解剖一致，但全3D生成模型计算量随体素体积立方增长，资源开销过大。
AI.method: MPAD为潜在扩散框架：首先用3D自编码器将MRI压缩为各向同性3D潜在表示；再训练2D扩散模型，以源对比度切片和未遮挡的目标对比度切片为条件，重建被遮挡的目标对比度潜在切片；推理时采用带平面间先验的平面级自回归合成，先在同一平面方向内以随机顺序自回归生成切片以保证平面内连续性，再将其作为条件先验传播至正交平面方向以增强平面间一致性。
AI.result: 相比3D潜在扩散基线，MPAD训练FLOPs降低7倍、推理FLOPs降低3倍，同时降低推理时间与峰值显存；在多个数据集上取得更优性能，可生成高保真3D容积，并在单一统一模型中支持一对多翻译。
AI.conclusion: MPAD通过平面级2D操作与多平面自回归条件传播，在避免3D模型立方级计算开销的同时实现全容积3D一致的MRI对比度合成，兼顾效率、保真度与多对多生成能力。

title: ScribbleEdit: A Benchmark for Scribble-Only Image Editing
summary: Scribble-based interaction provides a lightweight and intuitive way for users to specify image editing intents in interactive editing tools. However, current image editing models based on VLMs or LLMs struggle to understand and execute edits based solely on scribble inputs. To systematically study this problem, we construct a new benchmark, ScribbleEdit, that evaluates the ability of image editing models to perform image editing conditioned on scribbles. This task requires both a deep understanding of the intention of the scribble and an accurate interpretation of its spatial information. In ScribbleEdit, we design an automated data construction pipeline and introduce a dedicated evaluation protocol that explicitly measures intention alignment. Our analysis reveals that existing VLM/LLM-based editing models fail to accurately capture scribble intentions. To guide future progress on scribble-only image editing, we propose a simple yet effective soft-token baseline, which enhances the model's understanding of scribble semantics and outperforms standard image editing models on our benchmark. Our evaluation and baseline together provide a concrete foundation for assessing and improving the scribble-driven image editing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ScribbleEdit 基准，用于评估图像编辑模型在仅凭涂鸦（scribble）条件下进行图像编辑的能力，并指出现有 VLM/LLM 编辑模型难以准确捕捉涂鸦意图，同时提出一种 soft-token 基线方法加以改进。
AI.motivation: 涂鸦交互是一种轻量、直观的指定图像编辑意图的方式，但当前基于 VLM 或 LLM 的图像编辑模型难以仅凭涂鸦输入理解并执行编辑。为系统研究该问题，作者构建了专门基准，以填补涂鸦驱动图像编辑评估与方法的空白。
AI.method: 构建新基准 ScribbleEdit，用于评估模型在涂鸦条件下执行图像编辑的能力，该任务需同时理解涂鸦意图与准确解析其空间信息。设计了自动化数据构造流程与专门的评测协议，显式衡量意图对齐。基于分析结果，提出一种简单有效的 soft-token 基线，增强模型对涂鸦语义的理解。
AI.result: 分析表明现有基于 VLM/LLM 的编辑模型无法准确捕捉涂鸦意图；所提出的 soft-token 基线在 ScribbleEdit 基准上优于标准图像编辑模型。
AI.conclusion: 该评测与基线共同为评估和改进涂鸦驱动的图像编辑提供了具体基础。

title: PPCAR-Net: Projection-Refined Parametric 3D Coronary Artery Reconstruction from Sparse X-ray Angiographic Views
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendix. Code and pretrained models: https://github.com/G2304138H/PPCAR-Net . Project page with video results: https://G2304138H.github.io/PPCAR-Net/
summary: Sparse-view 3D coronary reconstruction commonly relies on cross-view correspondence and triangulation, which are vulnerable to vessel overlap and foreshortening, or on volumetric prediction followed by vascular-graph extraction, which does not directly provide centrelines and radii. We introduce PPCAR-Net, a projection-refined parametric coronary artery reconstruction network that directly predicts a branch-structured centreline-and-radius representation without explicit point matching, triangulation, or an intermediate volume. Given a variable number of segmented views, a coarse predictor combines frozen VGGT features with learned branch queries to estimate branch presence, B-spline centreline trajectories, and dense radius profiles. Projection-guided geometry and radius refiners then sample local evidence from the input views and apply residual corrections learned with 3D supervision. We evaluate representation fidelity and sparse-view reconstruction quantitatively and qualitatively. On simulated angiographic masks generated from CT-derived coronary anatomy, PPCAR-Net produces better connected artery reconstructions and achieves strong centreline accuracy, particularly for RCA, while maintaining competitive volumetric overlap. Coarse-to-fine inference takes 121 ms, enabling real-time reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出PPCAR-Net，一种投影精化的参数化冠状动脉重建网络，直接从可变数量分割视图预测分支结构化的中心线与半径表示，无需显式点匹配、三角化或中间体数据，实现实时稀疏视图重建。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图3D冠状动脉重建现有方法存在两类局限：基于跨视图对应与三角化的方法易受血管重叠和透视缩短影响；基于体数据预测再提取血管图的方法无法直接给出中心线与半径。因此需要一种直接、参数化的重建方案。
AI.method: PPCAR-Net由粗到细：粗预测器将冻结的VGGT特征与可学习的分支查询结合，估计分支存在性、B样条中心线轨迹和稠密半径剖面；随后投影引导的几何精化器与半径精化器从输入视图中采样局部证据，并在3D监督下学习残差修正。整个流程无需点匹配、三角化或中间体数据，且支持可变数量视图输入。
AI.result: 在由CT冠脉解剖生成的仿真血管造影掩膜上评估，PPCAR-Net产生连通性更好的动脉重建，中心线精度较高（尤其对RCA），同时保持有竞争力的体积重叠度；粗到细推理耗时121 ms，可实时重建。
AI.conclusion: PPCAR-Net以参数化分支结构表示直接完成稀疏视图冠状动脉重建，兼顾中心线精度、连通性与实时性，为无需三角化和中间体的血管重建提供了有效方案。

title: The Persona Hierarchy Model: Understanding Contextual Generalization in Fine-Tuning LLMs
summary: Language models are routinely fine-tuned under a fixed context, such as a generic system prompt, persona or domain-specific instruction, yet the learned behavior sometimes stays confined to that context and sometimes broadly generalizes to unseen contexts. We propose the Persona Hierarchy Model to explain this: a shared default persona influences behavior across contexts. Under this model, fine-tuning that modifies the shared persona promotes broader transfer, whereas changes to local personas remain more context-specific. Across 120 fine-tuned models spanning four behaviors and 15 training contexts, generalization narrowness positively correlates with the similarity between the training context's persona and the default persona (Pearson's r = 0.72 for Qwen3-4B). Prior fine-tuning under the default context can broaden generalization in subsequent training under other contexts. Aligning contextual responses with default-persona responses produces stronger effects. Finally, we propose persona-preserving regularization (PPR) to confine undesired contextual generalization. In RL, PPR cuts reward hacking from 42-55% to at most 0.2% under every evaluated prompt while retaining accuracy gains. These results support the Persona Hierarchy Model as an explanation for contextual generalization and can motivate future controls on unintended generalization for better alignment of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"人格层级模型"（Persona Hierarchy Model），认为大模型存在一个跨上下文的共享默认人格；微调若改变默认人格则泛化更广，只改局部人格则行为局限于该上下文。基于120个微调模型验证了泛化狭窄度与训练上下文人格和默认人格相似度的正相关（Qwen3-4B上 r=0.72），并提出人格保持正则化（PPR）抑制非预期泛化，在RL中将奖励黑客从42–55%降至最多0.2%。
AI.motivation: 语言模型通常在固定上下文（如通用系统提示、人格设定或领域指令）下进行微调，但所学行为有时局限于该上下文，有时却能广泛泛化到未见上下文，这一差异缺乏解释。作者希望揭示上下文泛化的机制并实现对非预期泛化的控制，以服务于LLM对齐。
AI.method: 1) 提出人格层级模型：模型具有共享的默认人格与各上下文的局部人格，微调对二者的影响不同；2) 在4种行为、15种训练上下文下微调共120个模型，计算"泛化狭窄度"与"训练上下文人格—默认人格相似度"的相关性；3) 检验在默认上下文下先微调对后续其他上下文泛化的扩展作用；4) 将上下文响应与默认人格响应对齐以增强效果；5) 提出人格保持正则化（PPR），在强化学习中约束非预期上下文泛化。
AI.result: 泛化狭窄度与训练上下文人格和默认人格的相似度呈正相关（Qwen3-4B上 Pearson r = 0.72）；在默认上下文下的先前微调可以拓宽后续在其他上下文中的泛化；将上下文响应与默认人格响应对齐会产生更强效果；在RL中，PPR将每个评估提示下的奖励黑客从42–55%降至最多0.2%，同时保留准确率收益。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持人格层级模型作为上下文泛化的解释，并可为未来控制LLM非预期泛化、提升对齐效果提供依据。

title: Quantifying Volumetric Risk: Class-Aware Asymmetric Weighted Conformal Prediction for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Reliable volumetric segmentation is critical for clinical diagnostics, yet foundation models such as MedSAM remain deterministic and lack calibrated uncertainty under distribution shift. Existing conformal prediction methods offer statistical guarantees but are frequently applied in 2D and assume symmetric error distributions, so they do not capture the class-specific biases that arise in 3D multi-class segmentation. We propose Class-Aware Asymmetric Weighted Conformal Prediction (CA-WCP), which combines latent-space density-ratio weighting for covariate shift with directional quantiles for the lower and upper volume bounds, and scales each bound by a class-specific asymmetry factor derived from validation-set false-positive and false-negative rates. We prove that CA-WCP retains the weighted-exchangeability marginal coverage guarantee for every class, and we evaluate it on 3D brain tumor segmentation (BraTS 2020) and on a synthetic multi-organ CT benchmark constructed under covariate shift. On both benchmarks the 95\% Clopper--Pearson interval for the observed coverage of CA-WCP contains the nominal 90\% level for every semantic class, while interval width is reduced by 8--14\% relative to symmetric weighted conformal prediction. We further encode the calibrated intervals into structured prompts for a multimodal large language model to produce uncertainty-conditioned radiology reports, linking distribution-shift-aware uncertainty quantification to interpretable clinical communication.

AI.tldr: 提出类别感知非对称加权共形预测CA-WCP，为3D多类分割提供带有分布偏移感知的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 医学影像体积分割对临床诊断至关重要，但MedSAM等基础模型是确定性的，在分布偏移下缺乏校准的不确定性。现有共形预测方法多用于2D且假设误差对称，无法刻画3D多类分割中的类别特定偏差。
AI.method: CA-WCP结合潜空间密度比加权以应对协变量偏移，并采用上下界方向分位数，每个界由验证集假阳性率与假阴性率推导出的类别特定非对称因子缩放。
AI.result: 理论上证明CA-WCP对每个类别保持加权可交换的边际覆盖保证。在BraTS 2020脑肿瘤分割与协变量偏移下构建的合成多器官CT基准上，CA-WCP的95% Clopper-Pearson区间均包含名义90%水平，且区间宽度较对称加权共形预测缩小8-14%。
AI.conclusion: 将校准区间编码为结构化提示输入多模态大语言模型，生成不确定性条件化放射报告，打通分布偏移感知的不确定性量化与可解释临床沟通。

title: ARCS: Towards Precise Text-to-SQL via Structured Disambiguation
summary: As text-to-SQL systems move beyond demonstrations toward real-world deployment, ambiguity in user questions becomes a primary source of errors. Such ambiguities are often subtle, domain- or data-specific, and can silently cause system outputs to deviate from the user's true intent. Ambiguity is traditionally addressed through conversational clarification, which is often inefficient, cognitively demanding, and poorly aligned with real-world user workflows. We propose structured disambiguation, a new paradigm in which ambiguity is resolved through explicit, constrained interactions rather than free-form dialogue. We construct ARCS (Ambiguity Resolution Corpus for SQL), the first text-to-SQL benchmark featuring naturally occurring, unconstrained ambiguities over real-world databases, with complete annotations of all valid ambiguity points, interpretations, and SQL queries. Experimental results show that text-to-SQL remains challenging in the presence of ambiguity: gpt-6-sol achieves only 51% end-to-end execution accuracy, and no open-source model exceeds 27%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出结构化消歧范式，并构建了首个自然歧义文本到SQL基准ARCS，实验表明现有系统在歧义下性能大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 文本到SQL系统走向实际部署时，用户问题的歧义成为主要错误来源，且传统对话式澄清效率低、认知负担重、与真实工作流不符。
AI.method: 提出结构化消歧范式，通过显式、受限的交互而非自由对话来解决歧义；构建ARCS基准，覆盖真实数据库上自然产生的无约束歧义，并完整标注所有有效歧义点、解释和SQL查询。
AI.result: 文本到SQL在歧义存在时仍具挑战性：gpt-6-sol端到端执行准确率仅51%，开源模型均不超过27%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化消歧与ARCS基准为歧义场景下的文本到SQL研究提供了新方向与评测基础，揭示了当前模型的显著不足。

title: One Frame, Full Heartbeat: ECG-Free Cardiac Cine MRI Synthesis via Phase-Conditioned Flow Matching
summary: Cine cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) analysis relies on multi-frame sequences capturing the full cardiac cycle. However, standard multi-frame acquisition depends heavily on electrocardiogram (ECG) gating and repeated breath-holds, posing challenges in uncooperative populations, resource-limited settings, and temporally corrupted datasets. Existing methods that synthesize full cardiac sequences either rely on explicit ECG signals to parameterize myocardium function, or employ deformable registration without physiological constraints, failing to faithfully reproduce clinically relevant dynamic metrics such as ejection fraction (EF) and ventricular contraction magnitude. We present PhaseFlow, a unified generative framework that overcomes both limitations. PhaseFlow estimates a non-linear cardiac phase signal directly from the input sequence via a segmentation-derived left-ventricular (LV) area curve, capturing the asymmetric dynamics of systole and diastole without any ECG dependency. At inference, this phase signal is provided by a pathology-specific template, informing phase-specific frame generation. A rectified flow model conditioned on the phase and slice position synthesizes the full cardiac motion trajectory in the latent space, decoded into a diffeomorphic displacement field that warps end-diastole pixel intensities directly, eliminating the reconstruction blur often accompanying the variational autoencoder. On the ACDC benchmark, PhaseFlow achieves superior physiological fidelity and image realism, with best LV volume curve $R^2$, structural similarity (SSIM) and generative quality (FID) among all baselines. Ablation studies confirm that each proposed component contributes measurably to the overall performance.

AI.tldr: PhaseFlow 是一个统一生成框架，通过从序列中估计非线性心动相位信号，并结合相位与切片位置条件的 rectified flow 模型，在潜空间合成完整心脏运动轨迹，直接形变舒张末期像素强度，无需 ECG 门控。
AI.motivation: 标准多帧心脏磁共振采集依赖心电图门控和反复屏气，在不配合人群、资源受限场景及时间受损数据集中难以实施。现有合成完整心动序列的方法要么依赖显式 ECG 参数化心肌功能，要么采用无生理约束的可变形配准，无法忠实复现射血分数、心室收缩幅度等临床动态指标。
AI.method: PhaseFlow 通过由分割导出的左心室面积曲线直接从输入序列估计非线性心动相位信号，捕捉收缩与舒张的不对称动力学，不依赖 ECG；推理时相位信号由病理特异性模板提供。以相位和切片位置为条件的 rectified flow 模型在潜空间合成完整心脏运动轨迹，解码为微分同胚位移场，直接对舒张末期像素强度进行形变，从而避免变分自编码器常见的重建模糊。
AI.result: 在 ACDC 基准上，PhaseFlow 实现了更优的生理保真度与图像真实感，在所有基线中取得最佳的左心室容积曲线 R²、结构相似性（SSIM）和生成质量（FID）。消融研究证实每个提出组件对整体性能均有可测量的贡献。
AI.conclusion: PhaseFlow 通过无 ECG 的相位估计与相位条件 rectified flow 形变生成，统一解决了生理约束缺失与 ECG 依赖两大限制，在心脏序列合成中兼顾生理保真度与图像真实感。

title: TiTok: Audio-Visual LLM for Multi-Segment Temporal Grounding
summary: Audio-visual multi-segment grounding (AV-MSG) in untrimmed videos, reasoning over audio-visual evidence and predicting multiple segments for a query, is a fundamental problem but remains challenging. Visual-only models overlook complementary acoustic cues, while audio-visual models often fail to calibrate the number of events - a phenomenon we refer to as count miscalibration. We present TiTok, an audio-visual large language model (AV-LLM) that localizes an arbitrary number of temporal event segments for each query. For precise boundary prediction, we introduce the Time Token Interleaving (TTI) method, which explicitly injects special time tokens into the audio-visual stream to align input-side temporal perception with output-side temporal prediction. We further propose decoupled, multi-segment-oriented rewards for reinforcement learning, consisting of global, local, count, precision, and format rewards, optimized with Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). To assess the performance on AV-MSG, we establish a new UnAV-100-based evaluation protocol, and propose the CountF1 metric for quantifying count miscalibration that overlap metrics fail to capture. TiTok reaches 65.7 mIoU and 0.58 CountF1, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Our code is available at this link.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TiTok，一个面向无剪辑视频的音视频多片段定位（AV-MSG）任务的大型音视频语言模型，通过时间令牌交错（TTI）实现精确边界预测，并利用解耦的多片段奖励与 GDPO 强化学习优化事件数量校准，达到 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: AV-MSG 任务具有基础性但极具挑战：纯视觉模型忽略互补的声学线索，而现有音视频模型常无法正确校准事件数量，作者将这一现象定义为"数量误校准"（count miscalibration）。此外，现有重叠度量指标无法量化该问题。
AI.method: 提出 TiTok（AV-LLM），可对每个查询定位任意数量的时间事件片段。核心方法包括：(1) 时间令牌交错（TTI），将特殊时间令牌显式注入音视频流，使输入端时间感知与输出端时间预测对齐；(2) 面向多片段的解耦强化学习奖励，包含全局、局部、数量、精度和格式五类奖励，并采用组奖励解耦归一化策略优化（GDPO）进行优化。同时建立基于 UnAV-100 的新评测协议，并提出 CountF1 指标以量化数量误校准。
AI.result: TiTok 取得 65.7 mIoU 和 0.58 CountF1，达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: TiTok 有效解决了 AV-MSG 中数量误校准与边界预测问题，验证了时间令牌交错与解耦多片段奖励机制的有效性；同时所提出的评测协议与 CountF1 指标为量化数量校准提供了新工具。代码已开源。

title: Shared Geometry As A Rosetta Stone: Cross-Modal Alignment Without Paired Data
summary: Multimodal representations enable zero-shot classification and retrieval, but aligning independently trained models usually requires large amounts of paired data. Yet, the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that models trained on different modalities may converge spontaneously toward a shared representation geometry. But then, do we even need paired examples for cross-modal alignment? Remarkably, we show that paired examples are unnecessary for coarse cross-modal alignment. Our simple Wasserstein Procrustes method with a coarse geometric initialization aligns two disjoint embedding sets by estimating a single orthogonal map without seeing any pairs. Across datasets, modalities, and unimodal models, we show that we can consistently align independently trained representations without pairs, and standard geometric alignment metrics accurately predict when this is possible. Nevertheless, we can naturally benefit from paired examples. In the very few-pair regime, our method substantially outperforms existing ones, while staying competitive with pair-based methods with more added examples. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting alignments can enable text-to-image generation without paired examples. These results show that independently trained models often share enough geometry to establish cross-modal correspondence with little or no paired data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Wasserstein Procrustes方法，通过几何初始化与单一正交映射估计，在无配对样本条件下实现跨模态嵌入集的粗粒度对齐，并在少配对场景下显著优于现有方法，甚至可支持无配对文本到图像生成。
AI.motivation: 多模态表示虽支持零样本分类与检索，但独立训练的模型通常需要大量配对数据才能对齐。受Platonic Representation Hypothesis启发，作者质疑跨模态对齐是否真的需要配对样本，探索无配对条件下的对齐可能性。
AI.method: 提出Wasserstein Procrustes方法，结合粗粒度几何初始化，估计一个正交映射，将两个不相交的嵌入集合对齐，全过程不使用任何配对样本；同时分析几何对齐度量对对齐可行性的预测能力，并研究加入少量配对样本时的性能提升。
AI.result: 在多个数据集、模态和单模态模型上，无需配对即可一致地实现独立训练表示的对齐，标准几何对齐度量能准确预测其可行性；在极少配对场景下显著优于现有方法，与更多配对数据的方法相比仍具竞争力；所得对齐还可实现无配对文本到图像生成。
AI.conclusion: 独立训练的模型通常共享足够的几何结构，使得仅需极少甚至无需配对数据即可建立跨模态对应关系，挑战了配对数据不可或缺的传统假设。

title: Finding the Right Balance: Relevance and Diversity in LLM Retrieval
comment: 36 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables. Code and results: https://github.com/GuillaumeBrouillette/finding-the-right-balance
summary: Retrieval diversification is widely available in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks, yet prior studies disagree on whether it improves retrieval and answer quality. We show that its effectiveness varies primarily with candidate-pool redundancy, in a pattern consistent with the number of distinct evidence pieces a query requires. Using controlled near-duplicate injection and production-style overlapping chunking, we find that diversification harms relevance, evidence coverage and answer quality on clean pools, but becomes beneficial on multi-evidence tasks when redundancy causes nearest-neighbor retrieval to select repeated passages. We therefore introduce a query-adaptive rule that diversifies only when the effective number of distinct documents in the nearest-neighbor top-$k$ selection falls below the query's evidence requirement. Computed from existing embeddings, the rule captures most of the achievable gain, transfers across datasets and encoders and automatically reduces to nearest-neighbor retrieval for single-evidence queries. We also introduce RNG-Score, a geometric reranker with an exact nearest-neighbor fallback whose margin indicates duplicate structure. Overall, we conclude that diversification should be used selectively, based on observable redundancy and evidence requirements.

AI.tldr: 检索多样化在RAG中效果不一，其增益主要取决于候选池冗余度；据此提出按查询证据需求自适应的多样化规则，并给出RNG-Score重排器。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对检索多样化能否提升检索与答案质量结论矛盾，缺乏对其适用条件的统一解释，因此需要厘清多样化何时有益、何时有害的边界条件。
AI.method: 通过受控的近重复注入与生产风格的重叠分块构造不同冗余度的候选池，考察多样化对相关性、证据覆盖与答案质量的影响；提出查询自适应规则——仅当最近邻top-k中有效不同文档数低于该查询所需证据数时才进行多样化，该规则可直接由现有嵌入计算；同时提出RNG-Score几何重排器，并配备精确最近邻回退，其间隔反映重复结构。
AI.result: 在干净候选池上，多样化损害相关性、证据覆盖与答案质量；在多证据任务中，当冗余导致最近邻检索选中重复段落时，多样化转为有益。自适应规则可捕获大部分可实现的增益，并能跨数据集与编码器迁移，对单证据查询自动退化为最近邻检索。
AI.conclusion: 检索多样化应基于可观测的冗余度与查询的证据需求选择性地使用，而非普遍启用；所提规则与重排器为此提供了可操作的判据。

title: trACT: temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap
summary: Effective remote monitoring and surveillance using drones are frequently impeded by severe environmental and thermal clutter, dynamic vegetation, target camouflage, and system latency. Drawing inspiration from the hunting strategies of birds of prey that hover and stabilize their vision to isolate subtle ground motion, we introduce trACT (temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap), a lightweight, real-time aerial robotics framework designed for autonomous consumer drones. The system integrates Temporal Max Pooling (TMP), a low-level signal processing method that transforms imperceptible movement across a rolling integration window into robust value and time encodings, with self-supervised motion anomaly detection to isolate target motion from background environmental motion caused by wind gusts and drone drift. To overcome mechanical and processing delays, trACT combines motion prediction with automated gimbal-stabilized optical zoom verification and equitable multi-target verification balancing. Extensive real-world field experiments in densely forested wildlife habitats and surveillance scenarios demonstrate that trACT successfully bridges the gap between wide-area aerial monitoring and precise, autonomous target verification under challenging operational conditions.
