Our results show that relational abstractions significantly improve reasoning capabilities of diffusion models on a variety of complex reasoning tasks, while enabling robust generalization in out-of-distribution settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合无监督物体发现与物体关系抽象的扩散模型框架，通过关系知识为扩散过程注入结构原语，在训练与推理中引导生成表征空间，从而满足空间推理约束；同时发布包含四个数据集的大规模生成式空间推理基准，实验证明关系抽象显著提升推理能力并增强分布外泛化。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在图像合成上表现优异，但难以可靠满足结构化的空间推理约束。在具有隐式逻辑结构的条件分布建模任务（如由可见线索与一致解构成的谜题）中，现有先进生成模型往往只逼近像素空间分布，而未学到推理所需的底层逻辑规则。
AI.method: 提出一个面向空间推理的扩散模型新框架：利用无监督物体发现（object discovery）获得以物体为中心的表征，并在此基础上构建物体关系的抽象。由这些物体中心表征导出的关系知识为扩散模型提供结构原语（structural primitives），在训练与推理两个阶段引导生成表征空间，从而实现满足推理约束的条件图像生成。
AI.result: 在多种复杂推理任务上，引入关系抽象显著提升了扩散模型的推理能力；同时在分布外（out-of-distribution）场景下表现出稳健的泛化性能。此外构建了一个大规模生成式空间推理基准，包含四个受人类可解谜题启发的数据集。
AI.conclusion: 将无监督物体发现与关系抽象相结合，可有效弥补扩散模型在结构化空间推理上的缺陷；关系知识作为结构原语能同时服务于训练与推理阶段的表征引导，兼顾推理性能与分布外泛化。

title: CIRSeg: Coarse-to-Fine Intensity-Robust Liver Segmentation with Source-Free Continual Test-Time Adaptation
comment: Accepted at the CARE 2026 Workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: Reliable liver segmentation in contrast-enhanced MRI is essential for quantitative hepatic assessment, treatment planning, and longitudinal disease monitoring. However, limited annotated data and scanner- or vendor-dependent intensity variations can cause overfitting and poor generalization to unseen acquisition domains. Moreover, simultaneously achieving robust global localization and precise boundary delineation remains challenging, while predictions may contain isolated false-positive regions outside the main liver component. To address these challenges, we propose CIRSeg, a coarse-to-fine, intensity-robust liver segmentation framework based on nnU-Netv2. CIRSeg combines 3D CutMix with stochastic intensity transfer using either Nyul augmentation or histogram matching to improve robustness to heterogeneous MRI intensities. Its cascaded architecture decouples low-resolution anatomical localization from full-resolution boundary refinement. At inference, source-free test-time adaptation based on confidence-filtered predictions and probability-prior regularization further improves robustness to out-of-distribution inputs. As a final deterministic post-processing step, largest connected component filtering removes isolated false-positive regions. On the CARE 2026 test set, CIRSeg achieves Dice scores of 97.13\% and 97.93\% on the in-domain and unseen-domain subsets, with corresponding HD95 values of 20.18 mm and 11.30 mm, respectively. These results demonstrate consistently accurate segmentation across both in-domain and unseen acquisition settings. The code is available at https://github.com/jingkunchen/MICCAI_CARE_2026

AI.tldr: 提出CIRSeg——基于nnU-Netv2的粗到细、强度鲁棒肝脏分割框架，结合3D CutMix与随机强度迁移、级联架构、无源测试时自适应及最大连通域后处理，在CARE 2026测试集域内与未见域上分别取得97.13%/97.93%的Dice和20.18mm/11.30mm的HD95。
AI.motivation: 对比增强MRI中的可靠肝脏分割对量化评估、治疗规划与纵向监测至关重要。但标注数据有限、扫描仪或厂商相关的强度差异易导致过拟合与跨域泛化差；同时兼顾全局定位与精确边界刻画困难，且预测中常出现主肝脏之外的孤立假阳性区域。
AI.method: 以nnU-Netv2为基础构建粗到细框架CIRSeg：采用3D CutMix结合随机强度迁移（Nyul增强或直方图匹配）提升对异质MRI强度的鲁棒性；级联架构将低分辨率解剖定位与全分辨率边界细化解耦；推理阶段使用基于置信度过滤预测与概率先验正则的无源测试时自适应增强对分布外输入的鲁棒性；最后以最大连通域过滤作为确定性后处理去除孤立假阳性。
AI.result: 在CARE 2026测试集上，CIRSeg在域内子集取得Dice 97.13%、HD95 20.18 mm，在未见域子集取得Dice 97.93%、HD95 11.30 mm，表明在域内与未见采集设置下均能实现稳定准确的分割。
AI.conclusion: CIRSeg通过强度鲁棒增强、级联粗到细结构、测试时自适应与后处理的有效组合，在域内与未见域肝脏分割上均表现一致且精确，验证了其在有限标注与跨域场景下的泛化能力，代码已开源。

title: UltraWorld: Learning Interactive Ultrasound World Models from Untracked Clinical Videos with Acoustic Sampling Map
summary: World models can enable autonomous ultrasound scanning by predicting the outcomes of probe motions from local observations. Learning this action--observation relationship typically relies on synchronized video--pose pairs, which are costly to collect at scale and largely unavailable in routine clinical recordings. Reliable action following further requires modeling ultrasound's cross-sectional sampling geometry. We present UltraWorld, a self-distillation recipe that transfers priors from clinical ultrasound videos into interactive world models without real action annotations. Starting from clinical videos, we adapt a video foundation model into an ultrasound generator conditioned on reference images and anatomical masks. Anatomical masks sampled along programmable trajectories through 3D anatomy provide spatial guidance for synthesizing action--video pairs. We then use these synthetic pairs to self-distill the generator into a world model that predicts future observations from local observations and actions, without requiring anatomical masks or other 3D assets at inference time. To further improve action following, we introduce the Acoustic Sampling Map (AsMap), which represents probe poses and imaging settings as pixel-wise 3D sampling positions, beam directions, and depths. Experiments demonstrate improved prediction fidelity and action following. Across nine simulated closed-loop local planning episodes, UltraWorld reduces the mean final distance to the goal and orientation error by 29\% and 38\%, respectively, compared with visual servoing. Project Page: https://ultraworld-project.github.io/.

AI.tldr: UltraWorld 提出自蒸馏框架，将临床超声视频先验迁移至交互式世界模型，无需真实动作标注，并通过声学采样图（AsMap）提升动作跟随能力。
AI.motivation: 超声自主扫描需要世界模型从局部观测预测探头运动结果，但动作-观测配对数据（同步视频-位姿）在临床中大规模采集成本高、难以获取；同时还需建模超声的横截面采样几何。
AI.method: 1) 将视频基础模型适配为超声生成器，以参考图像和解剖掩码为条件；2) 沿可编程轨迹在3D解剖中采样掩码，合成动作-视频对；3) 用合成对自蒸馏，得到仅凭局部观测和动作预测未来观测的世界模型，推理时无需掩码或3D资产；4) 引入声学采样图（AsMap），以像素级3D采样位置、波束方向和深度表示探头位姿与成像设置。
AI.result: 预测保真度和动作跟随均改善；在9个模拟闭环局部规划任务中，相比视觉伺服，最终平均目标距离和朝向误差分别降低29%和38%。
AI.conclusion: UltraWorld 无需真实动作标注即可构建超声交互世界模型，AsMap 有效增强动作跟随，验证了在闭环自主超声扫描中的潜力。

title: Judging in Latent Space: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Semantics-Preserving Compression
summary: Reward modeling often requires jointly representing and reasoning over multiple evaluation criteria, yet verbalizing this process token by token can incur substantial inference cost. Recent work on latent reasoning suggests that continuous states may support this computation more compactly. We introduce LatentGRM, a latent evaluation framework built on semantic chunking, compression, and reconstruction. By using the structure of rubric-guided evaluations to guide compression, LatentGRM learns compact continuous trajectories that support autonomous pairwise judgments without generating textual assessments. A separate interpreter reconstructs evaluation text from these trajectories, providing an offline view of the information retained under compression. Under matched training data and backbones, LatentGRM achieves competitive aggregate preference accuracy relative to explicit Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) judges at both 4B and 8B scales. Across four benchmark domains, LatentGRM-8B compresses evaluation trajectories by 8.9--9.2x and reduces total judge inference time by 6.1--7.0x at vote@5. Controlled rubric interventions show that criterion-dependent preference information is carried through the latent sequence. Together, these results demonstrate that continuous latent evaluation can substantially reduce inference cost while preserving competitive judgment quality.

AI.tldr: LatentGRM 用语义分块、压缩与重构构建潜空间评估框架，将评分标准的评估过程压缩为连续潜轨迹，实现无需生成文本的成对偏好判断，在保持竞争力准确率的同时大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 奖励建模通常需对多评估标准进行联合表示与推理，但逐 token 的口头化推理会带来高昂的推理开销。近期潜空间推理研究表明连续状态可更紧凑地支持这类计算，因此作者希望利用评分标准引导的评估结构来压缩评估过程，从而在降低推理成本的同时保留判断质量。
AI.method: 提出 LatentGRM，基于语义分块、压缩与重构的潜空间评估框架。利用 rubric 引导评估的结构指导压缩，学习支持自主成对判断的紧凑连续轨迹，而不生成文本评估；另设独立解释器从潜轨迹重构评估文本，作为压缩下信息保留情况的离线视图。实验在 4B 与 8B 规模、匹配训练数据与骨干网络的条件下与显式 SFT 评判器对比。
AI.result: 在匹配训练数据和骨干网络下，LatentGRM 在 4B 和 8B 规模上的总体偏好准确率与显式 SFT 评判器相当。在四个基准领域，LatentGRM-8B 在 vote@5 下将评估轨迹压缩 8.9–9.2 倍，并将评判器总推理时间降低 6.1–7.0 倍。受控的 rubric 干预实验表明，依赖评分标准的偏好信息通过潜序列被承载。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明连续潜空间评估能够在保持有竞争力的判断质量的同时显著降低推理成本。受控 rubric 干预进一步验证了依赖标准的偏好信息确实被编码在潜序列中，说明压缩并未牺牲关键的评估信息。

title: Counterfactual Route Optimization for Gaussian Head Avatar Modeling
summary: Head avatar modeling requires jointly optimizing multiple objectives with different dominant effects on geometry, appearance, and cross-view consistency. However, their relative effectiveness varies across training states, while existing pipelines typically rely on fixed loss weights or handcrafted stage-wise schedules. A central challenge is therefore to identify which optimization direction is more beneficial at each training state. We propose a counterfactual route optimization framework for Gaussian head avatar modeling, which characterizes state-dependent optimization preference from the realized effects of alternative updates rather than predefined heuristic weighting. Starting from the same training state, we perform short-horizon route-restricted lookahead over geometry, appearance, and joint update routes and evaluate their outcomes under a unified utility. The resulting counterfactual evidence is factorized into a geometry--appearance preference and a residual joint advantage, separately capturing the relative preference between individual update directions and the additional benefit of coordinated optimization. We further amortize this offline evidence into a lightweight controller that directly estimates the current optimization preference and applies bounded modulation to the training objectives during full avatar optimization. Experiments on the NeRSemble dataset validate the effectiveness of the proposed design, consistently outperforming existing methods while preserving clearer local facial structures and finer details.

AI.tldr: 提出反事实路线优化框架，通过短程前瞻评估几何、外观及联合更新路线的实际效果，将偏好分解为几何-外观偏好与联合残差优势，并摊销为轻量控制器动态调制损失权重，在NeRSemble上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 头部化身建模需同时优化几何、外观与跨视角一致性等多个目标，其相对重要性随训练状态变化；但现有流程依赖固定损失权重或人工设计的阶段式调度，难以判断当前训练状态下哪个优化方向更有利。
AI.method: 从同一训练状态出发，对几何、外观和联合更新路线进行短程路线受限前瞻，在统一效用下评估结果；将反事实证明分解为几何-外观偏好与残余联合优势，分别刻画单个更新方向的相对偏好及协同优化的额外收益；再将离线证据摊销为轻量控制器，直接估计当前优化偏好并对训练目标施加有界调制。
AI.result: 在NeRSemble数据集上的实验验证了所提设计的有效性，持续优于现有方法，并保留了更清晰的局部面部结构与更精细的细节。
AI.conclusion: 以反事实路线前瞻替代预定义启发式加权，可状态自适应地识别更有益的优化方向，实现几何与外观的协调优化，提升高斯头部化身的建模质量。

title: MIRROR: From Imitation to Internalization in LLM Personalization
summary: The demand for personalized LLMs is shifting from style imitation toward content quality. We investigate whether self-distillation can bridge this gap in existing fine-tuning paradigm. To address this limitation, we introduce MIRROR(Meta- personalization by Internalizing Reference-Revealed On-policy Reflections), a novel self-distillation framework that shifts LLM personalization from imitation toward preference internalization. First, we replace reference-token imitation with reference-revealed on-policy self-distillation, aligning the model's next-token distributions along its own generation trajectories with those of its reference-conditioned self, thereby internalizing user preferences rather than reproducing reference wording.Second, we introduce MIRROR-F, a focal plug-in that augments on-policy distributional alignment with selective supervision over informative reference tokens, thereby strengthening content generation while preserving user-specific expression. Across three personalized generation benchmarks, two model scales, and complementary reference-based and LLM-based evaluations, MIRROR and MIRROR-F achieve leading overall personalization performance and superior text quality, while exhibiting less catastrophic forgetting than SFT-based baselines on three unseen personalized generation tasks. The gains are consistent across model scales and application scenarios, translating to improved performance in LLM personalization tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MIRROR 自蒸馏框架，将 LLM 个性化从参考文本模仿转向偏好内化，并通过 MIRROR-F 插件增强内容质量，在多项基准上取得领先的个性化与文本质量表现。
AI.motivation: 个性化 LLM 的需求正从风格模仿转向内容质量，但现有微调范式难以弥合这一差距，作者探究自蒸馏能否解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出 MIRROR（Meta-personalization by Internalizing Reference-Revealed On-policy Reflections）自蒸馏框架：一是用"参考揭示的在线自蒸馏"替代参考 token 模仿，沿模型自身生成轨迹对齐其下一 token 分布与"参考条件化的自身"的分布，从而内化用户偏好；二是引入 MIRROR-F 焦点插件，在在线分布对齐基础上对信息量高的参考 token 施加选择性监督。
AI.result: 在三个个性化生成基准、两种模型规模以及基于参考与基于 LLM 的评测下，MIRROR 与 MIRROR-F 取得领先的整体个性化性能和更优的文本质量；在三个未见个性化生成任务上，相比基于 SFT 的基线表现出更少的灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 收益在不同模型规模与应用场景下保持一致，能够转化为 LLM 个性化任务的性能提升，表明自蒸馏可有效实现从模仿到偏好内化的范式转变。

title: Beyond Masks and Trajectories: Flow-Guided Latent Action Injection for Stable Surgical Video Generation
summary: Surgical video generation holds substantial potential for surgical education, simulation, and data augmentation, yet generating surgical videos with realistic and clinically plausible motion remains challenging. Most existing methods rely on auxiliary conditions, such as masks, trajectories, depth, or reference videos, to achieve visually plausible synthesis. Yet, these auxiliary conditions typically require additional manual annotation or specialized acquisition, making it difficult to scale such methods beyond small, curated datasets. This motivates the need for a reference-free architecture capable of generating high-quality surgical video without requiring auxiliary visual conditions at inference time. We propose FLAIR, a Flow-guided LatentAction Injection framework for Reference-free surgical video generation. FLAIR learns action priors from optical flow of real surgical videos, dynamically predicts corresponding latent action representation from an input prompt, and injects it into a frozen base model to generate surgical videos with improved action consistency. We further construct SurgActionClip-30K, the first large-scale surgical vision dataset comprising action-centric segmented clips and structured caption labels, addressing the persistent lack of fine-grained, action-centric surgical datasets. Lastly, we introduce SurgMetrics, the first surgical domain-specific evaluation metrics for quantifying the quality of generated surgical videos, addressing the persistent absence of clinically grounded evaluation standards in this domain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FLAIR enables generating high-quality surgical videos using text-only inference without auxiliary conditions, and validation in SurgMetrics demonstrates its strength in alignment with human perception compared to traditional metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出FLAIR框架，实现无需辅助条件的参考自由手术视频生成，并构建数据集SurgActionClip-30K与评估指标SurgMetrics。
AI.motivation: 手术视频生成对手术教育、仿真和数据增强具有重要价值，但现有方法依赖掩码、轨迹、深度或参考视频等辅助条件，需额外人工标注或专门采集，难以扩展到大规模数据集。因此需要一种推理时无需辅助视觉条件的参考自由架构。
AI.method: FLAIR（Flow-guided Latent Action Injection）从真实手术视频的光流中学习动作先验，根据输入提示动态预测对应的潜在动作表示，并将其注入冻结的基座模型，以提升生成视频的动作一致性。同时构建首个大规模手术视觉数据集SurgActionClip-30K（动作中心的分段片段与结构化字幕标签），并提出首个手术领域专用评估指标SurgMetrics。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FLAIR仅用文本推理、无需辅助条件即可生成高质量手术视频；在SurgMetrics上的验证显示其与人类感知的对齐程度优于传统指标。
AI.conclusion: FLAIR为参考自由、文本驱动的手术视频生成提供了可行方案，并通过新数据集与领域专用指标弥补了数据与评估标准的空白。

title: DisParQ: Self-Supervised Part Concepts for Interpretable Vision Foundation Models
summary: Concept-based vision models represent images through an intermediate layer of human-inspectable concepts, so what a model relies on can be traced to those concepts. However, those models are often limited to fixed categories or depend on language to define their concepts. We introduce DisParQ (Discrete Parts with Quantized attributes), a method that learns spatially grounded, discrete concept representations from a powerful frozen vision-only self-supervised backbone. It requires no class labels and no language supervision. Each image patch is assigned to exactly one concept from a learnable prototype dictionary, and only a sparse subset of concepts may activate per image. To capture how each concept varies across images (e.g., the type of a "wheel"), we learn continuous residuals alongside the concepts and then quantize them into discrete attributes. A spatial decoder reconstructs the backbone's representation from the concepts and attributes alone, so successful reconstruction means that the discrete representation preserves the backbone's information. We evaluate DisParQ across seven datasets, from general recognition (ImageNet, PartImageNet, Places) to fine-grained benchmarks (CUB, Cars, Dogs, Flowers). We show that DisParQ closely matches its frozen DINOv2 teacher on ImageNet linear probing (83.2% top-1), achieves higher concept consistency than language-aligned models, remains competitive on fine-grained recognition, and enables cross-category part-based retrieval.

AI.tldr: DisParQ 从冻结的纯视觉自监督骨干中学习空间定位的离散概念表示，无需类别标签和语言监督，通过概念加离散属性重构骨干特征。
AI.motivation: 现有基于概念的视觉模型受限于固定类别，或依赖语言来定义概念，限制了其通用性与可解释性。
AI.method: 将每个图像块分配给可学习原型字典中的唯一概念，且每张图仅稀疏激活部分概念；学习连续残差并量化为离散属性以刻画概念变化；用空间解码器仅凭概念与属性重构骨干表示，重构成功即代表离散表示保留了骨干信息。
AI.result: 在七个数据集上评测，ImageNet 线性探测达 83.2% top-1，接近冻结的 DINOv2 教师；概念一致性高于语言对齐模型；在细粒度识别上具有竞争力，并支持跨类别基于部件的检索。
AI.conclusion: DisParQ 证明无需标签与语言监督即可从纯视觉自监督骨干学到可解释、空间定位的离散概念表示，兼顾性能与概念一致性。

title: Concentration, Not Uncertainty: Why Targeted Synthetic Data Doesn't Help Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged object detection requires pixel-accurate masks, but obtaining such annotations is slow and costly, making synthetic training images an attractive alternative. Under a fixed generation budget, however, it remains unclear which real-image regions to target for synthetic data generation. We study an uncertainty-guided generation strategy that clusters the unlabelled real images, identifies clusters on which the model is least certain, allocates synthetic generation toward those clusters, and iteratively retrains the model. Across 103 training runs, uncertainty-based targeting does not outperform random allocation. Five independent controls further show that this null result is not an artifact: targeted training sets are measurably different from random sets, but the difference is explained by concentrating the generation budget rather than by where uncertainty is concentrated, as every concentration rule we test reproduces the effect and, on boundary accuracy, so does aiming at the clusters the model was most certain about. Separately, we find substantial data contamination in CHAMELEON, with 50 of its 76 images duplicated from training data despite the standard overlap check reporting zero overlap. Together, these results show that, under a fixed synthetic-data budget, budget concentration, not uncertainty-based targeting, accounts for the observed training-set effects.

AI.tldr: 在固定合成数据预算下，按不确定性定位生成合成数据并不优于随机分配；起作用的因素是预算集中，而非不确定性定位，且CHAMELEON数据集存在严重数据污染。
AI.motivation: 伪装目标检测需像素级掩码，标注代价高，合成图像成为替代方案；但固定生成预算下，应针对哪些真实图像区域生成合成数据尚不清楚，因此需要检验"不确定性引导生成"策略是否有效。
AI.method: 提出不确定性引导生成策略：对未标注真实图像聚类，找出模型最不确定的簇，将合成生成预算倾斜到这些簇，并迭代重训练。共进行103次训练运行，并设计五项独立对照实验，检验目标化训练集与随机训练集的差异来源。
AI.result: 不确定性定位未优于随机分配。对照实验显示：目标化训练集确实与随机集可测地不同，但该差异可由"预算集中"解释——所有集中规则都能复现该效应；在边界精度上，瞄准模型最确定的簇也产生同样效应。此外发现CHAMELEON数据集严重污染：76张图像中50张与训练数据重复，而标准重叠检查报告零重叠。
AI.conclusion: 在固定合成数据预算下，训练集效应由预算集中而非不确定性定位造成；不确定性引导生成在该设定下缺乏优势，同时数据集评测需警惕现有重叠检查漏检的污染问题。

title: Efficient 3D Gaussian Head Avatars for Edge Devices
summary: Generative 3D Gaussian head avatars provide high-quality, efficient rendering, but synthesising the Gaussian representation remains computationally expensive, limiting deployment on resource-constrained and edge devices. We introduce an efficient generator architecture for unconditional 3D Gaussian head synthesis, based on a parameter-efficient synthesis block and depth-wise separable convolutions while retaining style-based conditioning. Our architecture reduces generator complexity without requiring model compression or quantisation. Compared with the baseline model, our approach reduces FLOPs by 94%, parameter count by 70%, and model size by 81%, while maintaining competitive generation quality. We further demonstrate practical CPU inference and browser-based execution on mobile devices using ONNX Runtime, enabling 3D Gaussian avatar synthesis without dedicated GPU hardware or application-specific software. In addition to conventional image-quality metrics, we evaluate multi-view consistency, training cost, and deployment performance. Code, trained models, and evaluation tools will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效的3D高斯头部Avatar生成器，采用参数高效合成模块与深度可分离卷积，在保持风格条件机制的同时将FLOPs降低94%、参数量降低70%、模型体积降低81%，并实现移动端浏览器CPU推理。
AI.motivation: 生成式3D高斯头部Avatar虽渲染质量高、效率好，但高斯表示的合成计算开销大，难以部署在资源受限的边缘设备上；作者希望在无需模型压缩或量化的前提下降低生成器复杂度。
AI.method: 基于参数高效的合成模块（synthesis block）与深度可分离卷积构建无条件3D高斯头部合成生成器架构，同时保留style-based条件机制；并通过ONNX Runtime实现CPU推理与移动端浏览器执行。
AI.result: 相较基线模型，FLOPs减少94%，参数量减少70%，模型体积减少81%，生成质量保持竞争力；实现了移动设备上无需专用GPU硬件或特定应用软件即可进行3D高斯Avatar合成。除常规图像质量指标外，还评估了多视角一致性、训练成本与部署性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构层面的高效设计而非压缩/量化，可在维持生成质量的同时大幅降低3D高斯头部Avatar生成器的计算与存储开销，使其具备在边缘及移动设备上实际部署的能力；代码、训练模型与评估工具将公开。

title: UltraText Bench: A Comprehensive Bilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Image Generation
summary: Dense visual text requires image generators to reproduce long strings across multiple regions with correct placement and legibility. As short-string rendering improves, evaluation must test sustained performance across more demanding scenes. We introduce UltraText Bench, a bilingual benchmark for prompt-only generation of dense visual text. It contains 432 prompts spanning 24 real-world scene categories and three difficulty levels, split equally between English and Chinese. Each human-reviewed prompt supplies exact strings for four to twelve text regions, paired with structured references for their content, placement, and visual attributes. We use the Q-Judger vision-language model to assess each image against the complete reference, reporting text fidelity, text clarity, spatial quality, and scene quality. Across 24 model configurations, these dimensions reveal different strengths: Z-Image-Turbo gains 3.81 clarity points over Z-Image-Base while losing 14.76 fidelity points under the reported settings. Performance also varies with workload; Qwen-Image-2512's English composite falls from 86.50 at L1 to 42.86 at L3. Ten participants took part in human evaluation of the automatic scores. Repository: https://github.com/LINs-lab/UltraText_Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UltraText Bench，一个面向密集视觉文本纯提示生成的中英双语基准，包含 432 条覆盖 24 类真实场景、三个难度等级的提示，并提供结构化参考与 Q-Judger 自动评估框架。
AI.motivation: 随着短字符串渲染能力提升，现有评测已不足以检验模型在更苛刻场景中跨多区域生成长字符串的持续性能，因此需要面向密集视觉文本的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 432 条中英各半的提示，覆盖 24 个真实场景类别与三个难度等级；每条提示经人工审核，指定 4 至 12 个文本区域的精确字符串，并提供内容、位置与视觉属性的结构化参考；采用 Q-Judger 视觉语言模型对生成图像与完整参考进行比对，从文本保真度、文本清晰度、空间质量和场景质量四个维度打分。
AI.result: 在 24 个模型配置上，各维度呈现不同优势：在报告设置下，Z-Image-Turbo 相比 Z-Image-Base 清晰度提升 3.81 分，但保真度下降 14.76 分；性能随工作负载变化，Qwen-Image-2512 的英文综合分从 L1 的 86.50 降至 L3 的 42.86；10 名参与者参与了自动评分的human评估。
AI.conclusion: UltraText Bench 为密集视觉文本生成提供了细粒度、多维度且经人工校验的评测手段，揭示了模型在清晰度与保真度之间的权衡以及难度敏感性问题，代码与数据已开源。

title: MOTIF: Person-of-Interest Deepfake Detection Beyond 3DMM Coefficients
comment: 6 pages. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Information Forensics and Security (WIFS)
summary: Video deepfakes targeting a specific individual, the Person-of-Interest (POI), are the most harmful ones, and, since a public figure is abundantly recorded, a detector can be built from genuine footage of that individual. Such detectors commonly describe a subject through a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) and adopt its coefficients as a whole, so which part of that description carries the signal has never been measured. We dissect it, holding the encoder, the training corpus and the enrollment protocol fixed and varying only what the encoder observes. The groups of coefficients prove largely redundant, since the shape block alone recovers almost all the accuracy of the full vector, and their temporal evolution contributes a real but bounded amount. We further show that the dense surface the same fit returns, which these detectors discard, carries identity information that the coefficients do not, and that it helps precisely where they are weakest. We assemble the best configuration into MOTIF, a visual-only detector trained on real videos only, with no manipulated video and no POI-specific data. It improves on both state-of-the-art POI detectors in every dataset and manipulation of our benchmark and at two quality levels. Our experimental code will be released at https://github.com/polimi-ispl/MOTIF.

AI.tldr: 该论文对基于3DMM系数的POI深度伪造检测器进行解构分析，发现形状系数块几乎可恢复全系数向量的全部准确率、系数组高度冗余，而同一拟合得到的密集表面（通常被丢弃）携带系数之外的额外身份信息。作者据此构建了仅用真实视频训练的视觉检测器MOTIF，在基准上全面超越现有POI检测器。
AI.motivation: 针对特定个体（Person-of-Interest, POI）的视频深度伪造危害最大，且公众人物真实影像充足，可据此构建检测器。但现有检测器通常用3DMM描述被检对象并整体使用其系数，从未测量描述中哪一部分真正携带判别信号，因此需要对该表征进行解构以明确有效成分。
AI.method: 固定编码器、训练语料与注册协议，仅改变编码器所观测的输入，逐组变化3DMM系数进行消融；进一步考察同一3DMM拟合返回但被现有检测器丢弃的密集表面，并将其与系数表征结合，组装成视觉单模态检测器MOTIF。
AI.result: 各系数组之间高度冗余：仅用形状（shape）系数块即可恢复接近全系数向量的准确率；系数的时间演化贡献真实但有限。同一拟合的密集表面携带系数不具备的身份信息，且恰在系数表现最弱处提供增益。MOTIF仅用真实视频训练（无伪造视频、无POI专属数据），在基准的全部数据集与全部操纵类型上、以及两个质量层级下，均优于两种最先进的POI检测器。
AI.conclusion: 3DMM系数表征中真正有效的判别信号主要集中于形状块，整体向量存在大量冗余；被丢弃的密集表面是补充性身份线索。基于该解构结果构建的MOTIF证明：仅依赖真实视频、无需伪造样本与POI专属数据，也能实现优于现有POI检测器的视觉单模态检测性能。代码将开源。

title: A Deafening Silence: Catastrophic Forgetting Lives in the Output Embeddings of Tokens the Data Never Speaks
summary: Continual pre-training and fine-tuning in Large Language Models (LLMs) inevitably induce catastrophic forgetting, typically mitigated by replay using often-inaccessible original data. In this data-free regime, we analyze where forgetting occurs and why. Systematic parameter freezing across five settings up to 1.4B reveals that forgetting concentrates selectively in the output embeddings of tokens rarely seen in the new corpus, whereas the same sqrt(v-hat) band of the body is inert and new learning resides elsewhere. This localization is governed by the vocabulary deficiency of the corpus rather than the training mode, allowing pre-retraining risk ranking from token counts alone within a fixed base model. Mechanistically, absent tokens receive persistent one-sided softmax gradients that Adam's second-moment (sqrt(v-hat)) normalization amplifies into full-sized updates. We therefore propose an intervention: raising Adam's epsilon exclusively for the output projection during training. Across eight settings spanning 160M to 12B parameters and four model families, this removes 39.4% to 67.9% of forgetting across all seven stable configurations without degrading target learning or requiring per-model tuning. The defense combines additively or better with replay (79.8% on Qwen/Korean) and rescues released-head LoRA from a 23-fold forgetting surge. Because post-hoc editing of the drifted rows recovers under 5% of forgetting, the intervention must operate during training. Our findings indicate that a single-line optimizer adjustment may serve as the primary defense against catastrophic forgetting where the corpus starves the vocabulary.

AI.tldr: 本文发现无数据回放场景下的灾难性遗忘集中于输出嵌入层中低频词对应的行，机制为Adam二阶矩对缺失词的持续单侧softmax梯度进行放大，提出在训练中仅对输出投影层提高Adam的epsilon即可大幅缓解遗忘。
AI.motivation: 持续预训练与微调会引发灾难性遗忘，常用回放方法依赖原始数据，而原始数据在现实中往往不可得。作者希望在无数据（data-free）条件下，先厘清遗忘发生在何处、为何发生，从而找到不依赖原始数据的防御手段。
AI.method: 1）在最多1.4B参数、五种设置下进行系统性的参数冻结实验，定位遗忘的位置；2）从词汇覆盖角度分析成因，并与训练模式对比；3）机制分析：考察缺失词在softmax中的单侧梯度及Adam二阶矩（sqrt(v-hat)）归一化效应；4）提出干预：训练期间仅对输出投影（output projection）提高Adam的epsilon；5）在160M–12B、四个模型家族、八种设置下验证，并与回放、LoRA等方法结合测试；6）通过事后编辑漂移行验证干预必须在训练时进行。
AI.result: 1）遗忘选择性地集中在输出嵌入层中在新语料里罕见的token对应行，而body中相同的sqrt(v-hat)区间保持惰性、新知识存于别处；该局部化由语料的词汇缺失程度决定，而非训练模式，因而可仅凭token计数在固定基座模型上做预训练风险排序；2）机制上，缺失token获得持续的单侧softmax梯度，被Adam的二阶矩归一化放大为满幅更新；3）仅提高输出投影的Adam epsilon，在八种设置（160M–12B、四个模型家族、七个稳定配置）中消除39.4%–67.9%的遗忘，且不损害目标学习、无需逐模型调参；4）与回放叠加可加或更优（Qwen/韩语上79.8%），并使released-head LoRA从23倍遗忘激增中得到挽救；5）事后编辑漂移行仅能恢复不到5%的遗忘，说明该干预必须在训练中执行。
AI.conclusion: 在语料使词汇覆盖严重不足的场景下，遗忘可通过一行优化器调整（提高输出投影的Adam epsilon）作为首要防御手段，且与回放等方法兼容；由于事后修复几乎无效，防御必须在训练过程中介入。

title: ORCA: Hunting Compositional Failures in Text-to-Image Diffusion
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models fail predictably on compositional prompts: attributes bind to the wrong objects, spatial relations invert, and multi-object scenes lose count. Recent architectures already augment CLIP with a T5 encoder precisely because CLIP's contrastive embedding loses compositional structure, yet these failures persist. We argue the binding problem is therefore not one of missing information but of misaligned information: a text encoder preserves compositional structure, but in a representation space shaped by language modelling rather than vision, and the denoising objective does not directly reward aligning the two. We show this correspondence can be supplied as an explicit training signal, that the relevant cross-modal information is concentrated in a low-rank subspace of self-supervised visual features, and that supplying it can be folded into diffusion training as a single auxiliary loss. Our method, ORCA (Orthogonal Residual Compositional Alignment), aligns the latent of a diffusion transformer with a low-rank target derived from a frozen visual encoder, through a predictor whose orthogonal basis is parameterised by a learned residual between T5 and CLIP embeddings, which provides a prompt-dependent signal for selecting the visual readout subspace. We prove that the cross-modal information recoverable at a given rank is bounded by the spectral mass of the visual encoder's covariance in the top components. Across three diffusion-transformer backbones (DiT-B/2, DiT-L/2, U-ViT-L), ORCA improves FID and GenEval over both vanilla and REPA baselines at zero inference-time cost; on DiT-L/2 it reaches FID 16.65 and GenEval 0.291 at 200K steps, exceeding the strongest 400K baseline at half the training cost, with the largest gains concentrated on attribute binding, spatial relations, and multi-object prompts.

AI.tldr: 提出 ORCA 方法：通过单一辅助损失，将低秩视觉表征对齐信号注入扩散训练，以零推理开销改善组合式文生图的属性绑定、空间关系与多物体生成。
AI.motivation: 文生图扩散模型在组合式提示上存在可预测性失败（属性错绑、空间关系反转、多物体计数丢失）。作者认为根本原因并非文本编码器缺失组合结构（T5 已保留），而是信息错位：文本表征处于语言建模空间而非视觉空间，且去噪目标未直接奖励跨模态对齐。
AI.method: ORCA（Orthogonal Residual Compositional Alignment）将跨模态对应关系显式化为训练信号：把扩散 Transformer 的潜变量对齐到由冻结视觉编码器导出的低秩目标；预测器的正交基由 T5 与 CLIP 嵌入之间的学习残差参数化，从而提供依赖提示的视觉读出子空间选择；该对齐以单一辅助损失形式折叠进扩散训练。理论上证明给定秩下可恢复的跨模态信息受视觉编码器协方差前若干主成分谱质量上界约束。
AI.result: 在 DiT-B/2、DiT-L/2、U-ViT-L 三种扩散 Transformer 骨干上，ORCA 在零推理成本下同时改善 FID 与 GenEval，优于 vanilla 与 REPA 基线；DiT-L/2 在 200K 步达到 FID 16.65、GenEval 0.291，以一半训练成本超过最强 400K 基线，增益主要集中于属性绑定、空间关系与多物体提示。
AI.conclusion: 组合式生成失败可由显式跨模态对齐信号缓解，其中关键信息集中于自监督视觉特征的低秩子空间；将该对齐作为单一辅助损失即可有效注入扩散训练，在提升组合式生成质量的同时不增加推理开销。

title: For Those Who Believe in Faithfulness: Optimizing the Area Under Insertion and Deletion Curves for Ranking Relative Feature Importance
summary: The adoption of machine learning for socially relevant tasks requires effective explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods to better understand the behavior of machine learning models. Attribution methods are a popular XAI approach in which input-output relationships are characterized by heat maps that reflect the relative importance of input features for a particular prediction. The quality of such maps is often assessed by measuring faithfulness based on the area under insertion and deletion curves, which measures changes in the model output as features are added and removed. In this study, we derive an objective function from this notion of faithfulness and a way to approximate its gradient. We establish the connection between insertion curves and top-$k$ feature selection, which leads to a loss function measuring the quality of attributions. Randomization of the loss allows us to efficiently approximate its gradient. To show the effectiveness of the general approach, we combine the loss function with the neural explanation mask framework. The resulting method, termed Ra-NEM, can be used with any differentiable model without affecting the model's performance. Experiments demonstrate that Ra-NEM provides accurate attributions robustly and efficiently. Compared to other algorithms, the attributions have not only higher faithfulness but also perform well in terms of other XAI metrics. The high inference speed of Ra-NEM makes the method suitable for online applications. The code is available online: https://github.com/baerminator/Ra_Nem

AI.tldr: 本文将归因方法的忠实性（插入/删除曲线下面积）与top-k特征选择建立联系，导出可微损失并用随机化高效近似其梯度，结合神经解释掩码框架提出Ra-NEM，在任意可微模型上获得更忠实、鲁棒且高速的归因。
AI.motivation: 面向社会相关任务的机器学习需要有效的可解释AI方法；归因方法（热力图）的质量常以插入/删除曲线下面积衡量的忠实性来评估，但如何直接优化这一忠实性指标、并高效获取其梯度仍是挑战。
AI.method: 从忠实性概念出发推导目标函数及其梯度近似：建立插入曲线与top-k特征选择的联系，得到衡量归因质量的损失函数；通过对损失进行随机化高效近似其梯度；将该损失与神经解释掩码（NEM）框架结合，得到Ra-NEM，适用于任意可微模型且不影响模型性能。
AI.result: 实验表明Ra-NEM能稳定且高效地给出准确归因；相比其他算法，其归因不仅忠实性更高，在其他XAI指标上也表现良好；推断速度快，适合在线应用。
AI.conclusion: 通过将忠实性目标与top-k特征选择关联并随机化近似梯度，可在不改动模型的前提下训练高质量归因；Ra-NEM在忠实性、鲁棒性、多指标表现与速度上均具优势，代码已开源。

title: Hard, Yet Reducible: Controlled Forward Transfer for Synthetic Degradation Curation
summary: Selecting synthetic degradations for dense prediction requires an estimate of their training utility, the generalization gain they bring under a finite training budget. Clean and degraded twins share content and labels, suggesting a score based on how much short training reduces the excess error caused by degradation. However, this gap can also shrink when clean performance deteriorates. Measuring the improvement on degraded images alone avoids that confound, but it still credits progress that the same amount of clean training would have produced. We propose the \textbf{controlled Reducible Degradation Gap} (cRDG) for regions defined by degradation type and severity. From a common checkpoint, cRDG runs two budget-matched probes that differ only in one augmentation slot, which holds either a synthetic degradation or a clean augmentation. The score is the gain on held-out degraded images relative to the clean-control probe. Clean harm is a separate feasibility constraint. cRDG reveals a correctable severity band in which training on the degradation yields high controlled gain under the available budget, and the band moves with the predictor, the starting checkpoint, and the training budget. \textbf{Curation of Reducible Bands} (\method) uses cRDG to select synthetic data without changing the predictor. On semantic segmentation and salient object detection, \method{} improves representative predictors under matched synthetic-data budgets and training schedules, extends to existing data-generation pipelines, and preserves clean performance. Code and supporting materials will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可控可削减退化差距（cRDG）指标以评估合成退化在稠密预测任务中的训练效用，并基于此构建Reducible Bands整编方法选择合成数据，在语义分割与显著目标检测上提升代表性预测器并保持干净性能。
AI.motivation: 为稠密预测选择合成退化需要估计其训练效用，即有限训练预算下带来的泛化增益。但干净与退化孪生样本共享内容与标签，直接以过度误差差距为分数会受干净性能下降的混淆；仅看退化图像上的提升又会误算干净训练本身即可带来的进步。因此需要一个能剥离这些混淆的效用度量。
AI.method: 提出可控可削减退化差距（cRDG）：在按退化类型与严重程度划分的区域上，从同一检查点出发运行两个预算匹配的探针，二者仅在一个增强槽位上不同——分别放入合成退化或干净增强。分数为在留出退化图像上相对于干净对照探针的增益，干净性能损害作为单独的可行性约束。基于cRDG的Reducible Bands整编方法据此在不改变预测器的前提下选择合成数据。
AI.result: cRDG揭示出一个可纠正的严重程度带，在该带内训练退化数据可在现有预算下获得高可控增益，且该带随预测器、起始检查点和训练预算变化。在语义分割与显著目标检测上，Reducible Bands在匹配的合成数据预算与训练计划下提升了代表性预测器，可扩展至现有数据生成流程，并保持干净性能。
AI.conclusion: cRDG提供了一种与预算匹配、剥离混淆因素的合成退化训练效用度量，Reducible Bands据此实现合成数据整编，在稠密预测任务上有效且兼容现有流程，代码与材料将公开释放。

title: DeltaSplat: Iterative Gaussian Refinement for Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructs a scene from sparse, unposed images in a single network pass, removing the need for camera calibration and per-scene optimization. However, camera estimation errors propagate into the predicted Gaussians and compound the geometric and photometric inaccuracies of single-pass prediction. To correct these errors, we introduce DeltaSplat, a lightweight Gaussian refinement module for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS. It iteratively renders the current Gaussians at the input context views and predicts per-Gaussian updates from the resulting residuals. A 2D residual alone, however, underdetermines the 3D correction. DeltaSplat therefore conditions each update on per-pixel Plücker rays and rendered depth as a soft geometric prior. A dual-branch convolutional mixer efficiently encodes these inputs, and per-attribute heads decode the fused features into position, opacity, and color updates. The module adds only ~2.2% parameters to the backbone and remains fully feed-forward at inference. On DL3DV, DeltaSplat reaches 26.64 dB PSNR in the pose-free setting, improving its state-of-the-art backbone by 1.75 dB and surpassing even baselines supplied with ground-truth cameras; consistent gains hold across 6-24 views and all camera regimes.

AI.tldr: DeltaSplat是一种轻量级高斯细化模块，用于无位姿前馈3DGS，通过迭代渲染与残差预测校正相机估计误差，仅增加约2.2%参数，在DL3DV上达到26.64 dB PSNR。
AI.motivation: 无位姿前馈3DGS在单次网络前向中从稀疏、未标定图像重建场景，但相机估计误差会传播到预测的高斯中，加剧单次预测的几何与光度不准确性，因此需要对这些误差进行校正。
AI.method: 提出DeltaSplat细化模块：在输入上下文视图迭代渲染当前高斯，依据渲染残差预测每个高斯的更新。由于仅用2D残差无法确定3D校正，模块以逐像素Plücker射线和渲染深度作为软几何先验进行条件化；采用双分支卷积混合器高效编码输入，并通过逐属性头解码融合特征为位置、不透明度和颜色更新。
AI.result: 在DL3DV数据集上，DeltaSplat在无位姿设定下达到26.64 dB PSNR，较其最先进骨干提升1.75 dB，甚至超过提供真值相机的基线；在6-24视图及所有相机情形下均保持一致的增益。模块仅增加约2.2%参数，推理时保持完全前馈。
AI.conclusion: DeltaSplat以极小的参数开销有效校正了无位姿前馈3DGS中的相机估计误差传播，实现了无需逐场景优化的高质量重建，在多种视图与相机条件下均优于现有方法。

title: Training Advisors for LLM Agents from Task Outcomes
summary: Large language model agents tackle multi-step tasks by interleaving reasoning and tool calls with observations from the environment. Prior work has shown that natural-language feedback can help these agents revise their decisions during task execution. We introduce Caddie, a method for training critics to provide natural-language analysis and advice as agents work through a task. Unlike approaches that rely on step-level labels or reference critiques, Caddie learns from whether the agent ultimately succeeds after receiving the critic's feedback. We optimize the critic through reinforcement learning while keeping the base model frozen. Trained on multi-hop question answering with a single base model, our Qwen3-4B critic improves success rates across four base models of different scales and architectures, including three not used during critic training. On the MuSiQue benchmark, the trained critic improves Qwen3-4B's success rate by more than 25 percentage points, surpassing the performance of Kimi K3 without a critic. The same critic also yields gains on out-of-domain interactive benchmarks, including $τ^3$ and DeepDive, with no additional training. Our results show that agents can decide when to seek help from a critic at inference time and that outcome-based critic training can produce guidance that transfers across base models and task domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Caddie，一种以最终任务成败为奖励信号、用强化学习训练“评论家（critic）”的方法，使 critic 能在智能体执行多步任务过程中提供自然语言的分析与建议；训练时冻结基座模型。用 Qwen3-4B 训练出的 critic 可跨四种不同规模与架构的基座模型、以及多跳问答与域外交互式基准上稳定提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体通过交替进行推理与工具调用、并结合环境观测来完成多步任务，已有工作表明自然语言反馈有助于其在执行过程中修正决策。但既有 critic 训练方法依赖步骤级标注或参考评论（reference critiques），标注成本高、可扩展性差，且难以泛化。作者希望验证：能否仅凭“智能体收到反馈后最终是否成功”这一结果信号来训练 critic，并让所得指导跨模型、跨领域迁移。
AI.method: 1) 训练对象为 critic 模型，基座模型保持冻结（frozen），仅优化 critic；2) 奖励信号为结果驱动（outcome-based）：智能体在获得 critic 的自然语言分析与建议后，任务最终是否成功；3) 采用强化学习优化 critic，不依赖步骤级标签或参考评论；4) 在 multi-hop question answering 数据集上，使用单一基座模型（Qwen3-4B）训练 critic；5) 推理阶段由智能体自行决定何时向 critic 求助（decide when to seek help）。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen3-4B 训练得到的 critic 在四种不同规模与架构的基座模型上均提升成功率，其中三种基座模型未参与 critic 训练，体现跨模型迁移能力。在 MuSiQue 基准上，该 critic 使 Qwen3-4B 的成功率提升超过 25 个百分点，并超过无 critic 的 Kimi K3 的表现。同一 critic 在无需额外训练的情况下，在域外交互式基准 τ³ 与 DeepDive 上也取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明两点：第一，智能体可以在推理时自行判断何时寻求 critic 帮助；第二，基于最终结果（outcome-based）的 critic 训练能够产生可跨基座模型、跨任务领域迁移的指导。整体说明 critic 训练不必依赖昂贵的步骤级监督，具备良好的通用性与可扩展性。

title: DeepTopoClustering: Unsupervised Derivation of Surface Process Taxonomy from 4D Point Clouds for Topographic Monitoring
comment: Submitted to ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
summary: 4D point clouds acquired by permanent laser scanning (PLS) enable accurate high-frequency monitoring of surface change in dynamic topographic environments. However, existing methods remain limited in organizing detected surface activities into meaningful process types. We propose DeepTopoClustering (DTC), an unsupervised framework for deriving a hierarchical process taxonomy from object-based surface activities, so-called 4D objects-by-change (4D-OBCs). We transform each 4D-OBC into a GeoMorphogram, a distributional sequence representing the temporal evolution of topographic change within a spatially bounded surface activity. A convolutional autoencoder learns latent embeddings from GeoMorphograms, which are jointly optimized using a hierarchical deep clustering objective to organize surface activities into a hierarchy. We evaluate the learned hierarchy using expert annotations on two 4D datasets of sandy beach sites and their combination. DTC with GeoMorphograms achieves the highest agreement with expert judgment at the taxonomy level comprising eight major process types ($F_1=0.78$, match accuracy $=0.92$), outperforming dimensionality reduction and conventional flat clustering. The learned taxonomy separates major erosion- and deposition-dominated activities and distinguishes finer subtypes based on change magnitude, duration, compactness, and temporal evolution. DTC thus provides a scalable and interpretable route from 4D change detection to a data-driven, expert-supported surface process taxonomy, advancing automated knowledge derivation for understanding surface dynamics in topographic monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督框架DeepTopoClustering (DTC)，通过GeoMorphogram表示与卷积自编码器结合层次深度聚类，从4D点云地表活动中自动导出层次化过程分类体系，在沙滩数据集上取得与专家判断最高一致性。
AI.motivation: 永久激光扫描获得的4D点云可实现动态地形环境的高频地表变化监测，但现有方法难以将检测到的地表活动组织为有意义的"过程类型"，缺乏从4D变化检测到地表过程分类体系的自动化知识推导手段。
AI.method: DTC为无监督框架，面向基于对象的地表活动（4D objects-by-change, 4D-OBCs）。首先将每个4D-OBC转换为GeoMorphogram——表征空间受限地表活动内地形变化时间演化的分布序列；再用卷积自编码器学习潜嵌入，并通过层次深度聚类目标联合优化，将地表活动组织为层次结构。
AI.result: 在两个沙滩站点4D数据集及其组合上以专家标注评估：DTC+GeoMorphogram在含八种主要过程类型的分类层级上达到与专家判断最高一致性（F1=0.78，匹配精度=0.92），优于降维方法和常规平坦聚类。所学分类体系能区分侵蚀主导与沉积主导活动，并依据变化幅度、持续时间、致密度和时间演化区分更细子类型。
AI.conclusion: DTC提供了从4D变化检测到数据驱动、专家支持的地表过程分类体系的可扩展且可解释的路径，推动了地形监测中理解地表动态的自动化知识推导。

title: Global Average Precision for Representation Learning
summary: Standard information retrieval metrics, such as mean Average Precision (mAP), assess performance one query at a time, based on how the similarities between a query and its positives compare against those with its negatives. The same holds for common representation learning losses, such as InfoNCE and per-query AP surrogates. None of them considers whether similarities are comparable across queries, which any system with a single decision threshold relies on. Global Average Precision (gAP) does, by ranking all query-candidate pairs in one list and computing a single AP. We introduce gSAP, a differentiable surrogate of gAP. It needs only a similarity matrix and a binary matrix marking the positive pairs, the same input as existing losses, so it is a drop-in replacement for them and agnostic to the encoder, the modality, and the source of supervision. Since it considers all possible pairwise comparisons in the batch jointly, it also remains trainable at low temperatures, a regime where per-query surrogates run out of gradient. Swapping it into established recipes improves supervised metric learning, cross-modal alignment, and self-supervised pretraining, where, to our knowledge, it is the first ranking loss to replace the community standard InfoNCE in the latter two. Its similarities are more consistent across queries, which drives the gains under a universal threshold. gSAP retrieves up to four times as many positive pairs as the strongest AP surrogate at the same precision, and it degrades the least when queries with no positives in the database are added. Beyond thresholding, models trained with gSAP also learn better representations, with higher transfer, $k$NN and zero-shot classification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 gSAP，一种 gAP 的可微代理损失，可即插即用地替换现有检索式损失，提升监督度量学习、跨模态对齐与自监督预训练性能。
AI.motivation: 标准检索指标（如 mAP）和常用表征学习损失（InfoNCE、per-query AP 代理）逐查询评估相似度，不考虑相似度是否跨查询可比。而任何依赖单一决策阈值的系统都需要跨查询可比的相似度，gAP 虽满足此要求却不可微，难以直接用于训练。
AI.method: 提出 gSAP，即 gAP 的可微代理。它仅需相似度矩阵和标注正样本对的二值矩阵，与现有损失输入一致，因而可作为即插即用替代，且与编码器、模态和监督来源无关。由于在批次内联合考虑所有成对比较，它在低温度下仍可训练，而逐查询代理在此情形下梯度消失。
AI.result: 将 gSAP 替换进既有配方，在监督度量学习、跨模态对齐和自监督预训练中均取得提升，后两者中据称是首个替代社区标准 InfoNCE 的排序损失。其相似度跨查询更一致，在统一阈值下带来增益；相同精度下检索的正样本对数量最多为最强 AP 代理的四倍，加入无正样本查询时性能下降最小；除阈值化外，还学到更好表征，迁移、kNN 与零样本分类精度更高。
AI.conclusion: gSAP 作为 gAP 的可微代理，弥补了现有逐查询损失忽略跨查询相似度可比性的缺陷，兼具即插即用、低温度可训练的优势，并在多类任务中提升检索与表征质量。

title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
summary: Evaluating agents by outcomes alone can obscure the capabilities that produce them. This problem is especially pronounced in evolving environments, where outcomes reflect a closed-loop interaction between agent behavior and changing external conditions. We introduce LiveMACEBench, a process-aware benchmark that uses live financial markets as a naturally evolving testbed for persistent LLM agents. Five frontier LLMs operate along continuous trajectories under matched Tool Use, Persistent Memory, Rule Following, and Multi-Agent Collaboration configurations. We evaluate them through both realized outcomes and mechanism-specific diagnostics derived from complete decision traces. Across 30 days of live evaluation, we find a pronounced outcome-capability gap: realized returns often diverge from capability-specific measurements, and similar outcomes can arise from markedly different patterns of mechanism use. Trace-level diagnostics further expose distinct bottlenecks across capabilities, demonstrating that mechanism access, effective mechanism use, and downstream performance are not interchangeable measures of agent capability. LiveMACEBench makes this distinction measurable, turning live markets from a performance leaderboard into a diagnostic environment for agent capability

AI.tldr: 论文提出LiveMACEBench，一个以真实金融市场为动态测试环境的"过程感知"基准，通过结果指标与机制级诊断双轨评估，揭示LLM智能体的"结果—能力落差"。
AI.motivation: 仅以结果评估智能体会掩盖产生结果的能力。在动态演化环境中，结果反映的是智能体行为与外部条件之间的闭环交互，单一结果指标无法区分智能体是否真正具备某能力，因而需要过程感知的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建LiveMACEBench基准，以实时金融市场作为自然演化的测试床，部署5个前沿LLM作为持续运行的智能体，在工具使用、持久记忆、规则遵循、多智能体协作四种配置匹配条件下沿连续轨迹运行；基于完整决策轨迹同时采集结果指标与机制专属诊断指标。
AI.result: 30天实时评估发现显著的结果—能力落差：实际收益常与能力专属测量不一致，相似结果可能来自截然不同的机制使用模式；轨迹级诊断进一步揭示不同能力存在各自的瓶颈，说明"机制可获取""机制有效使用"与"下游表现"不可互换。
AI.conclusion: LiveMACEBench将"机制可获取—机制有效使用—下游表现"的区分变得可测量，把实时市场从性能排行榜转变为智能体能力的诊断环境。

title: Bringing BNNs to Fast Event Processing
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Accepted by NeVi Workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) enable efficient deep learning deployment on resource constrained devices with weights and activations compressed to one bit, substantially reducing model size and inference cost. Event cameras offer complementary advantages, including low latency, high dynamic range, and low power consumption, by capturing asynchronous streams of events rather than dense image frames. Despite their shared emphasis on efficiency, the combination of these technologies remains largely unexplored. This work aims at adapting and evaluating modern deep BNN architectures on event data. We also show that cross-modal pretraining from RGB data can improve the classification accuracy of BNNs on neuromorphic datasets. We introduce the Polar-wise Binary Event Volume (PBEV), a binary representation that enables event-camera data to be processed directly by BNNs and represents a step toward fully binarized event-based vision systems. Best evaluated BNN on N-Caltech101 classification benchmarks shows 90.58% accuracy with 7.5x less operations than their full-precision counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文将二值神经网络（BNN）与事件相机结合，提出极坐标二值事件体（PBEV）表示，使事件数据可直接被BNN处理，并发现RGB跨模态预训练能提升BNN在神经形态数据集上的精度；在N-Caltech101上最优BNN达90.58%精度，运算量比全精度模型少7.5倍。
AI.motivation: BNN可将权重与激活压缩至1比特，显著降低模型规模与推理开销，适合资源受限设备；事件相机以异步事件流捕捉信息，具备低延迟、高动态范围、低功耗优势。两者都强调高效性，但二者结合的研究仍基本空白，因此本文旨在适配并评估现代深度BNN架构在事件数据上的表现。
AI.method: 工作将现代深度BNN架构适配到事件数据上进行评估；提出Polar-wise Binary Event Volume（PBEV），一种二值化的事件表示，使事件相机数据能够直接被BNN处理，是迈向全二值化事件视觉系统的一步；同时利用RGB数据的跨模态预训练来提升BNN在神经形态数据集上的分类精度。
AI.result: 在N-Caltech101分类基准上，最佳BNN取得90.58%的准确率，同时运算量比对应的全精度模型少7.5倍。
AI.conclusion: BNN与事件相机的结合具备可行性并具高效性，PBEV表示实现了事件数据对BNN的直接输入，跨模态RGB预训练可有效提升BNN在神经形态数据上的精度，为全二值化事件视觉系统提供了方向。

title: SANet: Selective Attention Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection aims to accurately identify and locate dim targets in complex backgrounds and supports applications such as maritime surveillance and military search and rescue. However, the small size and weak contrast of infrared targets make it difficult to balance detection accuracy and false alarms. This paper proposes a selective attention network (SANet) for infrared small target detection. A dual-path semantic-aware module combines standard and pinwheel-shaped convolutions to preserve local spatial consistency and capture broader contextual information. Spatial and channel attention further refine the features and improve target-background discrimination. To address the limitations of static skip connections in U-Net, a selective attention fusion module adaptively integrates features across scales using spatially varying weights. It selectively enhances salient regions and improves discrimination between true targets and false alarms. Experiments on three public benchmarks, NUAA-SIRST, IRSTD-1K, and NUDT-SIRST, show that SANet achieves competitive performance in intersection over union (IoU), normalized IoU, detection probability, and false alarm rate. Its IoU exceeds that of the second-best method by 1.93, 4.32, and 2.21 percentage points, respectively. These results support the effectiveness of SANet in dim-target perception, discriminative feature representation, and background suppression.

AI.tldr: 提出选择性注意力网络SANet用于红外小目标检测，通过双路径语义感知模块、空间与通道注意力以及选择性注意力融合模块，在三个公开基准上取得竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标尺寸小、对比度弱，在复杂背景下难以兼顾检测精度与虚警率。同时，U-Net中静态跳跃连接限制了跨尺度特征的自适应融合能力。
AI.method: 1）双路径语义感知模块，结合标准卷积与风车形卷积，兼顾局部空间一致性与更广的上下文信息；2）空间注意力与通道注意力进一步细化特征，增强目标-背景区分度；3）选择性注意力融合模块替代U-Net静态跳跃连接，利用空间可变权重自适应融合跨尺度特征，选择性增强显著区域。
AI.result: 在NUAA-SIRST、IRSTD-1K、NUDT-SIRST三个公开基准上，SANet在IoU、nIoU、检测概率与虚警率上均表现竞争性；其IoU分别比次优方法高出1.93、4.32和2.21个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了SANet在暗弱小目标感知、判别性特征表示与背景抑制方面的有效性。

title: Safety-Oriented Trajectory Ranking from BEV Perception Outputs
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Vehicular Electronics and Safety (ICVES 2026). 6 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/UniBwTAS/bev-trajectory-eval
summary: Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) representations are increasingly used as compact inputs for autonomous driving perception and planning. However, lightweight and interpretable methods for evaluating candidate ego trajectories directly on BEV outputs remain useful for vehicular safety workflows, rapid prototyping, and human-in-the-loop validation. This paper presents a modular trajectory ranking pipeline that consumes BEVFusion object detections and map segmentations derived from nuScenes sensor data and ranks manually specified candidate trajectories according to safety-first criteria. The ranking prioritizes avoiding collisions and walkway violations, then smaller end distance to the target, and finally path efficiency. To study whether these rule-based rankings resemble human judgment, we created seven BEV traffic scenarios and compared the script output with preferences from a survey of 21 participants. Across 146 pairwise votes, 124 matched the trajectory ranked first by the evaluator, corresponding to an overall agreement of 84.9 %. The results indicate that simple BEV-centric safety heuristics can approximate human preferences in constrained trajectory choice tasks while remaining transparent enough for analysis, dataset curation, and autonomous driving studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个模块化的BEV轨迹排序流水线，基于BEVFusion检测与地图分割结果，按"安全优先"准则对人工指定候选轨迹排序，并与21名受试者的偏好调查对比，取得84.9%的一致率。
AI.motivation: BEV表示已广泛用作自动驾驶感知与规划的紧凑输入，但直接在BEV输出上评估候选自车轨迹的轻量、可解释方法仍有价值，可服务于车辆安全流程、快速原型验证与人机协同校验。
AI.method: 构建模块化轨迹排序流水线：输入nuScenes传感器数据经BEVFusion得到的物体检测与地图分割结果；对人工设定的候选轨迹按优先级排序——先避免碰撞与步道侵占，其次目标终点距离更小，最后路径效率更高。同时设计7个BEV交通场景，将脚本输出与21名参与者的偏好问卷进行成对比较。
AI.result: 在146组成对投票中，124组与评估器排名第一的轨迹一致，总体一致率为84.9%。
AI.conclusion: 简单的BEV中心化安全启发式可在受限轨迹选择任务中近似人类偏好，同时保持足够透明性，适用于分析、数据集筛选与自动驾驶研究。

title: Constrained-Action AI Remediation for SIEM/XDR via a NeMo-Guardrails Proxy
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR 2026)
summary: Security Operations Centers (SOCs) for information technology and operational technology share one incident-response problem: a flood of correlated alerts and too few analysts. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as reasoning engines that triage alerts and, in autonomous deployments, issue commands that block IPs, kill processes, or quarantine files on production hosts. This coupling introduces a new risk: a single adversarial alert can become a remote code path through the LLM's reasoning, leading it to recommend an action the SOC then executes. We present a constrained-action architecture with two coordinated layers: (i) a SIEM/XDR control plane that grounds remediation in correlated host events and confines the LLM's output to a closed intent vocabulary whose templated commands are executed by thin endpoint agents, backstopped by an argument validator; and (ii) a NeMo-Guardrails proxy that wraps the SOC-analyst LLM with input- and output-rail policies, evaluated out-of-the-box against a SOC-specific adversarial corpus we release. The stock proxy lifts injection recall from 25.0% to 94.5% at a 0.1% false-positive rate, and a live red-team exercise confirms that the closed intent vocabulary and argument validator contain the observed LLM failure modes before any command crosses the trust boundary. As an architectural fit (not yet a measured operational-technology deployment), the constrained-action property suits critical-infrastructure settings where a wrong remediation has physical, not merely operational, consequences. The loop is best run human-in-the-loop or delayed: the measured rail latency keeps inline control out of scope.

AI.tldr: 提出约束动作架构，通过闭合意图词汇表与NeMo-Guardrails代理两层防护，显著提升SOC场景下LLM的注入召回率并拦截危险处置命令。
AI.motivation: IT与OT的SOC共同面临告警洪流与分析师不足问题，LLM被用于告警分诊甚至自动执行阻断等命令，带来新风险：单个对抗性告警可能经由LLM推理变成远程代码路径，导致SOC执行非预期处置动作。
AI.method: 采用两层协同的约束动作架构：(i) SIEM/XDR控制平面，将修复动作锚定于关联主机事件，并把LLM输出限制在闭合意图词汇表内，由轻量端点代理执行模板化命令，并配有参数校验器兜底；(ii) NeMo-Guardrails代理，为SOC分析LLM包裹输入与输出护栏策略，并针对自建的SOC专用对抗语料库进行评估。
AI.result: 现成代理将注入召回率从25.0%提升至94.5%，误报率为0.1%；实时红队演练证实，闭合意图词汇表与参数校验器能在命令跨越信任边界前遏制所观察到的LLM失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 该约束动作属性在错误修复会产生物理后果的关键基础设施场景中具有架构适配性（尚非已实测的OT部署）。闭环宜采用人在回路或延迟执行方式，实测护栏延迟使在线控制暂不在适用范围。

title: FedSSMCoOp: SSM Encoders for light-weight Federated Prompt Learning for Few-shot Classification
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance across a wide range of downstream vision tasks, thanks to the complementary information contained in the respective domains. Despite the performance gains, most of these approaches rely on aligning these domains using the cosine similarity metric, which fails to capture token-level structure and cross-modal interactions prior to the classification stage. This is especially critical in biomedical applications under federated constraints, where data sharing is restricted, labeled data is scarce at each site, and it differs widely across institutions, leading to substantial statistical heterogeneity. To overcome this issue, we propose FedSSMCoOp, a federated few-shot image classification framework that enables multimodal learning while preserving data privacy. With the help of the SSM-based Vision Mamba and Cross Mamba blocks, and by optimizing only the soft-prompt and communication-prompt updates in the federated setting, the framework prioritizes both computation and performance. Importantly, this eliminates the need to use an external Large Language Model (LLM) for feature alignment. The framework is further trained and evaluated on various biomedical image datasets, and its performance is assessed. The proposed framework delivers stable performance relative to the baselines and is, on average, 1.96 times lighter. The corresponding script will be made available soon.

AI.tldr: 提出 FedSSMCoOp：一种联邦少样本图像分类框架，基于 SSM 的 Vision Mamba 与 Cross Mamba 模块，仅优化软提示与通信提示，实现隐私保护下的多模态学习，无需外部 LLM 对齐，平均比基线轻 1.96 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 方法多依赖余弦相似度进行模态对齐，无法在分类前捕捉 token 级结构与跨模态交互；在联邦生物医学场景中，数据不可共享、各站点标注稀缺且分布差异大，统计异质性显著，亟需一种兼顾隐私、性能与计算效率的对齐方案。
AI.method: 提出 FedSSMCoOp 联邦少样本图像分类框架：采用基于状态空间模型（SSM）的 Vision Mamba 和 Cross Mamba 模块进行多模态建模，在联邦设置下仅优化软提示（soft-prompt）与通信提示（communication-prompt）的更新，从而避免使用外部大语言模型进行特征对齐。
AI.result: 在多个生物医学图像数据集上训练与评估，性能相对基线保持稳定，且模型平均轻量化约 1.96 倍。代码将随后开源。
AI.conclusion: FedSSMCoOp 通过 SSM 架构与提示微调的联邦协同，在保护数据隐私的同时兼顾计算效率与分类性能，为联邦少样本生物医学多模态分类提供了无需外部 LLM 的轻量方案。

title: Inverting Multi-Vector Visual Document Indices
summary: Prevailing multi-vector visual document retrievers store each page as about a thousand patch vectors, often in vector databases run by a third party. Since no one can read a page from its vectors, this index is easily treated as less sensitive than the page. However, because the index keeps one vector per patch in raster order, and each vector is computed by a vision-language model pre-trained to read documents, we hypothesize that whoever runs or breaches the store can reproduce a page from its index alone. We frame inversion as conditional document image generation and infer from the vectors what the attack needs: the encoder, the page shape and, for shuffled vectors, their order. On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark, pages inverted from raw indices recover 47% of the words and 45% of the sensitive tokens. Used as queries against the stored indices, they rank their source page first 98.4% of the time. We test two cheap protections, token pooling and shuffling, which both cut word recall to about 8%. A model that restores the order of a shuffled index raises the share of source pages ranked first from 3.8% to 93.5%, while inverting a pooled index remains open. To test generalisation, we apply the same attack unchanged to another multi-vector retriever: its inverted pages still rank their source page first 70.2% of the time, though its word recall stays below a nearest-neighbour baseline. Multi-vector visual document retrievers are therefore vulnerable to inversion through their stored index, which should be protected like the documents it encodes.

AI.tldr: 多向量视觉文档检索器的索引（每页约千个patch向量）可被反演还原出原页面，ViDoRe v3上恢复47%词、45%敏感token，作为查询时98.4%将源页排第一；token池化与打乱两种低成本防护可将词召回降至约8%。
AI.motivation: 多向量视觉文档检索器通常把每页存为约千个patch向量，并常托管于第三方向量数据库。由于从向量无法"阅读"页面，该索引常被视为比页面本身更不敏感，从而疏于保护。作者假设：索引按栅格顺序保留每个patch的向量，且向量由预训练用于阅读文档的视觉-语言模型计算，因此任何运行或攻破该存储的人仅凭索引即可还原页面。
AI.method: 将索引反演建模为条件文档图像生成问题，并从向量出发推断攻击所需条件：编码器、页面形状，以及（对打乱向量而言）其顺序。在ViDoRe v3基准上以原始索引反演页面。测试两种低成本防护：token池化与向量打乱，并额外训练一个模型恢复被打乱索引的顺序。为验证泛化性，将同一攻击原样迁移到另一个多向量检索器。
AI.result: 原始索引反演出的页面可恢复47%的词和45%的敏感token；作为查询对存储索引检索时，98.4%的情况下将源页排在第一。token池化与打乱均将词召回降至约8%。顺序恢复模型将打乱索引的源页排第一比例从3.8%提升到93.5%，而对池化索引的反演仍属未解问题。迁移到另一多向量检索器时，反演页面仍以70.2%的概率将源页排第一，尽管其词召回低于最近邻基线。
AI.conclusion: 多向量视觉文档检索器通过其存储索引即存在反演漏洞，索引应与它所编码的文档受到同等保护。

title: Do Generative Priors Align with Human Naturalness Perception?
summary: Visual generative models are trained to capture the probability distributions of natural images, yet whether their native priors reflect the regularities governing human perception of image naturalness remains an open question. Here, we probe these priors through native prediction errors across 25 open image and video generators. Because raw single-image losses are dominated by scene content and visual complexity, we evaluate directional loss differences using content-preserving, paired relational interventions that selectively disrupt facial configurations or physical illumination consistency while limiting changes in low-level image statistics. Across both domains, these loss differences reproduce human-like selective sensitivities and tolerances, capturing the classic Thatcher effect on faces and shape-dependent responses to illumination inconsistencies. Notably, these loss differences reliably track continuous gradations of human naturalness judgments across individual stimulus pairs (peaking at $r = .84$ on faces and $.64$ on physical scenes) and retain unique human-aligned signals even after controlling for feature distances from frozen vision encoders and standard image quality metrics. We also find that while overall sensitivity to these violations broadly covaries with human alignment across models, the two systematically decouple along denoising schedules, with alignment peaking earlier than sensitivity, revealing that human-like naturalness judgments dissociate from generic violation detection. Together, these findings demonstrate that learning visual distributions yields generative loss landscapes that capture distinct aspects of human naturalness perception.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过25个开源图像/视频生成模型的"原生预测误差"探测其先验是否反映人类自然性感知规律，发现生成损失的定向差异可复现人类选择性敏感性与容忍度。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成模型学习自然图像的概率分布，但其内在先验是否编码了支配人类感知图像自然性的规律，仍是未解问题。
AI.method: 在25个开源图像与视频生成器上测量原生预测误差；由于单图原始损失受场景内容与视觉复杂度主导，采用内容保持的配对关系干预（选择性破坏面部构型或物理光照一致性，同时限制低层图像统计变化），评估方向性损失差异。
AI.result: 损失差异在两个域上复现了人类式的选择性敏感与容忍：面部出现经典撒切尔效应，物理场景呈现形状依赖的光照不一致响应。损失差异还能可靠追踪单个刺激对上的连续人类自然性判断梯度（面部 r = .84，物理场景 .64），且在控制冻结视觉编码器的特征距离与标准图像质量指标后仍保留独特的人类对齐信号。此外，整体违规敏感度与人类对齐度跨模型大致共变，但沿去噪调度系统解耦，对齐峰值早于敏感度峰值。
AI.conclusion: 学习视觉分布所产生的生成损失景观捕捉了人类自然性感知的不同侧面；类人自然性判断与通用违规检测相分离。

title: Itgan at NADI 2026 shared task: Parameter-Efficient Whisper Adaptation for Robust, Mixed-Dialect and Code-Switched Arabic ASR
summary: We describe the Itgan systems for the three ASR subtasks of NADI 2026, namely robust country-level ASR (1.1), mixed-dialect ASR (1.2), and Tunisian code-switched ASR (1.3). All three share one recipe, Whisper adapted with LoRA on consumer GPUs, and each was carried by a different addition to it. On 1.1, where the dialect label is given at test time, per-dialect specialists continued from a pooled adapter gave the largest gain, and the submitted system reached 57.1% country-average WER. A post-evaluation linear probe on frozen encoder features routes utterances without the label and recovers 44% of what oracle routing gives. On 1.2 the choice of base model mattered more than adapter capacity, and system combination helped only once we added a decorrelated member, reaching 46.7% WER. On 1.3 our system placed second at 14.49% WER with the lowest CER among the leading submissions, 5.38%. Its last 0.60 WER points came without further training, mostly from an exact weight-space average of independently trained runs, with ROVER voting adding the remainder. Every comparison carries a paired-bootstrap test, and we report eight directions that did not work.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Itgan 系统参加 NADI 2026 三个 ASR 子任务（1.1 鲁棒国家级 ASR、1.2 混合方言 ASR、1.3 突尼斯语码切换 ASR）的方案，共享同一套基于 Whisper+LoRA 的配方，并通过不同附加手段分别取得结果。
AI.motivation: 面向阿拉伯语方言 ASR 多子任务，需要在消费级 GPU 条件下构建统一、可复用的训练配方，并探索方言标签利用、底座模型选择与系统融合等关键因素。
AI.method: 统一配方为 Whisper 结合 LoRA 在消费级 GPU 上适配。1.1 在测试期给定方言标签，采用由 pooled adapter 继续训练的按方言专家模型，并额外进行冻结编码器特征上的线性探针路由；1.2 比较不同底座模型与适配器容量，并引入去相关成员做系统融合；1.3 采用无需再训练的权重空间精确平均，辅以 ROVER 投票。所有比较均配对待自举检验。
AI.result: 1.1 提交系统达 57.1% country-average WER；无标签线性探针路由可回收 oracle 路由收益的 44%。1.2 达 46.7% WER，底座模型选择比适配器容量更重要，且仅在加入去相关成员后系统融合才有效。1.3 以 14.49% WER 排名第二，CER 为领先提交中最低的 5.38%；其中最后 0.60 WER 的提升来自独立训练的权重空间平均，ROVER 投票贡献其余部分。
AI.conclusion: 在统一 Whisper+LoRA 配方下，按方言专家化、底座模型选择与去相关系统融合、权重空间平均加 ROVER 等针对性手段可有效提升各子任务表现；同时报告了八种未奏效的方向，强调结果需通过配对待自举检验验证。

title: Juno: Taming Predictive Latents for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict masked or future observations in representation space, offering a natural source of predictive latents for vision-language-action (VLA) models. Yet making these latents useful across pretraining, policy learning, and deployment requires addressing three failures: mismatch with embodiment-specific control, interference with action learning, and teacher miscalibration under distribution shifts. We introduce Juno, a unified framework built around one action-conditioned JEPA that serves as a control-aligned representation backbone, a predictive teacher, and an adaptable dynamics model. During pretraining, we train it on embodiment-matched trajectories and use a dynamic CLS loss to transfer motion-weighted patch dynamics to a compact global state. During policy learning, we fuse current-frame JEPA patches into VLA perception and use a decoupled reasoning branch with separate transformation parameters to distill future latent states for action generation. During deployment, we adapt the world model on all observed transitions, including failed rollouts, freeze the adapted teacher, and re-align the policy on verified executions using LoRA adapters and a trainable action head, without expert corrections or task rewards. On SimplerEnv, Juno raises average success from $60.9\%$ to $68.5\%$ over Qwen3GR00T, the strongest baseline, and test-time adaptation further reaches $72.7\%$; on a real robot, it retains $70\%$--$75\%$ success under background, height, and object shifts where the base policy collapses to $0\%$.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架Juno，围绕单一动作条件JEPA同时充当控制对齐表征骨干、预测教师与可适应动力学模型，覆盖预训练、策略学习与部署三阶段，在SimplerEnv与真机上显著提升成功率与分布偏移鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: JEPA在表征空间预测掩码或未来观测，可为VLA模型提供预测性潜变量，但存在三个失败点：(1) 与具体具身控制不匹配；(2) 与动作学习相互干扰；(3) 分布偏移下教师模型失准。论文旨在系统性地解决这三点，使潜变量在预训练、策略学习与部署全流程中可用。
AI.method: 构建Juno统一框架，核心为动作条件JEPA，承担控制对齐表征骨干、预测教师、可适应动力学模型三重角色。预训练：在具身匹配轨迹上训练，用动态CLS损失将运动加权patch动态迁移到紧凑全局状态。策略学习：将当前帧JEPA patch融合进VLA感知，采用解耦推理分支与独立变换参数蒸馏未来潜状态以生成动作。部署：在所有观测转移（含失败rollout）上适应世界模型，冻结适应后的教师，用LoRA适配器与可训练动作头在已验证执行上重新对齐策略，无需专家纠正或任务奖励。
AI.result: SimerEnv上平均成功率由最强基线Qwen3GR00T的60.9%提升至68.5%，测试时适应进一步达72.7%；真机在背景、高度、物体偏移下保持70%–75%成功率，而基线策略在这些偏移下跌至0%。
AI.conclusion: 单一动作条件JEPA可作为贯穿预训练、策略学习与部署的统一接口，有效解决控制不匹配、动作学习干扰与教师失准问题，且无需专家纠正或任务奖励即可实现鲁棒的测试时适应与分布偏移泛化。

title: Purifying Backdoored Large Vision-Language Models by Removing Hijacked Directions
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, yet they remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Defending against such attacks remains costly, as existing methods require either extensive retraining on clean data or per-query intervention at inference time. To address this limitation, we propose OrthoPurify, a more efficient method to purify backdoored model weights via one-step orthogonal projection. Specifically, through structural analysis of backdoor weight updates, we find that the backdoor is encoded by diverting a small number of weight update directions from task adaptation to backdoor shortcut encoding, a phenomenon we term direction hijacking. However, identifying these hijacked directions requires a benign reference model, which is typically inaccessible to the defender. We show that a pseudo-benign model, obtained by fine-tuning the pretrained weights on only a small set of clean samples, provides a sufficient approximation, as the dominant update directions stabilize within the first few gradient steps. OrthoPurify uses this pseudo-benign reference to isolate the hijacked directions and removes them through a single projection on the weight update. Extensive experiments show that OrthoPurify reduces the attack success rate to near zero while preserving the original performance across diverse benchmarks, without retraining the backdoored model or introducing inference-time overhead. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/womeimingzi/OrthoPurify.

AI.tldr: 提出 OrthoPurify，一种通过一步正交投影净化后门模型权重的高效方法，无需重训练或推理期干预。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）广泛用于安全关键场景，却易受后门攻击；现有防御方法要么需要在干净数据上大量重训练，要么需要在推理时逐查询干预，开销高昂。
AI.method: 通过结构分析后门权重更新，发现后门源于将少量权重更新方向从任务适配转向后门捷径编码（称为“方向劫持”）。识别被劫持方向需良性参考模型，而防御者通常无法获得。作者用小规模干净样本微调预训练权重得到伪良性模型作为近似，因为主导更新方向在前几步梯度即稳定。OrthoPurify 利用该伪良性参考隔离被劫持方向，并通过一次投影将其从权重更新中移除。
AI.result: 在多个基准上大量实验表明，OrthoPurify 将攻击成功率降至接近零，同时保持原始性能，且无需重训练后门模型，也不引入推理期开销。
AI.conclusion: OrthoPurify 为 LVLMs 后门防御提供了一种高效、低成本的权重净化方案，兼顾安全性与性能保持。

title: MSU Team at the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge 2026: Grounded Artifact Evidence for Deepfake Detection
summary: Recent advances in generative image models have made many manipulated images highly realistic, raising the need for detectors that are not only accurate but also able to provide visual evidence for their decisions. In this paper, we present our solution to the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge [2] on the XPlainVerse dataset [1], where systems are required to predict whether an image is real or fake and generate both complex and simple explanations grounded in visible forensic cues. Our method follows a modular detection-and-explanation design. For the real/fake decision, we build a multi-backbone detector that combines several DINOv3 models with Mesorch manipulation-localization features, bringing together pretrained visual representations, DCT-aware cues, and multi-scale forensic information. To inject explanation evidence into the detector, we use a Grounding-DINO-based pseudo-mask generation pipeline that converts local artifact descriptions from training explanations into weak patch- level supervision for an Artifact Evidence Map. We further introduce a local patch-level contrastive objective that separates artifact and authenticity evidence in the detector feature space without requiring paired images or pixel-level manipulation masks. For language output, we use class-conditional Qwen3-VL models to generate complex explanations for fake and real predictions, followed by a GRPO-optimized text simplification model. The proposed methods were trained and evaluated on the challenge subset of XPlainVerse. On the full test split, our submission achieves 0.9349 detection accuracy, 0.5571 explanation score, and a 0.7456 final challenge score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向可解释深度伪造检测挑战赛（XPlainVerse数据集）的模块化"检测+解释"方案，兼顾真假判别与复杂/简单解释生成，最终获得0.7456的挑战赛总分。
AI.motivation: 生成式图像模型使篡改图像高度逼真，检测器不仅需要准确，还需为决策提供可视化的取证证据，因此需要在检测的同时输出有依据的解释。
AI.method: 检测端采用多骨干DINOv3模型融合Mesorch篡改定位特征，结合预训练视觉表示、DCT感知线索与多尺度取证信息；通过基于Grounding-DINO的伪掩码生成流程，将训练解释中的局部伪影描述转为弱块级监督，构建Artifact Evidence Map；引入局部块级对比目标，在无需配对图像或像素级掩码的情况下分离伪影与真实证据。语言端用类条件Qwen3-VL生成复杂解释，再用GRPO优化的文本简化模型生成简单解释。
AI.result: 在XPlainVerse完整测试集上，检测准确率0.9349，解释得分0.5571，最终挑战赛得分0.7456。
AI.conclusion: 模块化检测与解释设计能有效结合多源取证线索与弱监督证据定位，并在可解释深度伪造检测任务上取得较好的检测精度与解释质量。

title: EASE: Entropy-Adaptive Distribution Shaping for Evading AI-generated Text Detectors
summary: AI-generated text (AIGT) detection can be sensitive to the decoding choices of the source large language model (LLM). We observe that perturbing next-token logits or adjusting sampling temperature can reduce detection performance, providing a clear signal of detector vulnerability to decoding-time distribution changes. Building on this observation, we propose EASE (Entropy-Adaptive Distribution Shaping for Evasion), a training-free and detector-agnostic framework for evading AIGT detectors. EASE computes predictive entropy directly from the source LLM's next-token distribution and uses it to adapt both logit perturbation and sampling temperature, without detector feedback or model fine-tuning. Experiments across three source LLMs and multiple detectors demonstrate consistent reductions in detection performance, with negligible degradation in text quality and negligible inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出EASE：一种免训练、与检测器无关的AI生成文本规避框架，通过预测熵自适应调整logit扰动与采样温度，显著降低检测性能。
AI.motivation: AIGT检测对源LLM的解码选择敏感；扰动下一token logits或调节采样温度即可削弱检测效果，说明检测器对解码期分布变化存在脆弱性，但缺乏系统性利用该漏洞的方法。
AI.method: EASE直接从源LLM的下一token分布计算预测熵，并据此自适应地调节logit扰动强度和采样温度；整个过程无需检测器反馈，也无需模型微调，属于免训练、检测器无关的方案。
AI.result: 在三种源LLM与多种检测器上的实验表明，检测性能持续下降，同时文本质量退化可忽略、推理开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 解码期分布整形是规避AIGT检测的有效途径，EASE以低代价实现稳定规避，揭示了现有检测器对解码策略的脆弱性。

title: Sensitive-Topic Leakage Through LLM Routing Metadata: Measurement and Mitigation
summary: LLM routers pick a cheap or expensive model per request by its content, and many gateways and some cloud platforms can log that choice with content logging off. We measure this privacy channel beyond token counts, accounting for noisy labels and repeated prompts. We run pre-registered studies on 1.7 million real requests (WildChat-1M, LMSYS-Chat-1M) with two cost/quality routers and a domain router, survey eleven systems' logging, and test post-processing defenses. At matched length, the shift's direction depends on category and router. For RouteLLM at the 50% operating point, harassment and self-harm requests reach the strong model 19 points less often than comparable ones on prompts unseen in exploration, medical requests (exploratory: LLM labels failed their gate) 31 points less often on distinct prompts (both post hoc), and sexual requests 10 points more often (secondary); the other router's four are negative. Twenty RouteLLM decisions separate frequent medical askers with AUC 0.71, exploratory and below the pre-registered primary endpoint's 0.75 (domain router: 0.92, an upper estimate). Per-category length-matched parity with accurate labels removes the gap on real traffic, costing at most 0.2 accuracy points on RouterBench (post hoc), where routers' gaps on sensitive subjects (13-42 points, pre-registered) exceed those of an oracle routing by realized accuracy gain (1-11, post hoc). Per-conversation stickiness, per-user budget bands, and pooled parity fail, the last as categories' shifts differ in size or sign. A post hoc exact per-user rate hides only even-prefix strong counts and forfeits most self-assessed routing value; it preserves odd-position decisions, from which a post hoc log attack reaches AUC 0.73 after 20 RouteLLM requests (exploratory).

AI.tldr: 该论文测量了LLM路由器选择决策所泄露的隐私信道：即便关闭内容日志，仅凭路由选择记录也能推断请求类别与用户特征，且现有防御大多失效。
AI.motivation: 许多网关和云平台在关闭内容日志的情况下仍会记录"廉价/昂贵模型"的路由选择。作者关注这一被忽视的隐私信道，要求超越单纯的token计数，考虑噪声标签与重复提示，系统量化路由决策对敏感类别的泄露程度，并检验后处理防御是否有效。
AI.method: 在170万真实请求（WildChat-1M、LMSYS-Chat-1M）上开展预注册研究，使用两个成本/质量路由器（含RouteLLM）和一个域路由器；匹配长度后比较各敏感类别到达强模型的概率偏移；调查十一个系统的日志策略；测试长度匹配的按类别均等化等后处理防御，并考察逐会话粘性、逐用户预算带与池化均等化；在RouterBench上评估防御的准确率代价，并实施逐用户速率隐藏与奇数位日志攻击。
AI.result: 长度匹配下，偏移方向随类别与路由器而变：RouteLLM在50%工作点使骚扰与自残请求进入强模型的概率低19个百分点，医疗请求低31个百分点（探索性、事后），性相关请求高10个百分点；另一路由器的四类均为负。二十次RouteLLM决策即可区分高频医疗提问者（AUC 0.71，探索性，低于预注册主终点0.75；域路由器0.92为上界估计）。按类别长度匹配均等化在真实流量上消除差距，在RouterBench上最多损失0.2个准确率点；路由器在敏感主题上的差距（13–42点，预注册）超过oracle按实际准确率增益路由的差距（1–11，事后）。逐会话粘性、逐用户预算带与池化均等化均失败（后者因各类别偏移大小或方向不同）。逐用户精确速率隐藏仅掩盖偶数前缀的强计数且牺牲大部分路由价值，保留奇数位决策，事后日志攻击在20次请求后达到AUC 0.73（探索性）。
AI.conclusion: 路由选择日志构成实质性的隐私信道，可在无内容日志下泄露敏感类别与用户画像。简单的池化均等化与粘性/预算带防御无效；长度匹配的按类别均等化能消除差距且代价极小。现有逐用户速率隐藏防御存在奇数位漏洞，可被日志攻击利用，需在路由与日志设计层面加以修正。

title: Perceptually Aligned Evaluation of Style Transfer
summary: Style transfer lacks a reliable evaluation standard: ground truth is inherently ill-defined, and existing automatic metrics often fail to reflect human preference. This paper introduces ASTRA (Assessment of Style TRansfer Algorithms), an approach for automatic evaluation of style transfer algorithms; it contains two components, ASTRA-Data and ASTRA-Score. ASTRA-Data consists of a benchmark image set of content and style references, a collection of style transfer results generated on the benchmark set, and user study data capturing human judgements through a two-stage pairwise comparison protocol. From these annotations, we derive ranking-based ground truth for content preservation, style fidelity, and overall preference. Based on ASTRA-Data, we construct ASTRA-Score, a learnt evaluator that predicts preference-aligned scores from content-style-stylization image triplets, enabling automatic and scalable evaluation of new models applied to the benchmark set. Experimental results demonstrate that ASTRA-Score achieves substantially higher correlation with human rankings compared to prior metrics. Overall, ASTRA establishes a robust mechanism for standardised evaluation of style transfer methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASTRA，包含基准数据集ASTRA-Data与学习式评测器ASTRA-Score，用于风格迁移算法的自动化、可扩展的标准化评估。
AI.motivation: 风格迁移缺乏可靠评估标准：真值本质上难以界定，现有自动指标常与人类偏好不符，导致评测不可靠。
AI.method: ASTRA-Data由内容与风格参考的基准图像集、在该基准上生成的大量风格迁移结果，以及通过两阶段成对比较协议采集的人工判断数据构成，并据此推导出内容保持、风格保真与整体偏好的排序式真值；在此基础上构建ASTRA-Score，从内容-风格-风格化图像三元组预测与偏好对齐的分数。
AI.result: 实验表明，ASTRA-Score与人类排序的相关性显著高于既有指标。
AI.conclusion: ASTRA为风格迁移方法的标准化评估建立了稳健机制。

title: Playing with Kruskal: algorithms for flat and hierarchical watershed cuts
summary: In the framework of edge-weighted graphs, watersheds have proven to be linked to well-known optimization problems, as Minimum Spanning Tree, which allowed the design of efficient algorithms for computing (hierarchical) watershed segmentations. In the present article, after reviewing the literature related to watershed segmentation, we present a detailed end-to-end pipeline of algorithms to compute (hierarchical) watershed segmentations, starting from the computation of graph-based image representations, up to the computation of connected components of the final (hierarchical) segmentation. We consider the several variations of watersheds, including their supervised and unsupervised versions, and the various ways of computing seeds, to name a few. For the first time, we bring together all these watershed notions and algorithms in a compact and understandable way. We aim at providing a reference for those interested in employing and reimplementing the watershed segmentation framework for their task at hand.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于边加权图的分水岭分割方法，梳理其与最小生成树等优化问题的联系，并提出一套从图表示到（层次）分割连通分量的端到端算法流程，统一整合多种分水岭变体。
AI.motivation: 分水岭分割与最小生成树等经典优化问题存在关联，但其多种变体（监督/无监督、不同种子计算方式等）散见于文献，缺乏统一、易理解的整合性参考，阻碍研究者应用与复现。
AI.method: 在边加权图框架下，先回顾分水岭分割相关文献，随后给出一套端到端算法流程：从基于图的图像表示构建，到最终（层次）分割的连通分量计算，涵盖分水岭的多种变体及其种子计算方法。
AI.result: 首次将各类分水岭概念与算法以紧凑、易理解的方式统一整合，形成完整的端到端处理流程。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为希望应用或复现分水岭分割框架的研究者提供了系统性参考。

title: Scalable Patch-Level Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) at scale produces powerful visual representations. However, most scalable SSL methods rely on ad hoc combinations of multiple objectives and stabilization mechanisms. Taking a step back, we ask if we can design a high-performing, yet principled SSL algorithm. Starting from the multi-view assumption, stipulating that task-relevant content is captured by the information common to different views, we construct an information-theoretic objective decomposing into interpretable terms. This derivation yields JEM, a student-teacher method that learns by aligning corresponding patch representations across views, explicitly regularized by information and structure preservation losses. JEM trains stably from 300M to 7B parameters, and, to our knowledge, is the first latent-space patch-level method demonstrated at 7B scale. Across all scales, JEM reaches strong performance on both global and dense probing tasks, on segmentation benchmarks consistently surpassing the DINOv2 algorithm, an influential foundation for today's strongest visual SSL methods. Notably, at 7B parameters, it exceeds the performance of DINOv3 on panoptic segmentation, despite being trained on $12\times$ less data without refinement stages. These results demonstrate that we can indeed design an SSL algorithm that learns strong representations, is principled and stable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JEM，一种基于多视图假设推导的信息论自监督学习目标，由多个可解释项组成，通过跨视图 patch 对齐并显式加入信息与结构保持正则项进行学生-教师学习，在 300M 至 7B 参数下稳定训练，性能超越 DINOv2 与 DINOv3。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模自监督学习方法多依赖多个目标的临时组合与稳定化机制，缺乏原则性设计。作者希望回到多视图假设，设计一种既有高性能又有理论依据的 SSL 算法。
AI.method: 从多视图假设出发，构建一个信息论目标函数，并分解为若干可解释项，由此推导出 JEM：一种学生-教师方法，通过跨视图对齐对应 patch 表示来学习，并显式引入信息保持与结构保持损失作为正则化。
AI.result: JEM 在 300M 到 7B 参数规模下均能稳定训练，是首个在 7B 规模验证的潜空间 patch 级方法。各规模下在全局与稠密探测任务上表现强劲，分割基准上持续超越 DINOv2；在 7B 参数下，尽管训练数据少 12 倍且无精炼阶段，其全景分割性能仍超过 DINOv3。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可以设计出一种既原则性、稳定又能学到强表征的自监督学习算法。

title: AdSpark: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Product-Centric Advertisement Video Generation
summary: Product-centric advertisement video generation aims to create promotional videos that preserve fine-grained product identity while presenting selling points through coherent multi-shot narratives.
