However, this emerging task remains underexplored due to the lack of large-scale advertisement-specific datasets and comprehensive evaluation frameworks. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{AdSpark}, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for product-centric advertisement video generation, based on data from a major e-commerce platform. \textit{AdSpark-300K} contains approximately 300K reference image--prompt--video triplets, comprising a real-world subset and a synthetic subset. Each sample provides structured advertisement annotations, including product identity annotations, selling-point descriptions, creative plans, and aligned audio scripts, enabling models to learn product preservation and advertisement-oriented visual storytelling. We further propose \textit{AdSpark-Bench}, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates generated advertisements across six dimensions, including visual quality, product fidelity, instruction adherence, temporal coherence, audio alignment, and advertisement effectiveness. Based on AdSpark-Bench, we evaluate representative models, revealing key challenges in product preservation, multi-shot storytelling, and selling-point visualization. Experiments with AdSpark-300K-finetuned models further validate the effectiveness of our dataset. AdSpark provides a unified dataset and benchmark for future research, and we will release the dataset upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdSpark——面向产品中心广告视频生成的大规模数据集与评测基准，包含AdSpark-300K（约30万条参考图-提示-视频三元组）和AdSpark-Bench（六维诊断性评测），以填补该领域数据集与评估框架的空白。
AI.motivation: 产品中心广告视频生成需在保持细粒度产品身份的同时，通过连贯的多镜头叙事呈现卖点。但该任务因缺乏大规模广告专用数据集与全面评估框架而研究不足。
AI.method: 构建基于某大型电商平台数据的AdSpark：包含约300K参考图-提示-视频三元组的AdSpark-300K，分真实子集与合成子集，每样本提供结构化广告标注（产品身份、卖点描述、创意方案、对齐音频脚本）；并提出跨六维度的诊断性基准AdSpark-Bench。
AI.result: 基于AdSpark-Bench评估代表性模型，揭示了产品保持、多镜头叙事与卖点可视化方面的关键挑战；使用AdSpark-300K微调的模型实验进一步验证了数据集的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AdSpark为未来研究提供统一的数据集与基准，数据集将于接受后公开释放。

title: The Long Road to the Same Answer: Cognitive Bias Under Escalating Reasoning Budgets in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 8th International Conference on Cognitive Machine Intelligence (IEEE CogMI 2026). 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/obadaKraishan/anchored-minds
summary: Reasoning models allocate extra computation at inference time and present their answers as the product of deliberate thought. If this deliberation works the way dual-process accounts of human cognition suggest, longer thinking should weaken the classic decision biases that fast, intuitive judgment produces. Using 30 vignettes covering six biases (anchoring, framing, loss aversion, escalation of commitment, availability, confirmation) from an established benchmark, we run a dose-response study across four model families, pairing each reasoning model with a matched non-reasoning sibling and requesting thinking ceilings of 0, 1,024, 4,096, and 8,192 tokens, for 12,350 API calls. Because a requested ceiling is not the same as realized deliberation, we use the reasoning tokens each call consumed as the dose. First, reasoning models are not less biased than their siblings; the point estimate leans the other way in every family, but the item-level pooled contrast is not reliable (Delta = +0.031, t(29) = 1.45, p = .157). Second, bias magnitude does not reliably fall as realized deliberation grows: no slope is significantly negative, and where anything moves it is the signed score drifting further from the human direction. Third, anchoring is the only bias in the human direction (d = 1.89). Four of the other five lean the opposite way in all seven models; with five items per bias, that reversal is reliable for framing and directional for escalation of commitment, confirmation, and loss aversion, while availability is absent. A one-line instruction to restate the anchor before answering lowered anchoring on all five anchoring items, which no amount of additional thinking did, although the effect does not reach significance (p = .057). The results argue against treating test-time reasoning as a rationality guarantee and for auditing deployed models bias by bias.

AI.tldr: 通过四个模型家族的配对剂量-反应实验（12,350次API调用）发现，推理模型并不比同源非推理模型偏见更少，且实际推理量增加并未可靠降低决策偏见；仅锚定效应方向与人类一致，且一句"先重述锚点"的提示即可降低锚定效应，而增加思考量则无效。
AI.motivation: 双过程理论认为深思熟虑应削弱快速直觉判断产生的经典决策偏见。推理模型在推理时投入额外计算并以"深思熟虑的产物"呈现答案，因此需要检验：更长的思考是否真的能降低决策偏见，还是推理能力被误当作理性保证。
AI.method: 采用30个情境题覆盖六种偏见（锚定、框架、损失厌恶、承诺升级、可得性、确认），来自既有基准。跨四个模型家族，将每个推理模型与其匹配的非推理同源模型配对，设定0/1,024/4,096/8,192 token的思考上限，共12,350次API调用。因请求上限≠实际推理量，以每次调用实际消耗的推理token数量作为剂量，进行剂量-反应分析。
AI.result: (1) 推理模型并不比其同源模型偏见更少，各家族点估计均偏向相反方向，但项目层面合并对比不显著（Δ=+0.031, t(29)=1.45, p=.157）。(2) 偏见幅度未随实际推理量增加而可靠下降，无显著负斜率，变动方向反而是带符号得分进一步偏离人类方向。(3) 仅锚定效应方向与人类一致（d=1.89）；其余五种中有四种在全部七个模型中方向相反，框架效应该反转可靠，承诺升级、确认与损失厌恶呈方向性反转，可得性效应缺失。一句"回答前重述锚点"的指令在全部五个锚定题上降低锚定效应，而增加思考量做不到，但该效应未达显著（p=.057）。
AI.conclusion: 结果反对将测试时推理视为理性保证，主张对部署模型逐一偏见进行审计。

title: Cache the Encoder Within:Compact, Reusable Memory across LLM Queries
summary: Repeated queries over shared documents incur redundant encoding, while caching model states introduces persistent storage costs. Building on CoMem's intermediate-state interface, EncBank treats a pretrained LLM's lower layers as a reusable document encoder and compactly stores their outputs for an adapted upper-layer reader. A self-distilled suffix adapter is shared across storage precisions within each backbone, without quantization-specific retraining. Across five benchmark suites on three Qwen backbones spanning different sizes and full-attention and hybrid architectures, 4-bit storage keeps each reported benchmark aggregate within one score point of native-precision EncBank. In a fixed Qwen3-8B workload, it retains 28.1% of the native-precision persistent GPU store. Separate native-precision controls yield a 1.40x selected-pack prefill speedup over same-evidence, same-adapter text replay, at a 3.12-point RULER accuracy cost. A native-precision Qwen3.8-27B configuration also passes 70 of 89 Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks. EncBank thus combines reusable computation with compact memory, while task fidelity and end-to-end benefits remain dependent on the workload, preparation costs, and reuse frequency.

AI.tldr: EncBank 将预训练 LLM 的下层视为可复用文档编码器并紧凑存储其输出，供适配后的上层读取器使用，通过自蒸馏后缀适配器在免量化的前提下实现跨精度共享，从而兼顾计算复用与存储压缩。
AI.motivation: 共享文档的重复查询会产生冗余编码，而缓存模型状态又带来持续性存储开销，二者形成效率与内存的权衡，因此需要一种既能复用计算又能压缩存储的方案。
AI.method: 基于 CoMem 的中间状态接口，EncBank 把预训练 LLM 的低层当作可复用文档编码器，紧凑保存其输出给适配后的高层读取器；每个骨干网络内使用一个自蒸馏后缀适配器，在多种存储精度间共享，无需针对量化单独重训练。
AI.result: 在三个 Qwen 骨干（涵盖不同规模及全注意力与混合架构）上的五个基准套件中，4-bit 存储使各基准聚合分数与原生精度 EncBank 相差不超过 1 分；固定 Qwen3-8B 工作负载下保留 28.1% 的原生精度持久 GPU 存储。原生精度对照下，相对同证据同适配器的文本重放取得 1.40x 的选中 pack 预填充加速，RULER 精度损失 3.12 分。原生精度 Qwen3.8-27B 配置通过 Terminal-Bench 2.1 的 89 项任务中的 70 项。
AI.conclusion: EncBank 将可复用计算与紧凑内存结合起来，但任务保真度与端到端收益仍取决于工作负载、准备成本和复用频率。

title: From Pixel to Coding: Evaluating the Figure Reproduction Capabilities of MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in both visual understanding and code generation. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate these two modalities in isolation, lacking a dedicated assessment of their unification, i.e., how a model can perceive complex visual structures and synthesize them into precise, executable code. Moreover, current visual code generation benchmarks often rely on simplified layouts within single programming environments, falling short of evaluating true unified multimodal reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose FigCodeBench, a comprehensive framework for rigorously evaluating MLLMs on figure reproduction, integrating multimodal comprehension and generation. We first design a systematic dataset construction pipeline, resulting in a total of 6,194 instances that cover 7 functional categories and 4 types of programming languages. We further categorize figure reproduction into three tiers with visual and code complexity modeling, specifically targeting complex structural reasoning, varying aspect ratios, and dense geometric constraints. We introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol, encompassing visual fidelity and syntactic isomorphism, that aligns highly with the Mean Machine Opinion Score (MMOS) and human preferences. Based on our framework, we conducted extensive experiments on 24 widely used proprietary and open-source MLLMs (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.4, and Kimi-K2.5), where we observed a universal, non-linear performance cliff across different programming languages and difficulty scenarios for all models, and gained several insights, such as the significant metric decline in rigid declarative languages.

AI.tldr: 提出FigCodeBench，一个面向多模态大模型的图形复现（视觉理解+代码生成统一）评测框架，含6194个实例、7类功能、4种编程语言、三级难度与多维评测协议，并实测24个模型发现普遍的非线性性能断崖。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型虽在视觉理解与代码生成上表现优异，但相关基准通常将两者割裂评估，缺乏对"视觉理解—可执行代码合成"这一统一能力的专门评测；同时现有视觉代码生成基准多依赖单编程环境下的简化布局，难以衡量真正的统一多模态推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 设计系统化的数据集构建流水线，生成6194个实例，覆盖7个功能类别与4种编程语言；2) 通过视觉与代码复杂度建模，将图形复现任务划分为三个难度层级，分别针对复杂结构推理、不同宽高比和密集几何约束；3) 提出涵盖视觉保真度与句法同构性的多维度评测协议，该协议与MMOS及人类偏好高度一致；4) 在24个主流闭源与开源MLLM上开展大规模实验。
AI.result: 对包括Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.4、Kimi-K2.5在内的24个模型实验显示：所有模型在不同编程语言与难度场景下普遍存在非线性的性能断崖；获得诸如在刚性声明式语言中指标显著下降等发现；所提评测协议与MMOS及人类偏好高度对齐。
AI.conclusion: FigCodeBench填补了图形复现任务上统一多模态理解与生成的评测空白，提供了覆盖多语言、多难度的系统化基准与可靠评测协议，并揭示了MLLM在该任务上的共性缺陷与非线性性能退化规律，为后续模型改进提供方向。

title: SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
summary: Self-evolving agents distill task-solving experience into skills for future reuse, but these skills can encode incorrect procedures or non-transferable knowledge. It is therefore critical to verify each skill's reusability: whether its guidance remains useful beyond the experience from which it was distilled. Such verification requires observing how a skill affects execution in new tasks, yet existing tasks may not expose the situations where the target skill can actually be exercised. To construct such situations, we propose SkillSandbox, a framework that dynamically synthesizes a task and its environment for each skill that are skill-relevant yet novel. A Proposer specifies the conditions to preserve and the source-specific details to vary, a Builder constructs an executable scenario, and a Verifier compares executions with and without the skill. The Verifier assesses executability, utility, and efficiency to assign a Keep or Reject verdict, determining whether the skill enters the library. Across ALFWorld and WebShop with three models, SkillSandbox consistently yields the strongest downstream performance and improved execution efficiency. Further analyses examine whether these gains reflect accurate assessment of skill reusability and identify which components of SkillSandbox contribute to them.

AI.tldr: 提出 SkillSandbox 框架，通过动态合成技能相关但新颖的任务与环境来验证自演化智能体技能的可复用性，并据此决定技能是否入库。
AI.motivation: 自演化智能体将任务解决经验蒸馏为可复用技能，但技能可能编码错误流程或不可迁移知识；现有任务难以暴露技能真正被触发的情形，因而缺少对技能可复用性的有效验证手段。
AI.method: SkillSandbox 为每个技能动态合成任务及其环境：Proposer 指定需保留的条件与需变化的来源细节，Builder 构建可执行场景，Verifier 对比有无技能时的执行情况，从可执行性、效用、效率三方面评估，给出 Keep 或 Reject 判定以决定技能是否进入技能库。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上结合三个模型，SkillSandbox 均取得最强的下游性能并提升执行效率；进一步分析检验这些增益是否反映对技能可复用性的准确评估，并识别出发挥作用的框架组件。
AI.conclusion: SkillSandbox 能通过合成技能相关且新颖的任务来有效验证技能可复用性，提升下游表现与执行效率，为自演化智能体的技能筛选提供可行方案。

title: Temporal Residual Bottleneck for Robust Asynchronous Collaborative Perception
summary: Collaborative perception extends the sensing range of autonomous vehicles, but its performance degrades when shared features arrive stale or incomplete. Most latency-robust methods compensate delayed collaborator features through flow-guided alignment or direct feature transport. In this work, we formulate asynchronous collaborative perception as temporal residual prediction. Our Temporal Residual Bottleneck keeps a deterministic pose-warped collaborator feature as a conservative anchor and uses a $Δt$-conditioned xLSTM to extract residual temporal evidence from the available history. A detector-facing residual bottleneck then applies only gated, regularized corrections before ego-side fusion, reducing the risk of overwriting reliable static structure when temporal correspondence is uncertain. Experiments on DAIR-V2X and OPV2V show that our method is especially effective under severe fixed/irregular delays and packet drops. On DAIR-V2X, the reported checkpoint trades a small amount of synchronized peak accuracy for better robustness under stronger communication degradation. Controlled diagnostics further indicate that direct feature transport has oracle headroom but can become unreliable when deployed without accurate correspondence. These results support temporal residual fusion as a practical alternative for asynchronous and incomplete collaborative perception. Code will be publicly released at https://url.fzi.de/8dk38.

AI.tldr: 将异步协同感知建模为时间残差预测：以确定性位姿扭曲特征为保守锚点，用 Δt 条件 xLSTM 提取残差证据，并通过门控正则化的残差瓶颈在自车融合前施加有限修正，从而在严重延迟与丢包下提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 协同感知可扩展自动驾驶感知范围，但当共享特征延迟到达或不完整时性能显著下降。现有延迟鲁棒方法（光流引导对齐、直接特征传输）在时间对应不确定时可能不可靠，甚至覆盖可靠静态结构。
AI.method: 提出时间残差瓶颈（Temporal Residual Bottleneck）：保留确定的位姿扭曲协作者特征作为保守锚点；使用 Δt 条件 xLSTM 从可用历史中提取残差时间证据；面向检测器的残差瓶颈仅在自车融合前应用门控且正则化的修正，避免在时间对应不确定时破坏静态结构。
AI.result: 在 DAIR-V2X 与 OPV2V 上，方法在严重固定/不规则延迟和丢包下尤其有效。DAIR-V2X 上以少量同步峰值精度换取更强通信退化下的鲁棒性。诊断实验表明直接特征传输存在 oracle 上限，但在缺乏准确对应时部署可能不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 时间残差融合是异步且不完整协同感知的实用替代方案。代码将公开于 https://url.fzi.de/8dk38。

title: ExperienceIndex: Artifact-Grounded Memory
summary: Knowledge-intensive tasks require answering many questions by reasoning about a shared corpus of artifacts (e.g., court cases, or scientific literature). As humans interact with these corpora, they naturally accumulate experiential knowledge about artifacts, enabling them to quickly identify the complete set of relevant artifacts for each new task. However, existing AI agents lack appropriate memory solutions to build or reuse such artifact-grounded experience, leading to lower answer quality and higher online cost. Existing memory solutions extract and reuse information from prior task-solving traces, but they primarily focus on user preferences, factual attributes, or abstract reasoning patterns rather than persistent artifact-specific knowledge. We introduce ExperienceIndex, a novel experience layer for AI agents that captures and reuses knowledge about artifacts based on prior reasoning traces. ExperienceIndex stores two complementary forms of experience: (i) single-artifact experiences that summarize an artifact's contribution to prior tasks and (ii) artifact-pair experiences that encode structural relationships discovered during past reasoning. Integrated as lightweight middleware, ExperienceIndex uses an experience retrieval mechanism to guide agents toward the complete set of relevant artifacts for new tasks, improving both answer quality and efficiency. Across diverse corpora and agentic solutions with different search frameworks, ExperienceIndex delivers consistent gains, raising answer quality by up to 11.0 points and reducing online dollar cost by up to 50.5%. We further demonstrate two benefits: (i) cross-task generalization, where experiences accumulated from text-to-SQL tasks transfer to factoid QA tasks over the same artifact corpus, and (ii) teacher-student learning, where experiences from a stronger model enable a weaker model to reach comparable performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 ExperienceIndex——一种面向知识密集型任务的智能体经验层，捕获并复用基于推理轨迹的"artifact 知识"，作为轻量中间件提升答案质量并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 人类在与共享语料（如判例、科学文献）交互时会自然积累关于 artifact 的经验知识，从而快速定位每个新任务所需的完整相关 artifact 集合；而现有 AI 智能体缺乏此类记忆机制，导致答案质量较低、在线成本较高。现有记忆方案主要抽取用户偏好、事实属性或抽象推理模式，无法保留持久的、artifact 专属的知识。
AI.method: ExperienceIndex 存储两种互补经验形式：(i) 单 artifact 经验，概括某 artifact 对既往任务的贡献；(ii) artifact 对经验，编码过往推理中发现的结构性关系。以轻量中间件形式集成，并通过经验检索机制引导智能体为新任务找到完整的相关 artifact 集合。
AI.result: 在多种语料及不同搜索框架的智能体方案上取得一致增益：答案质量最高提升 11.0 分，在线美元成本最高降低 50.5%。额外验证两点：跨任务泛化——text-to-SQL 任务积累的经验可迁移到同一 artifact 语料上的事实型问答任务；师生学习——强模型的经验可帮助弱模型达到接近的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过面向 artifact 的经验层设计，ExperienceIndex 有效提升知识密集型任务的质量与效率，并展现出跨任务泛化与师生知识迁移的潜力。

title: I would rather quit NLP than read another paper like this: The rise of antithesis in NLP papers
summary: For better or worse, LLMs are by now used routinely for scientific writing.\footnote{This paper is no exception; we did use AI to assist with writing some of the sections (see Acknowledgments).} Many have noticed that recent models fill papers with unnecessary antithesis, stating over and over what the work does not do, in ways that do not contribute to its precision or quality of expression and annoy reviewers \emph{rather than impressing them}. We study the construction \emph{rather than} in ACL papers from 2019, ACL-style arXiv papers from 2026, and papers written by GPT models from the same titles and abstracts. Its rate in 2026 is seven times the 2019 rate, and higher still in the GPT papers. Two annotators, blind to the source, find almost no 2019 use \emph{annoying} and about one in ten 2026 uses; they seldom agree on which, yet about half of 2026 papers contain a use that annoys each of them. \emph{Annoying} uses present the rejected alternative less favorably than legitimate uses. Raters of preference data and open reward models favor the construction, and an instruction to be honest promotes it. We conjecture that it is a side effect of post-training on pairwise preferences, which credit a disavowal in a single response and cannot register its cost across a text.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了学术写作中"rather than"这一对比结构的滥用现象，发现其使用率从2019年到2026年增长了七倍，GPT生成论文中更高，且约十分之一的2026年用法令审稿人反感，作者推测这是成对偏好后训练的副作用。
AI.motivation: 近期LLM被广泛用于科学写作，许多研究者注意到模型会在论文中堆砌不必要的"反义对比"表达，反复陈述工作"不做什么"，这种表达无助于提升精确性或表达质量，反而令审稿人反感而非印象深刻。作者希望系统研究这一现象的成因。
AI.method: 作者研究"rather than"结构在2019年ACL论文、2026年ACL风格arXiv论文，以及用相同标题和摘要由GPT模型生成的论文中的使用情况。两名不知来源的标注者对其"令人反感"程度进行标注。此外还考察了偏好数据评分者和开放奖励模型对该结构的偏好，以及"诚实"指令对其的影响。
AI.result: "rather than"在2026年论文中的使用率是2019年的七倍，在GPT生成论文中更高。标注者对2019年用法几乎不觉得反感，而约十分之一的2026年用法令人反感；两人虽很少就具体哪些用法达成一致，但约一半的2026年论文包含令各自反感的用法。令人反感的用法相比合法用法更倾向于贬低被拒绝的备选项。偏好数据评分者和开放奖励模型偏好该结构，"诚实"指令也会促进其使用。
AI.conclusion: 作者推测"rather than"结构的滥用是成对偏好后训练的副作用：偏好训练在单个回复中对"否认/反对"给予认可，却无法记录该结构在整篇文本中累积的成本。指出当前后训练方法在优化局部偏好的同时可能损害文本整体表达质量。

title: Mechanics of Long-Context Hybrid Models Part 1.1: From Hybrid Attention to Hybrid Position
summary: The architectural design of Large Language Models (LLMs) is shifting from traditional full-attention-only models to hybrid models, which combine different attention modules to improve long-context efficiency and performance in length extrapolation and context extension. To explain why hybrid models work and how to design them better, we propose Mechanics of Long-Context Hybrid Models. As Part 1.1 of this series, we begin with hybrids of full attention and either sliding-window attention (SWA) or gated variants of linear attention (LA), represented by GLA and GDN. We first observe a Seesaw Effect in Context Extension: LA hybrids benefit more from long-context continual pretraining, whereas SWA hybrids perform better under length extrapolation. We attribute this behavior to differences in the positional inductive biases induced by these attention mechanisms. We find that SWA hybrids suffer from a Short-Context Learning Trap, Short-Window Weariness, and Long-Window Laziness, and require extended windows to enhance performance in continual long-context pretraining. For LA hybrids, we summarize the Matthew Effect of Hybrid Position Extrapolation and propose Sliding-Window Linear Attention, achieving 16$\times$ training-free length extrapolation while maintaining 100\% accuracy on NIAH-SK1 in 64k context length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"长上下文混合模型机制"研究框架，作为系列第一部分，系统解释全注意力与滑窗注意力(SWA)或门控线性注意力(LA,如GLA/GDN)混合模型的行为差异，揭示"跷跷板效应"并提出改进设计。
AI.motivation: LLM架构正从纯全注意力转向混合注意力模型以提升长上下文效率、长度外推与上下文扩展能力，但缺乏对混合模型为何有效及如何更好设计的机制性解释。
AI.method: 对比研究全注意力与SWA混合及门控线性注意力(GLA、GDN)混合两类架构；通过长上下文持续预训练与长度外推实验，分析其位置归纳偏置差异；针对SWA混合总结短上下文学习陷阱、短窗口疲劳与长窗口惰性；针对LA混合提出混合位置外推的马太效应，并设计滑窗线性注意力(Sliding-Window Linear Attention)。
AI.result: 观察到上下文扩展中的"跷跷板效应"：LA混合更受益于长上下文持续预训练，SWA混合在长度外推下表现更佳；SWA混合需扩大窗口以提升持续长上下文预训练性能；所提滑窗线性注意力实现16倍免训练长度外推，并在64k上下文NIAH-SK1上保持100%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 混合模型的性能差异源于注意力机制诱导的不同位置归纳偏置；针对性地设计窗口与位置外推策略（如滑窗线性注意力）可显著提升长上下文能力，为混合架构设计提供机制性指导。

title: A Probabilistic Perspective on Wasserstein-Based Evidential Uncertainty for Out-of-Distribution Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation networks operate on a fixed set of classes and therefore fail when out-of-distribution (OOD) objects appear during deployment, a critical limitation for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Reliably identifying OOD objects requires well-calibrated epistemic uncertainty, yet common softmax-based confidence scores remain overconfident, while Bayesian alternatives such as Monte Carlo dropout or deep ensembles require costly repeated forward passes. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) offers an efficient alternative by modeling class probabilities as a Dirichlet distribution learned from a single deterministic forward pass. Existing EDL formulations rely on Euclidean objectives that push predictions towards the simplex vertices, encouraging overconfidence rather than preserving uncertainty for unfamiliar inputs. We instead employ Wasserstein-based objectives, which respect the geometry of the probability simplex, and study the influence of the Wasserstein order on segmentation accuracy and OOD detection within a unified evidential framework. We evaluate this framework on a convolutional (DeepLabV3+) and a transformer-based (SegFormer) architecture on the SegmentMeIfYouCan benchmark, including LostAndFound, RoadObstacle21, RoadAnomaly21, and Fishyscapes. Our results show the optimal Wasserstein order is architecture-dependent: second-order objectives dominate on the convolutional backbone, third-order objectives on the transformer backbone, and our framework surpasses comparable baselines on most metrics, with a single deterministic forward pass.

AI.tldr: 本文将证据深度学习（EDL）的欧氏目标替换为尊重概率单纯形几何的 Wasserstein 目标，研究 Wasserstein 阶数对语义分割精度与 OOD 检测的影响，揭示最优阶数依赖于网络架构。
AI.motivation: 语义分割网络仅在固定类别集上训练，部署时遇到分布外（OOD）对象会失效，这对自动驾驶等安全关键应用是严重隐患。可靠识别 OOD 需要良好校准的认知不确定性，但基于 softmax 的置信度过度自信，而 MC dropout、深度集成等贝叶斯方法需多次前向传播、代价高昂。EDL 虽只需一次确定性前向传播，但现有 EDL 采用欧氏目标，将预测推向单纯形顶点，导致对陌生输入过度自信。
AI.method: 采用基于 Wasserstein 的目标函数，以尊重概率单纯形的几何结构，并在统一的证据框架内研究 Wasserstein 阶数对分割精度与 OOD 检测的影响；在卷积架构 DeepLabV3+ 与 Transformer 架构 SegFormer 上，于 SegmentMeIfYouCan 基准（LostAndFound、RoadObstacle21、RoadAnomaly21、Fishyscapes）上进行评测。
AI.result: 最优 Wasserstein 阶数依赖于架构：在卷积骨干上二阶目标最优，在 Transformer 骨干上三阶目标最优；该框架在仅需一次确定性前向传播的情况下，在多数指标上超过了同类基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于 Wasserstein 的证据深度学习为语义分割中的 OOD 检测提供了高效且校准更优的替代方案，且最优阶数与网络架构相关，需按架构选择。

title: YANchor-4B: Effective Long-Horizon Reasoning in O(N) Time with O(1) Memory
summary: Long-horizon reasoning demands access to earlier information at a manageable generation cost. Full-history attention incurs growing storage and computation, while recurrent compression can lose precise details. Therefore, we present YANchor-4B, a general-purpose recurrent model that preserves crucial memory as ANchors for retrieval during subsequent reasoning. Beyond $O(N)$-time generation and $O(1)$ memory, YANchor enables effective long-horizon reasoning through its multidimensional memory mechanism. For example, on challenging math problems, it achieves 82.93% mean pass@1 on AIME 2024--2026 and 63.64% on HMMT, substantially outperforming linear-time, constant-state counterparts, including larger models. It also delivers several-fold higher batched long-generation throughput than Transformer and hybrid baselines on H100. Furthermore, evaluations across dozens of benchmarks demonstrate YANchor's superiority in general-purpose capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 YANchor-4B，一种通用循环模型，通过将关键记忆保留为可检索的锚点（ANchors），在保持 O(N) 生成时间和 O(1) 内存的同时实现有效的长程推理。
AI.motivation: 长程推理需要在可接受的生成成本下访问早期信息。全历史注意力带来不断增长的存储与计算开销，而循环压缩则可能丢失精确细节，因此需要一种兼顾效率与信息保真的方法。
AI.method: 提出 YANchor-4B 通用循环模型，将关键记忆以锚点形式保存，供后续推理检索；通过多维记忆机制实现长程推理，同时具备 O(N) 时间生成与 O(1) 内存特性。
AI.result: 在 AIME 2024--2026 上取得 82.93% 平均 pass@1，HMMT 上达 63.64%，显著优于线性时间、常数状态的同类模型（含更大模型）；在 H100 上批量长生成吞吐量比 Transformer 与混合基线高数倍；在数十个基准上展现通用能力优势。
AI.conclusion: YANchor 通过锚点式多维记忆机制，在保持线性时间与常数内存优势的同时，显著提升长程推理与通用任务表现，兼具高吞吐效率。

title: Lifelong small-object navigation in changing object layouts: a benchmark and method
summary: Household robots need to continually navigate to different objects in the same environment, many of which are small and portable, such as tools and toys. Their small visual footprint and frequent occlusion make reliable observation difficult, and they may be moved by people without the robot observing the changes. We formulate this challenging task as Lifelong Small-object Navigation in Changing Object Layouts (LiSoNav-COL). Agents must seek suitable viewpoints for reliable observation, accumulate and reuse scene knowledge to efficiently locate subsequent targets, and update outdated memory after object relocation. To eliminate the need for prior scene scanning, we also require agents to start navigation with empty scene memory. Although practical, this task still lacks benchmarks designed around its defining assumptions. To bridge this gap, we introduce LiSoNav-Eval, a dedicated benchmark spanning 28 indoor scenes with 45 small-object categories. Its lifelong navigation sequences include both unchanged and relocated targets to evaluate memory reuse and adaptation to object relocation. To address this challenging task, we propose a navigation method based on multi-view Inspection with Viewpoint-Anchored Memory, dubbed IVAM-Nav. IVAM-Nav actively observes supporting surfaces from complementary viewpoints for reliable small-object perception and anchors the resulting memory to their observation viewpoints, supporting relational memory reuse and revalidation under similar viewing conditions. Extensive experiments on LiSoNav-Eval demonstrate favorable performance of IVAM-Nav against representative methods. Benchmark analyses also show that smaller objects, larger environments, and longer relocation distances pose greater challenges. The dataset and code are available here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“终身小物体导航”任务LiSoNav-COL及其基准LiSoNav-Eval，并给出基于多视角检查与视角锚定记忆的导航方法IVAM-Nav。
AI.motivation: 家用机器人需在同一环境中反复导航至不同物体，其中许多是小巧可移动的工具或玩具。它们视觉足迹小、易被遮挡，且可能被人在机器人未察觉时移动，导致可靠观测与后续定位困难。同时，现有任务设定通常依赖预先场景扫描，缺乏围绕“空场景记忆起步”与物体重布局这一核心假设设计的基准。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为LiSoNav-COL：智能体需主动寻找合适视角以可靠观测目标，累积并复用场景知识以高效定位后续目标，并在物体被移动后更新过时记忆；且从空场景记忆开始导航，无需预先扫描。提出IVAM-Nav方法：基于多视角检查（multi-view Inspection），从互补视角主动观测承托表面以提升小物体感知可靠性；并将记忆锚定到对应观测视角（Viewpoint-Anchored Memory），以支持在相似视角条件下的关系式记忆复用与再验证。
AI.result: 构建LiSoNav-Eval基准，覆盖28个室内场景、45类小物体；终身导航序列同时包含未变动与已迁移目标，用于评估记忆复用与对物体重布局的适应能力。在LiSoNav-Eval上的大量实验表明，IVAM-Nav相较代表性方法具有较好性能。基准分析还显示：物体越小、环境越大、迁移距离越长，任务挑战越大。
AI.conclusion: 该工作补齐了终身小物体导航在“空记忆起步、物体重布局”设定下的基准缺口，并通过IVAM-Nav验证了多视角主动观测与视角锚定记忆在记忆复用和再验证上的有效性；数据集与代码已公开。

title: HarnessIR: Harnessing Multimodal Foundation Models for Universal Real-World Image Restoration
summary: Real-world low-quality images suffer from complex mixed degradations, including but not limited to noise, blur, atmospheric effects, etc. Recent agentic methods usually model real-world image restoration (Real-IR) as a sequential tool calling problem over task-specific single-degradation restoration models. This paradigm, however, is fundamentally limited because complex real-world degradations cannot be cleanly undone degradation by degradation, and the tool used for task-specific models caps the capability of the agent system. In this work, we present HarnessIR, an agentic framework for Real-IR by harnessing a multimodal foundation model (MFM) as the executor. HarnessIR consists of five stages: perception and diagnosis, on-demand tool invocation, prompt composition, execution, and verification-driven refinement. Unlike prior agentic Real-IR methods that rely on tool chains assembled from task-specific models, HarnessIR feeds the restoration requirements, the perceptual diagnosis, and the evidence into an MFM that performs restoration in a single pass, followed by verification stages to determine whether the result warrants further processing. Under our harness, off-the-shelf MFMs handle restoration tasks remarkably well, achieving state-of-the-art results on the widely used MiO100 synthetic benchmark. More importantly, by exploiting the strong generalization ability of MFMs, HarnessIR delivers compelling restoration quality on challenging real-world scenes where previous agentic IR systems often struggle. Codes is available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HarnessIR.

AI.tldr: 提出HarnessIR，以多模态基础模型作为执行器的智能体框架，用于真实世界图像复原，在MiO100合成基准取得SOTA，并在真实场景中展现强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 真实世界低质图像包含噪声、模糊、大气效应等复杂混合退化。现有智能体方法将Real-IR建模为在任务专用单退化复原模型上的顺序工具调用问题，但复杂退化无法按退化类型逐一干净消除，且任务专用模型的天花板限制了智能体系统的能力上限。
AI.method: HarnessIR包含五个阶段：感知与诊断、按需工具调用、提示词组合、执行、验证驱动的精修。与依赖任务专用模型工具链的既有方法不同，它将复原需求、感知诊断与证据输入多模态基础模型（MFM），由MFM单次完成复原，随后通过验证阶段判断结果是否需要进一步处理。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的MiO100合成基准上取得state-of-the-art结果；借助MFM的强泛化能力，在以往智能体IR系统难以应对的挑战性真实场景中也带来有说服力的复原质量。
AI.conclusion: 以MFM为执行器的智能体框架可有效突破任务专用工具链式方法的能力瓶颈，为真实世界图像复原提供新范式，代码已开源。

title: LLM4Impact: Integrating Heterogeneous Information for Scientific Impact Prediction
summary: Predicting the future impact of a newly published paper is challenging because it must be inferred from heterogeneous evidence available at publication time. Existing approaches often rely on a single source of information or combine multiple sources without accounting for their different predictive roles. In this paper, we present LLM4Impact, an evidence-aware method for scientific impact prediction that learns to represent, integrate, and calibrate heterogeneous information. LLM4Impact combines semantic, graph, LLM, and temporal representations, and injects graph information into a frozen LLM through continuous prefix tokens. A context aware gating mechanism adaptively weights different evidence, while a separate calibration module accounts for domain and temporal variation in citation scales. We further construct a large-scale benchmark dataset with 2 million papers, leakage-safe point-in-time heterogeneous ego graphs, temporal splits, and both year-level and month-level citation targets. Experiments show that LLM4Impact consistently outperforms strong semantic, graph, and LLM based baselines, with a 10.13% reduction in year RMSE on the in distribution test set and a 6.87% reduction under out-of-domain distribution. Our results reveal that the value of such evidence is context dependent: different papers benefit from different sources, while domain and publication time affect how evidence translates into citations. This finding motivates adaptive evidence selection and context-conditioned calibration rather than simply richer representations. We will release our code, benchmark, and an interactive web demonstration upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LLM4Impact，一种证据感知的科研影响力预测方法，通过融合语义、图、LLM 与时间四类异构表示并借助上下文感知门控与校准模块，在 2 百万篇论文基准上持续优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 预测新发表论文的未来影响力具有挑战性，因为必须依据发表时可获得的异构证据进行推断。现有方法通常依赖单一信息源，或将多源信息简单组合，而未考虑它们在预测中扮演的不同角色。
AI.method: LLM4Impact 融合语义、图、LLM 和时间四类表示；通过连续前缀 token（continuous prefix tokens）将图信息注入冻结的 LLM；采用上下文感知门控机制自适应加权不同证据；并设置独立的校准模块以应对引用量在不同领域和时间上的尺度差异。同时构建了含 2 百万篇论文的大规模基准数据集，具备防泄漏的时点异构自我图（ego graphs）、时间划分以及年粒度和月粒度引用目标。
AI.result: 实验表明 LLM4Impact 在语义、图与 LLM 类强基线上持续领先：在分布内测试集上年 RMSE 降低 10.13%，在分布外设定下降低 6.87%。结果揭示证据价值具有上下文依赖性：不同论文受益于不同来源，且领域与发表时间会影响证据向引用量的转化。
AI.conclusion: 该发现支持采用自适应证据选择与上下文条件化校准，而非仅追求更丰富的表示。作者将在论文发表时公开代码、基准数据集及交互式网页演示。

title: InterView-C: A Synchronized Multimodal Corpus of VR Avatar-Mediated Survey Interviews
summary: We present InterView-C, a German multimodal corpus of 27 survey interviews conducted entirely in virtual reality, with both interlocutors represented by avatars. The corpus aligns spoken interaction with synchronized behavioral data, including gaze, head and body movement, facial behavior, hand and finger tracking. Its reference transcripts and linguistic annotations provide a reliable interface between this multimodal spoken interaction and predominantly text-based NLP methods. This interface is important because automatically transcribing speech can distort linguistically relevant information, while downstream models trained on existing resources may additionally face transfer challenges when applied to transcribed spoken data. InterView-C therefore provides word-timed and manually post-edited verbatim transcripts for all 54 recordings, interview-item timings, questionnaire responses and negation cue and scope annotations for 1,422 sentences, 1,398 of them doubly annotated (α=0.87 for cues; α=0.81 for scopes). We demonstrate both challenges empirically: nine open-weight ASR systems disproportionately misrecognize short closed answers and number words, while negation models trained on existing corpora show lower and highly variable performance on our transcribed interviews than a model trained on the InterView-C annotations. InterView-C thus enables linguistic analyses of spoken interaction while retaining their alignment with rich multimodal behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 InterView-C：一个完全在虚拟现实中进行的德语多模态访谈语料库（27 场访谈、54 个录音），将口语交互与同步行为数据（注视、头身运动、面部行为、手势与手指追踪）对齐，并提供词级时间戳、人工后编辑逐字转写、访谈项时间、问卷回答及否定线索与辖域标注，用以支撑面向多模态口语交互的语言学与 NLP 研究。
AI.motivation: 多模态口语交互研究与主流文本型 NLP 方法之间存在接口鸿沟：自动语音转写可能扭曲语言学相关信息，而在既有资源上训练的下游模型迁移到转写口语数据时也面临挑战。因此需要一个兼具可靠转写标注与丰富同步行为数据的语料资源。
AI.method: 构建 InterView-C 语料库：27 场完全在虚拟现实中进行的德语调查访谈，双方以虚拟化身呈现；采集并同步注视、头身运动、面部行为、手与手指追踪等多模态行为数据；为全部 54 个录音提供词级时间戳、人工后编辑的逐字转写、访谈项时间与问卷回答；对 1,422 个句子（其中 1,398 个双人标注）标注否定线索与辖域。并通过实验验证两大挑战：测试 9 个开放权重 ASR 系统的识别表现，以及比较在既有语料上训练的否定模型与基于 InterView-C 标注训练的模型。
AI.result: 否定标注一致性为线索 α=0.87、辖域 α=0.81；9 个开放权重 ASR 系统对简短封闭式回答和数词存在不成比例的高误识；在既有语料上训练的否定模型在转写访谈上表现更低且波动大，而基于 InterView-C 标注训练的模型表现更好。
AI.conclusion: InterView-C 既支持对口语交互的语言学分析，又保持其与丰富多模态行为的对齐，为多模态口语交互与文本型 NLP 方法之间提供了可靠接口。

title: HySPE: Positional Encoding via Symplectic Dual Shears
summary: We introduce Hyperbolic Symplectic Positional Encoding (HySPE), grounding positional attention in non-compact symplectic transformations. While canonical Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) parameterizes the compact, elliptic branch of $\Sp(2,\R)$ via rotations, HySPE operationalizes its hyperbolic branch via a damped symmetric composition of dual shears, yielding a conformally symplectic contraction with two spectral decay rates per channel pair. To eliminate the exponential representation drift inherent to naive absolute factorizations, we diagonalize the operator in its invariant eigenbasis and introduce blockwise coordinate rebasing with adaptive centered execution. This guarantees length-independent numerical bounds while matching cached RoPE forward latency (7.21\,ms on an RTX 4090). On TinyShakespeare, HySPE-UltraLong maintains an invariant perplexity of 4.810 up to $16\times$ zero-shot extrapolation ($L=4096$), whereas RoPE degrades to 131.198. Scaled to a 51M-parameter subword Transformer on WikiText-103 ($L_{\text{train}}=512$), HySPE closely matches RoPE in-domain while robustly extrapolating to length 8192, reducing tail perplexity by 83.9\% over RoPE. While these controlled experiments establish HySPE's extrapolation robustness and numerical stability, evaluating its scaling behavior on large-scale foundation models remains an important direction for future investigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双曲辛位置编码(HySPE),将位置注意力建立在非紧辛变换上,利用$\Sp(2,\R)$的双曲分支实现长度无关的数值稳定性与显著的外推鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: RoPE仅参数化了$\Sp(2,\R)$的紧致椭圆分支(旋转),缺乏非紧致方向上的建模能力。朴素绝对因子分解存在指数级表示漂移,导致长序列外推时性能急剧退化。
AI.method: HySPE通过双剪切(dural shears)的阻尼对称组合实现共形辛收缩,每通道对具有两个谱衰减率;在不变特征基中对算子对角化,并引入分块坐标重基与自适应中心化执行,以消除指数漂移。
AI.result: 在RTX 4090上前向延迟与缓存RoPE持平(7.21ms)。TinyShakespeare上,HySPE-UltraLong在$16\times$零样本外推($L=4096$)下困惑度稳定为4.810,而RoPE退化至131.198;WikiText-103上51M参数子词Transformer在域内与RoPE相当,外推至8192时尾部困惑度较RoPE降低83.9%。
AI.conclusion: 受控实验验证了HySPE的外推鲁棒性与数值稳定性;其在大型基础模型上的扩展行为仍是未来重要研究方向。

title: HeiCo-FOCUS: A Clinically Grounded Dataset for Long-Context Video Understanding
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have led to rapid progress in video understanding across a wide range of benchmark tasks. However, existing evaluations largely focus on short-term reasoning, failing to assess a critical capability: maintaining cumulative temporal consistency over extended time horizons. To close this evaluation gap, we introduce HeiCo-FOCUS, a clinically grounded dataset for evaluating long-context video understanding through the task of Foreign Object Contextual Understanding in Surgery. Built on a dataset of Heidelberg Colorectal surgeries, this task requires models to continuously track multiple objects as they are inserted, manipulated, occluded, and removed over procedures lasting up to hours. HeiCo-FOCUS comprises 30,000 visual question answering (VQA) pairs covering five core capabilities: object recognition, temporal grounding, aggregation, event and procedural understanding, and complex reasoning. The dataset was constructed through a rigorous multi-stage annotation pipeline involving large-scale crowd annotation and 39 surgical domain experts to ensure high quality and clinical relevance. To systematically probe model behavior, we introduce a multi-track evaluation framework that progressively increases temporal and contextual demands from single frames to full procedures. Experiments with ten frontier VLMs show that HeiCo-FOCUS tasks are far from solved: only around half of the models clearly outperform a text-only baseline. Across the video tracks, models perform best on event and procedural understanding (mean Accuracy: 56.5% across all models), while temporal grounding remains particularly challenging for all evaluated models (mean Accuracy: 19.7%). We therefore expect HeiCo-FOCUS to serve as a catalyst for the development of models capable of reliable, temporally consistent reasoning over hours-long videos.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有VLM视频理解评测偏重短期推理，提出HeiCo-FOCUS——基于海德堡结直肠手术视频的长上下文VQA数据集，用以评估手术中异物上下文理解，并揭示前沿模型在长时间跨度一致性上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）的视频理解评测多集中于短期推理，未考察在长时程内保持累积时间一致性这一关键能力，存在明显评测空白。
AI.method: 构建HeiCo-FOCUS数据集：基于Heidelberg Colorectal手术视频，要求模型持续跟踪多个物体在插入、操作、遮挡、移除过程中的状态；包含30,000个VQA对，覆盖物体识别、时间定位、聚合、事件与流程理解、复杂推理五类能力；采用多阶段标注流程（大规模众包+39位外科领域专家）保证质量与临床相关性；并设计多轨道评测框架，从单帧到完整手术逐步提升时间与上下文要求。
AI.result: 在十个前沿VLM上的实验表明任务远未解决：仅约一半模型明显优于纯文本基线；视频轨道中事件与流程理解表现最好（平均准确率56.5%），时间定位最难（平均准确率19.7%）。
AI.conclusion: HeiCo-FOCUS可作为推动模型发展、实现数小时级视频可靠且时间一致推理的催化剂。

title: BagDINO: Multi-View Baggage Re-Identification with DINOv3
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, IEEE International Conference on Evolving and Adaptive Intelligent Systems 2026 (IEEE EAIS 2026)
summary: Mishandled checked baggage remains a recurrent issue in airport operations, and current recovery workflows still largely rely on tag-based tracking, which does not directly support visual identification when tag evidence is missing or unavailable. This paper investigates baggage re-identification as an instance-level retrieval problem in a multi-camera setting, leveraging DINOv3 foundation-model representations to match a query image against a gallery of registered baggage images. A Torchreid-style BNNeck re-identification head is placed on top of a DINOv3 backbone, and parameter-efficient adaptation is performed via LoRA. Experiments are conducted on the MVB benchmark using a progressive study that compares a fully frozen backbone against LoRA and fine-tuning strategies. Results indicate that parameter-efficient adaptation of foundation-model features provides an effective and stable approach for multi-view baggage re-identification under limited training data.

AI.tldr: 本文把多相机下的行李再识别建模为实例级检索任务，基于DINOv3基础模型特征，采用Torchreid风格BNNeck头与LoRA参数高效适配，在MVB基准上验证了冻结、LoRA与微调三种策略的效果。
AI.motivation: 机场错运托运行李问题频发，现有恢复流程主要依赖行李标签追踪，当标签证据缺失或不可用时无法直接支持视觉识别，因此需要研究基于视觉的多相机行李再识别方法。
AI.method: 将行李再识别定义为多相机场景下的实例级检索问题，利用DINOv3基础模型表征将查询图像与已登记行李图像库进行匹配；在DINOv3骨干网络之上加装Torchreid风格的BNNeck再识别头，并通过LoRA进行参数高效适配；在MVB基准上开展递进式实验，比较完全冻结骨干、LoRA与全量微调三种策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，在有限训练数据条件下，对基础模型特征进行参数高效适配，能够为多视角行李再识别提供有效且稳定的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 参数高效适配基础模型特征是多相机行李再识别的有效且稳定途径，可弥补标签追踪在视觉识别上的不足。

title: Beyond Anonymous Captions: Grounding Character Identity in Video Captioning and Question Answering
summary: Linking people's appearance and actions to character identities is essential for understanding video narratives. We present a framework for identity-aware video captioning and person-centric question answering that combines automatic character identification, explicit spatial grounding, and task-specific adaptation. Starting from LSMDC v2 movie clips, our pipeline matches detected faces to actor reference images, tracks characters across frames, and builds inputs with identity-linked bounding boxes. A strong vision-language model generates identity-aware captions and questions, which are manually verified and filtered to create a benchmark of 750 captioned clips and 3,000 person-centric questions. We study five grounding strategies combining textual coordinates with visual face or estimated person boxes across Video-MLLM families at roughly 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters and larger frontier models. Combining visual face boxes with textual coordinates yields the most consistent performance across scales and significantly improves overall performance over coordinates alone. Smaller models tend to over-assign known identities when the queried person is not grounded, while larger models better recognize such UNIDENTIFIED cases. We introduce BAC by LoRA fine-tuning Qwen models at 2B, 4B, and 8B scales on about 32K identity-aware captioned clips. Across all scales, BAC outperforms every other evaluated model family of comparable size. BAC-8B reaches 93.20\% overall QA accuracy, ranking behind only GPT-5.6 Sol among the frontier models evaluated in our study. Overall, explicitly communicating who is where, together with lightweight task-specific adaptation, substantially improves identity-aware video understanding without changing the underlying architecture. We release the benchmark, training data, code, and BAC checkpoints at https://github.com/momentslab/beyond-anonymous-captions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出身份感知视频理解框架，融合自动角色识别、显式空间定位与任务适配，构建含750个字幕片段与3000个人物中心问题的基准；发现"视觉人脸框+文本坐标"最稳健，并用LoRA微调Qwen（2B/4B/8B）得到BAC模型，其中BAC-8B达93.20%整体QA准确率。
AI.motivation: 将人物外貌与动作同角色身份关联，对理解视频叙事至关重要；但现有视频字幕与问答通常将人物视为匿名实体，缺乏身份与空间位置信息的显式建模，导致身份感知理解能力不足。
AI.method: 基于LSMDC v2电影片段：人脸检测并与演员参考图匹配、跨帧角色跟踪、构建带身份链接边界框的输入；由强视觉语言模型生成身份感知字幕与问题，经人工校验过滤构建基准；研究五种定位策略（文本坐标结合视觉人脸框或估计人体框），覆盖约2B/4B/8B的Video-MLLM及更大前沿模型；并用约32K身份感知字幕片段对Qwen进行LoRA微调得到BAC（2B/4B/8B）。
AI.result: 视觉人脸框结合文本坐标在各规模下表现最一致，且显著优于仅用坐标；小模型在被查询人物未被定位时倾向错误分配已知身份，大模型更能识别UNIDENTIFIED情况；BAC在各规模均优于同规模其他模型族，BAC-8B整体QA准确率93.20%，在本研究评估的前沿模型中仅次于GPT-5.6 Sol。
AI.conclusion: 显式表达"谁在哪里"并结合轻量任务适配，可在不改变底层架构的前提下显著提升身份感知视频理解；基准、训练数据、代码与BAC检查点已开源。

title: Beyond Outcome Rewards: Constructing and Assigning Retrieval Credit for Search Agents
summary: Search agents enable Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively retrieve and use information for complex multi-hop questions. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) offers a promising approach for post-training such agents, but its reliance on sparse, outcome-based supervision can make credit assignment difficult and limit learning efficiency. In this paper, we systematically investigate how intermediate supervision can improve reinforcement learning for search agents. We study a range of reward-shaping and credit-assignment strategies that provide learning signals from intermediate retrieval steps. Building on these insights, we develop a training framework that combines intermediate signals with final outcome rewards to improve learning from multi-step search trajectories. Experiments across multiple benchmarks under matched training conditions demonstrate improvements in aggregate search-agent performance and show that both the choice of intermediate signal and where its credit is assigned affect training behaviour. These findings show that reward design and credit assignment are important design dimensions for training effective search agents.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究中间监督如何改进搜索智能体的强化学习，提出结合中间信号与最终结果奖励的训练框架，实验证明奖励设计与信用分配是训练有效搜索智能体的关键设计维度。
AI.motivation: LLM搜索智能体处理复杂多跳问题时需迭代检索信息。RLVR虽是有前景的后训练方法，但其依赖稀疏的、基于结果的监督，导致信用分配困难、学习效率受限。
AI.method: 系统研究多种奖励塑形与信用分配策略，从中间检索步骤中提供学习信号；在此基础上构建将中间信号与最终结果奖励相结合的训练框架，并在多个基准上进行匹配训练条件的对比实验。
AI.result: 在多个基准、匹配训练条件下，聚合搜索智能体性能得到提升；中间信号的选择及其信用分配位置均会影响训练行为。
AI.conclusion: 奖励设计与信用分配是训练高效搜索智能体的重要设计维度。

title: Argos: Adapt Rich Geometric Priors for Generalizable Online Scene-Change-Detection
comment: More details on the project website: https://www.multyxu.com/argos/
summary: Robots operating in dynamic environments require reliable detection of how their surroundings change over time. Existing learning-based methods largely rely on pairwise 2D image features, which struggle under large viewpoint changes and occlusions, are sensitive to noise, and show limited generalization across domains, while explicit 3D approaches typically require costly offline optimization. We show that the implicit 3D knowledge of Geometric Foundation Models (GFMs) provides a strong basis for addressing these limitations. We introduce Argos, which adapts GFM features for joint scene change detection and 3D reconstruction. To address data scarcity and take a step toward a foundation model for scene change detection, we introduce a large-scale benchmark comprising two synthetic datasets and one real-world dataset, and train jointly across diverse datasets to improve cross-domain generalization. We further introduce Argos-SLAM, a real-time system designed for robotics, which performs online change detection and change-aware 4D mapping. Across benchmarks, our framework substantially outperforms existing baselines, with gains of up to 42.01% in change IoU and 27.91% in F1, while supporting scalable deployment in changing real-world environments.

AI.tldr: Argos利用几何基础模型（GFM）的隐式3D先验，联合进行场景变化检测与3D重建，并构建大规模基准及实时系统Argos-SLAM，在变化IoU和F1上显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中的机器人需要可靠检测环境随时间的变化。现有基于学习的方法主要依赖成对2D图像特征，在大视角变化和遮挡下表现不佳，对噪声敏感，跨域泛化能力有限；而显式3D方法通常需要昂贵的离线优化。作者希望借助GFM的隐式3D知识来突破这些局限。
AI.method: 提出Argos，将几何基础模型（GFM）特征适配用于场景变化检测与3D重建的联合任务。为缓解数据稀缺并迈向变化检测的基础模型，构建了包含两个合成数据集和一个真实数据集的基准，并进行跨数据集联合训练以提升跨域泛化。进一步提出面向机器人的实时系统Argos-SLAM，实现在线变化检测与变化感知的4D建图。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，该框架大幅优于现有基线，变化IoU提升最高达42.01%，F1提升最高达27.91%，并支持在动态真实环境中可扩展部署。
AI.conclusion: 隐式3D先验（GFM特征）为场景变化检测与3D重建提供了有力基础；结合大规模多源基准与联合训练，可显著提升精度与跨域泛化能力，并通过Argos-SLAM实现实时在线变化检测与4D建图，适用于动态真实环境中的机器人部署。

title: VideoEvolve: Co-Evolving Memory and Retrieval for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding increasingly relies on external memory to organize massive visual streams into compact representations. However, most memory-based methods dynamically adapt how information is retrieved for different questions, while largely fixing what is remembered. This mismatch makes missing details costly to recover, whereas stored information is valuable only when it can be reliably retrieved. To address this issue, we propose VideoEvolve, a novel self-evolving framework that jointly evolves memory and retrieval for long video understanding. Specifically, starting from a coarse low-frame-rate overview, VideoEvolve couples a Memory Evolver for selective memory augmentation with a Retrieval Evolver for adaptive retrieval over the evolving memory. We then co-evolve the two Evolvers through alternating agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL), updating one while freezing the other. To steer this alternating evolution, Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) identifies whether the current bottleneck lies in memory or retrieval and directs optimization toward the more limiting side. Furthermore, VideoEvolve introduces Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF) to alleviate downstream feedback from over-specializing memory to a fixed set of training questions, shifting training toward underdeveloped yet learnable video capabilities. By integrating Agentic RL with BEF and CEF, VideoEvolve transforms downstream reasoning experience into transferable capability updates, providing a concrete path from static long-video systems toward experience-driven, self-improving multimodal intelligence. Extensive experiments on multiple long video understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoEvolve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VideoEvolve，一个记忆与检索协同自演化的长视频理解框架，通过交替式Agentic RL联合进化记忆模块与检索模块，并借助BEF与CEF两种反馈机制引导优化方向，在多个长视频理解基准上取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于外部记忆的长视频理解方法大多只针对不同问题动态调整"如何检索"，却基本固定了"记忆什么"，导致记忆与检索之间存在不匹配：一旦记忆缺失关键细节，后续很难补救，而存储的信息也只有在能被可靠检索时才有价值。因此需要一种能够同时进化记忆与检索的框架。
AI.method: 从粗粒度低帧率概览出发，VideoEvolve将记忆演化器（Memory Evolver，负责选择性记忆增广）与检索演化器（Retrieval Evolver，负责对演化中记忆进行自适应检索）耦合；通过交替式Agentic强化学习协同进化两者（更新一个时冻结另一个）。引入Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback（BEF）判断当前瓶颈在记忆还是检索，并引导优化偏向更受限的一方；引入Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback（CEF）缓解下游反馈使记忆过度专门化于固定训练问题集，将训练导向尚未充分开发但可学习的视频能力。
AI.result: 在多个长视频理解基准上进行的大量实验验证了VideoEvolve的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VideoEvolve通过将Agentic RL与BEF、CEF结合，把下游推理经验转化为可迁移的能力更新，为从静态长视频系统走向经验驱动、自我改进的多模态智能提供了一条具体路径。

title: HuLiGen: Human LiDAR Generation from Parametric Body Models
summary: LiDAR point clouds of humans are extremely expensive to collect and annotate, thus represent a scarce resource that hinders the development of human analysis using this modality. To alleviate this scarcity, prior work relies on simulated human LiDAR, but such samples do not fully reflect the geometry and sensing characteristics of real observations. In contrast, we introduce HuLiGen, a generative model that generates human LiDAR point clouds from a parametric body model, using a point transformer trained with a flow-matching objective. We show that our generated point clouds are closer to the real capture distribution. Using HuLiGen to generate synthetic data, we propose a synthetic-only pretraining scheme for LiDAR-based HPE that achieves state-of-the-art performance, with even larger gains in low-annotation and low-data regimes, where MPJPE is reduced by up to 50%. Code, models and generated samples are available at https://github.com/valeoai/HuLiGen.

AI.tldr: HuLiGen 是一种从参数化人体模型生成人体 LiDAR 点云的生成模型，用于缓解真实人体点云数据稀缺问题，并在 LiDAR 人体姿态估计上取得 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 人体 LiDAR 点云的采集与标注成本极高，导致数据稀缺，阻碍了基于该模态的人体分析研究。已有工作依赖仿真人体 LiDAR 数据，但仿真样本无法充分反映真实观测的几何与传感特性。
AI.method: 提出 HuLiGen：以参数化人体模型为条件，使用点云 Transformer 结合 flow-matching（流匹配）目标训练，生成更接近真实采集分布的人体 LiDAR 点云。基于该生成数据提出纯合成数据预训练方案，用于 LiDAR 人体姿态估计（HPE）。
AI.result: 生成的 LiDAR 点云更接近真实采集分布；纯合成预训练的 LiDAR HPE 达到 SOTA 性能，在低标注与低数据场景下提升更显著，MPJPE 最多降低 50%。
AI.conclusion: HuLiGen 通过生成逼真的人体 LiDAR 点云，为缓解数据稀缺提供了有效途径，并验证了纯合成预训练在 LiDAR HPE 中的价值，尤其在低资源场景下优势明显。

title: VolCo: Volumetric Contact for High-Fidelity Human Grasp Generation
summary: Accurate contact modeling is fundamental to understanding hand-object interaction, yet existing contact representations are typically restricted to object surfaces and rely on hand-crafted rules to recover contact details, leading to severe penetrations and implausible results. To better exploit the rich detail in motion-capture data, we introduce Volumetric Contact (VolCo), a representation that expands surface points to a set of 3D volumetric grids. VolCo encodes 3D contact that allows precise hand part recovery, and is organized in an inherent hierarchy: local contact details within each volume and global hand geometry across all volumes. Our framework, VolCoDiff, employs two modules to capture local and global features following this hierarchy. For local contact details, we use a 3D variational autoencoder to model the possible hand configurations conditioned on the local object signed distance field (SDF). For global hand geometry, we design a prior-guided diffusion model that learns the distribution of compressed latent features aggregated from the volumetric grids. We evaluate our method on two benchmark datasets and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in penetration and stability, indicating the capability to generate tight grasps with much less severe penetrations. Our code is available at https://github.com/chzh9311/volco.

AI.tldr: 提出VolCo体素化接触表示与VolCoDiff框架，通过局部3D VAE与全局先验引导扩散模型的分层建模，实现高精度手-物接触生成。
AI.motivation: 现有手-物接触表示局限于物体表面，且依赖手工规则恢复接触细节，导致严重穿透和生成结果不合理；同时未能充分利用动作捕捉数据中的丰富细节。
AI.method: 提出Volumetric Contact（VolCo）表示，将表面点扩展为3D体素网格集合，具备分层结构（体素内局部接触细节+跨体素全局手部几何）。基于此构建VolCoDiff框架，含两模块：局部用3D VAE以局部物体SDF为条件建模手部构型；全局设计先验引导扩散模型，学习由体素聚合的压缩隐特征分布。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上评估，在穿透与稳定性指标上达到SOTA，能够生成紧密抓握且穿透显著减少。
AI.conclusion: VolCo体素化接触表示与分层扩散生成框架有效提升手-物接触建模精度，缓解穿透问题，代码已开源。

title: GAGR-Lab: Evaluating Joint Spatial-Geometric and Analytic Function Reasoning
summary: Joint spatial-geometric and analytic function reasoning requires translating a perceived spatial configuration into a symbolic function whose executed curve satisfies geometric constraints. We present GAGR-Lab, a framework for measuring this capability through Cartesian game scenes, explicit function semantics, and authoritative Rust trajectory execution. It distinguishes spatial perception, metric grounding, geometric relations, function interpretation, function construction, and constrained synthesis. We specify four configurable scene-difficulty presets and a prospective 24-cell diagnostic design, while reporting only the subset actually evaluated. A bounded pilot of one hosted model (Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct) using two API credentials as execution replicas yields 72 balanced games with 432 attempts, 429 valid provider responses, and no target hits; exploratory ordinary-function prompt variants also fail to hit, while the structured localization interface yields no scoreable outputs. A privileged analytic search control independently succeeds on 600 directional cases from 300 generated scenes, with exact repeatability and 1,200 successful vertical-reflection or translation checks. The framework separates serving reliability, symbolic compliance, and geometric success, and preserves exact model-visible inputs and realized paths. A staged protocol outlines diagnostic calibration, held-out replication, multi-model comparison, and paired robustness tests. The contribution is an operational research framework with an executed pilot and a clearly identified prospective study plan; the full difficulty matrix and comparative model results remain untested.

AI.tldr: 提出GAGR-Lab框架，通过笛卡尔游戏场景、显式函数语义和Rust轨迹执行来测量模型的"空间-几何与解析函数联合推理"能力，并报告了一个Llama 3.2 11B Vision的初步试点结果（全部未命中目标）。
AI.motivation: 联合空间-几何与解析函数推理要求将感知到的空间构型转化为符号函数，且其执行曲线需满足几何约束，这一能力缺乏可操作、可测量的评测框架。现有工作难以区分空间感知、度量落地、几何关系、函数解释、函数构造与约束综合等子能力，也无法分离服务可靠性、符号合规性与几何成功率。
AI.method: 构建GAGR-Lab框架：以笛卡尔游戏场景、显式函数语义、权威的Rust轨迹执行为核心；区分六类子能力（空间感知、度量落地、几何关系、函数解释、函数构造、约束综合）；设计四种可配置场景难度预设与一个前瞻性的24单元诊断设计；对单个托管模型（Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct）用两组API凭证作为执行副本进行有界试点；并设置"特权解析搜索"作为对照。
AI.result: 试点共72局平衡游戏、432次尝试、429次有效提供商响应，目标命中数为0；探索性普通函数提示变体同样未命中；结构化定位接口未产出可评分输出。特权解析搜索对照在300个生成场景的600个方向性案例上独立成功，具备精确可复现性，并通过1,200次垂直反射或平移检查。
AI.conclusion: 该工作贡献是一个带已执行试点与明确前瞻研究计划的可操作研究框架，能够分离服务可靠性、符号合规性与几何成功，并保留模型可见输入与真实路径；完整的难度矩阵与多模型比较结果仍待测试。

title: Masked Feature Encoding for Large-Scale Whole Slide Image Representation
summary: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis in computational pathology follows a multiple instance learning (MIL) pipeline where patch embeddings are extracted independently and aggregated for slide-level prediction, but within-slide variance from staining, scanner, and local texture can overwhelm the discriminative signal. We propose Masked Feature Encoding for Multiple Instance Learning (MFE-MIL), a feature-space masking framework that trains a lightweight MLP adapter jointly with a window-based masked reconstruction branch and a MIL classification head. The two objectives are complementary. Classification guides the adapter to suppress within-slide patch variance, while window-based masked reconstruction provides an auxiliary regularizer for the adapted features without using patch coordinates, coordinate graphs, or segmentation preprocessing. The raster patch-extraction order is used only as a weak implicit prior. At inference, the decoder is removed, leaving only the adapter and MIL head. Across CAMELYON16/17, PANDA, and TCGA-BRCA with four diverse encoders, MFE-MIL improves ACC/F1 for nearly all tested aggregator-encoder settings and AUC in most, outperforms coordinate-based spatial methods (CAMIL), and achieves higher AUC than 2DMamba on three of four datasets (UNI). On five TCGA survival cohorts it improves the average concordance index for every aggregator tested, its most consistent gain. Code is available at https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/MFE-MIL.

AI.tldr: MFE-MIL 提出一种特征空间掩码框架，通过轻量 MLP 适配器联合窗口掩码重建与 MIL 分类头，抑制切片内方差，无需坐标图或分割预处理，在多数据集与多编码器上稳定提升性能。
AI.motivation: 计算病理全切片图像（WSI）分析普遍采用多示例学习（MIL）流程：patch 嵌入独立提取后聚合做切片级预测。但染色、扫描仪、局部纹理带来的切片内方差会掩盖判别信号，影响聚合效果。
AI.method: 提出 MFE-MIL（Masked Feature Encoding for Multiple Instance Learning）：在特征空间做掩码，联合训练轻量 MLP 适配器、基于窗口的掩码重建分支与 MIL 分类头。两目标互补——分类引导适配器抑制切片内 patch 方差，窗口掩码重建为适配后特征提供辅助正则；不使用 patch 坐标、坐标图或分割预处理，仅将栅格化 patch 提取顺序作为弱隐式先验。推理时移除解码器，仅保留适配器与 MIL 头。
AI.result: 在 CAMELYON16/17、PANDA、TCGA-BRCA 上使用四种编码器，MFE-MIL 在几乎所有聚合器-编码器组合中提升 ACC/F1、多数提升 AUC，优于基于坐标的空间方法（CAMIL），在四个数据集中的三个上 AUC 超过 2DMamba（UNI）。在五个 TCGA 生存队列上，对每种测试的聚合器均提升平均一致性指数（C-index），这是其最稳定的增益。
AI.conclusion: MFE-MIL 是一种无需坐标与分割预处理的特征空间掩码框架，通过分类与掩码重建的互补目标有效抑制切片内方差，在分类与生存预测任务上均取得一致且稳健的提升，具有良好的通用性与可移植性。代码已开源。

title: From Prompts to Trees: Effective LLM-Guided Tree Generation for Few-Shot Tabular Classification
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main as an oral presentation. Code available: https://github.com/yueqiu0/LLMTree
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) possess rich world knowledge and impressive generalization capabilities, their direct application to tabular data classification is hindered by high inference costs and limited interpretability. In contrast, decision trees are fast and transparent but often underperform in low-data regimes. In this work, we propose a novel framework that bridges these paradigms by distilling LLM knowledge into interpretable decision trees under a few-shot learning setting. Instead of directly prompting the LLM to generate full trees, which is often unstable and inefficient, we develop a three-stage paradigm that prompts the LLM to generate rules and organize the rules into a tree. Experiments on multiple real-world tabular datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy and interpretability with significantly lower prompting overhead compared to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个少样本学习框架，将LLM知识蒸馏为可解释决策树，通过三阶段范式让LLM生成规则并组织成树，在多个真实表格数据集上兼顾精度与可解释性且提示开销更低。
AI.motivation: LLM虽具丰富世界知识和泛化能力，但直接用于表格数据分类存在推理成本高、可解释性差的问题；决策树虽快速透明，却在低数据场景下表现不佳。因此需要一种能结合二者优势的方案。
AI.method: 在少样本设置下，将LLM知识蒸馏进可解释决策树。不直接让LLM生成整棵树（不稳定且低效），而是采用三阶段范式：先提示LLM生成规则，再将规则组织为决策树。
AI.result: 在多个真实表格数据集上的实验表明，相比现有基线，该方法取得更优的准确率和可解释性，同时显著降低了提示开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过规则生成加规则组织成树的三阶段蒸馏范式，可有效融合LLM知识与决策树的轻量透明优势，为少样本表格分类提供了兼顾性能与可解释性的新思路。

title: LLM Persuasion Is in the Eye of the Evaluation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have already been shown to match or exceed human experts in persuasion. While their persuasive capabilities hold promise for beneficial uses such as education and health communication, they can also be used to manipulate and misinform, making their evaluation a growing priority for developers and regulators. That evaluation, however, remains fragmented: studies differ in what they treat as persuasion, and broad claims often rest on narrow, situation-specific assessments. Automated methods, often modelled on human studies, offer a way to compare such assessments directly, as they can be run on the same models at scale and can include high-risk forms of persuasion that would be difficult or unethical to test on people. In this study, we adapt nine published automated methods to a shared setup, run them on the same fifteen LLMs, and ask whether their rankings agree and why. We find that the methods agree only weakly (mean Spearman $ρ= 0.25$). Our analyses point to two contributing factors. Models that refuse some tasks but not others, directly or indirectly, lower agreement by about a quarter, and these refusals fall mostly on manipulation tasks. General capability also plays a part: most rational persuasion (non-manipulative) methods track it, whereas most manipulation methods do not. Together, these findings suggest that agreement depends more on the task a method sets than on how it scores persuasion, although this pattern is only indicative given the eight methods available for analysis. More broadly, our results suggest that persuasion scores combine a model's ability to persuade with its willingness to do so. A single score is therefore informative about its own setting, but says little about a model's persuasiveness across tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文对9种已发表的LLM说服力自动化评估方法进行统一复现，在相同15个LLM上运行并比较其模型排名一致性，发现方法间一致性很弱（平均Spearman ρ=0.25），主要受任务选择性拒答与通用能力混淆影响，说明单一说服力评分仅反映特定情境下的表现。
AI.motivation: LLM的说服能力已达到甚至超越人类专家水平，既可用于教育、健康传播等有益场景，也可被用于操纵与误导。开发者与监管方因此亟需对其进行评估，但现有评估高度碎片化：不同研究对"说服"的定义不一致，宏观结论往往建立在狭隘、情境化的测评之上。自动化方法（多模仿人类研究设计）可在同一模型上大规模运行、并覆盖在人类被试上难以或不宜测试的高风险说服形式，因而为直接比较这些评估提供了可行途径。
AI.method: 作者将9种已发表的自动化说服评估方法适配到统一实验框架中，在相同的15个LLM上运行，并检验这些方法给出的模型排名是否一致及其原因。分析重点关注两类因素：模型的任务选择性拒答（直接或间接）以及对通用能力的依赖程度，并对理性说服（非操纵类）与操纵类方法加以区分比较。
AI.result: 各方法间一致性仅为弱水平，平均Spearman ρ=0.25。模型对部分任务拒答而对另一些不拒答（无论直接还是间接）会使一致性下降约四分之一，且这些拒答主要集中于操纵类任务。通用能力亦起作用：多数理性说服（非操纵）方法能追踪通用能力，而多数操纵类方法则不能。由于可纳入分析的方法仅8种，该模式仅为提示性结论。
AI.conclusion: 方法间一致性更多取决于其所设定的任务类型，而非其打分方式。说服力得分实际上混合了模型"能否说服"（能力）与"是否愿意说服"（意愿）两方面。因此单一分数只对其自身设定的情境有信息量，难以推广描述模型在跨任务上的整体说服力。

title: Geometry-Supervised Visual Representation Learning for Multi-Phenotype Lesion Interpretation in Medical VLMs
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation. However, these models still struggle to interpret multi-phenotype lesions whose diagnosis requires the joint assessment of multiple pathological phenotypes. Existing vision-language alignment methods produce visual representations that fail to preserve anatomical hierarchies and relationships among phenotypic subclasses. This stems from their reliance on semantic supervision, which lacks geometric constraints to preserve these relationships in the visual embedding space. Moreover, the sparsity of lesion-related anatomical and phenotypic representations makes it difficult for medical VLMs to capture important diagnostic evidence. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{PureVision}, a geometry-supervised visual representation learning framework for multi-phenotype lesion interpretation in medical VLMs. It combines a geometry-supervised representation learning module, \textbf{PureEyes}, and an anatomy-guided evidence aggregation module, \textbf{PureNeurons}. PureEyes provides geometric supervision through ideal spatial distributions that encode anatomical hierarchies and phenotypic subclass relationships. PureNeurons projects visual representations into the learned latent space, using their positions to selectively aggregate lesion-specific anatomical and phenotypic evidence. Experiments on \textit{LIDC-IDRI}, \textit{CBIS-DDSM}, and \textit{3DReasonKnee} demonstrate that PureVision improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization in visual question answering and radiology report generation. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/purevision-06C2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PureVision几何监督视觉表示学习框架，用于医学视觉语言模型中的多表型病灶解读，包含PureEyes几何监督表示学习模块与PureNeurons解剖引导证据聚合模块，在三个数据集上提升了病灶定位与表型刻画性能。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型在临床图像解读中潜力渐显，但难以解读需联合评估多个病理表型的多表型病灶。现有视觉-语言对齐方法生成的视觉表示无法保留解剖层级与表型子类间关系，根源在于依赖语义监督、缺乏几何约束来在视觉嵌入空间中保持这些关系；同时病灶相关解剖与表型表示的稀疏性使模型难以捕捉关键诊断证据。
AI.method: 提出PureVision框架，由两部分组成：(1) PureEyes几何监督表示学习模块，通过编码解剖层级与表型子类关系的理想空间分布提供几何监督；(2) PureNeurons解剖引导证据聚合模块，将视觉表示投影到所学潜在空间，利用其位置选择性聚合病灶特异的解剖与表型证据。
AI.result: 在LIDC-IDRI、CBIS-DDSM和3DReasonKnee数据集上的实验表明，PureVision在视觉问答与放射报告生成任务中改善了病灶定位（lesion grounding）与表型刻画（phenotype characterization）。
AI.conclusion: 几何监督的视觉表示学习可有效弥补语义监督在保持解剖层级与表型关系上的不足，提升医学VLM对多表型病灶的解读能力，代码已开源。

title: LoomSC: Scalable Deep Subspace Clustering with Projector Factorization and Exact Spectral Reduction
summary: Dense self-expression matrices and full-affinity spectral clustering limit the scalability of subspace clustering. We introduce the Latent Orthogonal Optimization Model for Subspace Clustering (LoomSC), a framework that addresses both bottlenecks through projector factorization and exact spectral reduction. Motivated by the spectral structure of least-squares regression, LoomSC jointly learns latent features and a projector self-representation through two thin factors. Alternating Procrustes and least-squares updates preserve the sample factor's orthogonality while keeping the coefficient matrix implicit. We construct a nonnegative quadratic affinity that preserves the projector's support. An exact feature map then reduces its normalized spectral problem to an eigenproblem whose dimension depends only on the factor width. Neither the full affinity nor the sample Laplacian needs to be formed. Our analysis quantifies the projector approximation and identifies conditions for subspace preservation and within-subspace connectivity. For fixed dimensions and iteration budgets, the complete pipeline has linear time and memory complexity in the number of samples. Across five image-clustering benchmarks, LoomSC ranks first or second in all 15 dataset-metric comparisons against 9 state-of-the-art baselines. Its mean accuracy exceeds the highest baseline mean by 6.66 percentage points. Synthetic experiments scale to 500,000 samples while maintaining at least 99.8% accuracy.

AI.tldr: LoomSC通过投影因子分解与精确谱降维，解决子空间聚类中稠密自表达矩阵与全亲和谱聚类的可扩展性瓶颈，实现线性复杂度并在多个基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 稠密自表达矩阵与全亲和谱聚类限制了子空间聚类的可扩展性。需同时解决这两个瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出潜正交优化模型LoomSC，基于最小二乘回归的谱结构，通过两个薄因子联合学习潜特征与投影自表示；采用交替Procrustes与最小二乘更新以保持样本因子正交并隐式维护系数矩阵；构造保持投影支撑的非负二次亲和矩阵，并用精确特征映射将归一化谱问题约化为仅依赖因子宽度的特征问题，无需构造全亲和或样本拉普拉斯。
AI.result: 理论分析量化了投影近似，给出子空间保持与子空间内连通性的条件。固定维度与迭代预算下，整体流程关于样本数为线性时间和内存复杂度。在5个图像聚类基准的15项数据集-指标比较中，对9个先进基线均排名第一或第二，平均准确率高出最高基线均值6.66个百分点；合成实验扩展至50万样本仍保持至少99.8%准确率。
AI.conclusion: LoomSC通过投影因子分解与精确谱降维，同时缓解自表达与谱聚类瓶颈，实现线性复杂度并在准确率与可扩展性上均优于现有方法。

title: Video Prediction Policy 2: Predict Better, Act Better
summary: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as an important class of generalist robot policies, aiming to transfer video prediction priors to action learning. However, we find that existing WAMs frequently produce incorrect motion predictions in open-ended environment, leading to erroneous actions. We attribute this limitation to two factors: (1) base video models are not optimized for manipulation, and (2) naively incorporating action components into video models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities. We introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that enables strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. First, we curate a large-scale, diverse dataset of manipulation videos to continue pretraining the base video foundation model. We annotate video clips with detailed captions and perform \textit{event-level} video pretraining to promote generalization across open-ended manipulation tasks. Second, we post-train and distill the video model into a single-step visual planner with fixed prediction horizon. Finally, we introduce action module via a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture to learn implicit inverse dynamics model. Experiments demonstrate three key results: (1) VPP2-14B outperforms Cosmos3-64B by 11.0\% points in video prediction instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks; (2) VPP2 surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.5\% points in success rate on real-world zero-shot ALOHA manipulation tasks; and (3) following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on the challenging LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-OOD, and RoboDojo benchmarks.

AI.tldr: VPP2是一种世界动作模型，通过大规模操作视频预训练、视频模型蒸馏为单步视觉规划器及MoT动作模块，实现视频预测与动作生成的强零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）在开放环境中常产生错误运动预测，进而导致错误动作。作者归因于两点：基础视频模型未针对操作任务优化；将动作组件简单嵌入视频模型会显著损害其泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模多样化操作视频数据集，配详细字幕并进行事件级视频预训练以继续预训练视频基础模型；2) 对视频模型进行后训练并蒸馏为固定预测时长的单步视觉规划器；3) 通过混合Transformer（MoT）架构引入动作模块，学习隐式逆动力学模型。
AI.result: 1) VPP2-14B在开放任务视频预测指令遵循成功率上超过Cosmos3-64B 11.0个百分点；2) 在真实世界零样本ALOHA操作任务上比最强基线高18.5个百分点；3) 经基准特定后训练后，在LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-OOD和RoboDojo基准上取得最高成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对操作任务的视频预训练、单步视觉规划器蒸馏与MoT动作模块设计，VPP2在视频预测与动作生成上均实现强零样本泛化，并在多个操作基准上达到领先水平。

title: PatchBench: Measuring Collateral Damage in Activation Patching
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track)
summary: An LLM safety patch can pass a benchmark while still being a poor repair. This risk is especially acute for jailbreak repairs, where the goal is to correct a specific unsafe behaviour without changing unrelated behaviours. A patch may block exact evaluation prompts yet fail on close harmful variants, or suppress harmful behaviour by over-refusing benign prompts that share its wording or structure. Existing protocols primarily test whether models can be broken, while aggregate metrics (attack success, refusal rates, global capability) cannot distinguish selective repairs from broader local suppression. To address this gap, we introduce PatchBench, a benchmark of empirically observed model-specific jailbreak failures inducing actionable harmful answers. Starting from 27,870 prompts from 37 public datasets, we curate 15,314 English prompts and query 8 open-source instruction-tuned models. Combining WildGuard filtering, pairwise Elo ranking, and manual verification, we retain a curated bank of 400 high-confidence jailbreak failures. We further introduce PatchBench-Local, an evaluation protocol testing whether a patch is behaviourally precise. For each harmful source prompt, PatchBench-Local generates three families of local neighbours: harmful variants preserving malicious intent, benign prompts with matched structure, and benign prompts reusing key harmful terms. It evaluates harmful-neighbour correction and benign-neighbour preservation, distinguishing selective repair from broader local suppression. Evaluating four activation steering methods with PatchBench-Local and MMLU shows that global capability can remain nearly unchanged while local benign regressions are severe, confirming aggregate metrics miss important collateral damage. PatchBench-Local provides a more precise basis for developing and comparing jailbreak repair methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PatchBench 基准与 PatchBench-Local 评测协议，用于衡量越狱修复是否具有行为精准性，而非仅仅通过基准测试。
AI.motivation: LLM 安全补丁可能仅通过基准测试却仍是劣质修复。越狱修复的目标是纠正特定不安全行为而不影响无关行为，但补丁可能只挡住原评测提示词、在近邻有害变体上失效，或通过过度拒答同措辞、同结构的良性提示来压制有害行为。现有协议主要测试模型能否被攻破，聚合指标（攻击成功率、拒答率、全局能力）无法区分选择性修复与大范围局部压制。
AI.method: 构建 PatchBench：从 37 个公开数据集的 27,870 条提示出发，整理 15,314 条英文提示，查询 8 个开源指令微调模型；结合 WildGuard 过滤、成对 Elo 排序与人工验证，保留 400 条高置信度越狱失败样本。提出 PatchBench-Local：为每个有害源提示生成三类局部邻居——保留恶意的有害变体、结构匹配的良性提示、复用关键有害词元的良性提示；评测有害邻居纠正率与良性邻居保持率。用该协议与 MMLU 评估四种激活引导方法。
AI.result: 评估四种激活引导方法显示，全局能力几乎不变时局部良性回归却相当严重，证实聚合指标遗漏了重要的附带损害。
AI.conclusion: PatchBench-Local 为开发和比较越狱修复方法提供了更精准的依据。

title: Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability
summary: Humans can grasp everyday objects with almost perfect success rates using fingertip tactile feedback, yet much of the robotic grasping literature emphasizes vision-based grasp selection with parallel grippers. In this work, we systematically investigate how high-resolution, dynamic tactile sensing contributes to grasp stability prediction and model-guided grasping in dexterous robotic hands. To this end, we collected a dataset of 10,000 grasp trials across 200 objects using a multi-fingered robotic hand equipped with four Digit 360 tactile sensors, recording external vision, proprioception, and tactile streams throughout each grasp. With this dataset, we trained end-to-end temporal multimodal models to predict post-lift stability from pre-lift grasp observations and compared sensing modalities and encoding backbones. Experimental results and controlled input ablations show that incorporating touch, and particularly high-resolution, dynamic touch, improves grasp stability prediction. Finally, we deployed the learned predictor as an online stability gate on the real robot, where visuo-tactile model-guided regrasping improved the success rate among executed lifts by 10.5 percentage points over a non-tactile gate. These results show how rich fingertip sensing and expressive temporal models that capture the dynamics of touch can support learned grasping with multi-fingered hands without explicit contact or force modeling, providing a scalable data-driven path from tactile experience toward stable dexterous manipulation. The dataset is publicly available at https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了高分辨率动态触觉传感对灵巧手抓取稳定性预测与模型引导抓取的作用，构建了10,000次抓取试验的数据集并证明触觉（尤其是高分辨率动态触觉）能显著提升抓取稳定性预测与在线抓取成功率。
AI.motivation: 人类凭借指尖触觉反馈抓取物体几乎总能成功，而现有机器人抓取研究多依赖视觉与平行夹爪，忽视了触觉尤其是高分辨率动态触觉在灵巧手中的价值。作者希望量化触觉对抓取稳定性预测与模型引导抓取的贡献。
AI.method: 使用配备四个Digit 360触觉传感器的多指灵巧手，对200个物体采集10,000次抓取试验，记录外部视觉、本体感觉与触觉多模态流；训练端到端时序多模态模型，从抬升前的观测预测抬升后稳定性；对比不同传感模态与编码骨干网络，并进行受控输入消融；最后将预测器作为在线稳定性门控部署于真实机器人。
AI.result: 实验与消融表明，引入触觉（尤其是高分辨率动态触觉）可提升抓取稳定性预测；在真实机器人上，视觉-触觉模型引导的重抓使已执行抬升的成功率比无触觉门控高出10.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 丰富的指尖传感与捕捉触觉动态的时序模型能够支撑多指手的习得抓取，无需显式接触或力建模，为从触觉经验走向稳定的灵巧操作提供了可扩展的数据驱动路径；数据集已公开。

title: $Δ$Representation: Geometry Supervised Representation Learning of Phenotypes via Counterfactual Reasoning for Medical VLMs
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for radiological image interpretation. Medical VLMs encode radiological images into visual representations that capture both anatomical and phenotypic information for diagnosis. Existing approaches improve pathological phenotype representations through semantic-guided representation alignment. However, pathological phenotypes arise as lesion-specific visual changes superimposed on underlying normal anatomy. Such semantic alignment approaches fail to model the phenotype-specific increment relative to the corresponding normal anatomical representation. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{$Δ$Representation}, a visual phenotype representation learning framework based on counterfactual reasoning for medical VLMs. It comprises \textbf{BaseAnatomy}, a geometry-supervised representation learning module, and \textbf{$Δ$Phenotype}, a counterfactual incremental representation learning module. BaseAnatomy provides fine-grained geometric supervision through spatial relationships across and within anatomical structures. $Δ$Phenotype computes the representation increment between lesion representations and their corresponding normal anatomical representations, and supervises increments associated with the same phenotype to cluster in the representation space. Experiments on \textit{ReXGroundingCT} and \textit{LIDC-IDRI} demonstrate that $Δ$Representation effectively structures pathological phenotype representations and improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization accuracy in medical VLMs. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/deltarep-CF6D.

AI.tldr: 提出$Δ$Representation框架，通过反事实推理建模病变相对正常解剖的表型增量，改进医学视觉语言模型的病灶定位与表型辨识。
AI.motivation: 现有医学VLM多依赖语义引导的表征对齐来提升病理表型表征。但病理表型本质是在正常解剖基础上的病灶特异性视觉变化，这类方法无法刻画相对正常解剖表征的"表型增量"。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：BaseAnatomy，利用解剖结构间与结构内空间关系提供细粒度几何监督的表征学习模块；$Δ$Phenotype，基于反事实的增量表征学习模块，计算病灶表征与其对应正常解剖表征之差，并监督同一表型的增量在表征空间中聚集。
AI.result: 在ReXGroundingCT和LIDC-IDRI上实验表明，$Δ$Representation有效结构化病理表型表征，提升了医学VLM的病灶定位与表型刻画准确率。
AI.conclusion: 以反事实增量视角建模病理表型，可弥补语义对齐对"正常解剖基础上的病变增量"建模不足的问题，为医学VLM的表型表征学习提供新思路。

title: TouchScale: 500 Hours of Human Vision and Touch for Visual-Tactile Learning
summary: Large-scale egocentric human interaction data is becoming an important source of physical supervision for embodied learning, yet video alone leaves the contact and pressure that characterize physical interaction unrecorded. Recent visual-tactile datasets provide this missing supervision, but their synchronized tactile data remain far smaller in volume than human video. Moreover, the largest resources often merge recordings from different sensors or annotation procedures, which makes the effect of data scale difficult to isolate. We therefore introduce TouchScale, a 500-hour dataset of contact-rich human interaction recorded with a single unified wearable setup. Its approximately 2K predefined task descriptions span everyday activities and structured manipulation, and each recording temporally aligns egocentric RGB-D video with wrist RGB video and dense full-hand bimanual tactile measurements. Compared with prior tactile data, training on the full TouchScale raises zero-shot contact IoU on data from an unseen tactile sensor from 0.134 to 0.383. Pretraining a visual encoder on TouchScale also yields the highest action recognition accuracy on three benchmarks among the compared visual-tactile datasets. Used for visual-tactile mid-training of a robot policy, TouchScale improves the average real-world success rate across four contact-rich manipulation tasks from 22.5% to 57.5%. With the sensor and collection protocol held fixed, both zero-shot tactile prediction and robot success show an overall upward trend as more TouchScale data is used. These results suggest that human visual-tactile data collected at scale with consistent sensing benefits both perception and robot manipulation. We will publicly release TouchScale, including all synchronized visual-tactile recordings and reconstructed object models, to support future research on scalable visual-tactile learning.

AI.tldr: TouchScale：统一可穿戴设备采集的500小时视觉-触觉交互数据集，规模与一致性双优，显著提升零样本触觉预测、动作识别与机器人操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 第一人称人类交互数据是具身学习的重要物理监督来源，但视频无法记录接触与压力；现有视觉-触觉数据集触觉数据量远小于视频，且最大资源常混合不同传感器或标注流程，难以分离数据规模的作用。
AI.method: 构建TouchScale：用单一统一可穿戴装置采集500小时富含接触的人类交互数据，约2K预定义任务描述覆盖日常活动与结构化操作；每条记录在时间上对齐第一人称RGB-D视频、手腕RGB视频与密集全手双手触觉测量。
AI.result: 全量TouchScale训练将未见触觉传感器数据的零样本接触IoU从0.134提升至0.383；在TouchScale上预训练视觉编码器，在三个基准上取得对比视觉-触觉数据集中最高的动作识别准确率；用于机器人策略的视觉-触觉中期训练，四个富接触操作任务的平均真实世界成功率从22.5%提升至57.5%；固定传感器与采集协议下，随数据量增加，零样本触觉预测与机器人成功率整体呈上升趋势。
AI.conclusion: 以一致传感方式大规模采集的人类视觉-触觉数据同时有益于感知与机器人操作；将公开释放TouchScale，包括全部同步视觉-触觉记录与重建物体模型，支持可扩展视觉-触觉学习研究。

title: Large Language Model-Assisted Preparation of Transportation Management Plans: A Case Study with WisDOT WisTMP System
summary: Work zones are critical yet hazardous components of transportation infrastructure, requiring carefully designed Transportation Management Plans (TMPs) to ensure safety and mobility. However, TMP preparation remains labor-intensive and heavily dependent on practitioner expertise. This paper proposes a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to automate TMP content generation, leveraging the WisDOT WisTMP system as the application context. The framework fine-tunes multiple open-source LLMs across different model scales and deploys them locally to ensure data security. To support model training, we construct a domain-specific dataset from historical WisTMP documents by converting PDF files into structured question-answer pairs in JSON format. Experimental results show that fine-tuning significantly improves performance across standard text generation metrics. Further section-wise and strategy-level analyses reveal that, while LLMs achieve strong overall performance, they tend to over-generate strategies and struggle to produce project-specific justifications and accurate cost estimates. In addition, scaling from 7B/8B to 14B yields limited gains. These findings demonstrate the potential of LLMs to improve TMP preparation efficiency while highlighting remaining challenges in LLM-assisted TMP development. The source code and demo videos will be publicly available at https://zihaosheng.github.io/TMP-LLM/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的交通管理计划（TMP）内容自动生成框架，以WisDOT WisTMP系统为应用背景，通过本地部署微调多个不同规模的开源LLM实现自动化生成，并构建了领域问答数据集。
