AI.motivation: 工作区（work zone）是交通基础设施中关键但危险的组成部分，需精心设计TMP以保障安全与通行效率。然而TMP编制工作劳动密集、高度依赖从业者专业经验，自动化程度低，亟需借助LLM提升编制效率。
AI.method: 以WisDOT WisTMP系统为应用场景，提出LLM辅助框架；微调多个不同规模的（7B/8B/14B）开源LLM并本地部署以保障数据安全；将历史WisTMP的PDF文档转换为JSON格式的结构化问答对，构建领域专用数据集用于训练。
AI.result: 微调在标准文本生成指标上显著提升性能。分章节与策略层面分析显示：LLM整体表现良好，但倾向于过度生成策略，且难以给出项目针对性的论证理由和准确成本估算；此外，模型规模从7B/8B扩展至14B带来的收益有限。
AI.conclusion: LLM具备提升TMP编制效率的潜力，但在项目针对性论证、成本估算及策略生成精准度方面仍存在挑战。源代码与演示视频将在 https://zihaosheng.github.io/TMP-LLM/ 公开。

title: On the Necessity of Attention-FFN Split in Vision Transformers
summary: The standard Transformer architecture relies on a rigid pattern that alternates Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) layers. Despite its widespread adoption, the inductive bias imposed by this strict separation has not been systematically examined. In this work, we investigate the necessity of the Attention-FFN dichotomy in Vision Transformers (ViTs). To facilitate this analysis, we introduce the AttenFeed module, a unified component that integrates the functional properties of both Attention and FFN. Based on this module, we devise the unified Vision Transformer (uViT), which replaces the conventional alternating Attention-FFN structure with a sequence of AttenFeed modules. We then use uViT as a control group that relaxes the Attention-FFN dichotomy of the standard ViT and systematically compare the two models across multiple datasets and model scales. Our experiments reveal that the Attention-FFN dichotomy can hinder performance at smaller model scales due to the rigid parameter allocation of ViTs. The AttenFeed module and uViT serve as new analytical tools for understanding the Attention-FFN structure and offer theoretical insights into the heuristically designed architecture of conventional ViTs.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视 Vision Transformer 中"Attention 与 FFN 严格交替"这一设计，提出融合两者功能的 AttenFeed 模块并构建统一架构 uViT，作为放松该二分结构的对照组进行系统对比，发现该二分在小模型尺度下会因参数分配僵化而损害性能。
AI.motivation: 标准 Transformer 采用 Attention 与 FFN 层严格交替的固定模式，虽被广泛采用，但这种硬性分离所带来的归纳偏置从未被系统检验。作者希望探究 ViT 中 Attention-FFN 二分结构的必要性。
AI.method: 提出 AttenFeed 模块，将 Attention 与 FFN 的功能特性统一到同一组件中；基于该模块构建 uViT，用一串 AttenFeed 模块替换传统交替式 Attention-FFN 结构。以 uViT 作为放松二分结构的对照组，在多个数据集与多种模型尺度上与标准 ViT 进行系统对比。
AI.result: 实验表明，Attention-FFN 二分结构会在较小模型尺度下因 ViT 参数分配僵化而制约性能表现。
AI.conclusion: AttenFeed 模块与 uViT 为理解 Attention-FFN 结构提供了新的分析工具，并为传统 ViT 这一依赖经验设计的架构提供了理论层面的洞见。

title: SemanticFold: Latent Sequence Compression SeparatesLanguage Modeling, Decodability, and Reasoning
summary: We study whether latent sequence compression of prompt prefixes preserves the capabilities that large language models rely on during inference. We introduce SemanticFold, a compression scheme that folds prefix hidden states at learned boundaries, and evaluate it across five model scales: Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-8B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Pythia-1.4B, and Pythia-6.9B. We use a fixed-target protocol: a frozen prefix is executed natively or compressed, and both arms teacher-force identical continuation tokens. This design rules out target-selection explanations for likelihood changes. We examine five endpoint families: fixed-target negative log-likelihood, finite-label reasoning accuracy, linear probe accessibility, open-ended generation, and systems-level memory and latency. We find that compression moves these endpoints non-monotonically and that they do not share a single compression threshold. On Qwen3-1.7B at compression ratio R=1.7, compressed-minus-native mean NLL decreases by 0.135 under paired bootstrap with 10000 draws. On SmolLM2 at R=1.2, the mean change is 0.013 higher than native. On both Pythia checkpoints, NLL is effectively unchanged. An NLL decomposition separating sequence shortening from the learned residual transform shows that the favorable Qwen likelihood is attributable primarily to residual adaptation rather than to shortening alone. MLP-only, which applies the transform without shortening, achieves 0.082 lower NLL than Full SemanticFold. Linear probe accuracy and macro AUC change by less than 0.03 in absolute value across conditions, with confidence intervals crossing zero. We conclude that preservation under latent compression has no single scalar certificate: language-model fit, decodability, and reasoning behavior answer different questions and can move in different directions under the same compression operation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SemanticFold——在学到的边界处折叠前缀隐状态的潜在序列压缩方案，并在五个模型上以固定目标协议评测压缩对推理能力的影响，发现各评测端点随压缩非单调变化且不共享统一阈值。
AI.motivation: 探究提示前缀的潜在序列压缩是否能在推理中保留大语言模型所依赖的能力，即压缩后能力保持是否存在单一可度量的"证书"。
AI.method: 提出 SemanticFold，在学习到的边界处折叠前缀隐状态；覆盖 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-8B、SmolLM2-1.7B、Pythia-1.4B、Pythia-6.9B 五个规模。采用固定目标协议：冻结前缀分别以原生或压缩方式执行，两臂教师强制相同的后续 token，从而排除目标选择对似然变化的解释。评测五类端点：固定目标负对数似然（NLL）、有限标签推理准确率、线性探针可及性、开放式生成、系统级显存与时延，并做 NLL 分解区分序列缩短与学习到的残差变换，同时设 MLP-only 变体（仅变换不缩短）。
AI.result: 压缩使各端点非单调变化，且不共享同一压缩阈值。Qwen3-1.7B 在 R=1.7 时压缩相对原生的平均 NLL 在配对 bootstrap（10000 次抽样）下降低 0.135；SmolLM2 在 R=1.2 时平均变化比原生高 0.013；两个 Pythia 检查点上 NLL 基本不变。NLL 分解显示 Qwen 的有利似然主要来自残差适配而非单纯缩短；MLP-only 比 Full SemanticFold 的 NLL 低 0.082。线性探针准确率与 macro AUC 在各条件下绝对变化小于 0.03，置信区间跨零。
AI.conclusion: 潜在压缩下的能力保持不存在单一标量证书：语言模型拟合度、可解码性与推理行为回答的是不同问题，并可在同一压缩操作下朝不同方向变化。

title: One-Shot Adaptive Segmentation For Scientific Images
summary: Scientific image segmentation methods rely on extensive annotation and task-specific training, limiting adaptation across imaging modalities and experimental conditions. We present a training-free, one-shot framework that specializes vision foundation models using a single annotated reference image. The framework combines DINOv3 representations with background-adaptive feature orthogonalization to suppress artifact-related feature directions, after which cosine similarity localizes candidate regions for SAM segmentation. We evaluate the framework on red-blood-cell microscopy, structured-illumination pool boiling, and chest radiography. Relative to the strongest baseline, the proposed method improves mean IoU by 5.91% and 78.62% on the microscopy and pool-boiling datasets, respectively, while achieving comparable performance on chest radiographs. These results demonstrate that one-shot reference conditioning can adapt general-purpose vision models to specialized scientific segmentation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练、单样本（one-shot）框架，用单张标注参考图像特化视觉基础模型，融合DINOv3表征与背景自适应特征正交化抑制伪影方向，再由余弦相似度定位候选区域供SAM分割；在红细胞显微、结构光池沸腾与胸部X线数据集上平均IoU较最强基线提升5.91%与78.62%，胸片性能相当。
AI.motivation: 科学图像分割方法依赖大量标注和任务特定训练，难以跨成像模态与实验条件迁移，因此需要一种无需训练、仅需单张标注参考图即可适配通用视觉基础模型的分割方案。
AI.method: 免训练单样本框架：以单张标注参考图像进行条件化，使用DINOv3表征，结合背景自适应特征正交化（background-adaptive feature orthogonalization）抑制与伪影相关的特征方向，随后通过余弦相似度定位候选区域，交由SAM完成分割。
AI.result: 在红细胞显微、结构光池沸腾和胸部X线三类数据上评估：相较最强基线，显微数据集平均IoU提升5.91%，池沸腾数据集提升78.62%，胸部X线性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 单样本参考条件化可将通用视觉模型适配到专业科学分割任务，验证了免训练框架跨模态的适用性与有效性。

title: Nobody Truly Agrees on Sentiment: Humans, Bespoke Tools, and LLMs Struggle with Social Media Texts
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, accepted for publication at TPDL 2026
summary: Social media is a rich source of real-time public sentiment, but widely used sentiment analysis tools are often applied without understanding their limitations. In this study, we evaluate the inter-rater reliability of three bespoke sentiment analysis tools (TextBlob, VADER, and Twitter-roBERTa-base) and three large language models (LLMs: Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-120B, Llama-4-Maverick-17B) against six human raters across 100 tweets. We measured agreement using two statistical measures: Cohen's kappa for pairwise comparisons and Fleiss' kappa for multiple raters. Even among the human raters, our results showed only fair agreement, highlighting the subjectivity of sentiment analysis. Higher agreement was observed under the binary sentiment classification (negative vs. non-negative and positive vs. non-positive) than under the three-class classification across both humans and automated tools. The Twitter-roBERTa-base model showed the strongest alignment with human ratings, outperforming both bespoke sentiment tools and LLMs, particularly in distinguishing negative versus non-negative sentiment. LLMs showed substantial agreement among themselves and moderate to substantial alignment with humans, performing better in positive vs. non-positive classifications. Our findings underscore that domain-specific fine-tuning remains crucial for reliable social media sentiment analysis, and human-centered evaluation remains essential for establishing gold-standard labels.

AI.tldr: 该研究用Cohen's kappa和Fleiss' kappa评估了三种情感分析工具（TextBlob、VADER、Twitter-roBERTa-base）与三种大语言模型（Qwen3-32B、GPT-OSS-120B、Llama-4-Maverick-17B）在100条推文上与六名人类标注者的一致性，发现人类间一致性仅"fair"，二元分类一致性高于三分类，Twitter-roBERTa-base与人类对齐最佳，LLM之间高度一致。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体情感分析工具被广泛使用，但其局限性常被忽视；研究旨在系统评估自动化工具（含新兴LLM）与人类标注者之间的一致性信度，揭示情感分析的主观性问题。
AI.method: 以100条推文为样本，6名人类标注者；对比3种专用情感分析工具（TextBlob、VADER、Twitter-roBERTa-base）与3种LLM（Qwen3-32B、GPT-OSS-120B、Llama-4-Maverick-17B）；采用Cohen's kappa（成对比较）与Fleiss' kappa（多标注者）测量一致性，并比较三分类与二元分类设定。
AI.result: 人类标注者之间仅为fair一致性；二元分类（负/非负、正/非正）一致性高于三分类；Twitter-roBERTa-base与人类评分对齐最强，尤其擅长区分负/非负，优于专用工具与LLM；LLM彼此间一致性较高，与人类为中等至较高对齐，在正/非正分类上表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定的微调对可靠的社交媒体情感分析仍至关重要，且以人为本的评估仍是建立金标准标签的必要途径。

title: From Digital Human Interactions to Physics-Based Humanoid Skills: Physics-Grounded Post-Training of Interaction Generators
summary: Recent methods have made promising progress in generating interactions between two humanoids, largely relying on physics-based tracking policies to convert digital reference motions into executable trajectories. However, limited tracking capabilities restrict the range of reference motions that can be successfully executed, reducing data utilization. Moreover, even successful tracking does not guarantee physically plausible responses or faithful realization of the intended interactions. In this paper, we introduce DIGHT, a co-adaptive framework that couples a Digital human Interaction Generator with a Humanoid Tracking policy. Our DIGHT first executes multiple text-conditioned interaction candidates in simulation using a fixed tracker. It then constructs physics-grounded preferences from the resulting rollouts, covering both general executability and interaction fidelity. Rather than collapsing these signals into a single scalar reward for candidate ranking, we align the pretrained generator using physics-decoupled diffusion direct preference optimization (DPO), preserving criterion-specific supervision without differentiating through the simulator. To improve executability, preference pairs are derived from tracking error, friction, and floating. Additionally, to improve interaction fidelity, we propose to incorporate force feedback from simulator as a measure of contact fidelity and construct preferences over contact occurrence, location, duration, and force magnitude. The aligned generator then supplies reference motions for fine-tuning the tracker, improving compatibility between generation and physical execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only improves the physical plausibility of generated motions but also enables more reliable and faithful humanoid interactions in simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出DIGHT框架，通过物理解耦的扩散DPO对齐数字人交互生成器与类人跟踪策略，提升生成动作的物理可行性与交互保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有双类人交互生成方法依赖基于物理的跟踪策略将数字参考动作转化为可执行轨迹，但跟踪能力有限，限制了可用参考动作范围、降低数据利用率；且即使跟踪成功也不能保证物理合理响应或忠实实现预期交互。核心问题在于生成器与跟踪器之间的不匹配。
AI.method: DIGHT是一个协同自适应框架，耦合数字人交互生成器（Digital human Interaction Generator）与类人跟踪策略（Humanoid Tracking policy）。先用固定跟踪器在仿真中执行多个文本条件交互候选，从rollout构建基于物理的偏好，覆盖通用可执行性与交互保真度。不将信号压缩为单一标量奖励排序，而是采用物理解耦的扩散直接偏好优化（DPO）对齐预训练生成器，保留各准则的独立监督且无需通过模拟器求导。可执行性偏好对源自跟踪误差、摩擦、悬浮；交互保真度偏好引入模拟器力反馈衡量接触质量，并在接触发生、位置、持续时间、力大小上构建偏好。对齐后的生成器再为微调跟踪器提供参考动作，提升生成与物理执行的兼容性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法不仅提升了生成动作的物理合理性，还使仿真中的类人交互更可靠、更忠实。
AI.conclusion: 通过协同自适应与物理解耦DPO对齐，DIGHT有效弥合了数字人交互生成与物理执行之间的差距，兼顾物理可行性与交互保真度。

title: Performance at What Cost? A Sustainability-Aware Performance Index for Cell and Nucleus Instance Segmentation
summary: Pretrained models for cell and nuclear instance segmentation differ substantially in architecture, pretraining data and objectives, parameter count, inference strategy, adaptation requirements, postprocessing pipeline, and computational demand. Large pretrained and foundation models are increasingly adopted because of their strong zero-shot capabilities, but their use also imposes greater energy consumption, memory requirements, computational demands, adaptation costs, and operational carbon emissions. Whether these additional demands are justified by meaningful gains in segmentation performance remains unclear. We address this question by introducing the Sustainability-Aware Performance Index (SAPI), a configurable metric that combines segmentation performance, energy consumption, and model size. We benchmark 19 pretrained and foundation models across six CellBinDB datasets under zero-shot inference and evaluate 16 fine-tunable models using few-shot adaptation with both frozen encoder and full-model fine-tuning. We estimate energy consumption for GPU, CPU, and RAM using software-based monitoring tools. Our results show that larger and more computationally demanding models do not consistently achieve proportionate improvements in segmentation quality. While few-shot adaptation benefits several models, the gains and resource costs vary considerably across architectures, datasets, and adaptation strategies, causing SAPI-based rankings to differ from rankings based on performance alone. This study provides a practical framework for comparing segmentation models more comprehensively and supports more computationally accessible and environmentally responsible model selection in biomedical image analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出可持续性感知性能指数（SAPI），综合分割性能、能耗与模型规模，对19个预训练/基础模型在6个CellBinDB数据集上进行零样本推理，并对16个可微调模型进行少样本适应评估，发现更大模型并不必然带来成比例的分割性能提升。
AI.motivation: 细胞与细胞核实例分割的预训练模型在架构、预训练数据与目标、参数量、推理策略、适应需求、后处理流程与算力需求上差异显著。大型预训练与基础模型因强大的零样本能力被广泛采用，但也带来更高能耗、内存、算力、适应成本与碳排放。这些额外开销能否被分割性能的实际增益所抵消尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出可配置的可持续性感知性能指数（SAPI），将分割性能、能耗与模型规模相结合；在6个CellBinDB数据集上对19个预训练与基础模型进行零样本推理基准测试，并对16个可微调模型采用少样本适应（冻结编码器与全模型微调）进行评估；使用基于软件的监测工具估算GPU、CPU与RAM的能耗。
AI.result: 更大、算力需求更高的模型并未稳定获得与开销成比例的分割质量提升。少样本适应对多个模型有益，但增益与资源开销在架构、数据集与适应策略间差异显著，导致基于SAPI的排序与仅基于性能的排序不同。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个更全面比较分割模型的实用框架，支持在生物医学图像分析中做出更易获取算力且更环保的模型选择。

title: Learning to Act with Task Progress: Distilling Small Agents from Compact Teacher Supervision
summary: Learning from large-model demonstrations offers a way to train small agents that can complete recurring tasks without calling a large model at every step. A central design choice is what to retain from teacher trajectories that contain reasoning, actions, and information about task progress. We introduce Task-Progress Distillation (TPD), an offline approach that pairs each demonstrated action with a short label describing the current task stage. The student learns these compact targets and selects actions by jointly scoring admissible stage--action pairs, which a deterministic harness executes in the environment. On ALFWorld, a 1.7B student trained with 404 demonstrations achieves 72.4\% mean unseen task success with either TPD or action-only supervision, compared with 48.3\% for a reasoning-trained student using constrained action selection. Explicit stages provide an additional benefit at 200 demonstrations, improving success from 48.0\% to 67.7\% over action-only supervision. With more demonstrations, the action-only student closes the gap, and both approaches reach 76.9\% at 808 demonstrations. Shared-history analyses link part of TPD's local advantage to better decisions when moving between subgoals, particularly from object acquisition to processing. These results show that compact supervision can train effective small task agents, while explicit task progress provides additional guidance at an intermediate demonstration budget.

AI.tldr: 提出Task-Progress Distillation (TPD)离线蒸馏方法，用简短任务阶段标签替代教师推理轨迹，训练1.7B小模型在ALFWorld上达到72.4%未见过任务成功率，与仅动作监督相当，并优于基于推理监督的48.3%。
AI.motivation: 训练不依赖每步调用大模型的小型智能体处理重复任务时，关键问题是如何从包含推理、动作和任务进度信息的教师轨迹中保留有效监督信号。教师推理轨迹冗长，作为监督可能并非最优，需要探究更紧凑的监督形式。
AI.method: TPD是一种离线蒸馏方法：为每条示范动作配一个描述当前任务阶段的短标签；学生模型学习这些紧凑目标，通过对可行的"阶段-动作"对进行联合打分来选择动作，并由确定性执行器（harness）在环境中执行所选动作。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld上，使用404条示范训练的1.7B学生模型，在TPD或仅动作监督下均取得72.4%的平均未见任务成功率，而采用受限动作选择的推理训练学生仅为48.3%。在200条示范的中间预算下，显式阶段标签将成功率从48.0%提升至67.7%（相对仅动作监督）。示范数量增多后，仅动作监督学生追平差距，两者在808条示范时均达76.9%。共享历史分析表明，TPD的局部优势部分来自子目标切换时（尤其从获取物体到加工物体）更优的决策。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑监督足以训练有效的小型任务智能体；显式任务进度标签在中等示范预算下能提供额外增益，但在示范充裕时收益递减，仅动作监督亦可达到相当水平。

title: How Private is Private? A Comparative Study for Face De-Identification
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project Page: https://cv-ac.github.io/hifd/
summary: Face de-identification (FDeID) has emerged as a critical privacy-preserving technology, yet its evaluation remains fundamentally fragmented. Existing protocols rely on inconsistent metrics, heterogeneous datasets, and partial annotation coverage, so methods targeting different utility dimensions, such as landmark versus expression preservation, are reported on different benchmarks under different metrics, rendering cross-method comparison infeasible. We revisit FDeID evaluation from both the data and metric perspectives. On the data side, we introduce UtilFace, a curated, demographically balanced benchmark with high identity diversity, assembled from four large-scale face datasets through identity-aware cleaning, resolution enhancement, and stratified filtering. On the metric side, we propose HiFD, a Hierarchical Face De-identification metric that unifies identity suppression, multi-level utility preservation, and image quality under a single consistency-based paradigm: every component is computed from pretrained estimators' outputs on the original face and its de-identified counterpart, directly quantifying how much identity is suppressed and how much downstream-perceivable utility survives. HiFD organizes facial signals into a three-level utility hierarchy spanning macro cues (L1), micro cues (L2), and imperceptible cues (L3), and aggregates the five resulting components into a single interpretable score via weighted harmonic mean, with configurable application-specific profiles. Using this unified protocol, we conduct a comprehensive comparative study spanning adversarial, GAN-based, and diffusion-based methods, surfacing trade-offs and failure modes that remain invisible under existing protocols. We release the benchmark and evaluation toolkit to foster systematic and reproducible research in privacy-preserving human face analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文针对人脸去身份化（FDeID）评估碎片化问题，从数据与指标两方面提出统一评估协议：构建人口统计平衡的高身份多样性基准 UtilFace，并提出基于一致性范式的层级指标 HiFD，将身份抑制、多级效用保持与图像质量统一为单一可解释分数，并据此开展对抗、GAN与扩散方法的系统比较。
AI.motivation: 现有FDeID评估协议存在指标不一致、数据集异构、标注覆盖不完整等问题，导致面向不同效用维度（如关键点保持、表情保持）的方法在不同基准与指标下报告结果，跨方法比较不可行，亟需统一的数据与指标评估框架。
AI.method: 数据侧：构建 UtilFace，从四个大规模人脸数据集经身份感知清洗、分辨率增强与分层过滤，得到人口统计平衡、高身份多样性的基准。指标侧：提出 HiFD，采用一致性范式，所有组件均由预训练估计器在原始人脸与去身份化人脸上的输出计算，量化身份抑制程度与下游可感知效用的保留；将面部信号组织为三级效用层级（L1宏观线索、L2微观线索、L3不可感知线索），并将五个组件通过加权调和平均聚合为单一可解释分数，支持可配置的应用场景档位。
AI.result: 基于该统一协议，对对抗、GAN与扩散三类方法进行了全面比较研究，揭示了在既有协议下不可见的权衡关系与失效模式；同时开源基准与评估工具包。
AI.conclusion: 统一的FDeID评估协议（UtilFace + HiFD）可支持跨方法的系统、可复现比较，促进隐私保护人脸分析研究的规范化发展。

title: When to Unpair: Regulating Pairing Dependence in Medical Visual In-Context Learning
summary: Visual in-context learning (ICL), well suited to label-scarce medical imaging, uses support image-label pairs to demonstrate input-output mappings, while the labels collectively indicate the requested task. We diagnose dependence on individual pairings with a test-time derangement that reassigns every support label to another support image while preserving the query, support images, and label multiset. The resulting pairing gap, defined as shuffled-minus-matched performance, shows that all four released models depend on the pairing, to widely varying degrees. Further analysis of a paired-trained model reveals support-associated spurious regions and lesion-size biases even with real, unaltered supports, alongside sensitivity to mis-registered support labels. To regulate this dependence, we introduce a late unpairing curriculum (LUC), which starts with matched training and then applies random unpairing, replacing each support label with that of another support in the same episode. LUC nearly closes the pairing gap on two backbones while maintaining or improving matched-support performance across all evaluated task types, with gains extending to held-out tasks and cross-dataset episodes. It also mitigates these failure modes. On BraTS whole-tumor segmentation, matched-support DSC rises from 0.733 to 0.857 while the gap shrinks from -0.184 to -0.008. In a released model, brief fine-tuning with random unpairing reduces the gap. A reversed curriculum that places the same number of unpairing epochs at the start of training leaves a large gap. This shows that pairing dependence is shaped by the order of training and not only by the amount of unpaired training.

AI.tldr: 该研究报告了视觉上下文学习（ICL）模型对支持图像-标签配对关系的过度依赖，并提出“晚期解配对课程”（LUC）来缓解这一问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉ICL适用于医学影像等标签稀缺场景，它利用支持图像-标签对来演示输入-输出映射，但这些标签整体上指示的是所请求的任务。作者旨在诊断模型是否过度依赖单个图像-标签配对，而非真正理解任务。
AI.method: 作者设计了一种测试时错位（derangement）实验，将所有支持标签重新分配给其他支持图像，同时保持查询、支持图像和标签多重集不变，得到“配对差距”（shuffled-minus-matched performance）。基于此分析，提出晚期解配对课程（LUC）：先进行匹配训练，再施加随机解配对，将每个支持标签替换为同一episode中其他支持的标签。此外还设置了将相同解配对轮数放在训练开始的逆向课程进行对照。
AI.result: 四个已发布模型均依赖配对关系，但程度差异较大。配对训练的模型表现出与支持相关的虚假区域和病灶大小偏置，并对配准错误的支持标签敏感。LUC在两个骨干网络上几乎消除配对差距，同时保持或提升匹配支持性能，增益可泛化到留出任务和跨数据集episode，并缓解上述失败模式。在BraTS全肿瘤分割上，匹配支持DSC从0.733提升至0.857，差距从-0.184缩小至-0.008。对已发布模型进行短暂的随机解配对微调也能缩小差距。而将相同解配对轮数置于训练开始的逆向课程仍留下较大差距。
AI.conclusion: 配对依赖不仅由解配对训练的量决定，还受训练顺序影响。先匹配后解配对的课程能有效调控视觉ICL对支持配对的依赖，提升医学影像分割等任务的性能与鲁棒性。

title: Position Forcing: Self-Conditioning 3D Generation
summary: Recent single-stage 3D generative models commonly adopt VecSet representations, encoding 3D shapes as unordered sets of latent tokens. However, compared with two-stage methods that provide explicit positional guidance, these models must implicitly infer token positions throughout denoising, limiting their generation quality. We observe that, despite the absence of explicit positional conditioning, VecSet tokens retain recoverable spatial correspondences. Building on this observation, we propose Position Forcing, a position-based self-conditioning framework. During denoising, Position Forcing recovers token positions from the current clean latent estimate, quantizes them at progressively finer resolutions according to the denoising stage, and feeds the resulting positional encodings back into the diffusion Transformer. This progressively refined positional feedback provides spatial guidance at a granularity appropriate to each denoising stage, guiding shape generation along a coarse-to-fine trajectory and substantially improving generation quality without a separate position generation stage. Experiments demonstrate that Position Forcing achieves strong performance among single-stage 3D generative methods and outperforms several competitive multi-stage approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出Position Forcing，一种基于位置的自条件框架，从去噪过程中的干净隐变量估计恢复token位置并以渐进细化分辨率量化后回馈给扩散Transformer，为单阶段VecSet 3D生成模型提供显式空间引导，性能超越多种多阶段方法。
AI.motivation: 单阶段3D生成模型常用VecSet表示，将3D形状编码为无序隐token集合。相比提供显式位置引导的两阶段方法，这类模型必须在整个去噪过程中隐式推断token位置，限制了生成质量。
AI.method: 观察到尽管缺乏显式位置条件，VecSet token仍保留可恢复的空间对应关系。据此提出Position Forcing：去噪时从当前干净隐变量估计中恢复token位置，按去噪阶段以逐渐更细的分辨率量化，将所得位置编码反馈回扩散Transformer，实现与各去噪阶段粒度匹配的空间引导，沿由粗到细轨迹生成形状，且无需单独的位置生成阶段。
AI.result: 在单阶段3D生成方法中取得强劲性能，并优于若干有竞争力的多阶段方法。
AI.conclusion: 渐进细化的位置反馈可为单阶段VecSet 3D生成提供恰当粒度的空间引导，显著提升生成质量，同时避免引入独立的位置生成阶段。

title: Real-Time Joint Audio-Video Generation by Parallel Adapter Composition
summary: Deploying a joint audio-video diffusion transformer for real-time, interactive generation normally requires two essential modifications: block-autoregressive attention, so frames can be emitted before the whole clip is finished, and few-step sampling, so each block is cheap. Conventionally, the streaming video literature obtains both capabilities from a chained pipeline. It first distills a bidirectional teacher into a causal student, then into a few-step one, or proceeds in reverse order. Each stage of such a chain fine-tunes the weights the previous one produced, so a later objective can undo an earlier capability. Following the idea of model merging, we show that on a packed audio-video backbone the two capabilities can be acquired in parallel. A causal adapter is trained against the frozen backbone, and an off-the-shelf few-step adapter provides the few-step capability. As the two edit different functional axes, we predict, and then verify, that their weight-update directions are near-orthogonal, without any explicit orthogonality constraint during training. Orthogonal updates should combine without interfering, so parallel composition is a direct sum. The two adapters are simply added at inference, with no joint training, yielding few-step, streaming audio-video whose image quality tracks the bidirectional teacher. Compared to the chained baselines, the composed model matches or beats them on most metrics, making parallel composition a practical approach. The resulting streaming system generates joint audio-video in real time, $\approx$26 fps at $480\times832$ without quantization, and sustains 30 s of continuous generation with stable image quality. Demo Page: https://pac-demo-2027.github.io/demo/

AI.tldr: 本文提出并行组合（parallel composition）方法，在冻结的联合音视频扩散Transformer骨干上并行训练因果适配器与复用现成的少步适配器，无需联合训练即可实现少步、流式音视频生成。
AI.motivation: 实时交互式音视频联合生成需两项能力：块自回归注意力（流式输出）与少步采样（低成本）。传统链式流水线（双向教师→因果学生→少步，或反序）中，后一阶段微调会破坏前一阶段已获得的能力，存在能力相互抵消的问题。
AI.method: 借鉴模型合并思想，在packed音视频骨干上并行获取两种能力：因果适配器针对冻结骨干训练，少步适配器直接使用现成模型。由于二者作用于不同功能轴，作者预测并验证其权重更新方向近似正交（训练中无显式正交约束），因此可视为直和式的并行组合——推理时两适配器直接相加，无需联合训练。
AI.result: 组合模型图像质量接近双向教师，在多数指标上匹配或超越链式基线。流式系统在480×832下实现约26 fps的实时联合音视频生成（无量化），可持续30秒连续生成且画质稳定。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明权重更新近似正交的两种能力可无干扰地相加组合，使并行组合成为一种实用且有效的方案，优于链式蒸馏基线。

title: MultiFly: A Real-World Multimodal Aerial Dataset with Annotation-Efficient Label Transfer and Cross-Modal Semantic Consistency
summary: We introduce MultiFly, a real-world, low-altitude UAV dataset for semantic perception across RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar modalities. MultiFly provides 17,272 synchronized samples from four suburban scenes with frame-wise annotations for 15 semantic classes, together with calibration and GNSS-RTK/IMU measurements. To avoid costly and inconsistent modality-specific annotation, we propagate labels from only 115 manually annotated RGB images through shared geometric representations to all four modalities. This approach generates semantic labels for 17,157 additional RGB images, 17,272 thermal images, 840M LiDAR points, and 3.4M radar points. Transferred annotations achieve 89.93% average agreement with held-out manual annotations, and 90.94% average semantic consistency across all six modality pairs. We further establish semantic segmentation benchmarks for all four modalities, revealing distinct architectural behavior for dense LiDAR and sparse radar data. Taken together, MultiFly provides a scalable foundation for multimodal aerial perception and, to the best of our knowledge, the first public real-world low-altitude aerial benchmark that combines consistent frame-wise semantic annotations for RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar. Data at https://github.com/markus-42/multifly.

AI.tldr: MultiFly 是首个面向低空 UAV 的真实世界多模态语义感知数据集，涵盖 RGB、热成像、LiDAR 与雷达四种模态，提供 17,272 个同步样本与逐帧语义标注，并通过跨模态标签传播降低标注成本，同时建立了四种模态的语义分割基准。
AI.motivation: 多模态航空感知缺乏一致、可扩展的真实世界基准：传统方法需为每种模态单独标注，成本高且跨模态不一致；现有低空 UAV 数据集也少有同时覆盖 RGB、热成像、LiDAR 和雷达的逐帧语义标注。作者希望以低成本方式构建多模态一致的语义标注资源，支撑多模态航空感知研究。
AI.method: 采集四个郊区场景的同步多模态数据，包含 RGB、热成像、LiDAR 与雷达，共 17,272 个同步样本，覆盖 15 个语义类别，并提供标定与 GNSS-RTK/IMU 测量。仅人工标注 115 张 RGB 图像，借助共享几何表示将标签传播到其他模态，从而生成 17,157 张额外 RGB 图像、17,272 张热成像图像、840M LiDAR 点和 3.4M 雷达点的语义标签。随后为四种模态建立语义分割基准。
AI.result: 传播标注与留出人工标注的平均一致率达 89.93%，在全部六个模态对上的平均语义一致性为 90.94%。语义分割基准显示，密集 LiDAR 数据与稀疏雷达数据在架构行为上存在明显差异。
AI.conclusion: MultiFly 为多模态航空感知提供了可扩展基础，是据作者所知首个公开的真实世界低空航空基准，同时具备 RGB、热成像、LiDAR 与雷达一致的逐帧语义标注，数据已公开。

title: Input-Blind Controls Produce Substantial Oracle Headroom for Layer Programs in Multiple-Choice Evaluation
summary: Adaptive computation aims to improve language-model inference by tailoring execution to each input. For layer programs, oracle evaluations use known answers to estimate the potential gain from this flexibility, before a practical selector is available. However, a gain from selection does not by itself explain why the chosen programs help. This study examines this distinction using 32 layer-skipping and repetition programs on two models and 4,413 multiple-choice items. The analysis compares their gains over a fixed action selected without the evaluation prompt with those of input-blind perturbations at the same sites, re-evaluating selections on another prompt. With shared option order, the controls give 10.2-11.8 and 15.6-19.4 percentage points of headroom on Qwen3-4B-Base and Llama-3.1-8B, exceeding the real programs' 9.0 and 10.1 in all three random-direction draws per model. They match answer-change rate only, and the ordering depends on the menu: in post hoc comparisons, real programs lead on Llama's repeat-only menu in every draw. A smaller KL-calibrated comparison, including an input-dependent control, favours real programs in point estimate, with inconclusive corrected tests. Fixed letter offsets produce headroom of similar scale. Rotating options sharply reduces both families' headroom, while leaving positive real-minus-control differences of 1.4-2.3 and 3.7-4.5 points; their magnitudes and statistical support depend on further adjustments and the reference. A supplementary generated-answer test finds that search-selected programs keep a 26.0-point advantage over programs selected for other problems after rewording, without a placebo comparison. These results show that substantial headroom can persist across prompts with shared option order without establishing a benefit specific to the selected layer computation; neither ordering against these controls identifies that benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文区分"选择收益"与"程序为何有效"两个问题，用32个层跳过/重复程序在2个模型、4413道多选题上，将真实程序的收益与输入盲扰动控制组对比，发现共享选项顺序时控制组的headroom更大，说明存在大量可归因于非特异性因素的headroom，不能据此认定所选层计算具有特定收益。
AI.motivation: 先前关于自适应计算的研究使用oracle评估（借助已知答案）来估计层程序的潜在收益，但"选择带来收益"并不等于"被选中的程序本身有特定作用"。作者试图厘清这一区别，检验真实层程序的优势是否可被输入盲扰动等控制条件复现，从而判断收益是否源于被选中的层计算本身。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-4B-Base和Llama-3.1-8B两个模型、4413道多选题上考察32个层跳过与重复程序。对比真实程序的收益与同一位置输入盲扰动的收益，并在另一提示上重评选择结果。控制条件包括：共享选项顺序下的随机方向扰动、固定字母偏移、选项轮转、KL校准对比（含输入依赖控制），以及生成式答案的重述检验。
AI.result: 共享选项顺序下，控制组的headroom为10.2-11.8（Qwen3-4B-Base）和15.6-19.4（Llama-3.1-8B）个百分点，均超过真实程序的9.0和10.1；控制仅在answer-change rate上匹配，排序依赖菜单（Llama仅重复菜单下真实程序领先）。KL校准对比在点估计上支持真实程序，但校正检验不显著。固定字母偏移产生类似规模的headroom；选项轮转显著降低两族headroom，仅留真实减控制的正差1.4-2.3和3.7-4.5点，其幅度与统计支持依赖进一步调整与参照。生成式答案检验中，搜索选出的程序在重述后保持26.0点优势，但缺少安慰剂对照。
AI.conclusion: 共享选项顺序下，跨提示可持续存在大量headroom，但无法据此确立所选层计算的特定收益；对这些控制条件的任一排序都不足以识别该收益。需要更严格的控制（如输入依赖对照、选项轮转、KL校准）才能分离真实的层程序特异性效应。

title: PalmSpace: Towards a Versatile On-Palm Interaction Space through Unified Touch Modeling
summary: As smart glasses and lightweight MR devices become increasingly practical, input remains a key challenge. The bare palm is an always-available, tactile, and proprioceptively accessible surface, but it has neither an explicit coordinate system nor embedded touch sensing. Prior on-palm systems typically expose isolated touch events, discrete regions, continuous trajectories, or task-specific gestures, limiting the palm's ability to support precise selection and gesture manipulation through a common input representation. We present PalmSpace, a wrist-worn infrared system that exposes mode-aware, body-referenced absolute input on the bare palm without per-user sensing calibration. At the interaction level, PalmSpace jointly represents contact occurrence, interaction mode, and palm-referenced absolute location; at the model level, it learns these coupled outputs through a shared real-time representation. In leave-one-participant-out evaluation with 17 participants, PalmSpace achieved 6.7 mm mean localization error, 98.9% contact detection accuracy, and 96.7% F1 for four-class interaction-state recognition. User studies further demonstrated absolute pointing and dragging, eyes-free digit input, and representative multi-finger controls including scrolling and pinch-based map manipulation. These results show that a morphologically variable bare palm can function as a transferable, mode-aware interaction surface.

AI.tldr: 提出腕戴红外系统PalmSpace，在裸手掌上实现免标定、模式感知的身体参照绝对输入，联合建模接触、交互模式与掌面绝对位置，平均定位误差6.7 mm，接触检测98.9%，四类交互状态F1为96.7%。
AI.motivation: 智能眼镜与轻量MR设备日益实用，但输入仍是关键瓶颈。裸手掌是随时可用、具触觉与本体感受可达性的表面，却既无显式坐标系也无内嵌触觉传感。既有掌心系统多仅提供孤立触摸事件、离散区域、连续轨迹或任务特定手势，缺乏统一输入表示，难以支撑精确选择与手势操作。因此作者希望让形态各异的手掌成为可迁移、模式感知的交互表面。
AI.method: PalmSpace为腕戴红外系统，无需逐用户传感标定即可输出模式感知、身体参照的绝对输入。交互层面联合表征接触发生、交互模式与掌面参照绝对位置；模型层面通过共享的实时表示学习这些耦合输出，并在17名被试的留一被试交叉验证（leave-one-participant-out）中评估。
AI.result: 在17名参与者的留一被试评估中，平均定位误差为6.7 mm，接触检测准确率98.9%，四类交互状态识别F1为96.7%。用户研究进一步验证了绝对指点与拖拽、无视觉数字输入，以及包括滚动和基于捏合的地图操作等多指控制。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，形态可变的裸手掌可作为可迁移、模式感知的交互表面，为智能眼镜与轻量MR设备提供统一且精确的掌心输入方案。

title: Document-Level Text Simplification in Estonian Using Large Language Models
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Published at LREC 2026
summary: Document-level text simplification involves transformations that go beyond sentence-internal edits, addressing discourse coherence, anaphora resolution, and cross-paragraph consistency. Despite advances in sentence-level simplification for high-resource languages, document-level simplification in morphologically rich, low-resource languages such as Estonian remains largely unexplored. This study presents a comprehensive evaluation of five state-of-the-art multilingual large language models (LLMs) for document-level simplification in Estonian. Three prompting strategies are examined: single-pass generation, pipeline-based modular agents, and guideline-augmented pipelines. The evaluation framework integrates automatic metrics assessing readability, semantic preservation, and discourse coherence, alongside a structured manual annotation protocol. The findings indicate that Gemini-2.0 and LLaMA-3.3 produce outputs with near-native fluency and strong meaning preservation, whereas other models display notable grammatical and semantic limitations. This work contributes novel document-level coherence metrics, evidence-based prompting strategies, and publicly available resources for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 该研究对五种多语言大模型在爱沙尼亚语文档级简化任务上进行系统评测，比较三种提示策略，并构建融合自动指标与人工标注的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 文档级简化需处理语篇连贯、回指消解和跨段落一致性，远超句子内部编辑；而形态丰富、低资源语言（如爱沙尼亚语）的文档级简化研究几乎空白。
AI.method: 评测五种先进多语言大语言模型；考察三种提示策略：单次生成、基于流水线的模块化智能体、以及指南增强型流水线；评估框架整合可读性、语义保持和语篇连贯的自动指标，并配合结构化人工标注协议。
AI.result: Gemini-2.0与LLaMA-3.3输出接近母语者流畅度且语义保持良好，其他模型存在明显语法与语义缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 该工作贡献了新的文档级连贯性指标、基于证据的提示策略，以及可复现的公开资源，为低资源语言文档级简化提供了基准与范式。

title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboQuest，一个面向目标导向具身探索的基准，包含10个移动操作任务，覆盖搜索、基于操作的检查与交互式测试三类不确定性；评测显示当前最强多模态智能体仅23%成功率，失败主因是过早停止探索与未修复探索扰动，而非执行能力不足。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型已可作为通用物理智能体完成多种操作任务，但在陌生环境中，任务相关信息可能缺失于观测中（如目标物体位置、未观测属性、陌生工具的效果），智能体必须通过物理交互主动获取信息并据此调整行为，同时自主判断何时完成目标。现有基准缺乏对这类"目标导向具身探索"能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建 RoboQuest 基准：包含10个移动操作任务，围绕三类不确定性设计——搜索（search）、基于操作的检查（manipulation-based inspection）、交互式测试（interactive testing）。采用统一的视运动接口（visuomotor interface）评测五个前沿多模态智能体，并在作者发布的完整回合演示上微调 π0.5 策略作为对照。此外，在提供隐藏信息的条件下对任务拆解出的执行技能进行孤立测试，以区分探索/决策失败与执行失败。
AI.result: 最优智能体仅在23%的回合中成功，微调后的 π0.5 策略几乎从未成功。孤立执行技能测试表明，在提供隐藏信息的条件下智能体能够完成大部分所需动作。失败分析显示仅少数失败可归因于执行层面。
AI.conclusion: 探索类任务的核心瓶颈在于决策而非动作执行：智能体常在观察到完成任务所需证据之前就过早终止探索；且很少预防或修复自身探索造成的扰动；此外，多数模型仍难以通过试错进行学习。该基准揭示了通用物理智能体在主动信息获取与自主决策方面的显著能力缺口。

title: Explicit Geometric Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action in Autonomous Driving
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures. The code is available at https://github.com/TabGuigui/GeoCoTDrive
summary: Vision-language-action~(VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, existing VLA models still suffer from a fundamental mismatch: driving actions require precise 3D geometric cues, while visual-language understanding and reasoning are largely conducted in a 2D semantic space. In this paper, we propose GeoCoTDrive, an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework that grounds geometry in a planning-oriented manner. GeoCoTDrive follows a think with 2D first, drive with dedicated 3D priors paradigm. It first grounds 2D regions corresponding to decision-critical cues, and then retrieves localized 3D priors by sampling features from a geometric foundation model within the grounded regions. These localized geometric features are interleaved into the autoregressive context to support the trajectory generation. To supervise this process, we introduce planning-relevant grounding, a new region-level grounding task that focuses on local spatial cues directly affecting ego planning decisions, and construct the PlanningGrounding dataset to endow VLAs with planning-oriented grounding capability. Experiments across multiple end-to-end autonomous driving benchmarks show that GeoCoTDrive consistently improves safety-critical planning performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of the explicit geometric chain-of-thought process for VLA-based planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoCoTDrive，一种面向规划的显式几何思维链框架，通过"先2D思考、后3D先验驾驶"的范式，将几何基础模型的局部3D先验注入自回归上下文以生成轨迹，并构建PlanningGrounding数据集增强VLA的规划导向定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶VLA模型存在根本性错配：驾驶动作依赖精确的3D几何线索，而视觉-语言的理解与推理大多在2D语义空间中进行，导致几何与规划决策脱节。
AI.method: 提出GeoCoTDrive框架，遵循"先2D思考、后专注3D先验驾驶"范式：先定位与决策关键线索对应的2D区域，再从几何基础模型在定位区域内采样特征以检索局部3D先验，并将其交错插入自回归上下文以支持轨迹生成；同时提出规划相关定位（planning-relevant grounding）这一区域级定位任务，并构建PlanningGrounding数据集用于监督。
AI.result: 在多个端到端自动驾驶基准上，GeoCoTDrive持续提升安全关键场景下的规划性能，验证了显式几何思维链过程对VLA规划的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何思维链能有效弥合VLA中2D语义理解与3D几何规划之间的鸿沟，为基于VLA的自动驾驶规划提供可行路径。

title: MOTIP2: Spatial Priors for End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. 27 pages (14 pages main paper, appendix and references), 6 figures, 10 tables
summary: End-to-end multi-object trackers have narrowed the gap with classical tracking-by-detection on association-difficult benchmarks. Yet they still make spatially implausible errors no classical tracker would, such as assigning one identity to objects on opposite sides of the frame. A model could learn to avoid them, but tracking annotations are scarce, so we encode spatial priors explicitly instead, while keeping inference fully end-to-end with no post-hoc association. We propose three spatial priors, at the data, loss, and representation stages. Spatial ID Switches bias trajectory permutations toward spatially overlapping objects, reducing the mismatch between training and inference confusions. Spatial ID Loss scales each identity's penalty by its box distance, so a distant switch costs more than a nearby one. Spatial Anchor gives each track token its frame position, an explicit spatial cue for attention. We instantiate the three priors in MOTIP2, a tracker adapted from MOTIP and built on the real-time DEIM detection transformer. Trained without extra data, its main model, MOTIP2-L, sets a new state of the art: 73.4 HOTA on DanceTrack, 76.0 on SportsMOT, and 71.1 IDF1 on PersonPath22. MOTIP2 is a family of models spanning the speed-accuracy trade-off: a lighter model, MOTIP2-S, matches the original MOTIP at over 3x the speed, and MOTIP2-X reaches 74.8 HOTA on DanceTrack.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对端到端多目标跟踪器会产生空间上不合理错误的问题，提出在数据、损失和表示三个阶段显式编码三种空间先验，并在MOTIP2上实现，取得多个基准的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 端到端多目标跟踪器在关联困难基准上已缩小与经典tracking-by-detection的差距，但仍会产生经典跟踪器不会出现的空间不合理错误，例如将帧两侧的物体赋予同一身份。由于跟踪标注稀缺，模型难以自行学习避免此类错误，因此论文选择显式编码空间先验。
AI.method: 论文在数据、损失和表示三个阶段提出三种空间先验：Spatial ID Switches通过将轨迹置换偏向空间重叠物体，减少训练与推理混淆的不匹配；Spatial ID Loss按框距离缩放每个身份的惩罚，使远距离切换代价更高；Spatial Anchor为每个轨迹token提供其帧位置，作为注意力机制的显式空间线索。三种先验在MOTIP2中实现，MOTIP2基于实时DEIM检测transformer并对MOTIP进行适配，保持完全端到端推理且无后处理关联。
AI.result: 在未使用额外数据训练的情况下，主模型MOTIP2-L取得新SOTA：DanceTrack 73.4 HOTA、SportsMOT 76.0、PersonPath22 71.1 IDF1。MOTIP2构成覆盖速度-精度权衡的模型族：轻量模型MOTIP2-S在超过3倍速度下匹配原始MOTIP，MOTIP2-X在DanceTrack达到74.8 HOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过在数据、损失与表示阶段显式引入空间先验，可在不依赖额外标注数据的情况下有效抑制端到端多目标跟踪的空间不合理错误，并在多个基准上刷新SOTA，同时提供覆盖不同速度-精度需求的模型系列。

title: Gaussian Density Splatting Network
comment: This is the preprint version of the paper and supplemental material to appear in NeurIPS, 2026. Please cite the final published version
summary: This paper proposes a novel crowd counting approach, the Gaussian Density Splatting Network (GDSNet). Unlike methods that rely on conventional, grid-based density maps and are sensitive to spatial resolution, GDSNet represents a crowd as a superposition of continuous 2D Gaussian primitives. Our approach is built upon two key contributions. First, a control-point-based fitting mechanism is introduced to structure the prediction of Gaussian parameters. A set of control points is adaptively allocated to define local regions, from which features are pooled to regress each primitive's parameters. Second, we adapt a differentiable Gaussian Splatting framework to the counting task by parameterizing each primitive with geometric parameters and a scalar density mass. This formulation allows the network to be trained end-to-end via spatial matching of differentiably rendered density maps, naturally providing both local density supervision and global count optimization. Extensive evaluations on four standard benchmarks show GDSNet consistently outperforms the state of the art. The code is available at https://github.com/infinite0522/GDSNet-Gaussian-Density-Splatting-Network.

AI.tldr: 提出GDSNet，用连续2D高斯基元叠加表示人群，通过控制点拟合与可微高斯溅射实现端到端人群计数，在四个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统基于网格密度图的人群计数方法依赖空间分辨率，对分辨率变化敏感，限制了表示能力与计数精度。
AI.method: 1）基于控制点的拟合机制：自适应分配控制点定义局部区域，从中池化特征以回归每个基元的参数，从而结构化地预测高斯参数；2）将可微高斯溅射框架适配到计数任务，每个基元由几何参数和标量密度质量参数化，通过可微渲染密度图的空间匹配进行端到端训练，天然提供局部密度监督和全局计数优化。
AI.result: 在四个标准基准上的广泛评估显示，GDSNet持续优于当前最先进方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: GDSNet以连续高斯基元替代网格密度图，结合控制点参数拟合与可微高斯溅射，实现了分辨率鲁棒且端到端可训练的人群计数，性能达到领先水平。

title: Self-correction Optimization for Interleaved Multimodal Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation. However, generating interleaved image--text content remains challenging, as it requires tightly integrated multimodal understanding and generation capabilities. Although existing MLLMs provide promising solutions, most rely on additional training with augmented data, which is computationally expensive and remains limited in preserving visual subjects, temporal consistency, and physical plausibility. In this work, we propose self-correction optimization (SCO), an effective training-free method for consistent interleaved generation. SCO treats the classifier-free guidance update as a reference and performs minimal self-correction under two complementary constraints, including new-event and state-preserving constraints. Specifically, the new-event constraint promotes temporal consistency across image--text sequences, while the state-preserving constraint maintains the coherence of visual subjects throughout subsequent generation steps. Experiments on challenging interleaved multimodal generation benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements in temporal coherence and visual-subject preservation. Furthermore, SCO can be extended to video generation and improves the modeling of physically grounded processes, including robot manipulation and long-horizon handcrafting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自校正优化（SCO），一种无需额外训练的方法，用于生成一致性强的图文交错内容。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型生成图文交错内容时多依赖增强数据的额外训练，计算成本高，且在保持视觉主体、时序一致性和物理合理性方面仍受限。
AI.method: SCO以无分类器引导更新为参考，在两类互补约束下进行最小自校正：新事件约束促进图像—文本序列的时序一致性，状态保持约束维持后续生成中视觉主体的连贯性。
AI.result: 在具挑战性的图文交错多模态生成基准上，SCO在时序一致性和视觉主体保持方面取得显著提升；并可扩展至视频生成，改善机器人操作与长时程手工等物理过程建模。
AI.conclusion: SCO是一种有效的免训练自校正方法，可在不额外训练的前提下提升图文交错生成的时序一致性与主体保持能力，并具备向视频生成等任务的扩展潜力。

title: Reasoning-Token Spikes Under Prompted Untruthful Responses in Large Language Models
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/Wakaranaino/token-spike-project ; Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21895296
summary: Monitoring the chain-of-thought of reasoning artificial intelligence (AI) models remains a key approach to detecting deception and other forms of misbehavior in such models. However, semantic chain-of-thought monitoring depends on reasoning traces being legible and sufficiently faithful to the underlying computations that produced the model's behavior, not to mention accessible. Moreover, there is increasing evidence that chain-of-thought outputs may soon become illegible or unfaithful, if they even remain accessible. Based on cognitive load theory, we investigate a lower-bandwidth signal--the number of reasoning tokens generated--which does not require access to the content of the reasoning trace. Three reasoning-capable large language models answered 210 multiple-choice questions--across analytic, descriptive, and normative reasoning types as well as moral and non-moral domains--under system prompts instructing them to respond truthfully, falsely, or without regard for truth. Across all three models, truth-directed responses elicited fewer reasoning tokens than both lie-directed and truth-indifferent responses. In addition, in one model, untruthful instructions increased the likelihood of reasoning at all. These findings show that explicitly prompted untruthful response policies can produce robust group-level differences in test-time reasoning-token use. While not yet establishing reasoning-token count as a detector of spontaneous deception or general misalignment, our results are a proof of concept that it can serve as a simple, content-independent black-box candidate signal for differentiating untruthful from truthful model behavior when raw reasoning traces are unavailable or unreliable. Future work should test instance-level detection rates, out-of-distribution generalization, learned deceptive policies, hidden objectives, and robustness under adversarial pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"推理token数量"这一低带宽、无需访问推理轨迹内容的黑箱信号，来区分真实与不真实的模型行为。三个推理型大模型在210道多选题、三类推理类型与道德/非道德领域、三种真值指令下作答，真实导向回答的推理token数少于撒谎导向和无所谓真值导向的回答，且某模型在非真实指令下更可能启用推理。
AI.motivation: 现有对推理AI模型的欺骗行为监测主要依赖语义层面的思维链监控，但该路径预设推理轨迹可读、忠实且可获取；而越来越多证据表明思维链输出可能很快变得不可辨读或不忠实，甚至不再可访问。因此需要一种不依赖推理内容、带宽更低的替代信号。
AI.method: 基于认知负荷理论，选取"生成推理token的数量"作为不需访问推理轨迹内容的低带宽信号。实验让三个具备推理能力的大语言模型回答210道多选题，题目覆盖分析性、描述性与规范性推理类型，以及道德与非道德领域；通过系统提示分别要求模型真实作答、虚假作答或不考虑真值作答，比较不同条件下的推理token使用情况。
AI.result: 在三个模型中，真实导向回答产生的推理token数均少于撒谎导向和真值无关导向回答；此外，在其中一个模型上，不真实指令提高了模型是否进行推理的概率。结果表明，显式提示的不真实回答策略能够在测试时产生稳健的群体层面推理token使用差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究尚未确立推理token数量可用于检测自发欺骗或广义失配，但作为概念验证，表明当原始推理轨迹不可用或不可靠时，推理token数可作为简单、内容无关的黑箱候选信号来区分不真实与真实的模型行为。未来工作应检验实例级检测率、分布外泛化、习得性欺骗策略、隐藏目标以及对抗压力下的鲁棒性。

title: Rubix: Global Correspondence-Free Point Set Alignment through Assignment Geometry
comment: 67 pages, 20 figures. Includes full proofs and experimental appendices
summary: Procrustes-Wasserstein alignment jointly estimates a matching and rotation without supplied correspondences, but alternating minimization can stop at suboptimal solutions. Rubix solves the equally weighted planar problem globally under squared Euclidean loss. Each matching $σ$ of two centered $n$-point sets defines a complex correlation $z_σ=\sum_i\bar x_i y_{σ(i)}$. Their convex hull is the permutation polygon: supporting vertices give optimal matchings at fixed rotations, and the farthest vertex gives the global alignment. We prove the sharp bound of $n(n-1)$ vertices for $n\ge2$, answering Rote's rotation-assignment open problem. In exact arithmetic, assignment queries recover the polygon in $\mathcal O(n^5)$ operations. Assignment-based bounds extend the approach to three-dimensional rotations and partial matching at a supplied translation through branch-and-bound. On timed MPEG-7 shape pairs, Rubix attains every numerical reference value in 12 ms on average, 50 times faster than a rotation grid at the same accuracy. Its distances improve gravity-aligned matching of real 3D scans, shape retrieval and noisy crystal classification over alternating minimization.

AI.tldr: Rubix 通过构建“置换多边形”凸包实现等权平面点集在平方欧氏损失下的全局 Procrustes-Wasserstein 对齐，证明顶点数上界 n(n-1)，并扩展到三维与部分匹配。
AI.motivation: Procrustes-Wasserstein 对齐需同时估计匹配与旋转且无给定对应关系，交替最小化易陷入次优解，缺少全局求解方法。
AI.method: 对两个中心化 n 点集，每个匹配 σ 对应复相关 z_σ=Σ_i x̄_i y_{σ(i)}，其凸包构成置换多边形：固定旋转下的最优匹配为支撑顶点，最远顶点给出全局对齐；用赋值查询精确恢复多边形，并以赋值界结合分支定界扩展到三维旋转与给定平移下的部分匹配。
AI.result: 证明 n≥2 时置换多边形顶点数的精确上界为 n(n-1)；精确算术下以 O(n^5) 次运算恢复多边形；在 MPEG-7 形状对上平均 12 ms 达到全部数值参考值，比同精度旋转网格快 50 倍；在三维扫描、形状检索与含噪晶体分类中优于交替最小化。
AI.conclusion: 置换多边形为等权平面 Procrustes-Wasserstein 对齐提供了全局最优刻画，并可通过分支定界推广到三维与部分匹配，实证上兼顾精度与效率。

title: Training Parallel Speculative Draft Models by Directly Minimizing Expected Decoding Rounds
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a low-cost draft model to propose tokens that the full-size target model verifies in parallel. Parallel and semi-autoregressive (semi- AR) drafters improve drafting efficiency by proposing an entire block in a single forward pass, but training them raises a new difficulty: the draft distribution for a given position depends on where the decoding round starts, and where rounds start depends on how many tokens earlier rounds accepted. Existing training objectives typically rely on block-local surrogates that ignore this cross-round coupling, and therefore do not directly optimize the global decoding efficiency. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for training and evaluating these drafters by representing speculative decoding as a Markov reward process. This formulation yields the Expected Decoding Rounds (EDR) objective, which weights local rejection costs by state occupancies and exactly equals the expected number of decoding rounds. Unlike prior surrogate objectives, EDR introduces no auxiliary hyperparameters. We then derive an exact temporal-difference gradient that supports unbiased stochastic optimization from target-model rollouts. The same framework also yields an exact offline evaluator for round counts, enabling paired drafter comparisons on shared target rollouts without running speculative decoding. Finetuning two state-of-the- art drafters, DSpark and DFly, with EDR consistently improves mean accepted length and outperforms existing training objectives across nine benchmarks spanning math reasoning, code generation, and chat.

AI.tldr: 本文将推测解码建模为马尔可夫奖励过程，提出EDR目标及其精确时序差分梯度，实现无偏随机优化与离线评估，在九个基准上提升草稿模型效率。
AI.motivation: 并行与半自回归草稿模型虽能通过单次前向提出整块token提升草稿效率，但其草稿分布依赖解码轮次起点，而起点又取决于前轮接受token数，形成跨轮耦合。现有训练目标多采用块局部代理，忽略该耦合，无法直接优化全局解码效率。
AI.method: 将推测解码形式化为马尔可夫奖励过程，导出期望解码轮数（EDR）目标：以状态占用率对局部拒绝代价加权，且精确等于期望解码轮数，无需辅助超参。进一步推导精确时序差分梯度，支持基于目标模型rollout的无偏随机优化。
AI.result: 同一框架给出精确的离线轮数评估器，可在共享目标rollout上对草稿模型配对比较而无需实际运行推测解码。以EDR微调DSpark与DFly两个SOTA草稿模型，在数学推理、代码生成与对话等九个基准上，平均接受长度一致提升，优于现有训练目标。
AI.conclusion: EDR为并行/半自回归草稿模型的训练与评估提供了理论严谨、无需额外超参的全局优化框架，兼顾训练目标精确性与离线评估能力，验证了跨轮耦合建模对推测解码效率的重要性。

title: Which Rollout Taught It That? BehaviorTrace and the Limits of Training-Data Attribution in Online RL
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/AmitoVrito/BehaviorTrace
summary: When reinforcement learning teaches a language model a new behavior, can we find the training rollouts that taught it? And when an attribution method says it can, how do we know the answer is real? We study both questions on online RL fine-tuning with GRPO, using a planted behavior with a known cause. We release BehaviorTrace, an open evaluation harness that combines full-gradient sketching, the planted-behavior setup, and controls for gradient magnitude, fluency, headroom, and variation across seeds and generation draws. Across three seeds on Qwen2.5-1.5B, much of the apparent attribution signal comes from confounds. A control that ranks training steps by gradient size alone, with no behavior target, reaches 4.2 to 4.5 times chance and matches or beats the best targeted estimator on two of three seeds. At saturated checkpoints, model fluency predicts the behavior label at least as well as every gradient method we compared it with. Once fluency is controlled, the per-rollout results change from seed to seed and from one generation draw to the next, so a single run cannot settle the question. One signal does hold on all three seeds. The gradient of the trigger tokens aligns with a target built where the behavior actually occurs. We turn these findings into a checklist for evaluating attribution in RL. We test existing estimators, including GAS (renormalized TracInCP) and a TRAK-style estimator, and do not propose a new one.

AI.tldr: 研究在线RL微调（GRPO）中训练rollout的归因问题，发布BehaviorTrace评测框架，揭示大部分归因信号源自混淆因素，仅触发词梯度在三种子下稳定有效，并给出评测清单。
AI.motivation: 当强化学习教会语言模型新行为后，能否找出"教会"它的训练rollout？现有归因方法声称可以，但缺乏验证答案真实性的手段。作者希望区分真实信号与混淆因素。
AI.method: 基于GRPO在线RL微调，采用已知成因的植入行为（planted behavior）；发布BehaviorTrace开源评测框架，结合全梯度sketching、植入行为设定，并控制梯度幅度、流畅度、提升空间（headroom）以及随机种子与生成采样的变异。测试GAS（重归一化TracInCP）与TRAK式估计器。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B三个种子上，多数表观归因信号来自混淆：仅按梯度大小排序步骤的对照在三种子中两个上达到4.2–4.5倍随机水平，并匹敌或超过最佳定向估计器；饱和检查点上，流畅度预测行为标签的效果不劣于所有梯度方法；控制流畅度后，per-rollout结果随种子和生成采样波动。唯一稳健信号是触发词梯度与"行为实际发生处"构建目标的对齐。
AI.conclusion: 现有归因估计器在RL场景中的有效性受混淆因素严重干扰，单次运行无法定论；作者将其转化为RL归因评估清单，并指出触发词梯度对齐是唯一跨种子稳健的信号，不提出新估计器。

title: GraphRectify: Graph-Based Transfer of Adversarial Example Detectors Across Neural Networks
summary: Adversarial example detectors are often tied to the classifier backbone they were trained on, limiting reuse when the protected model is replaced or upgraded. Directly transferring such detectors across backbones is challenging because different networks generally produce incompatible internal representations. We propose GraphRectify, a graph-based framework for transferring adversarial image detectors across classifier backbones. GraphRectify learns a structured representation of intermediate classifier features and adapts representations from a new backbone to the detector learned on the original model, enabling detector reuse. We evaluate GraphRectify across multiple datasets, backbone architectures, and adversarial attacks, including detector-aware adaptive attacks that jointly target the classifier and detector. Across the complete evaluation matrix, GraphRectify achieves higher aggregate ROC-AUC than training a detector from scratch on the new backbone and the evaluated transfer ablations. The gains are particularly strong for transfers between different backbone families and when sufficient data are available. In contrast, training from scratch remains competitive in the most data-limited settings. These results show that adversarial detection knowledge can transfer effectively across heterogeneous classifier architectures rather than being relearned whenever the protected backbone changes.

AI.tldr: 提出GraphRectify，一种基于图的框架，可将对抗样本检测器从原始分类器骨干迁移到新骨干，实现检测器复用。在多种数据集、架构与攻击下，其聚合ROC-AUC优于从头训练及迁移消融方法。
AI.motivation: 对抗样本检测器通常与其训练所用的分类器骨干绑定，当受保护模型被替换或升级时难以复用。直接迁移困难，因为不同网络内部表征不兼容。因此需要一种能够跨骨干迁移检测器的方法。
AI.method: GraphRectify学习分类器中间特征的结构化图表示，并将新骨干的表征适配到在原模型上训练好的检测器，从而实现检测器复用。
AI.result: 在多个数据集、骨干架构和对抗攻击（含同时针对分类器与检测器的检测器感知自适应攻击）上评估。在整个评估矩阵中，GraphRectify的聚合ROC-AUC高于在新骨干上从头训练检测器及所评估的迁移消融方法；跨不同骨干家族、数据充足时增益尤为明显；而在数据极其受限时，从头训练仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 对抗检测知识可以跨异构分类器架构有效迁移，而无需在受保护骨干变化时重新学习。

title: CoTrace: Data Recipes for Training Terminal Agents with Harness-Model Co-Evolution
summary: Terminal-agent capability depends jointly on model weights and the runtime harness that formats prompts, binds tools, and handles error recovery. Existing harness-model co-evolution approaches improve both components, yet often treat trajectories produced during harness search as an undifferentiated replay buffer. This practice overlooks that a trajectory's value for model training depends on the harness under which it was generated. To systematically analyze this interface, we establish an alternating co-evolution framework that decouples harness search and policy training through component-wise promotion decisions. Within this framework, we introduce CoTrace, a harness-aware data recipe that explicitly governs trajectory routing, provenance matching, and curriculum refresh. Under CoTrace, recurring execution failures guide harness synthesis, while policy training is strictly conditioned on verified rollouts matched to the adopted runtime for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or fresh online interactions for reinforcement learning (RL). On the Tmax promotion split, CoTrace advances Qwen3.5-9B from 78 to 88 solved tasks under supervised fine-tuning while an online reinforcement variant reaches 90. Specifically, a compact harness-matched corpus produces steady model gains at substantially lower compute than much larger corpora pooled across sibling harnesses. Furthermore, evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-bench Lite show that out-of-distribution transfer depends fundamentally on harness compatibility, where maintaining consistency between training and evaluation runtimes prevents procedural execution breakdowns observed under foreign scaffolds.

AI.tldr: 论文提出交替式协同进化框架与CoTrace数据配方，实现“harness感知”的轨迹路由与课程刷新，使Qwen3.5-9B在Tmax上从78提升至88（SFT）/90（RL），并证明OOD迁移依赖harness兼容性。
AI.motivation: 终端智能体能力同时取决于模型权重与运行时harness（负责提示格式化、工具绑定、错误恢复）。现有harness-模型协同进化方法虽同时优化两者，但把harness搜索过程中产生的轨迹当作无差别的回放缓冲区，忽视了“轨迹对模型训练的价值依赖于其生成时所处的harness”这一关键事实，因而缺乏对该接口的系统性分析。
AI.method: 1）建立交替式协同进化框架：通过组件级晋升决策（component-wise promotion）解耦harness搜索与策略训练；2）提出CoTrace——一种harness感知的数据配方，显式管理轨迹路由、来源匹配（provenance matching）与课程刷新；3）在CoTrace下，反复出现的执行失败引导harness合成，而策略训练严格限定于经校验、且与所采用运行时相匹配的rollout：用于SFT，或用于RL的新鲜在线交互。
AI.result: 在Tmax晋升划分上，CoTrace使Qwen3.5-9B在SFT下由78提升至88个解决任务，在线RL变体达到90；一个紧凑的、与harness匹配的语料，以显著更低的算力带来稳定增益，优于跨同类harness池化的更大语料。在Terminal-Bench 2.1与SWE-bench Lite上的评估表明，分布外迁移根本上依赖harness兼容性：保持训练与评测运行时一致，可避免在异质脚手架（foreign scaffolds）下出现的程序化执行崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹数据必须以harness为条件进行筛选与路由，而非无差别回放；harness兼容性是harness-模型协同进化中数据效率与OOD迁移能力的核心决定因素。

title: SGF+: Decoupling Gradient Flows for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video generation requires denoising the current frames while writing their key-value representations as context for future predictions. However, these two roles typically share parameters, and we find that their gradients exhibit distinct patterns and systematic negative alignment, hindering the joint optimization of visual quality and temporal consistency. We introduce Self Gradient Forcing Plus (SGF+), which assigns separate parameters to context writing and denoising while preserving their interaction through causal attention. Both roles are jointly optimized using the original generation objective without auxiliary losses, with context writing supervised through its contribution to future predictions. This simple change improves visual quality and long-horizon consistency over the evaluated baselines in both framewise and chunkwise generation, without additional video training data or a longer training horizon. Trained on only 5s rollouts, SGF+ supports continuous generation for up to 24 hours without long-video fine-tuning. These results highlight role-specific parameterization as an effective design principle for high-quality autoregressive video generation and native long-horizon extrapolation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Self Gradient Forcing Plus（SGF+），将自回归视频生成中的"上下文写入"与"去噪"两个角色解耦为独立参数，通过因果注意力保持交互，在不增加辅助损失、额外数据或更长训练时长的情况下，同时提升视觉质量与长时程一致性，并支持长达24小时的连续生成。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成中，当前帧的去噪与其键值表示写入通常共享参数，导致两个角色的梯度模式不同且存在系统性负对齐，妨碍视觉质量与时序一致性的联合优化。
AI.method: 提出SGF+，为上下文写入与去噪分配独立参数，并通过因果注意力保留二者交互；两角色使用原始生成目标联合优化，不引入辅助损失，上下文写入通过其对未来预测的贡献被监督。
AI.result: 在逐帧与分块生成中，相比所评估的基线，视觉质量与长时程一致性均提升；无需额外视频训练数据或更长训练时长；仅在5秒rollout上训练即可支持最长24小时连续生成，且无需长视频微调。
AI.conclusion: 角色特定的参数化是高质量自回归视频生成与原生长时程外推的有效设计原则。

title: Detecting Adversarial Images through Response Profiles of Vision-Language Models
summary: Adversarial perturbations can alter the predictions of frozen vision-language models (VLMs) while leaving their confidence and image--text similarity patterns seemingly plausible. We investigate whether we can identify adversarial inputs based on the broader way an image interacts with a collection of general semantic prompts. Our detector summarizes these responses using category-level statistics, relationships among prompts, deviations from clean reference distributions, and stability under weak image transformations, producing a compact response profile that is classified by a lightweight model while the VLM remains fixed. We evaluate the approach on multiple public image datasets, several CLIP-style visual backbones, and a range of gradient-based, optimization-based, automated, and spatial attacks. The detector achieves strong discrimination in attack-specific settings and retains substantial performance when evaluated on attacks not seen during training. Under a controlled detector-specific protocol, the response-profile representation outperforms the evaluated embedding-geometry baselines. Additional analyses show that the feature groups provide complementary information and that the method remains effective under variations in the prompt configuration. We also examine inference cost and performance against detector-aware adaptive attacks. Overall, the results indicate that response patterns across semantic prompts provide a useful complementary signal for adversarial image detection in frozen VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对冻结视觉-语言模型（VLM）的对抗样本检测器，利用图像在一组通用语义提示上的响应模式（类别级统计、提示间关系、与干净参考分布的偏差、弱变换下的稳定性）构建紧凑响应画像，并由轻量模型分类，无需微调VLM。在多数据集、多CLIP式骨干、多类攻击下取得强判别力，对未见攻击也有较好泛化，并优于嵌入几何基线。
AI.motivation: 对抗扰动可改变冻结VLM的预测，但其置信度与图文相似度模式仍看似合理，导致仅依赖单次预测或相似度难以识别对抗输入。作者希望寻找一种互补信号：图像与一组通用语义提示的整体交互方式是否异常。
AI.method: 检测器在VLM固定不变的前提下，将图像对一组通用语义提示的响应汇总为类别级统计、提示间关系、相对干净参考分布的偏差以及弱图像变换下的稳定性等特征组，形成紧凑的响应画像（response profile），再用轻量分类模型判别其为干净或对抗样本。
AI.result: 在多个公开图像数据集、若干CLIP式视觉骨干及梯度型、优化型、自动化与空间攻击上，检测器在攻击特定设置下判别力强，在训练未见攻击上仍保持显著性能。在受控的检测器专用协议下，响应画像表示优于所评估的嵌入几何基线；消融分析显示各特征组信息互补，且在提示配置变化下仍有效。文中还评估了推理开销及对检测器感知的自适应攻击的表现。
AI.conclusion: 跨语义提示的响应模式为冻结VLM中的对抗图像检测提供了有用的互补信号，可作为现有检测思路之外的一种有效方案。

title: ECHO: Embodied Camera Observations of Human Object Carrying
summary: Embodied and assistive agents must do more than recognize objects: they must reason about where an object belongs given the layout of an environment and the habits of the people who live in it. Progress on this problem has been limited, in part because no dedicated benchmark or dataset exists to define and evaluate it. Existing RGB-D scan datasets reconstruct static rooms without human activity, while human-object-interaction datasets capture motion without a navigable, fully reconstructed scene or a ground-truth notion of an object's natural destination. We introduce contextual object placement as a benchmark task: predicting an object's destination during an observed object-carrying episode. To support this task, we present Embodied Camera observations of Human Object carrying (ECHO), a large-scale synthetic dataset that pairs dense RGB-D scans of indoor scenes with recordings of an embodied human carrying everyday objects to context-appropriate destinations. ECHO is the first publicly available dataset to combine reconstructed scenes, human activity, natural language, and contextual-placement annotations. It comprises 3,805 human-annotated episodes across 159 floors of 115 HM3D scenes, involving 198 distinct objects. Each floor includes a complete RGB-D scan with human-annotated room labels and a surface list. Each episode provides synchronized RGB-D encounter clips; 6-DoF camera, human, and object trajectories; start and destination surfaces; an action caption; and a human-written context: a single sentence describing the inhabitant's routine that implies the destination without naming it. We evaluate contextual object placement using input-masked probes and an end-to-end baseline. Results show that no single input modality is sufficient, highlighting the need to jointly reason over scene structure, human activity, and contextual knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"情境化物体放置"基准任务并发布ECHO数据集，首次将重建场景、人类活动、自然语言与情境放置标注结合，实验表明单一模态不足以支撑该任务。
AI.motivation: 具身与辅助智能体需要推理"物体应放在哪里"，即结合环境布局与居住者习惯判断物体的自然归属位置。该问题进展有限，原因在于缺少专门的基准与数据集：现有RGB-D扫描数据集重建的是无人类活动的静态房间，而人-物交互数据集只捕捉动作，既没有可导航的完整重建场景，也没有物体自然目的地的真值定义。
AI.method: 提出"情境化物体放置"（contextual object placement）基准任务：在观测到一段搬运物体的情节中，预测该物体的目的地。为此构建ECHO（Embodied Camera observations of Human Object carrying）大规模合成数据集，将室内场景的稠密RGB-D扫描与具身人类搬运日常物品至情境适宜目的地的记录配对。评估采用输入掩蔽探针（input-masked probes）与端到端基线。
AI.result: ECHO包含115个HM3D场景、159个楼层、3,805段人工标注情节，涉及198类不同物体。每个楼层含完整RGB-D扫描、人工标注的房间标签与表面清单；每段情节提供同步RGB-D遭遇片段、6-DoF相机/人体/物体轨迹、起始与目的表面、动作描述，以及人工撰写的"context"——一句描述居住者日常习惯、隐含目的地但不点明目的地名称的句子。评估结果显示没有单一输入模态是充分的。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集是首个公开的、同时结合重建场景、人类活动、自然语言与情境放置标注的数据集。实验表明必须对场景结构、人类活动与情境知识进行联合推理，才能完成情境化物体放置。

title: RunningTab: Direct Workspace Interaction with Environment-Side Tabs
summary: Much knowledge work produces new deliverables from files a workspace already holds, and LLM agents are beginning to take such work over. Through direct corpus interaction, an agent can search and read any of those files from a terminal with no indexing, and producing a deliverable from many of them in this way is what we call direct workspace interaction (DWI). Reaching the files, however, is only half the task: nothing keeps track of what the task asks for, what has been read, and what was listed but never opened, all of which slip through the context window without leaving a trace, so an agent may extract a figure and still deliver a report without it. To address this, we present RunningTab, a framework that equips direct workspace interaction with an environment-side tab: a per-task record of what the task still owes, kept by the environment alongside the agent. Specifically, the agent adds its requirements, while the environment records every file read as an excerpt with its provenance and every listed but unopened file as a candidate; the agent can then see each requirement beside its best-matching excerpts and top unopened candidates, resolve it against matching content or set it aside with a reason, and, should it try to finish with requirements still open, receive them in a finish check. We validate RunningTab on three benchmarks with three LLMs, where it consistently outperforms plain DWI and baselines that keep the record in the model, while its tab usually holds the values a deliverable needs once seen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RunningTab 框架，为 LLM 智能体的直接工作区交互（DWI）配备环境侧“任务标签”，记录任务要求、已读文件摘录与已列未打开候选，并支持要求逐条核对与完成前检查，在三项基准、三个模型上稳定优于纯 DWI 及模型内记忆基线。
AI.motivation: 知识工作常需从工作区已有文件生成新交付物，LLM 智能体正接手此类任务。通过终端直接检索与阅读文件（无需索引）即可访问全部文件，即 DWI；但仅能访问文件只完成一半：任务需求、已读内容、已列出却未打开的文件都会滑出上下文窗口且不留痕迹，导致智能体可能已提取某数据却仍交付缺失该内容的报告。因此需要环境侧机制追踪任务“欠账”。
AI.method: RunningTab 为 DWI 增加环境侧标签：按任务维护“仍欠缺什么”。智能体添加自身需求；环境将每次读取记为带来源的摘录，将每个已列出但未打开的文件记为候选。智能体可将每条需求与最佳匹配摘录及未打开候选并列查看，用匹配内容解决该需求，或附理由搁置；若在需求未关闭时尝试结束，会在完成检查中收到这些需求。
AI.result: 在三项基准与三个 LLM 上验证，RunningTab 持续优于纯 DWI 以及将记录保存在模型内的基线方法；其标签在内容被看到后通常已持有交付物所需的值。
AI.conclusion: 将任务追踪放在环境侧而非模型上下文内，可有效缓解 DWI 中需求、已读与未读文件的遗漏问题，提升交付物完整性；标签机制能在内容被观察后留存关键值，为智能体完成多文件知识工作提供可靠支撑。

title: MemoCare: An Interactive Multimodal Mobile System for Automated Cognitive Screening
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Demo paper submitted to the MMM 2027 Demo Track
summary: MemoCare is an interactive mobile system for automated multimodal cognitive screening. A React Native application combines spoken responses, temporal and spatial orientation, touchscreen actions, and visuoconstruction in complete English and Vietnamese workflows. Speech is transcribed by Google Speech-to-Text and scored locally with deterministic task-specific natural language processing rules; GPS coordinates are resolved by the MemoCare spatial module before answer matching; touch tasks are scored from interaction events; and the drawing task uses a three-model convolutional neural network consensus with separate visual interpretation. Software tests pass 151/151 predefined cases across speech/language, spatial-answer, and touch-interaction scoring, while spatial regression passes 48/48 four-country coordinate-resolution cases. For the drawing module, validation-selected ShuffleNetV2 x1.5 achieved 91.33% mean balanced accuracy and 78.87% exact three-criterion accuracy on a locked 71-image test set. Four clinician co-authors additionally inspected the end-to-end workflow, yielding a pooled median rating of 4/5 across eight criteria, with item-level medians ranging from 3 to 4.5. At MMM, attendees can directly try a shortened multimodal screening workflow and inspect automatic item-level and total scoring.

AI.tldr: MemoCare 是一个支持英越双语的多模态认知筛查移动系统，集成语音、时空定向、触屏操作与视空间构型任务，并给出自动评分，测试与临床评审结果良好。
AI.motivation: 认知筛查通常依赖人工施测与评分，效率与一致性受限；同时需要覆盖多语言与多模态任务，因此作者构建交互式移动系统实现自动化、多模态的一体化认知筛查。
AI.method: 基于 React Native 开发应用，提供完整英语与越南语流程；语音由 Google Speech-to-Text 转写后用确定性的任务特定自然语言处理规则在本地评分；GPS 坐标先经空间模块解析再做答案匹配；触屏任务依据交互事件评分；绘图任务采用三模型卷积神经网络共识并结合独立视觉解释。
AI.result: 软件测试在语音/语言、空间答案与触屏交互评分上通过 151/151 预定用例，空间回归在四国坐标解析用例上通过 48/48；绘图模块中经验证集选择的 ShuffleNetV2 x1.5 在锁定的 71 张图像测试集上取得 91.33% 平均平衡准确率与 78.87% 三标准完全准确率；四位临床医生共同作者对端到端流程按八项标准给出合并中位数 4/5，条目中位数 3–4.5。
AI.conclusion: MemoCare 展示了多模态、多语言认知筛查自动化的可行性，评分规则与模型在测试集和临床评审中均表现可靠；在 MMM 现场可体验简化流程并查看条目级与总分自动评分。

title: PHRBench: A Behavioral Evaluation of Post-Hallucination Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Hallucinated information can propagate through multi-stage LLM systems and become part of the context for subsequent reasoning. Existing studies of post-hallucination reasoning (PHR) mainly characterize changes in final outcomes and aggregate reasoning dynamics, leaving how models resolve hallucinated premises at the response level insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce PHRBench, a controlled benchmark for behaviorally structured PHR across four domains and 18 large language models. PHRBench characterizes each reasoning trajectory independently of final-answer correctness through Hallucination Compliance, Hallucination Avoidance, and Heuristic Correction, and defines an insightful trajectory as successful correction that ultimately reaches the correct answer. Across 4820 controlled instances, we find that successful recovery remains relatively rare and is associated with more frequent belief updates along the reasoning trajectory. We further find that properties of the hallucinated prompt contain substantial predictive signal for successful recovery, with a lightweight predictor achieving an AUROC of 0.847. These findings provide a behavioral view of post-hallucination reasoning, characterizing how LLMs resolve erroneous context and when successful recovery is likely to occur.

AI.tldr: 提出PHRBench基准，从行为层面刻画多阶段LLM系统在幻觉前提下的推理轨迹，定义三类行为（幻觉遵从、幻觉规避、启发式纠正）与"有洞察轨迹"，在4领域18个模型4820个受控实例上发现成功恢复罕见且与信念更新频率相关，并可用提示属性以AUROC 0.847预测成功恢复。
AI.motivation: 幻觉信息会在多阶段LLM系统中传播并进入后续推理的上下文。既有"事后幻觉推理（PHR）"研究主要刻画最终结果变化和聚合层面的推理动态，对模型在响应层面如何消解幻觉前提这一问题理解不足，缺乏独立于最终答案正确性的行为化分析框架。
AI.method: 构建PHRBench受控基准，覆盖4个领域、18个大型语言模型。不同于仅看最终答案正确性，该基准对每条推理轨迹独立标注三类行为：幻觉遵从（Hallucination Compliance）、幻觉规避（Hallucination Avoidance）与启发式纠正（Heuristic Correction）；并将最终达到正确答案的成功纠正定义为"有洞察轨迹"（insightful trajectory）。共构造4820个受控实例，据此分析成功恢复与推理过程中信念更新的关系，并检验幻觉提示自身属性对成功恢复的预测能力（训练轻量预测器）。
AI.result: 成功恢复整体上相对罕见；成功恢复与推理轨迹中更频繁的信念更新（belief updates）相关联；幻觉提示（hallucinated prompt）的属性对成功恢复具有显著预测信号，轻量预测器达到AUROC 0.847。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了事后幻觉推理的行为视角，刻画了LLM如何消解错误上下文、以及成功恢复在何种情形下更可能发生，为多阶段LLM系统的幻觉传播与鲁棒性研究提供了可复用的受控评测与行为分析框架。

title: MORCA: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Cache Reuse in Video Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve remarkable performance in video synthesis, but their iterative denoising process suffers from high inference latency. To address this, caching has emerged as an effective acceleration strategy by capitalizing on inter-step redundancy during denoising. Existing dynamic caching methods typically estimate the error that cache reuse would introduce at each denoising step (step error) to guide cache decisions, whereas our concern is how much quality loss cache reuse would cause in the final generated video (terminal error). We show that step error does not directly correspond to terminal error and that latent information helps capture their relationship, thereby informing cache decisions. Moreover, existing threshold-based methods cannot provide precise speedup control, making it difficult to meet practical requirements for user-specified acceleration targets. To address these limitations, we introduce MORCA, a cache scheduling framework trained through offline-to-online reinforcement learning to make latent-aware reuse/recompute decisions under user-specified acceleration targets. Extensive experiments on different video generation models across multiple target acceleration ratios demonstrate that MORCA achieves better generation fidelity than state-of-the-art caching methods under comparable computational budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/x10ngyx/MORCA.

AI.tldr: MORCA：一个基于离线到在线强化学习的缓存调度框架，面向用户指定加速目标，利用潜在信息做出复用/重算决策，在DiT视频生成中优于现有缓存方法。
AI.motivation: Diffusion Transformers在视频合成中性能优异，但迭代去噪推理延迟高。缓存通过利用去噪步间冗余加速。现有动态缓存方法以"步误差"（缓存复用引入的误差）指导缓存决策，但作者关注的是"终端误差"（对最终生成视频质量的影响）。论文指出步误差与终端误差并不直接对应，且潜在信息有助于捕捉二者关系。此外，现有基于阈值的方法无法精确控制加速比，难以满足用户指定加速目标。
AI.method: 提出MORCA缓存调度框架，通过离线到在线强化学习训练，在用户指定加速目标下进行潜在感知（latent-aware）的复用/重算决策。
AI.result: 在多种视频生成模型、多个目标加速比上的大量实验表明，在可比计算预算下，MORCA相比最先进的缓存方法实现了更好的生成保真度。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过关注终端误差而非步误差、引入潜在信息，并以强化学习实现精确加速控制，MORCA在DiT视频生成的缓存加速上取得更优的保真度与可控性。

title: Label-free cell counting and viability prediction with brightfield imaging and deep learning
summary: Cell viability assessment is a core requirement in cell culture systems, with critical applications in biopharmaceutical manufacturing and drug development. Conventionally, it is measured by adding membrane-impermeable dyes to a sample (a process called staining), which allows compromised cell membranes to be distinguished from intact ones. However, staining has several limitations: (a) chemical agents can perturb normal cellular processes of the cells being measured, (b) it is often ambiguous to assign viability to individual cells whose membrane integrity is only partially compromised. (c) photobleaching can undermine measurement accuracy over time when using fluorescent stains, and (d) staining cannot be performed in situ or in real time. Here, we show that (1) stained cells captured under brightfield imaging contain sufficient information to distinguish live and dead cells, and (2) cells captured under unstained brightfield imaging exhibit similar image features to their stained counterparts, enabling models trained on stained cells to generalize to unstained ones. We then report the development and validation of ViabiLens, an AI-assisted software for label-free cell viability analysis. The ViabiLens combines a cell detection model for localizing individual cells with a convolutional neural network (CNN) classifier for live/dead prediction, paired with an interactive UMAP-based viewer for visualizing and exploring individual cells across the sample. Evaluated on Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cells spanning a wide range of viability conditions, ViabiLens achieves a mean absolute error of 2.68\% on unstained samples against fluorescence-based reference measurements. We also release a benchmark dataset for label-free cell viability analysis to facilitate future research, available at https://amirrezavazifeh.github.io/ViabiLens-Project-Page/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViabiLens——一种无标记、AI辅助的细胞活力分析软件，通过明场图像实现活/死细胞判别，在未染色CHO细胞样本上达到2.68%的平均绝对误差，并公开了基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 传统细胞活力评估依赖染色法（添加膜不可渗透染料），但存在四大局限：(a) 化学试剂扰动细胞正常生理过程；(b) 膜完整性部分受损的细胞难以判定活力；(c) 荧光染料光漂白影响长时间测量精度；(d) 无法原位或实时检测。因此需要一种无标记、非侵入式的活力评估方法。
AI.method: 作者首先验证两点假设：(1) 明场成像下的染色细胞图像包含足以区分活/死细胞的信息；(2) 未染色明场图像与染色图像具有相似特征，使在染色细胞上训练的模型可泛化到未染色细胞。基于此构建ViabiLens，包含三部分：用于定位单细胞的细胞检测模型、用于活/死预测的CNN分类器，以及基于UMAP的交互式可视化查看器。
AI.result: 在覆盖广泛活力条件的中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞上评估，ViabiLens在未染色样本上相对荧光参考测量的平均绝对误差为2.68%。同时发布了用于无标记细胞活力分析的基准数据集。
AI.conclusion: ViabiLens证明了无需染色即可实现准确的细胞活力分析，为生物制药制造和药物开发中的细胞培养监测提供了一种无标记、可原位/实时应用的替代方案，并通过公开基准数据集促进后续研究。

title: Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies
comment: 26 pages. Updated Real-to-Sim experiments and added model evaluations
summary: A simulation of a real robot workspace must preserve task-relevant interactions, while policies developed in it must operate on observations available to the real robot. Yet scene reconstruction and policy development are often treated separately. We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR), a framework that links scene reconstruction, policy development, and real-robot execution through the same manipulation task. Given a workspace video, a task description, and a known robot model, an agent recovers metric scale, iteratively refines the scene using visual feedback, and checks task-relevant interactions in MuJoCo. A coding agent then develops an executable policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy can interleave multiple observations and actions within one invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback to continue, retry, or revise its approach. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and accumulated experience to the real robot, where fresh observations and safety checks guide execution. Using Claude Opus 5.5 through DeepSeek Harness (DSH), all 18 scenes across two robots pass the joint visual check; mean four-view Depth MAE against reference depth estimates is 0.0808 m, mean Lab $ΔE_{76}$ is 8.01, and mean grayscale SSIM is 0.7338. In real-robot experiments, the aggregate task success rate reaches 80% of the simulation task success rate, indicating substantial retention of simulated performance on hardware. Code and reconstructed scene data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agentic RSR 框架，用同一操作任务把场景重建、策略开发和真机执行串联起来，在 MuJoCo 中迭代细化场景并训练策略，再迁移到真实机器人，真机成功率约为仿真成功率的 80%。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人工作空间的仿真需保留任务相关交互，而在其中开发的策略必须依赖真机可获得的观测；但现有方法通常将场景重建与策略开发割裂处理，导致仿真环境与最终部署策略脱节，仿真到真实的迁移效率受限。
