AI.method: Agentic RSR 以同一操作任务贯穿三阶段：给定工作空间视频、任务描述与已知机器人模型，智能体先恢复度量尺度，借助视觉反馈迭代细化场景，并在 MuJoCo 中校验任务相关交互；随后由编码智能体开发可执行策略，从特权物体位姿逐步过渡到视觉观测与随机化仿真，策略单次调用可交错多个观测与动作，并能依据执行反馈继续、重试或修正；最后通过共享的任务级接口，将策略与累积经验迁移至真机，由新观测与安全检查指导执行。
AI.result: 使用 Claude Opus 5.5 经 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）驱动，两台机器人共 18 个场景全部通过联合视觉检查；相对参考深度估计的四视图深度 MAE 均值为 0.0808 m，Lab ΔE76 均值为 8.01，灰度 SSIM 均值为 0.7338。真机实验中，总体任务成功率达到仿真成功率的 80%，表明仿真性能在硬件上得到较大程度保留。
AI.conclusion: 通过以任务为中心统一场景重建、策略学习与真机部署，Agentic RSR 有效缩小了 real-to-sim-to-real 的割裂，实现了较高的仿真到真机性能保持率；代码与重建场景数据将公开。

title: Insights from Autoresearch for Solar Panel Segmentation
comment: Accepted at AutoML4EO 2026 (non-archival AutoML conference workshop). 4 pages + references. https://automl4eo.org/accepted-papers/
summary: This paper investigates AutoResearch, a protocol in which a coding language model edits a training program under a one-hour GPU budget and retains a change only if validation IoU improves. The protocol is applied to photovoltaic panel segmentation on a frozen real-image split, with DeepLabV3--ResNet-50 held fixed. Three campaigns of 24 experiments, using Gemma~4 12B, Qwen3-8B all improve their one-hour baselines, but retained modifications do not transfer across hardware. The Qwen3-8B configuration, trained on real images only, reaches a test IoU of 0.836 versus 0.833 for the reference GAN-augmented schedule. Research repository https://github.com/VU-AIML/automl4eo-autoresearch-segmentation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究AutoResearch协议：语言模型在一小时GPU预算下修改训练程序，仅当验证IoU提升时保留改动；应用于光伏板分割，三个campaign均超越一小时基线，但保留的修改无法跨硬件迁移。
AI.motivation: 探究编码语言模型能否在受限的一小时GPU预算内自动改进训练程序，并评估其相对人工设计（GAN增强）基线的效果与可迁移性。
AI.method: 采用AutoResearch协议，在冻结的真实图像划分上进行光伏板分割，固定DeepLabV3–ResNet-50主干；运行三个campaign、每个24次实验，分别使用Gemma 4 12B与Qwen3-8B；仅保留能提升验证IoU的编辑。
AI.result: 三个campaign均优于各自的一小时基线；Qwen3-8B配置（仅用真实图像训练）测试IoU达0.836，略高于GAN增强参考方案的0.833；但保留的修改无法跨硬件迁移。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型驱动的自动研究可在受限预算下小幅超越人工GAN增强基线，但保留改动对硬件敏感、泛化性有限，跨硬件可迁移性仍是关键问题。

title: QuadTok: Quadtree Visual Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: We introduce QuadTok, a novel framework for visual tokenization and autoregressive image generation. Compared to traditional approaches using 2D grids or 1D token sequences, we propose a hierarchical quadtree structure, bridging the gap between 2D spatial binding and 1D sequence-level flexibility. The QuadTok tokenizer dynamically allocates representational capacity to visually intricate areas while leaving homogeneous regions at a coarse resolution. Compared with a fixed 256-token grid, our ImageNet-trained tokenizer saves approximately 10% of tokens on ImageNet and 9% when transferred zero-shot to the COCO dataset, while maintaining comparable reconstruction fidelity. Furthermore, the natural causality introduced by the tree structure seamlessly enables autoregressive image generation. Conditioned on a quadtree topology supplied before generation, our 947M GPT-style generative model achieves a 2.08 gFID on the ImageNet $256 \times 256$ benchmark. Additionally, leveraging the strong spatial correlation preserved by the quadtree structure, the QuadTok generator enables zero-shot spatially controlled image generation capabilities. Code: https://github.com/myc634/QuadTok.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QuadTok，一种基于层次化四叉树结构的视觉分词与自回归图像生成框架，兼顾 2D 空间绑定与 1D 序列灵活性。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉分词方法采用 2D 网格或 1D 序列结构，前者难以契合序列建模的灵活性，后者丢失二维空间绑定关系，二者之间存在结构鸿沟。
AI.method: 设计层次化四叉树分词器，动态将表征容量分配给视觉复杂区域，对均质区域保持粗分辨率；树结构天然引入的因果性可直接支持自回归生成，并以生成前给定的四叉树拓扑为条件驱动 947M GPT 式生成模型。
AI.result: 相比固定 256 token 网格，在 ImageNet 上节省约 10% token，零样本迁移至 COCO 节省约 9%，同时保持相近重建保真度；在 ImageNet 256×256 基准上取得 2.08 gFID，并利用四叉树保留的强空间相关性实现零样本空间可控图像生成。
AI.conclusion: QuadTok 通过四叉树结构有效统一了 2D 空间绑定与 1D 序列灵活性，在分词效率、生成质量与空间可控性方面均具优势，为视觉分词与自回归生成提供了新范式。

title: Validity Without Ground Truth: What Stated-Preference Economics Offers the Evaluation of Language Models
summary: Many of the questions now put to large language models have no correct answer to score against: what a policy is worth, which option a user should choose, how to weigh competing values. Stated-preference economics has faced this problem for decades. It judges survey responses without knowing the true value, through a framework of validity and related concepts: content, construct, and criterion validity, reliability, incentive compatibility, and consequentiality. We argue that this framework is a general method for evaluating language models, and we set out what each concept means for LLM evaluation. We demonstrate the approach using a published water-quality stated preference economic valuation survey (Vossler et al. 2023) administered to six models. In this economic application, the validity tests take the form of predictions from economic theory: demand should slope down, and willingness to pay should respond to the scope of the good and to income. The tests separate the models sharply. Two older models fail the most basic test at a household income level of \$75,000, and the two newest pass every test of theoretical validity we can score, but diverge on convergent validity. Passing validity tests shows that a model's answers are coherent, not that they are correct.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将陈述偏好经济学中的效度框架（内容效度、结构效度、效标效度、信度、激励相容性、结果性）作为评估大语言模型的通用方法，并以水质量陈述偏好调查（Vossler et al. 2023）对六个模型进行实证检验。
AI.motivation: 许多向大语言模型提出的问题没有可用于评分的正确答案（如政策价值、选项选择、价值权衡），而传统准确性指标失效；陈述偏好经济学数十年间正是在不知真实值的情况下评判调查回答，因此其效度框架可为LLM评估提供可迁移的方法论。
AI.method: 将陈述偏好经济学的效度概念体系逐一套用到LLM评估中，明确各概念在LLM语境下的含义；以已发表的水质量陈述偏好经济价值评估调查为测试载体，对六个模型施测，并将效度检验操作化为经济学理论预测：需求曲线向下倾斜、支付意愿对物品范围（scope）与收入变化的响应。
AI.result: 效度检验清晰区分了各模型：两个较旧模型在家庭收入75,000美元水平下未通过最基本的检验；两个最新模型通过了所有可评分的理论效度检验，但在收敛效度（convergent validity）上出现分歧。
AI.conclusion: 通过效度检验表明模型回答具有内在一致性与理论连贯性，而非回答正确；该框架为无标准答案情境下的LLM评估提供了可操作的通用范式。

title: Your Prompt Should Do More: Effects of Retrieval Instructions in Embedding Models
summary: Prompted embedding models have recently received increasing attention, particularly for retrieval, where detailed retrieval instructions are provided as part of the retrieval prompt. Several new datasets and studies have examined this setting, showing that the current embedding models often struggle to follow such instructions reliably. In this paper, we study the mechanism of how instructions actually affect the representations of retrieval queries in asymmetric retrieval tasks. We show that models can fail to follow even simple task instructions when query-side distractors are included in the evaluation. We hypothesize that this behavior is driven by the training setup of current embedding models and their evaluation, and show that fine-tuning with added query-side distractors leads to substantial improvements, with minimal effect on other tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究检索提示（retrieval prompt）中指令如何影响非对称检索的查询表示，指出现有嵌入模型在评估中加入查询侧干扰项时难以遵循简单任务指令，并证明针对查询侧干扰项微调可显著改善该问题且对其他任务影响极小。
AI.motivation: 提示式嵌入模型在检索中日益受关注，但已有数据集与研究表明当前嵌入模型难以可靠遵循检索指令。作者希望深入理解指令实际如何影响非对称检索任务中的查询表示，并解释模型在这一设定下失败的原因。
AI.method: 研究指令对查询表示的机制影响；在评估中引入查询侧干扰项（query-side distractors）以检验模型对任务指令的遵循能力；从当前嵌入模型的训练设置与评估方式角度提出假设；并采用添加查询侧干扰项的微调策略进行改进实验，同时考察其对其他任务的影响。
AI.result: 当评估中加入查询侧干扰项时，模型即使面对简单任务指令也会失败；作者认为该行为源于现有嵌入模型的训练与评估设置；加入查询侧干扰项进行微调后，模型表现获得显著提升，且对其他任务的影响极小。
AI.conclusion: 指令遵循失败主要与训练和评估设置相关，而非模型能力本身的绝对缺陷；通过在训练中引入查询侧干扰项，可有效提升模型对检索指令的遵循能力，并保持较好的任务泛化性。

title: Video-Conditioned Generative Joint 2D-3D Hand Motion Recovery
summary: Recovering faithful 3D hand motion from video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions and incomplete visual observations, which make frame-wise pose estimates unreliable and temporally inconsistent. To address this problem, we propose JoHan, a unified generative framework that recovers hand motion directly from video sequences without relying on intermediate per-frame pose predictions. Trained from scratch, our model jointly generates aligned 2D and 3D local hand pose sequences by learning their temporal dynamics and cross-representation correspondence. The generated 2D trajectories exploit direct spatial and temporal cues from the 2D images to guide the following generative 3D motion reconstruction, while the learned motion prior promotes temporal consistency. Their learned 2D-3D correspondence further enables recovery of the hand's global position and orientation relative to the camera. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate significantly improved accuracy and speed in local hand-pose and camera-space reconstruction. Notably, our method captures much better hand-motion dynamics, producing significantly smoother motion than previous methods while maintaining high per-frame pose accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出JoHan，一个统一的生成式框架，直接从视频序列联合生成对齐的2D与3D局部手部姿态序列，无需逐帧中间姿态估计，在局部手部姿态与相机空间重建上同时提升精度与速度，且运动更平滑。
AI.motivation: 从视频恢复忠实的三维手部运动面临挑战，主要因为频繁遮挡与不完整的视觉观测导致逐帧姿态估计不可靠、时间上不一致。
AI.method: JoHan从零训练，不经中间逐帧姿态预测，直接联合生成对齐的2D与3D局部手部姿态序列，学习其时间动态与跨表示对应关系；生成的2D轨迹利用图像中直接的时空线索引导后续生成式3D运动重建，学习的运动先验促进时间一致性；学到的2D-3D对应关系进一步用于恢复手部相对相机的全局位置与朝向。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的基准上，局部手部姿态与相机空间重建的精度与速度均显著提升；相比先前方法更好地捕捉手部运动动态，在保持较高逐帧姿态精度的同时产生明显更平滑的运动。
AI.conclusion: 联合生成2D-3D对齐手部姿态序列的统一生成式框架，可有效缓解遮挡与观测不完整带来的不可靠与不一致问题，在精度、速度与运动平滑性上取得综合优势。

title: GRACE: Generation-aware latent compression for efficient video generation
summary: Highly compressed video autoencoders offer an effective way to accelerate video diffusion models, as the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) operates on far fewer tokens. However, such autoencoders are challenging to train, since a higher compression ratio degrades reconstruction quality and recovering it requires more channels, which is known to slow the convergence of the DiT. The compressed latent also differs from the one the DiT was trained on, so the pretrained DiT must be either retrained from scratch or adapted at considerable cost. Compressing the autoencoder the DiT was trained with appears to preserve compatibility, yet optimizing it for reconstruction alone still shifts the latent away from the distribution the DiT has learned. To address this, we propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE), a two-stage framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while keeping it compatible with the pretrained DiT. Specifically, we keep a frozen base latent from the pretrained encoder and learn a residual latent for the information lost under stronger compression, while aligning the compressed latent with the pretrained latent in the feature space of the frozen DiT so that the autoencoder is optimized for generation. We then adapt the DiT with lightweight fine-tuning and asymmetric denoising, where the base is denoised ahead of the residual. GRACE reduces the token count of Wan2.1-I2V-14B by 8x and its latency by 11.1x at 480x832x81, while matching the generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on VBench.

AI.tldr: GRACE：一种面向视频扩散模型的两阶段生成感知潜空间压缩框架，在保持与预训练DiT兼容的前提下将预训练视频自编码器进一步压缩，实现8倍token减少与11.1倍加速。
AI.motivation: 高压缩比视频自编码器虽能通过减少token加速DiT，但压缩比提升会降低重建质量，需增加通道数以恢复质量，从而拖慢DiT收敛；同时压缩后的潜空间分布偏移，使预训练DiT需从头重训或高成本适配，而单纯以重建为目标优化仍会偏离DiT已学习的分布。
AI.method: GRACE采用两阶段框架：1）保留预训练编码器的冻结基础潜变量，学习残差潜变量以承载强压缩下丢失的信息；2）在冻结DiT的特征空间中将压缩潜变量与预训练潜变量对齐，使自编码器面向生成任务优化；随后以轻量微调与非对称去噪（基础潜变量先于残差潜变量去噪）适配DiT。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-I2V-14B上，GRACE将token数量减少8倍，在480×832×81分辨率下延迟降低11.1倍，同时VBench生成质量与压缩前预训练管线相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成感知的潜空间压缩与DiT兼容性对齐，GRACE在显著提升视频生成效率（token与延迟大幅下降）的同时保持生成质量，验证了保持与预训练DiT兼容性的压缩策略的有效性。

title: Rephrase Before You Act: Characterizing and Mitigating Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are strikingly sensitive to instruction phrasing and do not inherit the language robustness of the vision-language models they are built on. A one-word edit can move success by tens of points: $π_{0.5}$ turns on a LIBERO stove 100% of the time for "switch on the stove" and 2% for "switch on the hot plate", and a $π_0$ checkpoint finetuned with rephrase augmentation still shows swings of up to 61 points. We characterize this sensitivity with statistically tested single-edit swings and an oracle phrase search, which shows that phrasing alone nearly closes the 21-point gap between in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. We then reduce it without modifying the policy. Because the sensitivity is systematic, it can be expressed as explicit rules: we score many phrasings of a few training tasks, have a large language model distill the evidence into ten to twenty rephrasing rules, and at deployment rewrite each incoming instruction once under these rules. The rules improve the frozen $π_0$ by 16 to 27% relative on twelve held-out tasks across adversarial, VLM-generated, and human-generated phrasings, with gains concentrated on out-of-distribution tasks. The pipeline replicates on $π_{0.5}$ and LIBERO, lifting in-finetune success from 93.6% to 97.8%. The method requires no retraining and no per-step verification, and applies zero-shot to unseen tasks and instructions. Project website: https://sttawm.github.io/rephrase-before-you-act

AI.tldr: 本文揭示视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）对指令措辞高度敏感，并提出一种无需修改策略的推理期改写流程来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: VLA模型继承了视觉-语言模型的语义能力，却未继承其语言鲁棒性：一词之差（如"stove"换成"hot plate"）可令成功率从100%骤降至2%，甚至在经过改写增强微调的检查点上也出现高达61个百分点的波动。作者希望刻画这种敏感性的系统性，并在不重训练策略的前提下加以消除。
AI.method: 首先用统计检验的单次编辑波动与"神谕式措辞搜索"量化敏感性，发现仅靠措辞即可弥合分布内与分布外任务间21点的差距。随后将敏感性显式化为规则：对少量训练任务的多种措辞打分，用大语言模型蒸馏证据，生成10–20条改写规则；部署时对每条输入指令按规则改写一次，冻结策略不变。
AI.result: 规则使冻结的π0在12个留出任务上相对提升16–27%，覆盖对抗式、VLM生成与人工生成的措辞，增益集中于分布外任务；在π0.5与LIBERO上复现，微调内成功率由93.6%升至97.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该流程无需重训练、无需逐步验证，可零样本迁移到未见任务与指令，说明VLA的措辞敏感性是系统性的、可被显式规则捕获并低成本缓解。

title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
summary: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long. Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO. Streaming observation encoding, asynchronous execution, and hardware-specific acceleration enable deployment on RTX 5090, DGX Spark, and Jetson AGX Thor without dropping future prediction; on RTX 5090, each action chunk, including future-video latent prediction, takes 107.4 ms. Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials. As a memory-informed executor, Long-WAM also complements higher-level planning in composite tasks.

AI.tldr: Long-WAM：面向实时机器人控制的因果世界-动作模型，通过自回归预训练+长上下文扩展+流式/异步部署，实现长时程操作并保持实时性。
AI.motivation: 实时机器人控制需要在动作前获取足够视觉历史以推断运动与任务进度，但处理长历史会拖慢动作输出，因此核心矛盾是：如何在实时约束下扩展因果世界-动作模型的上下文并真正利用历史信息。
AI.method: 提出模型-系统协同框架Long-WAM：先用无动作标签的机器人及自我中心视频学习因果预测，进行自回归（AR）预训练；在世界-动作适配阶段保留历史到未来的结构；结合流式观测编码、异步执行与硬件特定加速实现部署。
AI.result: RoboCasa GR-1上上下文由0.0秒增至19.2秒，成功率从63.3%升至78.7%，而双向预训练初始化无净增益；机器人域AR预训练进一步提升GR-1与LIBERO-Long峰值成功率。在LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin 2.0、DOMINO上优于对比方法。RTX 5090、DGX Spark、Jetson AGX Thor可部署且不损失未来预测；RTX 5090上每个动作块含未来视频潜变量预测耗时107.4 ms。Unitree G1与YAM上实现动态长时程操作，动态叠杯成功率95%，Pi0.5与Fast-WAM在20次试验中均失败。
AI.conclusion: 历史可访问不等于会利用：上下文增益依赖自回归式视频预训练。Long-WAM作为记忆驱动的执行器，在保持实时性的同时支持长时程与动态操作，并可补充复合任务中的高层规划。

title: EngramEdit: Decoupled Knowledge Updates in LLMs through Conditional Memory
summary: Conditional memory architectures such as DeepSeek Engram use input n-grams to look up learned embeddings, expanding the capacity of large language models (LLMs) with limited additional computation. Beyond model scaling, this architecture has demonstrated the potential to decouple factual knowledge storage from general-purpose computation, offering a promising route to updating factual knowledge while keeping the Transformer backbone fixed. Realizing this potential is challenging because different expressions of a fact may activate different n-gram embeddings, while updating shared embeddings can unintentionally change the model's predictions about other facts. We propose EngramEdit for decoupled knowledge updates through conditional memory. EngramEdit first computes target memory representations that make the model predict the updated fact across multiple expressions. It then jointly updates the shared n-gram embeddings to match these targets across expressions and edits, penalizing updates to frequently reused embeddings more strongly to preserve unrelated knowledge. Experiments show that EngramEdit enables independent factual knowledge updates through conditional memory, achieving near-perfect editing success. Revised knowledge is usable across unseen expressions and in multi-hop reasoning, with nearly three times the strongest baseline's accuracy under chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting. Unrelated knowledge and general capabilities are largely preserved even as factual updates accumulate. These findings show that EngramEdit turns conditional memory into an editable knowledge interface, extending its role beyond model scaling to support decoupled knowledge updates.

AI.tldr: 提出EngramEdit方法，通过条件记忆（conditional memory）实现与大模型骨干解耦的事实知识更新，近乎完美地编辑事实且保留无关知识与通用能力。
AI.motivation: 条件记忆架构（如DeepSeek Engram）用输入n-gram查表获取嵌入，在有限额外计算下扩展LLM容量，并有望将事实知识存储与通用计算解耦，从而在固定Transformer骨干的情况下更新事实知识。但实现该目标存在挑战：同一事实的不同表达会激活不同的n-gram嵌入，而更新共享嵌入又可能意外改变模型对其他事实的预测。
AI.method: EngramEdit首先计算目标记忆表示，使模型在多种表达下都能预测更新后的事实；然后联合更新共享n-gram嵌入，使其在多种表达与多次编辑中匹配这些目标，并对被频繁复用的嵌入施以更强的更新惩罚，以保护无关知识。
AI.result: EngramEdit通过条件记忆实现独立的事实知识更新，编辑成功率近乎完美；修订后的知识可泛化到未见表达，并支持多跳推理，在思维链（CoT）提示下准确率约为最强基线的三倍；即使事实更新不断累积，无关知识与通用能力也基本保持。
AI.conclusion: EngramEdit将条件记忆转变为可编辑的知识接口，使其作用超越模型扩展，支持解耦式知识更新。

title: Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR
summary: Modern language models undergo reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on top of already-trained checkpoints. A key promise of RLVR is the discovery of new reasoning strategies. In principle, a model can sample novel ideas absent from its prior training data. In practice, however, augmenting RLVR with strong novelty incentives has seen limited success and can degrade model quality. Because verifiable rewards supervise only a narrow slice of the model's knowledge and behavior, such degradations are difficult to recover from. Instead, we decouple exploration from optimization in a framework we call Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis). We train one or more explorer policies with a novelty bonus in the reward, filter their trajectories for correctness and quality, and distill them into a separate student policy. The student policy is then trained without a novelty bonus. We repeat the above procedure for several rounds, alternating between exploration and optimization. This decoupling allows us to aggressively scale exploration without degrading the student policy. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families, ExpDis outperforms DAPO at the same wall-clock budget. Moreover, we observe improved pass@$k$ scaling, indicating that ExpDis produces models that generate more diverse correct solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Exploration-Distillation（ExpDis）框架，将探索与优化解耦：用带新颖性奖励的 explorer 策略采样并筛选轨迹，再蒸馏到不带新颖性奖励的 student 策略，多轮交替探索与优化，从而在不损害模型质量的前提下大幅扩展探索，在数学推理任务上优于 DAPO 并改善 pass@k 扩展性。
AI.motivation: RLVR 建在已训练好的检查点上，其核心愿景是发现新的推理策略、采样出训练数据中不存在的新想法。但实践表明，直接在 RLVR 奖励中加入强新颖性激励效果有限，甚至会损害模型质量；且由于可验证奖励只监督模型知识与行为的一小部分，这种退化难以恢复。因此需要一种既能积极扩展探索、又不会让最终策略质量下降的方法。
AI.method: ExpDis 将探索与优化解耦。训练一个或多个带新颖性奖励（novelty bonus）的 explorer 策略；对其轨迹按正确性与质量进行过滤；再将这些轨迹蒸馏到一个独立的 student 策略。student 策略在不含新颖性奖励的情况下训练。上述过程重复多轮，交替进行探索与优化。
AI.result: 在七个数学推理基准和两个模型家族上，ExpDis 在相同 wall-clock 预算下优于 DAPO。此外观察到 pass@k 扩展性提升，说明 ExpDis 训练出的模型能生成更多样且正确的解。
AI.conclusion: 将探索从优化中解耦，使探索可以激进地扩展而不损害 student 策略，从而在 RLVR 中更有效地利用新颖性激励，提升推理多样性与正确性。

title: Never Look Back: Understanding Persistence in 3D Object Memory from Egocentric Videos
summary: As we move through the world and carry out everyday tasks, we encounter objects that may become relevant only later. We are capable of recalling where we left something or what was inside a container, even without knowing we would need it later. Here, we study how an embodied assistant can build a similar memory from egocentric videos, by observing a person's day-to-day activities. We present Ledger, a persistent 3D object memory that combines object locations, their histories, and contextual descriptions. It associates observations across the recording and retains objects after they leave the view, including those the person never touches. It clusters each object's observations by resting locations and records a move only after repeated evidence, reducing the effect of localization noise. Short descriptions preserve details such as an object's contents or supporting surface. It saves these records to later answer spatial questions without having to access the original images or video. Our memory raises HD-EPIC accuracy from 29.7% to 42.6%, UCS-Bench accuracy from 33.8% to 38.5% and localizes Ego4D objects with a 0.99 m median error on returned predictions. Our analyses identify complementary roles for temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and retrieval. Our study on 100 stitched streams of multiple scenes each further exposes failures in both retrieval and construction. Per-scene construction partially recovers the performance lost across scene changes compared to that of single scene streams.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ledger，一种从第一人称视频中构建的持久 3D 物体记忆，融合物体位置、历史与上下文描述，显著提升空间问答与定位性能。
AI.motivation: 人在日常生活中能记住物体的位置与内容，即使当时并不需要，具身助手也需要具备类似能力。现有方法难以在长时间视频中跨视角关联物体、保留离屏物体并抑制定位噪声。
AI.method: Ledger 构建持久的 3D 物体记忆：关联跨时段观测，保留离开视野（含未被触碰）的物体；按静止位置对观测聚类，仅在重复证据后记录移动，以降低定位噪声影响；并用简短描述保留物体内容或支撑面等细节。记录以结构化形式存储，后续空间问题无需访问原始图像或视频。
AI.result: HD-EPIC 准确率由 29.7% 提升至 42.6%，UCS-Bench 由 33.8% 提升至 38.5%，Ego4D 物体定位返回预测的中位误差为 0.99 m。分析显示时间持久性、上下文描述与检索具有互补作用。在 100 条多场景拼接流上的研究进一步暴露了检索与构建两方面的失败；相较单场景流，按场景分别构建可部分恢复跨场景性能损失。
AI.conclusion: Ledger 通过持久 3D 物体记忆有效支持具身助手的长期空间记忆任务；时间持久性、上下文描述与检索共同贡献性能，而跨场景的检索与构建仍是主要挑战，按场景构建可缓解部分损失。

title: Tetris3D: 3D Scene Generation With Objects That Fit Together
summary: We propose Tetris3D, a generative framework for single-image 3D scene reconstruction that recovers objects which are physically and geometrically coherent as a scene. Existing methods often generate objects independently or couple them implicitly, providing limited guidance for ensuring fine-grained spatial compatibility between neighboring objects that interact with one another. To address this, we explicitly condition the generation of each object on the geometry of surrounding objects and their physical relationships, guiding its shape and pose to remain geometrically and physically plausible within the scene. Moreover, we introduce ComOb, a physics simulation-based dataset of 1.2M scenes featuring physical interactions across diverse object categories, with per-object meshes and pairwise physical relation annotations. Comprehensive experiments on synthetic and realworld scenes show that Tetris3D recovers coherent object shapes and poses even when interacting regions are occluded, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both generation quality and physical stability.

AI.tldr: 提出 Tetris3D，一种单图像 3D 场景重建生成框架，通过显式建模物体间几何与物理关系，使重建物体在场景中保持几何与物理一致，并发布 1.2M 规模的物理仿真数据集 ComOb。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么独立生成各物体，要么仅隐式耦合物体，缺乏对相邻交互物体之间细粒度空间兼容性的显式约束，导致重建结果在几何与物理上难以保持一致。
AI.method: Tetris3D 显式以周围物体的几何及其物理关系作为条件，约束每个物体的生成，引导其形状与姿态在场景中保持几何与物理合理性；同时构建 ComOb 数据集，包含 1.2M 场景、跨多类物体的物理交互、逐物体网格与成对物理关系标注。
AI.result: 在合成与真实场景上的实验表明，Tetris3D 即使交互区域被遮挡，也能恢复连贯的物体形状与姿态，并在生成质量与物理稳定性上达到当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入物体间几何与物理关系条件，并结合大规模带关系标注的物理仿真数据，可有效提升单图像 3D 场景重建的几何一致性、物理合理性与鲁棒性。

title: Seeing Through the Glare: A Multi-Source Benchmark and Ocular-Adaptive Pixel MeanFlow for Eyeglass Reflection Removal
summary: Eyeglass reflection removal is important across smartphone imaging, video conferencing, and other face-centric visual applications. The task is challenging because reflections range from mild photometric contamination to severe ocular occlusion, requiring selective correction and plausible reconstruction without altering identity or natural appearance. Existing datasets cover limited reflection conditions, constraining generalization to complex real-world scenes and systematic evaluation. We introduce \textbf{OcuBench}, a multi-source benchmark comprising 10,280 controllable synthetic pairs, 732 real-input pseudo-pairs, and 458 independent real-world test images, supporting both paired evaluation and assessment beyond generated supervision. We further propose \textbf{OcuFlow}, an ocular-adaptive pixel MeanFlow (pMF) framework for efficient, detail-preserving restoration. It combines geometry-adaptive representation with one-step pMF to focus reconstruction on reflection-obscured ocular regions, together with native-resolution frequency-preserving synthesis to retain reliable observed details. Experiments across diverse reflection conditions demonstrate that OcuFlow achieves consistent advantages in reflection removal quality, ocular fidelity, and efficiency. In a blind user study, it receives $67.32\%$ of selections, $6.2\times$ the next-best share. Both the code and dataset will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出眼镜反光去除基准OcuBench与高效框架OcuFlow，实现细节保留的眼镜反光去除。
AI.motivation: 眼镜反光去除在手机成像、视频会议等以人脸为中心的应用中很重要，但反光程度从轻微光度污染到严重遮挡不等，需要在选择性校正与合理重建之间权衡且不能改变身份或自然外观。现有数据集覆盖的反光条件有限，限制了在复杂真实场景中的泛化能力和系统评估。
AI.method: 构建多源基准OcuBench，含10,280对可控合成样本、732个真实输入伪配对样本及458张独立真实测试图，支持配对评估与生成监督之外的评估。提出OcuFlow，一种眼区自适应像素MeanFlow框架，结合几何自适应表示与一步像素MeanFlow，将重建聚焦于反光遮挡的眼部区域，并采用原生分辨率频率保持合成以保留可靠观测细节。
AI.result: 在多种反光条件下，OcuFlow在反光去除质量、眼部保真度和效率上均取得一致优势。盲测用户研究中获得67.32%的选择率，为次优方法的6.2倍。
AI.conclusion: OcuBench为眼镜反光去除提供了多源、多评估范式的基准，OcuFlow验证了眼区自适应与一步像素MeanFlow在质量、保真度与效率上的有效性，代码与数据集将公开。

title: LinSlot: Exploiting Linear Representation hypothesis for unsupervised attribute discovery from slot based object representation
summary: This paper studies the problem of learning disentangled representations of objects and their attributes from raw, unstructured image data. Slot-based methods have shown considerable success in unsupervised learning of object representations from images. Block-slot attention-based methods extend this framework to attribute representations by assuming a uniform factorization of object representations into attributes, which may be suboptimal and consequently limit the quality of the learned representations. We therefore investigate a framework for jointly discovering object and attribute representations. Our key contribution is leveraging the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which postulates that composable concepts can be represented as linearly additive subspaces in slot representations. Based on this insight, we propose a probabilistic model connecting images, slots (objects), and blocks (attributes). We present an architecture that leverages block attention to connect attribute representations to slots and incorporates LRH in both object and attribute representation spaces. This architecture effectively optimizes the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) of the proposed graphical model. Our experiments demonstrate (i) effective discovery of disentangled object and attribute representations, (ii) empirical evidence for LRH in slot space, and (iii) the ability to perform image editing owing to the disentangled and interpretable nature of the learned representations. Our experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate improvements in DCI scores over state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于线性表示假设（LRH）的概率框架，联合学习图像中物体（slots）与属性（blocks）的解耦表征，在多个数据集上DCI指标超越SOTA，并支持图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有slot-based方法虽能无监督学习物体表征，但block-slot注意力方法假设物体表征可均匀分解为属性，这种均匀分解可能是次优的，限制了所学表征的质量。因此需要研究能够联合发现物体与属性表征的框架。
AI.method: 利用线性表示假设（LRH）——可组合概念可表示为slot表征中的线性可加子空间。基于此构建连接图像、slots（物体）与blocks（属性）的概率模型；设计架构用block attention将属性表征连接到slots，并在物体与属性表征空间中同时引入LRH约束，从而有效优化该图模型的ELBO。
AI.result: 实验表明：(i) 能有效发现解耦的物体与属性表征；(ii) 为slot空间中的LRH提供了经验证据；(iii) 由于表征的解耦与可解释性，可实现图像编辑；在多个数据集上DCI分数优于SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入LRH并联合建模物体与属性，克服了均匀分解假设的局限，获得更优的解耦表征质量，并验证了LRH在slot空间的有效性及编辑应用潜力。

title: Cognitive Thermometers: Machine Learning and Logical Complexity
summary: How does the human mind represent semantic categories? Why do natural languages favor certain meanings over others? Prior explanations have relied on logical definability and complexity, but these are highly sensitive to the choice of logical language, rendering some design choices unmotivated. In this article, we propose that machine learning provides a somewhat more agnostic approach to measuring semantic complexity. We review emerging evidence that logic and machine learning often yield converging results on relative complexity and its resulting effects in semantic typology. Where they diverge, learning appears to be a better explanation than logical complexity. We argue that treating machine learning models as ``cognitive thermometers'' enables a unified approach to complexity that bridges symbolic logic and connectionist AI.

AI.tldr: 该文主张以机器学习作为度量语义复杂度的更中立方法，认为机器学习与逻辑学在相对复杂度上常得出收敛结论，分歧时学习解释力更强，并提出把机器学习模型视为"认知温度计"以统一符号逻辑与连接主义AI。
AI.motivation: 既有解释依赖逻辑可定义性与复杂度，但这些标准对逻辑语言的选择高度敏感，导致部分设计选择缺乏合理依据，因此需要一个更中立的语义复杂度度量框架。
AI.method: 提出以机器学习作为相对中立的语义复杂度度量方式，综述机器学习与逻辑学在语义类型学中关于相对复杂度及其效应的证据，并对二者一致与分歧的情形进行比较分析。
AI.result: 新兴证据表明逻辑与机器学习在相对复杂度及其对语义类型学的影响上常呈现收敛结果；在二者出现分歧时，学习比逻辑复杂度更能解释相关现象。
AI.conclusion: 将机器学习模型视为"认知温度计"，可为复杂度研究提供统一路径，连接符号逻辑与连接主义AI，并为语义类型学提供新的解释框架。

title: Lossy Compressive Text Autoencoders
summary: Our work explores learning a compressed latent representation of text, at the intersection of data compression and representation learning. We propose an autoencoder architecture that performs residual downscaling and upscaling of hidden representations along the time axis, with a residual low-dimension discrete bottleneck. We analyze our approach for different quantization methods, training objectives, and datasets. For different levels of compression, we evaluate the similarity between the original and reconstructed text both at the surface-level (BLEU) and at the semantic-level (LLM-based judge). Additionally, we evaluate our models on downstream question-answering and semantic text similarity benchmarks. Our approach results in compressed representations which are on par with lossless text compression algorithms at 2.24 bits per byte on web text data, while having good reconstruction and downstream task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自编码器架构，沿时间轴对隐藏表示进行残差下采样与上采样，并引入残差低维离散瓶颈，学习文本的压缩潜在表示。在Web文本上达到2.24 bits/byte，与无损压缩算法相当，且重建与下游任务表现良好。
AI.motivation: 研究目标位于数据压缩与表示学习的交叉点：如何学习文本的压缩潜在表示，使其在接近无损压缩算法的压缩率下，仍保留良好的重建质量与下游任务性能。
AI.method: 提出一种自编码器架构：沿时间轴对隐藏表示执行残差下采样（downscaling）与上采样（upscaling），并采用残差低维离散瓶颈（residual low-dimension discrete bottleneck）。系统地分析了不同量化方法、训练目标与数据集的影响。评估涵盖表面级（BLEU）与语义级（基于LLM的评判）的重建相似度，以及下游问答与语义文本相似度基准。
AI.result: 在Web文本数据上，压缩表示达到2.24 bits per byte，与无损文本压缩算法相当；同时保持良好的重建质量与下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够在接近无损压缩算法的比特率下学习文本的压缩潜在表示，并兼顾重建与下游任务表现，验证了压缩与表示学习结合路线的可行性。

title: Conversational Task Disambiguation over Tabular Data: Leakage-Aware Formulation, Benchmark Suite, and Training
comment: 39 pages (9 main, 30 appendix), 12 figures (5 main, 7 appendix)
summary: Conversational task disambiguation over tabular data uses dialogue to resolve missing information about a user's intended task before producing a solution over tables or databases. Existing evaluation and training lack a leakage-aware foundation. Task success mixes the agent's disambiguation and solution-generation capabilities and can also reflect oracle leakage, that is, information that a user simulator reveals beyond what a real user would. Existing datasets also lack a shared representation of ambiguities and access boundaries. We introduce the notion of an ambiguous verifiable task, which formalizes ambiguities and resolutions, decomposing the agent into an asking policy and a solution policy, and the environment into an oracle and verifier. This framework provides baselines and metrics for evaluating task disambiguation separately from solution generation, formal definitions of oracle leakage, judge-free leakage diagnostics, and a training objective for the asking policy. We instantiate the framework in text-to-SQL with AmbiTab, a benchmark suite that unifies six ambiguous datasets under a common representation specifying what the agent, oracle, and verifier may access. We evaluate clarification strategies and oracle leakage, and train an asking policy with reinforcement learning. The trained asker improves our disambiguation metrics on all six datasets and task success on five, and our leakage diagnostics measure how training affects oracle leakage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"模糊可验证任务"框架，将对话式表格任务消歧分解为提问策略与求解策略、oracle与验证器，并给出oracle泄漏的形式化定义、无评判者泄漏诊断及提问策略训练目标；在text-to-SQL上构建AmbiTab基准，统一六个模糊数据集，实验显示训练后的提问器在全部六个数据集的消歧指标和五个数据集的任务成功率上均提升。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式表格数据任务消歧的训练与评测缺乏"泄漏感知"基础：任务成功率混合了智能体的消歧能力与求解能力，还可能反映oracle泄漏（用户模拟器泄露超出真实用户所给的信息）；同时已有数据集缺少对模糊性与访问边界的统一表示。因此需要一套能将消歧与求解分离评测、并显式刻画访问权限与泄漏的框架与基准。
AI.method: 提出"模糊可验证任务"（ambiguous verifiable task）这一概念，把模糊性与消解过程形式化：将智能体拆分为提问策略（asking policy）与求解策略（solution policy），将环境拆分为oracle与验证器（verifier）。该框架提供：消歧与求解分离评测的基线与指标、oracle泄漏的形式化定义、无需评判者的泄漏诊断方法，以及提问策略的训练目标。在text-to-SQL上实例化为AmbiTab基准套件，将六个模糊数据集统一到共同表示下，明确规定智能体、oracle与验证器各自可访问的信息；随后评测澄清策略与oracle泄漏，并用强化学习训练提问策略。
AI.result: 训练出的提问器在全部六个数据集上提升了消歧指标，在五个数据集上提升了任务成功率；所提出的泄漏诊断能够度量训练对oracle泄漏的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为对话式表格任务消歧提供了泄漏感知的评测与训练基础，通过将消歧与求解解耦、显式区分各方访问边界，实现了更可靠的评测与可训练的提问策略，并为后续研究提供了统一的基准与诊断工具。

title: CORAL-KV: Compact Cross-Layer Prediction and Residual Coding for Autoregressive Video KV Caches
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models maintain a growing attention key-value (KV) cache, making memory a key bottleneck for long video generation. Recently, clustering-based quantization has emerged as an effective method to compress video KV caches by grouping similar key and value vectors then quantizing residual errors. However, when later frames attend to the compressed history, small reconstruction errors can compound as the video grows. Beyond the within-layer similarity exploited by clustering, we find strong dependencies across cache layers in video models. This motivates Coral-KV - Calibrated Offline, Residual-coded, and Adapted Locally - a KV-cache compression framework that uses cache states in each layer to predict keys and values in subsequent layers, then quantizes the remaining prediction residuals. We construct compact block-diagonal-plus-low-rank (block-DPLR) predictors: block-diagonal components model channel relationships within each attention head, while a global low-rank term models dependencies between heads. Coral-KV exposes a flexible fidelity-memory trade-off: it can reuse its predictors across videos or refit lightweight block-diagonal predictors to the current video for higher fidelity. Across extensive evaluations on both HY-WorldPlay and MAGI-1, our reusable configuration improves PSNR over QVG-4 by 0.32 dB and 4.95 dB, respectively, while using 48% and 37% less cache memory. Against QVG-Pro, our video-adapted configuration improves MAGI-1 PSNR by 3.77 dB while using 33.7% less cache memory. Coral-KV also maintains higher reconstruction fidelity over extended generation and reduces temporal discontinuities while retaining comparable generation latency.

AI.tldr: Coral-KV 利用视频扩散模型 KV 缓存跨层依赖，通过块对角加低秩预测器编码预测残差来压缩缓存，在更低显存下显著提升重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型需维护不断增长的 attention KV 缓存，显存成为长视频生成瓶颈。现有基于聚类的量化方法仅利用层内相似性，当后续帧访问压缩历史时，累积的重建误差会随视频增长而放大。作者发现视频模型缓存还存在强跨层依赖，可利用该依赖提升压缩效率。
AI.method: 提出 Coral-KV（Calibrated Offline, Residual-coded, Adapted Locally）框架：用每层缓存状态预测后续层的 key 和 value，再对预测残差量化。构造紧凑的块对角加低秩（block-DPLR）预测器，块对角部分建模注意力头内通道关系，全局低秩项建模头间依赖。提供两种配置：跨视频复用预测器，或针对当前视频轻量重拟合块对角预测器以提升保真度。
AI.result: 在 HY-WorldPlay 和 MAGI-1 上，可复用配置相比 QVG-4 分别提升 PSNR 0.32 dB 和 4.95 dB，同时减少 48% 和 37% 缓存显存；视频自适应配置相比 QVG-Pro 在 MAGI-1 上提升 PSNR 3.77 dB，减少 33.7% 缓存显存。Coral-KV 在长时间生成中保持更高重建保真度，减少时间不连续，且生成延迟相当。
AI.conclusion: Coral-KV 通过挖掘跨层缓存依赖并对预测残差编码，实现了显存与保真度的灵活权衡，在多个模型上以更少缓存取得更好重建质量，并改善长视频生成的时间一致性，同时保持可比延迟。

title: Clarify, Then Focus: Statement Normalization for Conversation Analytics at Scale
summary: Enterprise conversation analytics asks many questions of millions of interactions. Each question can require reconstructing what people mean and identifying which information matters, repeating costly interpretive work across the same transcripts. We propose a simple principle: clarify the text, then focus the reader. Statement normalization transforms dialogue into short, speaker-attributed statements with source references and semantic tags. The statements make meaning more explicit; the tags support selecting evidence for a particular question. Downstream models can use the full representation or a relevant subset, depending on what helps them make the decision. In an offer-suppression task on customer-service calls, normalization improves a supervised classifier without selection, while weaker prompted readers benefit from both normalization and selection. A small model can learn the normalization contract, while lightweight encoders handle tagging and downstream decisions. Sharing this preparation across questions supports an inference pipeline built entirely from small models, making analytics over millions of conversations substantially less expensive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"先澄清文本、再聚焦读者"的原则：通过语句归一化将对话转为带说话人归属、来源引用与语义标签的短语句，使含义更显式并支持按问题筛选证据，从而用小模型构建可复用的低成本企业对话分析流水线。
AI.motivation: 企业对话分析需在数百万交互上回答大量不同问题，而每个问题都要重新重构语义、判断哪些信息重要，导致对同一批转写文本重复进行昂贵的解释性工作。
AI.method: 提出语句归一化（statement normalization）：将对话转化为短的、带说话人归属的语句，并附加来源引用和语义标签。语句使语义更显式，标签用于为特定问题选取证据；下游模型可使用完整表示或相关子集。实现上，小模型学习归一化契约，轻量编码器负责打标签与下游决策，并在客服通话的"报价抑制"任务上验证。
AI.result: 在客服通话的报价抑制任务中，归一化在无筛选情况下即提升了监督分类器；而较弱的提示式阅读器则同时受益于归一化与证据筛选。
AI.conclusion: 将这种准备工作在多个问题间共享，可支撑一个完全由小模型构成的推理流水线，使面向数百万对话的分析成本大幅降低。

title: MESSENGER: Memory-Enhanced Sequential Scene Flow Estimation via Autoregressive Next-Frame Forecasting
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code will be released at: https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger
summary: Scene flow can capture low-level 3D motion displacements in dynamic scenarios. Early pairwise estimators relying on instantaneous two-frame motion lack long-term temporal correlation and also struggle with poor extrapolation ability in future prediction. Although some recent methods attempt to explore multi-frame scene flow estimation in a sequence-to-sequence manner, they typically suffer from heavy computational overhead with increasing input frames and long-horizon prediction degradation due to ineffective motion propagation. To address these problems, we propose a novel memory-enhanced sequential scene flow pipeline, called MESSENGER. To sufficiently mine long-term temporal dependencies naturally within consecutive sequences, a memory buffer is designed by explicitly storing multiple history flow estimates and latent states. For each input frame, the temporally stored flows and states are correlated and retrieved to predict the current initialized flow in a next-frame forecasting manner. Furthermore, we develop an uncertainty-aware reweighting module to filter unreliable retrievals and mitigate accumulated errors. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of our MESSENGER, reducing EPE3D by 71.6% on nuScenes and 67.7% on Argoverse 2 in long-horizon future extrapolation. This superiority can be attributed to our designed autoregressive forecasting paradigm, which naturally forces the network to progressively learn the next-frame distribution based on history observations. Code will be released at https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger.

AI.tldr: 提出记忆增强的序列场景流估计框架MESSENGER，通过显式记忆缓冲与不确定性重加权实现长时程预测，性能达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 早期双帧估计器缺乏长时时间关联且外推能力差；现有多帧序列方法随输入帧增加计算开销大，且因运动传播无效导致长时程预测性能退化。
AI.method: 设计记忆缓冲显式存储多历史流估计与隐状态，对每帧进行时序关联与检索以预测当前初始流（下一帧预测方式）；引入不确定性感知重加权模块，过滤不可靠检索、缓解累积误差。
AI.result: 在nuScenes与Argoverse 2上达到SOTA，长时程未来外推中EPE3D分别降低71.6%和67.7%。
AI.conclusion: 其优势源于设计的自回归预测范式，迫使网络基于历史观测逐步学习下一帧分布；代码将开源。

title: DOGS: Design-Space Sampling for Prompt-Driven Logo Generation
summary: Prompt optimization for text-to-image (T2I) generation has been pursued almost entirely as text rewriting, in which a short user brief is expanded into a longer, model-preferred token sequence. We argue that such a language-space formulation is ill-suited to structured visual design tasks such as logo creation, where a one-line brief leaves most design decisions unspecified. These decisions depend on relational priors that a linear sequence cannot encode, and they leave an uncontrolled channel through which protected marks may be reproduced. We therefore recast logo prompting as sampling within a structured design space, and instantiate this idea as DOGS (Design-space prompting with an Originality-aware GFlowNet Sampler). From a large corpus of real-world logos, we mine a typed, graph-structured design grammar whose edges record empirical co-occurrence. A GFlowNet sampler then generates design graphs with probability proportional to a terminal reward that combines recognizability, aesthetics, and corpus-relative originality. Every slot draws only from a closed design-level vocabulary, and any infringement-inducing or harmful token is removed during parsing. The originality reward further penalizes proximity to existing logos, thereby incorporating infringement avoidance into the method by construction. On two open-source renderers and against nine baselines, DOGS produces logos that are more recognizable and aesthetic, substantially more diverse, and far less prone to trademark infringement.

AI.tldr: 本文将 logo 提示优化从文本改写重新表述为结构化设计空间采样，提出 DOGS：用图结构设计语法 + GFlowNet 采样器生成设计图，奖励联合优化可识别性、美观性与原创性，并天然抑制侵权输出。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2I 提示优化几乎都是"文本改写"：把简短用户描述扩写成模型偏好的长 token 序列。这种语言空间表述不适合 logo 等结构化视觉设计任务——一句简要说明留下大量设计决策未定；这些决策依赖线性序列无法编码的关系先验；同时留下一条不受控通道，可能复现受保护标识。
AI.method: 将 logo 提示重构为结构化设计空间采样，提出 DOGS（Design-space prompting with an Originality-aware GFlowNet Sampler）。从大规模真实 logo 语料挖掘带类型的图结构设计语法，边记录经验共现；GFlowNet 采样器按与终端奖励成比例的概率生成设计图，奖励融合可识别性、美观性和相对语料的原创性。每个槽位只从封闭的设计级词表中取值，侵权诱导或有害 token 在解析阶段被剔除；原创性奖励进一步惩罚与已有 logo 的接近程度，从构造上纳入侵权规避。
AI.result: 在两个开源渲染器、对比九种基线方法下，DOGS 生成 logo 的可识别性与美观性更强、多样性显著更高，且商标侵权倾向大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 将 T2I 提示优化由语言空间改写转向结构化设计空间采样，是应对 logo 等结构化视觉设计的更合适范式；通过设计语法约束、封闭词表与原创性奖励，可在提升生成质量与多样性的同时从机制上降低侵权风险。

title: VICO: Visual Environments Co-Evolving for Vision-Language Model Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs), but it typically assumes a static training environment. As the actor improves, fixed tasks drift out of its learning frontier: many become trivial, others remain unsolvable; and the learning signal collapses. We argue that VLM post-training should evolve the visual environment alongside the actor, not just the actor itself. We propose VICO, a co-evolutionary framework in which an actor and an Environment-as-Rewriter (EnvRewriter) are trained jointly: the EnvRewriter edits verifiable image-side structures, such as scene graphs, chart tables, or protected region masks, and re-renders them to produce label-valid training samples whose difficulty is calibrated to the actor's current ability through a pass-rate-based reward. This loop continuously realigns task difficulty with actor capability without any additional human annotation. Across nine multimodal benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning and visually grounded understanding, VICO-8B improves over its base model by up to +5.0% on out-of-domain tasks, surpasses the strongest self-evolution and text-editing co-evolution baselines by +4.3% and +8.4% respectively, and stays comparable to chart-specialized RLVR methods using 16-160 times fewer labeled samples. By shifting from human-labeled supervision to image-editing co-evolution, VICO offers a scalable path beyond static-corpus RLVR for visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出VICO：一种演员与"环境即改写器"(EnvRewriter)协同进化的RLVR框架，通过可验证的图像侧结构编辑与重渲染，动态校准训练样本难度，无需额外人工标注。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR通常假设静态训练环境；随着策略（actor）能力提升，固定任务会滑出学习前沿——部分变得过于简单、部分始终不可解，导致学习信号崩塌。作者主张VLM后训练应让视觉环境与actor共同进化。
AI.method: VICO联合训练actor与环境改写器EnvRewriter。EnvRewriter编辑可验证的图像侧结构（场景图、图表表格、受保护区域掩码等）并重渲染，生成标签有效、难度经pass-rate奖励校准的训练样本；该闭环持续将任务难度对齐到actor当前能力，且无需额外人工标注。
AI.result: 在9个涵盖数学推理与视觉接地理解的多模态基准上，VICO-8B在域外任务较基座模型最高提升+5.0%；分别超越最强自进化基线与文本编辑协同进化基线+4.3%与+8.4%；在使用少16–160倍标注样本的情况下，与图表专用RLVR方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 从人工标注监督转向图像编辑协同进化，VICO为视觉推理提供了一条超越静态语料RLVR的可扩展路径。

title: Plan-and-Patch: Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Planning
summary: Planning is increasingly important for long-horizon agents, where successful execution requires coordinating subgoals, tool use, and intermediate outcomes over many steps. Yet assumptions made during planning may be invalidated by the environment, tools may return unexpected results, or actions may fail. Effective agents must therefore not only generate plans, but also revise them. Such revisions often affect only part of a plan, leaving the preceding and subsequent structure intact. Rather than regenerate the entire plan and risk unnecessary changes, repair can regenerate the affected region conditioned on the preserved prefix and suffix. We introduce Plan-and-Patch, a plan-and-act framework in which a diffusion language model (dLLM) generates a structured, program-like plan through parallel unmasking and repairs it by filling in selected regions while keeping the surrounding steps fixed. We compare DreamReasoner-8B and Qwen3-8B as diffusion and autoregressive (AR) planners. On Natural Plan without task-specific training, diffusion (53.7%) achieves nearly twice the plan repair success rate of AR (27.0%). After task-specific training on agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and TextCraft, the planners achieve similar observed success in plan generation, while diffusion reduces mean plan-generation latency by 39-46% relative to AR. Our results show that Plan-and-Patch provides a framework for faster plan generation and effective plan repair in long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 Plan-and-Patch 框架，用扩散语言模型并行生成结构化计划并定点修补，实现更快的计划生成与更有效的计划修复。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体执行需协调多步子目标、工具调用与中间结果，但规划假设可能被环境推翻、工具可能返回意外结果、动作可能失败，因此智能体不仅要生成计划，还需修改计划。全局重规划会引入不必要改动，而计划修改通常只涉及局部区域。
AI.method: Plan-and-Patch 是一个"规划-行动"框架：由扩散语言模型（dLLM）通过并行去掩码生成程序式结构化计划；修复时以保留的前缀与后缀为条件，仅对选定区域进行填充式重写。实验对比 DreamReasoner-8B（扩散）与 Qwen3-8B（自回归）作为规划器。
AI.result: 在无任务特定训练的 Natural Plan 上，扩散模型计划修复成功率为 53.7%，约为自回归（27.0%）的两倍。在 ALFWorld 与 TextCraft 上经任务特定训练后，两者计划生成成功率接近，但扩散将计划生成平均延迟降低 39–46%。
AI.conclusion: Plan-and-Patch 为长程智能体提供了兼顾更快计划生成与有效计划修复的框架，验证了扩散语言模型在计划局部修补上的优势。

title: NavGPT-3: Harnessing Context in a Hierarchical Navigation Runtime
summary: Language models trained with long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning can generalize knowledge through reasoning, express precise actions, and pursue goals over many steps, raising the ceiling on what an embodied agent can understand and decide. Physical interaction, however, remains the domain of action policies, which provide dense, low-latency control. We present NavGPT-3, a harness that connects the two models, with an OS-like runtime built above it: reasoning, acting, and monitoring run as threads with their own context, tools, and permissions, while the runtime schedules them and decides which thread controls the robot's motion, so that the robot can react to sudden real-world events through interruption and thread switching. Beneath it, our action policy NavGPT VLA, trained on 19.28M examples, allocates visual tokens using codec allocation, in proportion to scene change; its 8B model alone reaches 76.94 SR on R2R-CE and leads RxR-CE with 82.39 SR. With the complete harness, NavGPT-3 sets the state of the art on R2R-CE (81.51 SR) and, for the first time, brings an autonomous agent to human level: on RxR-CE it matches human followers in success (90.43 vs. 90.4 SR) and path fidelity (78.47 vs. 77.7 nDTW) at 1 min 22 s per episode, versus roughly 3 min for a human. We comprehensively ablate the harness design and the interaction between the two models, showing how tools and the action policy shape the path from language-model reasoning to physical control: when NavGPT VLA executes the route, the reasoning loop shortens and the system's minimum reaction time falls from 3-19 s per language-model decision to 0.5-1 s per action-policy step (1-2 Hz). These results show that designing this embodied interface is central to connecting frontier language-model intelligence with low-level physical control. We will release all models, code, and evaluation records.

AI.tldr: 提出 NavGPT-3，用类操作系统运行时衔接语言模型推理与动作策略控制，实现推理、动作与监控的线程化协作与中断切换；配套 NavGPT VLA 动作策略，在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 上取得最优性能并首次达到人类水平。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体强化学习训练的语言模型具备推理与多步目标追求能力，但物理交互仍依赖密集、低延迟的动作策略；两类模型之间存在"具身接口"鸿沟，缺乏统一机制连接高层语言推理与底层物理控制。
AI.method: 1) NavGPT-3 harness：类 OS 运行时，将 reasoning、acting、monitoring 作为带独立上下文、工具与权限的线程，由运行时调度并决定控制机器人运动的线程，支持中断与线程切换以应对突发真实事件；2) NavGPT VLA 动作策略：基于 19.28M 样本训练，采用 codec allocation 按场景变化比例分配视觉 token，提供 8B 规模模型；3) 消融 harness 设计与两模型交互机制。
AI.result: NavGPT VLA 8B 单独在 R2R-CE 达 76.94 SR，在 RxR-CE 以 82.39 SR 领先；完整 harness 下 NavGPT-3 在 R2R-CE 达 81.51 SR（SOTA），在 RxR-CE 成功率 90.43 对 90.4 SR、路径保真度 78.47 对 77.7 nDTW，与人类跟随者持平，每回合 1 分 22 秒（人类约 3 分钟）。当 NavGPT VLA 执行路线时，推理循环缩短，系统最小反应时间从每语言模型决策 3-19 秒降至每动作策略步 0.5-1 秒（1-2 Hz）。
AI.conclusion: 具身接口设计是连接前沿语言模型智能与低层物理控制的关键；所提 harness 与动作策略的协同验证了这一接口的有效性，并将开源全部模型、代码与评测记录。

title: Velocity Scaling in Flow Matching
summary: Scaling a learned flow-matching velocity field $v_θ$ by a gain $γ(t)$ was recently shown to greatly improve generation quality. Prior work argued that velocity fields trained with mean-squared error (MSE) systematically underestimate velocity magnitude and that scaling corrects this error. We show that MSE training does not create a velocity-magnitude deficit. We find instead that velocity scaling reduces population time lag: sampled states at model time $t$ resemble training states from an earlier time. Velocity scaling and moving model time back are two ways to address this population time lag. Across architectures and model sizes, measuring population time lag and using it to select a gain greatly improves generation quality, reducing FID from 28.0 to 12.2 (estimated by linear interpolation between FID measurements at neighboring gains) on ImageNet-256 at NFE 25 without guidance.

AI.tldr: 该论文反驳了此前"MSE训练导致速度幅值被系统性低估"的解释，指出速度缩放(gain γ(t))改善生成质量的真正机制是缓解"群体时间滞后"(population time lag)，并据此提出用滞后量选择gain的方法。
AI.motivation: 此前工作发现将学习到的flow-matching速度场v_θ乘以增益γ(t)能显著提升生成质量，并将其归因于MSE训练系统性地低估速度幅值、缩放恰好修正该误差。作者质疑这一解释，希望厘清速度缩放为何有效的真正机制。
AI.method: 作者通过实验分析证明MSE训练并不会造成速度幅值欠缺；进而提出"群体时间滞后"这一概念——模型时间t处的采样状态实际上更接近训练数据中更早时刻的状态。作者将速度缩放与"把模型时间往回推"视为解决同一滞后问题的两种等价手段，并在不同架构与模型规模上测量群体时间滞后，用该滞后量来选取增益γ(t)。
AI.result: 群体时间滞后在不同架构与模型规模上普遍存在；用它来选取gain可大幅提升生成质量。在ImageNet-256、NFE=25、无引导设置下，FID由28.0降至12.2（通过相邻gain的FID测量值线性插值估计）。
AI.conclusion: MSE训练不导致速度幅值欠缺；速度缩放有效的机制是减少群体时间滞后，而速度缩放与将模型时间后移等价。基于群体时间滞后选择增益是一种跨架构、跨尺度通用的有效改进手段。

title: Grammar Concept Annotation at Scale: Deployed Fine-Tuned Small Language Models Outperform Prompted Frontier Models
summary: Corrective feedback is among the best-evidenced drivers of second-language acquisition, yet corrections delivered during lessons rarely accumulate into an actionable view of grammar mastery. Prompted frontier models can provide such a view from learner--tutor lesson transcripts, but they are costly at scale. We close this gap by fine-tuning Qwen3.5 small language models (SLMs) on filtered and rebalanced teacher-generated supervision, then deploying an efficient 0.8B model in an end-to-end grammar mastery tracker for all English learners on our platform. Internalizing the annotation contract into adapter weights enables pairing the 0.8B model with a compact matched prompt rather than verbose instructions. On two human-curated benchmarks, both the deployed 0.8B model and a 4B reference comparator outperform prompted GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.6 Sol in precision and recall under nested matching criteria of increasing strictness: concept, evidence span, and correctness. The deployed 0.8B SLM reduces serving cost by approximately 16$\times$. A feature-level online experiment shows significant gains in learner engagement ($+15.8\%$) and key business metrics, including scheduled hours ($+2.1\%$) and GMV from new lessons ($+13.2\%$).

AI.tldr: 该论文通过微调 Qwen3.5 小型语言模型（最终部署 0.8B 模型），构建端到端语法掌握度追踪器，以低成本实现优于前沿大模型的标注性能并提升业务指标。
AI.motivation: 纠正性反馈是二语习得最有力的驱动因素之一，但课堂中产生的纠正很少能累积成可操作的语法掌握度视图。前沿模型虽可从师生对话转录中生成此类视图，但大规模使用成本过高，存在性能与成本之间的差距。
AI.method: 在过滤并重平衡的教师生成监督数据上微调 Qwen3.5 小型语言模型；将标注契约内化到适配器权重中，使 0.8B 模型可搭配紧凑的匹配提示而非冗长指令；随后将该 0.8B 模型部署到面向平台全体英语学习者的端到端语法掌握度追踪器中。
AI.result: 在两个人工标注基准上，部署的 0.8B 模型与 4B 参考对比模型在概念、证据跨度、正确性三种逐级严格的嵌套匹配标准下，精确率和召回率均超过提示式 GPT-5.4 与 GPT-5.6 Sol；0.8B 模型将服务成本降低约 16 倍。在线特征级实验显示学习者参与度提升 15.8%，关键业务指标也显著改善，包括预约课时数 +2.1% 和来自新课程的 GMV +13.2%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将标注契约内化到小型模型适配器中，可在显著降低服务成本的同时取得优于前沿大模型的语法掌握度追踪性能，并带来可观的参与度与业务收益，证明了小模型在特定教育场景替代大模型的可行性。

title: TraceICL: Thread-Resolved Demonstration Curation with Consistency Calibration for Robust Multimodal In-Context Learning
summary: Interleaved multimodal in-context learning (ICL) lets frozen large vision-language models (LVLMs) acquire new tasks from a handful of image-text-answer demonstrations, yet it remains fragile: demonstrations bind to the wrong images, redundant exemplars crowd out informative ones, and noisy answers are copied verbatim into predictions. We present AVA, a training-free framework that organizes the demonstration pipeline of multimodal ICL into three composable stages. A Thread-Resolved Decomposer (TRD) segments the interleaved context into per-sample threads and re-stitches them with explicit boundaries, restoring image-text binding. An Influence-scored Demonstration Selector (IDS) estimates each candidate's marginal influence with one extra forward pass, removes redundancy, and orders the survivors by descending value. A Weak-to-Strong Consistency Calibration (WSC) module scores each demonstration by a weak sibling model's reconstruction confidence and softly reweights its contribution during decoding. On five vision-language benchmarks with interleaved 4-shot prompts, AVA improves the strongest same-setting baseline by +1.7 points on average, with gains of up to +2.4 points on VizWiz, shrinks the require-visual performance gap on ScienceQA-IMG, and retains most of its gain under 30% noisy demonstrations, at a 26% latency overhead that an offline cache amortizes. No gradients are ever computed; the LVLM stays frozen.

AI.tldr: AVA是一个免训练的多模态上下文学习框架，通过分解、筛选与校准三个阶段提升冻结大视觉语言模型的少样本性能。
AI.motivation: 交错式多模态ICL存在三大脆弱性：示范与图像绑定错误、冗余样本挤占有效信息、噪声答案被逐字复制进预测，导致性能不稳定。
AI.method: 将示范流程组织为三个可组合阶段：Thread-Resolved Decomposer（TRD）把交错上下文切分为单样本线程并以显式边界重拼接，恢复图文绑定；Influence-scored Demonstration Selector（IDS）用一次额外前向估计各候选的边际影响，去冗余并按价值降序排列；Weak-to-Strong Consistency Calibration（WSC）用弱同级模型的重建置信度打分并软加权解码贡献。全程无梯度计算，LVLM保持冻结。
AI.result: 在五个视觉语言基准、交错4-shot提示下，AVA比最强同设置基线平均提升+1.7分，VizWiz上最高提升+2.4分，缩小了ScienceQA-IMG的需视觉性能差距，并在30%噪声示范下仍保留大部分增益，延迟开销26%可通过离线缓存摊销。
AI.conclusion: AVA以免训练、可组合的三阶段设计有效缓解了多模态ICL的绑定、冗余与噪声脆弱性，在多个基准上稳定提升性能且开销可控。

title: TerraAgent: Demonstration-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Long-Context Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering
summary: Remote sensing visual question answering (RS-VQA) requires answers that truly depend on image evidence, yet current remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS MLLMs) are still evaluated mainly by accuracy, which cannot reveal whether a correct answer was produced without using the image. This setting introduces three challenges: demonstrations retrieved across different ground sample distances (GSD), sensors, and city textures may be poorly matched; real queries often involve long visual contexts from multi-scale tiles, multi-temporal frames, and retrieved knowledge, where evidence can be diluted and errors can propagate through multi-step reasoning; and prior-only answering remains invisible to standard metrics. We present AVA, a training-free framework that wraps a frozen RS MLLM with three modules. GDR performs GSD-bucketed, scene-graph-based demonstration retrieval and filters demonstrations whose answers are unsupported by their images. MACE decomposes each query into an evidence-typed sub-question DAG, routes sub-questions to suitable perception tools, and records verified provenance in a shared evidence ledger with bounded re-perception. CVA audits the final answer through counterfactual perturbations of cited evidence, including ablation and swap, and computes a visual-dependency score for confidence calibration and evidence-forcing re-query. On RSVQA-LR/HR, VRSBench, and LHRS-Bench, AVA improves average accuracy by up to 2.40 points over the strongest same-setting baselines, raises the visual-dependency score from 0.28 to 0.49, reduces the prior-only answer rate from 46.2 percent to 21.7 percent, and lowers the hallucination rate from 17.1 percent to 9.8 percent, with 2.6x the cost of a single backbone forward pass and no fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 AVA，通过 GDR、MACE、CVA 三个模块提升 RS-VQA 的准确率与视觉依赖性，降低先验答题与幻觉率。
AI.motivation: 现有 RS MLLM 主要用准确率评估，无法揭示正确答案是否真正依赖图像证据；演示检索跨 GSD、传感器、城市纹理易失配，长视觉上下文与多步推理导致证据稀释和错误传播，且仅凭先验作答对标准指标不可见。
AI.method: AVA 以冻结 RS MLLM 为骨干，外挂三个免训练模块：GDR 进行按 GSD 分桶、基于场景图的演示检索，并过滤答案无图像支持的演示；MACE 将查询分解为带证据类型的子问题 DAG，路由至合适感知工具，并在共享证据账本中记录可验证溯源，支持有界再感知；CVA 对引用证据做反事实扰动（消融与替换）审计最终答案，计算视觉依赖分数用于置信度校准和证据强制重查询。
AI.result: 在 RSVQA-LR/HR、VRSBench、LHRS-Bench 上，AVA 相比同设置最强基线平均准确率最高提升 2.40 分；视觉依赖分数由 0.28 升至 0.49；先验答题率由 46.2% 降至 21.7%；幻觉率由 17.1% 降至 9.8%；计算开销为单骨干前向的 2.6 倍，且无需微调。
AI.conclusion: AVA 表明免训练的外挂式证据检索与反事实审计能同时提升 RS-VQA 性能与视觉证据依赖，抑制先验作答和幻觉，为 RS MLLM 提供更可靠的评估与推理范式。

title: Real Long-Term Memory for AI: A 50-Million-Token Window That Is Faster and Cheaper Than Recompute
summary: A large language model can only use the text that fits in its context window, and it recomputes its internal key-value (KV) state for a prompt every time the prompt is sent. We test a memory layer, the public package galahad-kv, that saves the KV state of each block of about 16,000 tokens to encrypted local NVMe disk and loads it back later, byte-exact, without recomputing it. We ran it on 50,000,000 tokens of real public text, served through vLLM on one NVIDIA H100, with Gemma 4 12B and Gemma 4 31B. Every block we probed was loaded back from the encrypted store with no recompute (100 of 100, at depths from 0 to 50M tokens) on both models. Loading a block was 2.8x to 4.3x faster than recomputing it and used 8.8x to 12.3x less GPU energy, and GPU memory stayed flat over the whole 50M-token stream. Asked about facts planted millions of tokens earlier, the 12B model gave the right answer 82 times out of 100 and the 31B model 98 times out of 100. Neither model made up an answer. The limits are as follows. This is reuse of stored state, not a wider attention window: one block is loaded at a time, and how well a question is answered depends on the model. Writing the memory is a one-time cost, and the store takes terabytes of local NVMe disk. We describe the test protocol, which is built to resist common ways of gaming long-context benchmarks, and give a single-GPU reproduction that uses public software and a free licence for the package.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证了galahad-kv记忆层：将约16k token块的KV状态按字节精确存入加密本地NVMe并在后续直接复用，实测50M公开文本上100/100块免重算加载，加载比重算快2.8–4.3倍、能耗低8.8–12.3倍，显存恒定，种植事实问答准确率82%(12B)/98%(31B)。
AI.motivation: 大模型受限于上下文窗口，且每次收到提示都需重新计算全量KV状态，导致长序列推理中重复计算开销大、显存与能耗随流式输入增长。作者希望以存储换算力，用KV状态的持久化与精确复用替代重复前向计算，从而在固定硬件上服务超长token流。
AI.method: 使用公开包galahad-kv作为记忆层，将每约16k token块的KV状态以字节精确方式写入加密本地NVMe，后续按需加载而不重算。在单张NVIDIA H100上通过vLLM部署Gemma系列12B与31B模型，对50M token真实公开文本进行流式测试；比较加载与重算的时延与GPU能耗，监测显存占用，并以数千万token前植入的事实进行问答评测。
AI.result: 所有探测块（100/100，深度覆盖0至50M token）在两个模型上均从加密存储免重算加载成功；加载比重算快2.8–4.3倍，GPU能耗低8.8–12.3倍，显存在整个50M token流中保持恒定。对早期植入事实的问答，12B模型100题答对82题，31B答对98题，两模型均未编造答案。同时给出可单卡复现的公开软件与免费许可方案。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明KV状态的加密持久化与字节精确复用是可行的工程路径，可显著降低长流场景的重算成本与能耗并稳定显存，但本质是存储态复用而非扩展注意力窗口；一次仅加载一个块，效果依赖模型能力，写入为一次性成本，且需数TB本地NVMe空间。作者还提供了抗长上下文基准投机的测试协议与单卡复现方案。

title: Enabling Preference-driven Unlearning in Few-step Distilled Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly distilled into few-step variants and being deployed to enable fast inference. However, their ability to generate harmful or undesired content poses significant safety risks. Data-driven unlearning methods suppress targeted generations by fine-tuning model weights using specialized unlearning objectives. Crucially, these objectives implicitly rely on multi-step denoising dynamics, an assumption that breaks down for few-step distilled (FSD) models, resulting in ineffective forgetting. Furthermore, performing unlearning on the non-distilled base model and subsequently re-distilling it to obtain an unlearned FSD model incurs substantial computational and time overhead, making it impractical in many settings. Hence, we address this limitation with a preference-driven unlearning framework that revisits Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for diffusion models. We show that standard DPO and its unlearning derivatives, formulated around noise-prediction error, transfer poorly to FSD models due to their altered generation dynamics. To overcome this, we introduce a modified preference optimization formulation explicitly aligned with the few-step generation properties, enabling direct concept removal in FSD models while preserving few-step efficiency and maintaining strong retention of desirable (non-targeted) capabilities. We evaluate our framework primarily on identity and NSFW (nudity) removal tasks and also extend our method to object-level unlearning. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent and effective forgetting, and strong retention performance, establishing our method as a practical and principled solution for unlearning in FSD models.

AI.tldr: 针对少步蒸馏(FSD)扩散模型难以有效遗忘目标概念的问题，本文提出一种偏好驱动的遗忘框架，将DPO重构为与少步生成动力学对齐的偏好优化形式，实现FSD模型中的直接概念移除。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型被蒸馏为少步变体以实现快速推理，但其可能生成有害或不良内容，带来安全风险。现有数据驱动的遗忘方法依赖多步去噪动力学假设，该假设在少步蒸馏模型上失效，导致遗忘无效；而先在未蒸馏基座模型上遗忘再重新蒸馏的方案计算与时间开销巨大，不具实用性。
AI.method: 提出偏好驱动的遗忘框架，重新审视面向扩散模型的直接偏好优化(DPO)。指出标准DPO及其遗忘变体基于噪声预测误差，因生成动力学改变而难以迁移到FSD模型；据此引入与少步生成特性显式对齐的改进偏好优化公式，直接在FSD模型中移除概念。
AI.result: 在身份移除与NSFW（裸露）移除任务上进行了主要评估，并扩展至物体级遗忘。大量实验表明，该方法实现了一致且有效的遗忘，同时保持少步推理效率，并良好保留了期望（非目标）能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为FSD模型中的遗忘提供了一个实用且有原则的解决方案，兼顾遗忘有效性、少步效率与非目标能力保留。

title: Disentangling Linguistic and Paralinguistic Information with Routed Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Self-supervised speech encoders contain linguistic and paralinguistic information in a shared, entangled representation space. We combine a TopK sparse autoencoder with route-specific supervision and cross-factor adversaries. Across frozen SPEAR and WavLM encoders, independent probes show factor-specific retention and suppression: linguistic information remains stronger in the linguistic route, while paralinguistic factors, including speaker identity, emotion, and prosody, are retained in the paralinguistic route and substantially reduced in the linguistic route. The route organisation learned on LibriSpeech persists on MSP-Podcast without representation-side retraining. Feature-space route interventions further transfer the swapped factor while largely preserving the information carried by the unchanged route. These results show consistent route-selective separation across encoders, corpora, independent probes, and representation-level interventions.

AI.tldr: 通过TopK稀疏自编码器结合路由特定监督与跨因子对抗器，在冻结的语音编码器中实现语言与副语言信息的路由选择性分离。
AI.motivation: 自监督语音编码器将语言与副语言信息纠缠在共享表示空间中，缺乏对因子可分离性的系统验证。
AI.method: 采用TopK稀疏自编码器，引入路由特定监督与跨因子对抗器，在冻结的SPEAR与WavLM编码器上训练，并通过独立探针与特征空间路由干预进行验证。
AI.result: 独立探针显示因子的定向保留与抑制：语言信息在语言路由中更强，说话人、情感、韵律等副语言因子保留于副语言路由，并在语言路由中显著降低；LibriSpeech上学到的路由结构在MSP-Podcast上无需表示端重训练即可泛化；路由干预可交换目标因子并基本保留未改动路由的信息。
AI.conclusion: 跨编码器、语料、独立探针与表示级干预均表现出一致的路由选择性分离效果。

title: Conversational Voice Aesthetic Model with Reinforcement Learning from Human Listeners
summary: We introduce Conversational Voice Aesthetic Model, a speech large language model for describing the voice aesthetics of real or synthetic speech responses in natural conversational contexts. Given a context and a response speech, CVAM describes salient moments that characterize the voice and predicts nine categorical attributes spanning gender, pitch, pacing, emotion, and delivery. The key challenge lies in perceptual fields such as emotion and delivery, which are inherently subjective and lack definitive ground truth. Therefore, we collect ~10 human annotations for each of 3k real and synthetic responses derived from the CANDOR corpus. CVAM is supervised finetuned on synthesized aesthetic descriptions and labels, then optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization on human judgments. Experiments show that CVAM better agrees with human listeners than Gemini 3.1 Pro and open-source speech LLMs, and outperforms single-human-vs.-rest agreement. Together, we demonstrate the importance of grounding voice aesthetics in human perception and propose a principled framework for human alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出对话语音美学模型（CVAM），一种用于在自然对话语境中描述真实或合成语音响应美学特征的语音大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 语音美学中的感知维度（如情感与表达方式）本质主观、缺乏确定性真值标签，导致模型与人类感知对齐困难。
AI.method: 基于 CANDOR 语料库采集 3k 条真实与合成语音响应、每条约 10 份人工标注；先用合成的美学描述与标签进行监督微调，再用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）基于人类判断进行优化。
AI.result: CVAM 与人类听者的判断一致性优于 Gemini 3.1 Pro 及开源语音大语言模型，并超过“单人对其余标注者”的一致性水平。
AI.conclusion: 证明将语音美学锚定于人类感知的重要性，并提出一套面向人类对齐的原则性框架。

title: Sparse Attention Is Matrix Approximation, Not Choosing from a Bag of Values
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many domains, but their efficiency is limited by the quadratic cost of attention with respect to prompt length. Sparse attention reduces this cost by retaining only a small fraction of query-key interactions to approximate the full attention matrix. However, existing methods are trapped in a mathematically wrong view: they simply keep large scalar entries or high-mass regions of the attention matrix. This treats the attention matrix as a bag of values, ignoring that it is used as a structured matrix whose entries jointly determine the attention output through multiplication with value vectors. We argue that this is the core conceptual issue: sparse attention should be formulated as matrix approximation, not as blindly choosing the largest values from a bag of entries. Based on this view, we propose Matrix Approximation Sparse Attention (MASA). MASA replaces raw attention-mass ranking with a closed-form score that measures how much each sparse unit reduces matrix-product approximation error. As a theory-grounded plug-in correction, MASA can be added to existing sparse attention frameworks without changing their sparse kernels or budgets. Extensive experiments across multiple sparse attention methods, benchmarks, and LLM backbones show consistent accuracy gains, supporting both MASA and the matrix-approximation view of sparse attention.

AI.tldr: 本文指出稀疏注意力现有方法把注意力矩阵当作"数值集合"来选择最大值是错误的，提出应将其形式化为矩阵近似问题，并据此设计 MASA，用闭式分数衡量每个稀疏单元对矩阵乘积近似误差的削减，可即插即用地提升多种稀疏注意力方法的精度。
AI.motivation: LLM 中注意力对提示长度的二次开销限制了效率，稀疏注意力通过保留少量 query-key 交互来近似完整注意力矩阵以降本。但现有方法在概念上存在缺陷：它们仅保留注意力矩阵中数值大的标量或高密度区域，把注意力矩阵视为一堆独立数值，忽略了该矩阵是通过与 value 向量相乘、以结构化方式共同决定注意力输出的。作者认为"应把稀疏注意力表述为矩阵近似，而非从数值袋中挑最大项"是核心概念问题。
AI.method: 提出矩阵近似稀疏注意力（MASA）。MASA 用闭式评分（closed-form score）替代原始的注意力质量排序，该评分衡量每个稀疏单元对矩阵乘积近似误差的削减程度。作为理论支撑的即插式修正，MASA 可直接加入现有稀疏注意力框架，无需改动其稀疏核或预算。
AI.result: 在多种稀疏注意力方法、多个基准和多种 LLM 骨干上进行了大量实验，均取得一致的准确率提升，验证了 MASA 的有效性以及"稀疏注意力应视为矩阵近似"这一观点。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏注意力应从"挑选大数值条目"的数学上错误的视角转为矩阵近似视角；MASA 作为理论驱动的即插式修正，在不改变稀疏核与预算的前提下，跨方法、跨基准、跨骨干稳定提升精度，支持该矩阵近似框架。

title: Stochastic Teacher Intervention for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) efficiently transfers capabilities from a stronger teacher to a student language model through dense token-level supervision on student-generated rollouts and has shown promise on complex tasks such as mathematical reasoning. However, in multi-turn agentic tasks, student decisions shape subsequent observations, causing early errors to accumulate across turns. The resulting trajectories can drift away from the teacher's rollout distribution, making the teacher's token-level supervision less reliable or even counterproductive for OPD training. To address this issue, we introduce STI-OPD, a stochastic teacher intervention framework for multi-turn agentic OPD. During multi-turn interaction, STI-OPD uses teacher intervention guided by teacher-student policy discrepancy to replace the student's proposed action with a teacher-generated one to maximize the acquisition of reliable supervision. We further develop a stochastic intervention strategy, addressing the limitations of previous threshold-based or fixed-schedule approaches, that estimates policy discrepancy using KL divergence and maps it to an intervention probability. By sampling whether to intervene from this probability, STI-OPD adaptively balances teacher control with student exploration. To learn from the resulting mixed-policy trajectories, we introduce an Importance-Weighted Reverse KL objective that corrects the token sampling mismatch between teacher-generated responses and the student policy to preserve the original OPD objective. Across tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon interaction, STI-OPD outperforms the strongest prior OPD baseline on every evaluated benchmark and student size. Ablations further show that both discrepancy-guided intervention and importance weighting contribute to these gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 STI-OPD，一种面向多轮智能体在线策略蒸馏的随机教师干预框架，通过教师-学生策略差异引导的随机干预与重要性加权反向 KL 目标，缓解多轮任务中误差累积导致的监督不可靠问题。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过学生生成轨迹上的密集 token 级监督，将强教师模型能力迁移至学生模型，在数学推理等复杂任务上表现良好。但在多轮智能体任务中，学生的决策会改变后续观测，早期错误会跨轮次累积，导致轨迹偏离教师的 rollout 分布，使教师的 token 级监督变得不可靠甚至有害。
AI.method: 提出 STI-OPD 随机教师干预框架：在多轮交互中，依据教师-学生策略差异进行教师干预，用教师生成的动作替换学生提议的动作，以最大化获取可靠监督。具体采用随机干预策略，用 KL 散度估计策略差异并映射为干预概率，通过按概率采样决定是否干预，自适应平衡教师控制与学生探索。针对混合策略轨迹，引入重要性加权反向 KL 目标，修正教师生成回复与学生策略之间的 token 采样失配，以保持原始 OPD 目标。
AI.result: 在工具集成推理与长时程交互任务上，STI-OPD 在所有评测基准和所有学生规模上均优于最强的先前 OPD 基线。消融实验进一步表明，差异引导干预与重要性加权均对性能提升有贡献。
AI.conclusion: STI-OPD 通过差异驱动的随机教师干预与重要性加权反向 KL 目标，有效缓解多轮智能体在线策略蒸馏中的轨迹漂移与监督失配问题，显著优于既有 OPD 方法。

title: SPLIT-RL: Staged Perception-Language Reasoning Training with Claim-Level Advantages
summary: Vision-Language (VL) reasoning requires a model to both extract relevant and accurate information from an image (visual reasoning, VR), and to infer the answer from it (language reasoning, LR). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards typically trains both through a single chain-of-thought with a final-answer reward. This gives every CoT token the same sequence-level advantage, failing to distinguish capability specific errors. We propose SPLIT-RL, a staged post-training approach that trains VR and LR in disjoint phases. Because a group's rollouts differ along one capability at a time, the group-relative advantage isolates it, and each phase is optimized using phase-specific reward. We further introduce Claim-Level Advantage (CLA-GRPO), which decomposes VR-phase rollouts into atomic visual claims and provides a fine-grained advantage at claim level based on visual-type group formation. Although trained in two phases, trained policy is evaluated like GRPO model, with a single CoT call at inference time. Under this protocol, SPLIT-RL improves average accuracy over GRPO by 1.4-6.1 points across Qwen3-VL models from 2B to 30B-A3B and InternVL3.5-8B. Evaluating each capability using an oracle based diagnostic shows that answer-only GRPO leaves perception unchanged, whereas SPLIT-RL improves both VR and LR.

AI.tldr: SPLIT-RL 通过分阶段训练将视觉推理（VR）与语言推理（LR）解耦，并引入 Claim-Level Advantage（CLA-GRPO）在声明级提供细粒度优势，在多个 VL 模型上平均准确率较 GRPO 提升 1.4-6.1 个点。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习通常用单一思维链加最终答案奖励来联合训练视觉推理与语言推理。这导致所有 CoT token 共享同一序列级优势，无法区分不同能力所导致的错误，尤其难以定位感知类与推理类失误。
AI.method: 提出 SPLIT-RL 分阶段后训练方法，在互不重叠的阶段分别训练视觉推理（VR）与语言推理（LR），使组内 rollout 仅沿单一能力变化，从而用组相对优势隔离该能力，并配以阶段专属奖励。进一步提出 CLA-GRPO，将 VR 阶段 rollout 分解为原子视觉声明，基于视觉类型分组在声明级给出细粒度优势。推理时仍采用单次 CoT 调用，与 GRPO 模型评测方式一致。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL 2B 至 30B-A3B 及 InternVL3.5-8B 上，SPLIT-RL 平均准确率较 GRPO 提升 1.4-6.1 个点。基于 oracle 的诊断评估显示，仅答案奖励的 GRPO 对感知能力没有改善，而 SPLIT-RL 同时提升了 VR 与 LR。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉推理与语言推理解耦分阶段训练，并配合声明级细粒度优势，可有效区分并分别优化不同能力，在推理开销不变的前提下实现 VL 推理的稳定提升，同时揭示了单阶段答案奖励方法在感知层面的局限。

title: Less from More: Reinforcing Sparse Video Reasoning from Dense References
summary: Video-language models commonly assume that more temporal observations lead to more reliable reasoning. We question this assumption and argue that the key challenge is not merely processing more video frames efficiently, but learning to reason reliably under limited temporal evidence. We propose SAVER, a dense-to-sparse post-training framework that uses dense video views as training-time references for sparse-frame inference. During reinforcement post-training, paired dense and sparse views are optimized with grounding rewards and a reliability-gated reference reward, encouraging sparse view predictions to preserve task-relevant temporal evidence. Notably, SAVER is trained only on 1,250 randomly sampled temporal grounding examples, without using any video question answering annotations. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks and six video question-answering benchmarks, SAVER consistently improves performance across frame budgets. In particular, SAVER can match or surpass dense-frame Qwen3.5 baselines while using substantially fewer frames. These results show that temporal grounding can serve as an effective evidence-localization proxy for learning sparse video reasoning that transfers to broader video understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAVER，一种稠密到稀疏的后训练框架，以稠密视频视图作为训练参考，使模型在稀疏帧推理时仍能保留任务相关时序证据，从而在少帧条件下提升视频理解性能。
AI.motivation: 视频-语言模型通常假定时序观测越多，推理越可靠。本文质疑该假设，认为关键挑战不是高效处理更多帧，而是在有限时序证据下实现可靠推理。
AI.method: 提出 SAVER 稠密到稀疏的后训练框架：训练时使用成对的稠密与稀疏视频视图，通过强化后训练优化，结合定位奖励（grounding rewards）与可靠性门控参考奖励（reliability-gated reference reward），促使稀疏视图预测保留任务相关的时序证据。训练仅使用 1,250 个随机采样的时序定位样本，不使用任何视频问答标注。
AI.result: 在三个时序定位基准和六个视频问答基准上，SAVER 在不同帧预算下均持续提升性能；尤其在显著减少帧数的情况下，可匹配甚至超越稠密帧的 Qwen3.5 基线。
AI.conclusion: 时序定位可作为有效的证据定位代理，用于学习可迁移到更广泛视频理解任务的稀疏视频推理能力。

title: When Listening Becomes Easier: Scrubbing Visual Cues for Shortcut-Free VLAs
summary: Shortcut learning is a prevalent issue in robot learning. The limited diversity of robot demonstration datasets can mislead policies into exploiting spurious correlations between tasks and irrelevant features, such as viewpoint or background. Collecting sufficiently diverse robot demonstrations is costly and inefficient, motivating algorithmic alternatives. We focus on vision-language-action (VLA) models and discover that different vision-language model backbones exhibit substantially different levels of susceptibility to visual shortcut learning. We find that model behavior correlates with our proposed representation-level metric, action margin, which requires no policy rollouts. Visual shortcuts consistently enter action representations in early layers, with models differing in the extent to which later layers correct them by incorporating language information. To boost models' attention to language, we introduce task scrubbing, a new domain-adversarial training method that decreases models' likelihood of using visual shortcuts and improves VLAs' generalization. Experiments in both simulation and the real world across multiple VLAs and visual cues show that task scrubbing improves out-of-distribution robustness and often eliminates visual shortcut learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的视觉捷径学习问题，提出无需策略 rollout 的表征层指标 action margin，揭示捷径在早期层进入动作表征、后期层靠语言信息纠正的机制，并提出对抗训练方法 task scrubbing 以提升分布外鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示数据多样性有限，策略易利用任务与无关视觉特征（如视角、背景）之间的伪相关，即视觉捷径学习。而收集足够多样的演示代价高、效率低，因此需要算法层面的替代方案。
AI.method: 聚焦 VLA 模型；提出表征层度量 action margin（无需策略 rollout）；分析不同 VLM 骨干对视觉捷径的敏感性差异及捷径进入与纠正的层级机制；提出 task scrubbing——一种域对抗训练方法，降低模型使用视觉捷径的倾向，增强其对语言信息的关注。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验中，跨多种 VLA 模型和视觉线索，task scrubbing 均提升了分布外（OOD）鲁棒性，且常常消除视觉捷径学习；action margin 与模型行为相关。
AI.conclusion: 视觉捷径出现在早期层，后期层的语言纠错程度决定模型敏感性；action margin 可作为预测性指标；task scrubbing 是缓解 VLA 视觉捷径、提升泛化的有效方法。

title: Large Language Models for Machine Translation Quality Annotation: Humans and Models Are Both Challenged
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are considered to be a more efficient and cost-effective alternative to human judgment for Machine Translation (MT) evaluation. With MT evaluation spanning a large number of language pairs, domains and levels of annotation granularity, LLMs must be thoroughly evaluated across these dimensions before being reliably used as alternatives to human evaluation. In this paper, we evaluate the performance of LLMs for two prominent MT quality evaluation schemes: Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) and Error Span Annotation (ESA) by comparing their agreement with human annotators. We present results on a long-context test set of 70 language pairs and the publicly available WMT23 and WMT25 data, investigating both score and error span annotation agreement across a variety of language pairs and domains. Our results show that while LLM agreement with human annotators exceeds agreement between human annotators for some evaluation tasks, both vary substantially across annotation schemes, language pairs and domains and remain unreliable for most settings. Furthermore, we identify challenges facing both human and LLM annotators: humans are particularly challenged by fine-grained MQM annotations and low-resource language pairs, while LLMs struggle with minor errors, wrong language variants and error span annotation. Our results highlight the potential for improvement for both human and LLM annotation performance, possibly through human-LLM collaborative annotation pipelines that address the reliability issues identified in this work.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了大语言模型在机器翻译质量评估中的可靠性，覆盖MQM与ESA两种标注方案、70个语言对及WMT23/WMT25数据。结果显示LLM与人工标注者的一致性在某些任务上超过人工标注者之间的一致性，但在多数设置下随方案、语言对和领域显著波动且仍不可靠，并揭示了人工与LLM各自的标注难点。
AI.motivation: LLM被视为机器翻译评估中比人工判断更高效、更经济的替代方案，但MT评估涉及大量语言对、领域与标注粒度，LLM必须在这些维度上被充分验证后才能可靠替代人工评估。现有工作缺乏跨方案（MQM、ESA）、跨语言对与跨领域的系统性一致性比较。
AI.method: 以人工标注者的一致性为基准，比较LLM与人工标注者在两种主流MT质量评估方案（Multidimensional Quality Metrics, MQM 与 Error Span Annotation, ESA）下的一致性。实验数据包括一个包含70个语言对的长上下文测试集，以及公开的WMT23和WMT25数据；评估维度涵盖多种语言对与领域，并同时考察分数（score）一致性与错误片段（error span）标注一致性。
AI.result: LLM与人工标注者的一致性在某些评估任务上超过人工标注者之间的一致性；但一致性在标注方案、语言对和领域之间存在显著差异，在大多数设置下仍不可靠。人工标注者的主要困难在于细粒度MQM标注和低资源语言对；LLM则在细微错误、错误语言变体（wrong language variants）以及错误片段标注上表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: LLM目前尚不足以在多数场景下可靠替代人工进行MT质量评估。研究指出人工与LLM标注性能均有提升空间，并提出通过人机协同标注流程（human-LLM collaborative annotation pipelines）来缓解本文所识别出的可靠性问题。

title: Language Models for Page-Level Layout Decisions in E-commerce Search
comment: Accepted at the OARS Workshop, ACM RecSys 2026
summary: E-commerce search pages are critical touchpoints for millions of online shoppers. While traditional search engines return a ranked list of results, modern E-commerce search pages increasingly incorporate recommender system modules -- for example, secondary stacks that surface alternative product groupings at specific positions. When introduced appropriately, secondary stacks can improve user engagement; however, suboptimal placement may disrupt browsing flow and degrade the primary results.
