Unlike traditional search ranking, where evaluation techniques such as interleaving are well established, evaluating page-level layout changes e.g., when and where to insert a secondary stack remains challenging without costly online A/B testing. To address this, we study offline methods for evaluating whether a given layout decision -- specifically, the inclusion of a secondary stack at a particular position -- is beneficial to users. We investigate language models as scalable evaluators by comparing direct prompt-based, prompt-derived feature, and representation-based methods. Our results show that representation-based approaches consistently outperform prompt-based judging in predicting user engagement, suggesting they provide a reliable foundation for offline layout evaluation in E-commerce search.

AI.tldr: 研究离线评估电商搜索页面中二级推荐模块插入位置是否有利，比较三类基于语言模型的评估方法，发现表示类方法预测用户参与度效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 电商搜索页面除传统排序列表外还嵌入推荐模块（如在特定位置插入二级商品堆栈）。布局合理可提升参与度，不当放置则会打断浏览流程、损害主结果。传统排序评估（如interleaving）已成熟，但页面级布局决策（何时何地插入二级堆栈）缺乏低成本离线评估手段，只能依赖昂贵的在线A/B测试。
AI.method: 研究离线评估布局决策（即在特定位置加入二级堆栈）是否有益。以语言模型作为可扩展评估器，比较三类方法：直接基于提示（prompt-based）评判、基于提示衍生的特征（prompt-derived feature），以及基于表示（representation-based）的方法。
AI.result: 在预测用户参与度方面，基于表示的方法始终优于基于提示的评判方法。
AI.conclusion: 表示类方法为电商搜索的离线页面布局评估提供了可靠基础，可替代或减少对高价在线A/B测试的依赖。

title: StoreBench: A Live-Commerce Environment for Evaluating and Training Autonomous Operator Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning environments are now a primary lever for improving large language model (LLM) capabilities in post-training, yet most agentic benchmarks remain static: the world moves only when the agent acts, the reward is a terminal verdict, and the pass bar is set arbitrarily. We introduce StoreBench, a live-commerce environment in which an agent runs a mid-size online apparel store on a production-grade commerce backend, testing long-horizon planning and economic judgment under uncertainty. Customers order around the clock, suppliers reprice and fail, and market shocks arrive with partial or no warning. The agent acts through the same 29 merchant tools a human operator would use, under a windowed operation budget that makes simulated time a function of actions taken, so model latency cannot influence simulated time. Pass thresholds are calibrated against scripted anchor policies, the reward is hardened against a catalogue of reward hacks, and every episode replays identically given a sequence of actions. We evaluate seven frontier LLMs on 11 scenarios of 30 to 45 days and a full simulated year, over three world seeds at matched reasoning effort. No model matches the scripted smart-triage policy on average: the best, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, passes 49% of task-seed cells against the heuristic's 97%. Human experts working through the same tools and budgets outscore every model (mean composite 0.708 vs. 0.700). Over a full simulated year under the Claude Code harness, most models show dramatic performance improvement. In a GRPO post-training run, Qwen3.5-27B trained on only five disjoint tasks raises its mean composite on the held-out evaluation tasks from 0.136 to 0.373. We release five example training-split tasks, ten sample trajectories, and the scoring and verification tooling; the full environment and evaluation suite are withheld to keep the benchmark uncontaminated.

AI.tldr: 提出 StoreBench：一个基于生产级电商后端的实时电商智能体强化学习环境，用于测试大语言模型在不确定性下的长程规划与经济决策能力，并对七个前沿模型进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数智能体基准是静态的：环境仅在智能体行动时变化、奖励为终局判定、通过标准主观设定，无法反映真实长程规划与不确定性决策需求，因此需要更贴近真实世界的动态环境。
AI.method: 构建 StoreBench：智能体以 29 个商户工具运营中型线上服装店；顾客全天候下单、供应商调价与断供、市场冲击部分或完全无预警；采用窗口化操作预算使模拟时间仅由动作决定；通过与脚本化锚定策略校准合格阈值、加固奖励抵御奖励黑客、保证同一动作序列可复现回放。评估 7 个前沿 LLM，覆盖 11 个场景（30–45 天及完整模拟年）、3 个世界种子与匹配的推理强度。
AI.result: 无模型平均超过脚本化 smart-triage 策略：最佳模型 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 通过 49% 的任务-种子单元，启发式策略为 97%；人类专家（均值综合分 0.708）超过所有模型（0.700）。在 Claude Code 框架下完整模拟一年，多数模型性能显著提升；GRPO 后训练中，仅用 5 个不相交任务训练的 Qwen3.5-27B 将留出评估任务均值综合分从 0.136 提升至 0.373。
AI.conclusion: StoreBench 提供了一个可复现、抗奖励黑客、阈值经校准的动态电商智能体基准，揭示前沿 LLM 与启发式/人类专家仍存显著差距，同时证明其作为 RL 后训练环境的有效性；已开源样例任务、轨迹与评分验证工具，完整环境与评测套件暂不公开以避免污染。

title: GHARP: Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 35 pages (14 main + references + 15 pages supplementary), 14 figures, 17 tables
summary: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. We decouple the problem into an identity stage that builds a representation of the subject's geometry and appearance offline, and an animation stage that predicts expression-dependent residuals on top of it at runtime. This separation offers a favorable trade-off with respect to fidelity, quality and runtime: the identity stage can be expensive while the animation stage runs a lightweight network, optimized for mobile devices. Our method performs animation in a semantically structured latent space of a pretrained reconstruction model, where expression changes remain spatially contained, making residual prediction efficient. This reconstruction prior provides a consistent spatial layout, allowing fusion of multiple input views into a compact, fixed-size canonical Gaussian representation. While this two-stage design improves the runtime-quality trade-off, it still inherits a problem common to all expression-driven avatar methods: expression codes describe only the face and thus omit body pose and clothing position, making these regions underspecified in the input. The animation network faces an ill-posed mapping and resorts to averaging over conflicting body appearances, producing blur and temporal flicker. We address this with a body alignment network that learns to align the person's body in the target image with the input reference images, removing the ambiguity from the training signal. Our method achieves state-of-the-art quality on the Ava-256 benchmark while running up to 13x faster on an A100 GPU with 8x fewer Gaussians.

AI.tldr: 提出GHARP方法，通过将3D人头动画解耦为离线身份建模与实时动画两阶段，并结合身体对齐网络解决身体姿态与衣物位置欠约束问题，在Ava-256数据集上实现SOTA质量，同时在A100 GPU上最高快13倍、高斯数量减少8倍。
AI.motivation: 表情驱动的3D人头头像方法存在一个共性问题：表情编码仅描述面部，忽略身体姿态与衣物位置，导致这些区域在输入中欠约束。动画网络面对病态映射，只能对冲突的身体外观取平均，从而产生模糊与时间闪烁。此外，现有方法在保真度、质量与运行效率之间难以取得良好平衡，尤其难以在移动设备上实时运行。
AI.method: 1. 将问题解耦为两部分：离线身份阶段构建主体的几何与外观表示；运行时动画阶段在轻量网络中预测依赖于表情的残差。2. 在预训练重建模型的语义结构化隐空间中进行动画，使表情变化在空间上保持局部化，提升残差预测效率。3. 利用重建先验提供一致的空间布局，将多视角输入融合为紧凑的固定大小规范化高斯表示。4. 引入身体对齐网络，学习将目标图像中的人物身体与输入参考图像对齐，从训练信号中消除身体姿态和衣物位置的歧义。
AI.result: 在Ava-256基准上达到最先进的质量；在A100 GPU上运行速度最高提升13倍，同时所需高斯数量减少8倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过身份-动画两阶段解耦、结构化隐空间残差预测与身体对齐网络的结合，GHARP在保证高保真与高质量的同时显著提升运行效率，为实现移动端实时3D人头动画提供了有效方案。

title: AI4Fire: Evaluating Large Language Models on Wildfire Tasks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are entering wildfire management, where overstated evaluations can cost property and lives. How do they perform on wildfire tasks, with and without grounding? Bare means a model receives the task input alone. Grounded means it also receives one task-specific addition: for smoke detection, a smoke-free reference frame from the same camera. AI4Fire runs six core models bare and grounded on five wildfire tasks, zero-shot; a sweep adds 29 more. Our literature search on fire tasks found 138 works; none combines this roster, task coverage, and paired bare and grounded runs. We report three findings. (1) Grounding helped most where the addition carried the answer: a read-only SQL tool lifted every core model's database accuracy from at most 16 to at least 88 percent. (2) Simple rules were hard to beat: no core model outperformed repeating today's staffing count, and two open-weight models mostly copied the median of similar earlier fire-days, a worse forecast. (3) Public releases carry hazards: a fire-danger column separates the holdout perfectly, and 67 aerial fire frames carry smoldering or fire-free labels read from a clipped thermal maximum. We release prompts, responses, scores, code, and the survey record.

AI.tldr: AI4Fire 对6个核心大模型在5类野火任务上进行零样本测评，包括"裸跑"与"接地"配对共约35个模型；接地仅在补充信息直接含答案时显著提升表现，简单规则仍难超越，公开数据中还发现两处标注隐患。
AI.motivation: 野火管理事关财产与生命安全，夸大或失真的模型评估会带来实际代价，因此需要更严谨、可对照的基准来检验大语言模型在野火任务上的真实能力，并澄清"接地/外部信息注入"是否真正带来增益。
AI.method: 构建 AI4Fire 基准：在烟雾检测、数据库查询等5类野火任务上，对6个核心模型做零样本测评，采用"裸跑"（仅任务输入）与"接地"（额外提供一项任务特定补充，如同一相机的无烟参考帧、只读SQL工具）配对运行，另加29个模型的扩展扫描；并开展覆盖138篇文献的综述，未见同类组合。
AI.result: (1) 接地在补充信息直接承载答案时收益最大：只读SQL工具使所有核心模型的数据库准确率从最高16%提升到至少88%。(2) 简单规则难以击败：没有核心模型超过"重复今日执勤人数"这一基线，两个开放权重模型大多只是复制相似历史火日的值班中位数，预测更差。(3) 公开发布数据存在隐患：某"火险"列能完美区分留出集，67张航空火场图像因读取裁剪后的热红外最大值而被错标为阴燃或无火标签。
AI.conclusion: 现有大语言模型在野火任务上尚不具备可靠能力，接地增益高度依赖补充信息是否直接给出答案；简单启发式与公开数据缺陷构成双重风险。作者公开提示词、回答、评分、代码与综述记录，以支持可复现与更审慎的评估。

title: GPU-Accelerated Computation of Persistent Homology for Topological Analysis of Image Data
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). Includes supplementary material (8 pages) after the main paper. Code: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data
summary: In recent years, persistent homology has seen rapid adoption in deep learning, yet its computation remains a major bottleneck in network training. This paper introduces TopoGPU, a GPU streaming pipeline that computes persistence diagrams of cubical complexes induced by 2D and 3D images. TopoGPU streams the input image chunk by chunk, processing each chunk with massively parallel GPU kernels on a grid of GPU blocks; the resulting boundary relations are accumulated in host memory, where the CPU performs the boundary matrix reduction. TopoGPU introduces a stratification-aware discrete Morse matching that provably preserves persistent homology under streaming, together with a parallel topological sorting algorithm and a parallel V-path parity algorithm for deriving Morse boundaries on the GPU. TopoGPU outperforms Cubical Ripser, a state-of-the-art method for persistent homology computation, on every benchmark evaluated, achieving an average end-to-end speedup of 53.24x and a maximum of 198.01x. We further integrate TopoGPU into a topology-preserving deep network, demonstrating that it substantially reduces the cost of persistent homology computation during network training. TopoGPU is open source, with pre-built binaries, Google Colab notebooks, and Docker images available at the project's GitHub page: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data.

AI.tldr: TopoGPU：一种GPU流式管线，分块并行处理2D/3D图像的立方复形，在CPU完成边界矩阵约简，实现持续同调的高效计算，平均加速53.24x、最高198.01x。
AI.motivation: 持续同调在深度学习中应用日益广泛，但其计算是网络训练的主要瓶颈；现有方法（如Cubical Ripser）在图像数据上计算代价高，亟需高效加速方案。
AI.method: 提出TopoGPU GPU流式管线：按块流式读取图像，用大规模并行GPU核在GPU块网格上处理每块，边界关系累积于主机内存并由CPU执行边界矩阵约简；引入分层感知的离散Morse匹配，可证明在流式处理下保持持续同调，并设计并行拓扑排序算法与并行V路径奇偶算法以在GPU上导出Morse边界。
AI.result: 在所有评测基准上均优于SOTA方法Cubical Ripser，端到端平均加速53.24x，最高198.01x；集成到拓扑保持深度网络后，显著降低训练中持续同调计算开销。
AI.conclusion: TopoGPU有效缓解了图像数据持续同调计算瓶颈，兼顾理论正确性与显著加速，并已开源（含预编译二进制、Colab笔记本与Docker镜像）。

title: LVSPM: Long Sequence View Synthesis and Pose Estimation Model
summary: We present LVSPM, a generalizable model that jointly estimates camera poses and synthesizes novel views from uncalibrated image collections. Trained with only RGB images and pose supervision, LVSPM avoids dense 3D ground truth and employs test-time training (TTT) layers to scale seamlessly to hundreds of input views. On RealEstate10k, Co3Dv2, and DL3DV, LVSPM surpasses VGGT in pose estimation across 16-256 views, with especially large margins at strict thresholds. For novel view synthesis under a practical protocol where more views cover larger scenes, LVSPM achieves state-of-the-art pose-free quality---surpassing even pose-dependent models in PSNR---and still maintains high quality as scene scale grows, while baselines collapse. The code is available at https://burningdust21.github.io/Projects/LVSPM .

AI.tldr: LVSPM：面向未标定图像集合的联合位姿估计与新视角合成模型，仅用RGB与位姿监督，可扩展至数百视图。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3D基础模型的方法通常依赖稠密3D真值，且在大规模输入视图下难以扩展；未标定、稀疏视角、大场景条件下的位姿估计与新视角合成质量易退化。
AI.method: 提出LVSPM，联合估计相机位姿并合成新视角；仅使用RGB图像和位姿监督训练，避免稠密3D真值；引入测试时训练（TTT）层，实现向数百输入视图的无缝扩展。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10k、Co3Dv2、DL3DV上，LVSPM在16-256视图范围内位姿估计优于VGGT，严格阈值下优势尤为显著；在更贴近实际的协议下（更多视图覆盖更大场景），取得无位姿新视角合成的最优质量，PSNR超过依赖位姿的模型；随场景尺度增大仍保持高质量，而基线方法出现崩溃。
AI.conclusion: LVSPM证明仅用RGB与位姿监督即可实现可泛化的联合位姿估计与新视角合成，并在多视图和大场景扩展性上优于强基线；代码已开源。

title: When Citations Mislead? A Claim-Level Benchmark for Legal Hallucination Detection
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Published in the 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026), Singapore. Dataset: https://github.com/mmikaildemir/PARCEL
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in legal research and drafting, but they can still produce claims that sound convincing without being supported by the cited source. We introduce PARCEL, a benchmark for checking whether a legal claim is supported by the underlying authority. Using recent New York State Court of Appeals decisions, we build a dataset of 3,396 parenthetical-style claims labeled as Supported, Refuted, or Not Found. We cast this task as a three-way natural language inference problem and evaluate several state-of-the-art LLMs in a zero-shot setting. Although the strongest models reach up to 0.97 accuracy, the results also show an important weakness: models still incorrectly mark unsupported claims as supported, even when the full opinion text is provided. Across models, missing support is harder to detect than direct contradiction, and fabricated but plausible citations cause the largest drop in performance. Overall, PARCEL provides a practical benchmark for testing claim-level groundedness in legal RAG systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PARCEL基准，用于检验法律主张是否被所引权威来源支持，基于纽约州上诉法院判决构建3396条三种标签的数据集，并评估多种大模型。
AI.motivation: 大模型在法律研究与起草中日益普及，但常生成听起来可信却缺乏引文支持的主张，亟需检验主张级"接地性"的评估工具。
AI.method: 以纽约州上诉法院近期判决为基础，构建包含3396条括号式引注主张的数据集，标注为Supported、Refuted、Not Found三类；将任务建模为三分类自然语言推理，在零样本设定下评估多个先进大模型。
AI.result: 最强模型准确率可达0.97；但即使提供完整判决文本，模型仍会把无支持的主张误判为有支持。相较直接矛盾，"缺失支持"更难识别，而虚构但貌似合理的引注导致性能下降最大。
AI.conclusion: PARCEL为法律RAG系统中的主张级接地性检验提供了实用基准。

title: Fluid-Gen-Zero: Grounding Pretrained Video Generators in Physics without Training
summary: We present Fluid-Gen-Zero, a training-free framework for physics-aware fluid-object interaction video generation that decouples physical reasoning from appearance synthesis. Our key insight is to delegate motion dynamics to a physics simulator while preserving the appearance modeling capacity of pretrained video generators. We bridge these two domains through a two-level agentic workflow: generation-time planning, where a vision-language model (VLM) agent interprets intent and the simulation rollout to organize generation clips, and latent-space guidance, which injects simulation signals into denoising through region-aware latent wrapping. This plug-and-play design is compatible with current video foundation models. We further introduce a benchmark for fluid-object interaction video generation. Across Tora (CogVideoX-based), VACE and WanMove (Wan-based), Fluid-Gen-Zero consistently improves simulation alignment, reducing object trajectory error by 26.7%-81.5% and fluid fEPE (fluid flow endpoint error) by 67.9%-84.0%, while largely preserving perceptual quality. In a human preference study, raters favor Fluid-Gen-Zero in 55.1%-74.4% of same-backbone comparisons across three backbones, and in 90.4%-94.2% of comparisons against simulation-based methods. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: Fluid-Gen-Zero是一个免训练的物理感知流体-物体交互视频生成框架，将物理推理与外观合成解耦：由物理仿真器负责运动动力学，预训练视频生成器保留外观建模能力，通过两层智能体工作流实现桥接，并在多骨干模型上一致提升仿真对齐度。
AI.motivation: 流体-物体交互视频生成需要同时具备准确的物理动力学建模与高质量的外观合成能力。现有预训练视频生成模型外观表现强但物理推理弱，而基于仿真的方法物理准确却外观受限。作者希望在不重新训练的前提下，兼顾两者优势。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架Fluid-Gen-Zero，将物理推理与外观合成解耦：运动动力学交由物理仿真器，外观建模由预训练视频生成器承担。通过两层智能体工作流桥接两域——（1）生成时规划：由VLM智能体解析用户意图与仿真推演，组织生成片段；（2）潜空间引导：通过区域感知的潜空间包装（region-aware latent wrapping），在去噪过程中注入仿真信号。该设计为即插即用，兼容现有视频基础模型。
AI.result: 在Tora（基于CogVideoX）、VACE与WanMove（基于Wan）上，Fluid-Gen-Zero一致提升仿真对齐度：物体轨迹误差降低26.7%-81.5%，流体fEPE降低67.9%-84.0%，同时大体保持感知质量。人类偏好研究中，在同骨干对比下55.1%-74.4%的评估者更偏好该方法，在与基于仿真方法的对比中偏好比例为90.4%-94.2%。
AI.conclusion: Fluid-Gen-Zero验证了将物理仿真与预训练视频生成器解耦并通过智能体工作流桥接的有效性，可在免训练、即插即用条件下显著提升流体-物体交互视频的物理对齐度，并保持感知质量。作者还提出了相应的评测基准，代码与数据将在录用后开源。

title: Back in Style: A Sociolinguistic Approach to Authoring and Measuring Persona Fidelity in User Simulation
comment: Accepted to the UserSim @ NeurIPS 2026 workshop (non-archival)
summary: As agentic systems gain commercial popularity, user simulators increasingly serve as measurement instrument for their evaluation. However, the fidelity of simulated users in comparison to real human users is generally low, and typically assessed by costly, subjective LLM judges. In this pilot study, we ask whether fidelity can instead be measured deterministically by treating a user persona sociolinguistically: as a social type that emerges from observable linguistic style, rather than one predicted by labels or descriptions a model must extrapolate into behaviour. We author personas as concrete stylistic rates, which lets us transfer two established, model-free instruments -- authorship-verification stylometry and lexicon-based content analysis -- as fidelity diagnostics. We A/B-test the sociolinguistic schema against a flat descriptive baseline across five task-oriented customer-service agents. Results show that the sociolinguistic schema improves both stylistic adherence and stylometric distinguishability for most of the tested models, with a caveat that persona style fidelity does not necessarily equal persona "naturalness". We argue that a sociolinguistic approach to persona design is a promising path towards more diverse and representative user personas, and that these metrics are most valuable in an error-attribution analysis, localizing where fidelity breaks down. This is a first step towards interventions that move user simulations closer to faithful renderings of diverse and variable linguistic outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将用户画像从“标签/描述”重构为可观测的语言风格社会类型（社会学语言学视角），以具体的风格比率来撰写角色，从而把作者身份验证文体计量学与基于词典的内容分析这两种无需模型、可确定性计算的工具迁移为用户模拟保真度诊断指标。在五个任务导向客服智能体的A/B实验中，该方案在多数模型上同时提升了风格遵循度与文体计量可区分性，但风格保真并不等同于“自然度”。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体系统的商业化，用户模拟器成为其评估的测量工具，但模拟用户相对真实用户的保真度普遍偏低，且通常依赖成本高、主观性强的LLM评委来评估。作者希望找到一种确定性、无模型依赖的保真度测量路径，并提升用户画像的多样性与代表性。
AI.method: 以社会学语言学方式定义用户画像：将其视为由可观测语言风格涌现出的社会类型，而非需要模型从标签或描述外推行为的对象；把画像作者化为具体的风格比率（stylistic rates）。据此将两种既有的、无需模型的工具——作者身份验证文体计量学（authorship-verification stylometry）与基于词典的内容分析（lexicon-based content analysis）——迁移为保真度诊断指标。在五个任务导向的客服智能体上，将该社会学语言学方案与扁平化描述性基线进行A/B测试。
AI.result: 结果表明，对大多数被测模型而言，社会学语言学画像方案在风格遵循度（stylistic adherence）与文体计量可区分性（stylometric distinguishability）两方面均有提升；但存在一个警示：画像的风格保真度并不必然等同于画像的“自然度”（naturalness）。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，社会学语言学的画像设计是通向更多样、更具代表性用户画像的有前景路径；这些指标在误差归因分析中最具价值，可用于定位保真度失效之处。该工作是迈向使模拟用户更忠实呈现多样且可变语言输出的干预措施的第一步。

title: Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation: On the Equivalence of Distribution Matching Distillation and Drifting Models
summary: Researchers are exploring effective one-step generative model continuously, and, Drifting Models (Deng et al., 2026), demonstrate great potential in one-step generation recently. There are works that reveal the connection between Diffusion & Flow Style Generative Models (DFSGMs) (Ho et al., 2020; Song et al., 2020a;b; Lipman et al., 2022; Liu et al., 2022) and Drifting Models (Li & Zhu, 2026; Lai et al., 2026; Turan et al., 2026). But no one has yet established a precise correspondence between the Drifting Model and the widely used distillation method- Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD/DMD2) (Yin et al., 2024b;a) to the best of our knowledge, even though their optimization objective formulas are virtually identical. In this paper, we prove that by converting the velocity-field / noise-field from the pre-trained DFSGMs into the attraction force field in Drifting Models and estimating the repulsion force field from the generative distribution, training the Drifting Model is naturally equivalent to the Distribution Matching Distillation. With this equivalent concept, we propose an improved method based on DMD from the Drifting Model's perspective- Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation (MBDMD).

AI.tldr: 本文建立了 Drifting Models 与分布匹配蒸馏（DMD/DMD2）之间的精确等价关系，并据此提出改进方法 MBDMD。
AI.motivation: 一步生成模型是研究热点，Drifting Models 近期展现出良好潜力，且已有工作揭示其与扩散/流式生成模型（DFSGMs）的联系。然而，尽管 Drifting Model 与广泛使用的蒸馏方法 DMD/DMD2 的优化目标公式几乎相同，二者之间尚未建立精确对应关系。
AI.method: 作者证明：将预训练 DFSGMs 的速度场/噪声场转换为 Drifting Model 中的吸引力场，并从生成分布估计排斥力场，此时训练 Drifting Model 自然等价于分布匹配蒸馏。基于此等价视角，提出改进方法——多带宽分布匹配蒸馏（MBDMD）。
AI.result: 通过等价性证明，统一了 Drifting Models 与 DMD/DMD2 的理论联系，并由此导出 MBDMD 方法（摘要未给出具体实验数值）。
AI.conclusion: Drifting Model 的训练在特定场转换下等价于分布匹配蒸馏，该等价概念为改进 DMD 提供了新视角，并催生了 MBDMD。

title: Omni-Diffusion-Distill: Few-Step Distillation of Unified Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Unified multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a single architecture for both image generation and multimodal understanding, but their iterative decoding requires tens to hundreds of forward passes. Existing few-step distillation methods largely focus on either image generation or text generation, making it unclear how to compress a fully discrete multimodal dLLM into a single efficient student while preserving both generation and understanding. We introduce Omni-Diffusion-Distill, a unified two-stage distillation framework that retains strong generation and understanding capabilities while substantially reducing the inference cost of a unified multimodal dLLM. Omni-Diffusion-Distill aligns the distillation of both generation and understanding, for both images and text, in the discrete token space. In the first stage, the student is trained to skip decoding steps by replaying cached teacher trajectories, and in the second stage the student is refined on intermediate states along its own rollouts. We further remedy two sources of degradation in unified distillation with a pairwise collision penalty that reduces repetition under parallel text decoding, and entropy-matched guidance that prevents entropy collapse caused by fitting the sharpened teacher distribution in image generation. Omni-Diffusion-Distill achieves state-of-the-art trade-offs between decoding efficiency and generation and understanding performance for multimodal dLLMs, reducing image generation from 128 to 8 decoding steps and multimodal understanding from 512 to 64, giving 18.2x and 21.2x wall-clock speedups. Under these budgets, it scores 0.828 on GenEval and 83.0 on DPG-Bench for text-to-image generation, while reaching GPT judge scores of 20.0 on MM-Vet and 57.2 on COCO captioning (twice the teacher's 28.4 at the same steps) for multimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Omni-Diffusion-Distill 统一两阶段蒸馏框架，将多模态扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的图像生成与多模态理解的迭代解码从 128/512 步压缩至 8/64 步，实现 18.2x 与 21.2x 加速，同时保持甚至超越教师模型性能。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态扩散大语言模型虽以单一架构支持图像生成与多模态理解，但其迭代解码需数十至数百次前向传播，推理成本高昂。现有少步蒸馏方法多仅针对图像或文本生成之一，无法明确如何将完全离散的多模态 dLLM 压缩为单一高效学生模型并同时保留两种能力。
AI.method: Omni-Diffusion-Distill 在离散 token 空间中对图像与文本的生成和理解进行对齐蒸馏，采用两阶段框架：第一阶段通过重放缓存的教师轨迹训练学生跳过解码步骤；第二阶段在学生自身 rollout 的中间状态上精炼。另引入两项修正：成对碰撞惩罚（pairwise collision penalty）以减少并行文本解码中的重复；熵匹配引导（entropy-matched guidance）以防止拟合尖锐化教师分布导致的图像生成熵崩溃。
AI.result: 在多模态 dLLM 上实现解码效率与生成/理解性能的最优权衡：图像生成由 128 步降至 8 步，多模态理解由 512 步降至 64 步，分别获得 18.2x 与 21.2x 墙钟加速。该预算下，文本到图像生成在 GenEval 得 0.828、DPG-Bench 得 83.0；多模态理解在 MM-Vet 的 GPT 评判得 20.0，COCO captioning 得 57.2（相同步数下为教师 28.4 的两倍）。
AI.conclusion: Omni-Diffusion-Distill 首次统一压缩完全离散多模态 dLLM 的生成与理解能力，通过两阶段蒸馏与两项针对性修正，在极大降低推理成本的同时达到 SOTA 性能，验证了统一少步蒸馏在多模态 dLLM 上的可行性与有效性。

title: Region-Aware CLS Token Augmentation for Fine-Grained Image Retrieval
summary: Image retrieval methods often rely on a single global semantic descriptor extracted from an image, e.g., the [CLS] token in vision transformers. However, trying to squeeze all the semantic information of an image into a single descriptor can hurt downstream retrieval performance, especially for fine-grained retrieval tasks. In this work, we augment the semantic tokens in the newer visual transformers, the global [CLS] token and the four register tokens, with a carefully selected collection of spatial tokens, aiming to capture the spatial region representation that characterizes the contents captured in each of the semantic tokens. We leverage the DINOv2-reg model, which includes register tokens that emergently learn object and part-based representations. For each "cue" token ([CLS] and each register token), we find a "buddy" image patch token and extract an N x N patch region to produce a set of localized ROI tokens. Our approach automatically captures important regions of interest without any external bounding boxes or saliency modules, purely by matching semantic tokens with their spatial representation regions. Furthermore, we incorporate these tokens into a multi-vector retrieval framework inspired by ColBERT, enabling fine-grained matching via a per-token alignment mechanism while avoiding the large storage cost of keeping all patch embeddings. Through extensive experiments, we find that (1) register tokens encode useful fine-grained details that can complement the [CLS] token; (2) automatically pooled ROI tokens further improve fine-grained discrimination; and (3) multi-vector retrieval with a small set of tokens improves over a DINOv2-reg single-vector baseline while remaining tractable for large-scale search. The code is available at https://github.com/IdhcbIan/Augmenting_CLS_with_ROI_tokens.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过将DINOv2-reg中的[CLS]与register token与自动匹配的空间patch ROI token结合，并采用类ColBERT多向量检索框架，在细粒度图像检索中提升了性能且存储可控。
AI.motivation: 现有图像检索方法多依赖单一全局语义描述子（如ViT的[CLS] token），将图像全部语义压缩进单一向量会损失信息，尤其在细粒度检索任务中性能受限。
AI.method: 利用包含register token的DINOv2-reg模型；对每个"cue"token（[CLS]与各register token）匹配一个"buddy"图像patch token，并提取N×N patch区域生成局部ROI token；无需外部边界框或显著性模块即可自动捕获ROI；将上述token引入受ColBERT启发的多向量检索框架，通过逐token对齐实现细粒度匹配，同时避免存储全部patch嵌入。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1) register token编码了可补充[CLS]的细粒度细节；(2) 自动池化的ROI token进一步提升细粒度区分能力；(3) 少量token的多向量检索优于DINOv2-reg单向量基线，且在大规模搜索中仍然可行。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义token与空间ROI token的互补增强，并结合多向量检索，可在细粒度图像检索中兼顾性能与可扩展性，为单向量基线提供有效改进方案。

title: Loose Lips: Understanding Privacy Leakage in Agentic Dialogue
summary: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in high-stakes enterprise settings, understanding how they handle sensitive information in agentic dialogue has become critical. Privacy leakage in such settings requires reasoning about whether information flows respect the contextual norms under which they originated. We extend CIMemories to CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE, a benchmark of 4,410 two-agent dialogue instances grounded in Contextual Integrity theory. Using this benchmark, we systematically evaluate 7 open-weight models from the Qwen3 and Llama 3.1 families across conversation lengths of 1 and 6 turns under three prompting conditions. We find that task capability and privacy leakage are fundamentally coupled: more capable models are systematically leakier, with no model in our evaluation able to decouple the two. Thinking models consistently leak more than their non-thinking counterparts, a pattern we attribute to the extended reasoning surface created by chain-of-thought. Leakage compounds with conversation length, rising up to 3x from 1 to 6 turns. Our results suggest that the coupling between task capability and privacy leakage is not an artifact of misconfiguration but a structural feature of current agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于情境完整性理论的对话隐私基准CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE（4,410条双智能体对话），系统评测Qwen3与Llama 3.1共7个开源模型，发现任务能力与隐私泄露存在结构性耦合。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体日益部署于高风险企业场景，其在智能体对话中如何处理敏感信息变得至关重要；判断隐私泄露需要考察信息流动是否遵循其产生时的情境规范。
AI.method: 将CIMemories扩展为CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE，构建4,410条双智能体对话实例，以情境完整性理论为基础；在该基准上系统评测Qwen3与Llama 3.1系列共7个开源权重模型，覆盖1轮与6轮对话长度及三种提示条件。
AI.result: 任务能力与隐私泄露根本性耦合：能力越强的模型泄露越严重，无一模型能解耦二者；思考型模型泄露持续高于非思考型，归因于思维链带来的更长推理暴露面；泄露随对话长度累积，从1轮到6轮最高增至3倍。
AI.conclusion: 任务能力与隐私泄露之间的耦合并非配置失误的产物，而是当前智能体系统的一项结构性特征。

title: PCAsplat: Gaussian Splatting with Local PCA Regularization
summary: Gaussian splatting has emerged as a flexible representation for 3D reconstruction from posed images. However, existing methods are optimized primarily using rasterization-based losses, which supervise a splat only when it contributes to sampled camera rays. Gaussians that are occluded or contribute little to the sampled view therefore receive weak or no geometric gradients and may drift away from the underlying surface, producing undesired floaters. We introduce PCAsplat, a geometry-aware regularization framework for Gaussian splatting based on differentiable local principal component analysis (PCA). Our PCA regularizer acts directly on neighborhoods of Gaussian centers and can therefore update Gaussians that do not contribute to the current training view. We regularize the PCA eigenvalues to encourage Gaussians to move to the underlying surface with isotropic tangent-plane coverage. We also align each Gaussian normal with the PCA-estimated neighborhood normal to enforce consistent orientation. Experiments on DTU, Tanks and Temples, and NeRF Synthetic show that the splats produced by PCAsplat better approximate samples of the reference surface while substantially reducing undesired floaters. These surface-aligned splats enable downstream geometry-processing tasks, including point cloud segmentation, and direct Poisson reconstruction. Additionally, PCAsplat remains competitive under conventional novel view synthesis and mesh extraction tasks. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: PCAsplat 提出基于可微局部主成分分析（PCA）的几何感知正则化框架，通过对高斯中心邻域施加 PCA 特征值与法向一致性约束，更新不参与当前视角渲染的高斯，抑制漂浮物并使高斯贴附于真实表面。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）方法主要依赖基于光栅化的损失进行优化，仅当高斯对采样相机光线有贡献时才被监督。被遮挡或对采样视角贡献很小的高斯因此获得较弱甚至没有几何梯度，容易偏离真实表面形成漂浮物（floaters）。作者希望引入不依赖当前训练视角的几何正则化来纠正这一问题。
AI.method: 提出 PCAsplat：基于可微局部 PCA 的几何感知正则化框架。正则项直接作用于高斯中心邻域，因而能更新对当前训练视角无贡献的高斯。具体包括两方面：(1) 正则化 PCA 特征值，促使高斯移动到真实表面并形成各向同性的切平面覆盖；(2) 将每个高斯的法向与 PCA 估计的邻域法向对齐，以强制法向方向一致。
AI.result: 在 DTU、Tanks and Temples 和 NeRF Synthetic 数据集上的实验表明，PCAsplat 生成的泼溅更接近参考表面的采样，同时显著减少漂浮物。这些表面对齐的泼溅支持下游几何处理任务，包括点云分割和直接泊松重建；同时在新视角合成与网格提取等常规任务上仍保持竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过可微局部 PCA 正则化，PCAsplat 有效解决了高斯泼溅中因视角依赖监督导致的漂浮物与表面偏离问题，生成几何一致、表面对齐的表示，兼顾几何处理与常规渲染任务，代码将开源。

title: Prompts versus Rules: Auditing and Controlling Speech Naturalness Behaviors in Voice User Simulators
comment: Accepted to the UserSim @ NeurIPS 2026 workshop (non-archival)
summary: As voice agents gain more popularity commercially, the user simulators used to evaluate the deployed agents are also being developed to include more realistic, variable, and diverse speech naturalness behaviors -- disfluency, interruption and backchanneling. The quality of the user simulator directly affects the validity of agent evaluation results. However, we find that most studies so far have not examined in detail whether the intended configuration for these behaviors is realized in the simulation. In this study, we audit the realized naturalness behaviors of tau-Voice, our own LLM-based prompting approach across three models, and our rule-based injection algorithm for disfluency, interruption, and backchanneling. We find that prompting for these behaviors is unreliable and produces speech inconsistent with the instructions, placed and distributed less naturally than the instruction implies. In contrast, our rule-based, model-free algorithm produces controllable and diverse naturalness behaviors more aligned with natural speech. Our results suggest that LLMs not purpose-trained for user simulation are not sufficient on their own to represent authentic user behavior, and that linguistically informed deterministic approaches or specialized models are needed to close the gap; auditing and reporting realized naturalness behaviors, rather than configured settings, is what makes that gap visible.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了LLM提示方法（tau-Voice）与规则注入方法在用户模拟器自然度行为（不流畅、打断、反馈语）上的实际表现，发现提示方法不可靠，而规则方法更可控、更贴近真实语音。
AI.motivation: 随着语音智能体商业化普及，用于评估智能体的用户模拟器正被开发得更加真实、多样，加入不流畅、打断和反馈语等自然度行为。用户模拟器质量直接影响智能体评估结果的有效性，但多数研究未细致检验这些行为的预设配置是否真正实现。
AI.method: 审计自身基于LLM提示的方法tau-Voice（跨三个模型）以及基于规则的注入算法，针对不流畅、打断和反馈语三种自然度行为，考察其实际生成行为是否实现预设配置。
AI.result: 提示方法不可靠，生成的语音与指令不一致，其位置和分布的自然程度低于指令预期；相反，基于规则、无模型的算法产生可控且多样的自然度行为，更符合自然语音。
AI.conclusion: 未针对用户模拟专门训练的LLM不足以单独表征真实用户行为，需要语言学驱动的确定性方法或专门模型来弥合差距；审计并报告“实际实现的”自然度行为而非配置设置，才能使这一差距显现。
